chapters.title: Chapter 501 Second Beast Contract
paragraphs: On earth, Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived above the Amazon forest, and it was not difficult for him to find the beast with Mei's help. The thunderbird boasts a massive body adorned with golden feathers, a head resembling that of an eagle, six wings spread across three sections of its body, and two long tails.
However, it appeared to be in a state of hibernation, and there was a lightning field surrounding its body.

"This beast is truly huge, yet no human has noticed its presence in this forest." Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself as he watched the thunderbird, which curled up on the ground under the shade of the trees. "Scan that bird, Mei."
Name: Lei Que
Age: 250+ Years Old
Gender: Male
Race: Thunderbird
Rank: Core Beast
Cultivation: 10-Star Core Realm
Element: Lightning [intermediate stage]
Core: Upper-Rank Lightning Core
Physique: Beast Physique
Strong: lightning and water
Weak: Earth

Zhang Fei [5] looked disappointed after he read Lei Que's status. "A male beast, huh? Initially, I intended to gift this bird to Zhong Yan, but I changed my mind, and I decided to make him my second contract beast."
[Hahaha! You are such a possessive and jealous man, master!]

"No man can stay near my wife, even if they are contract beasts." However, Zhang Fei [5] felt that there was something strange about the beasts on earth, including the thunderbird. "Hey, Mei, have you noticed anything unusual about the lifespan of these beasts? Except for Jie Yuan, all of them are only around 250 years old, and their cultivation stuck at a 10-Star level.

Therefore, I believe the disappearance of Qi from this planet occurred not too long ago, likely within their lifespan. Unfortunately, neither they nor the system have definitive information about it."

[The only way for us to find out about this matter is to meet the cultivators who previously lived on Earth, Master. Unfortunately, this universe is too vast, and there are countless realms within it, so we can only rely on luck to meet them. Perhaps we can find some of them in the Xianjin realm, but that realm is still too far away from your reach.]
Zhang Fei [5] didn't want to think too much about it and slowly landed toward the thunderbird's location, but the lightning surrounding him immediately struck him.
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*

Zhang Fei [5] didn't avoid it and stretched his hand forward, especially since Hong Xinxin often beat Zhang Xiaolong [3] with her lightning, so he wanted to test his body's strength to withstand the lightning.

In an instant, Zhang Fei [5] was electrocuted by that lightning, and it caused him quite a bit of pain. "God damn it! Even though his cultivation is far below that of Hong Xinxin, his lightning still causes immense pain."
[Hahahaha! I told you before that his lightning would not be inferior to Hong Xinxin, so he is the right choice to help you train your lightning body cultivation technique.]
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*

Another lightning strikes towards him again, but he still doesn't avoid it and continues to float down to the ground. However, his arrival makes the thunderbird, which was previously still in hibernation, immediately open his eyes.
Lei Que looked furious as he glared fiercely at Zhang Fei [5], but he immediately summoned Boitata and the other contract beasts out of the beast space, except for Hai Ma, who was an aquatic beast.

Lei Que's beast instincts instantly kicked in as soon as he saw Boitata, and his body shivered uncontrollably as he realized that the dragon serpent was much stronger than him. Even Jie Yuan, Hu Er, Hu Yi, You Bai, and Lan Zhen were significantly stronger than him, particularly after Zhang Fei had taught them the dual cultivation technique and supplied them with his yang qi.

"So, he is the last beast on this planet, Master?" Boitata inquired, gazing at Lei Que with a playful smile on her face. She immediately destroyed the lightning field, causing the thunderbird to tremble even more.

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] immediately transformed into his half-fox form, surprising the thunderbird. "As you can see, I am a beast like you, and I came here because I need you, so I want to make a contract with you. Moreover, you should have realized the power of my bloodline, and I could force you to submit to me easily, but I don't want to do that.

You are the last beast on this planet, and you have no one here. If you are willing to become my contract beast, then I will take you to a much higher realm where you can continue your cultivation there, and you don't have to live alone in this kind of place anymore. If you choose to follow me, I dare to guarantee that you won't regret it, and I will assist you in becoming as strong as they are."

"Hey! Stupid bird! My master didn't lie to you!" Jie Yuan also spoke to the thunderbird, as he seemed doubtful of Zhang Fei [5]. She then pointed at the wind weasel, You Bai. "The two of us used to live on this planet, just like you, but we decided to follow him. Our cultivation has greatly improved since then, so you don't need to doubt him.
Furthermore, we now reside in the middle realms, where the Qi is exceptionally strong, enabling us to cultivate even more quickly."

You Bai swiftly approached Lei Que, aiding Zhang Fei [5] in persuading him. "In fact, I only followed him for three months because my master was his wife, and my cultivation was still the same as yours at that time, but I have already broken through to the soul realm now. Although you are a male beast and you cannot use our method to cultivate, I believe he can still help you become very strong.
That's why you don't need to hesitate anymore and become his contract beast, especially since it will give you many benefits."
Unlike them, Lan Zhen seemed indifferent about the thunderbird, but the two python-tailed tigresses roared at Lei Que several times as if they wanted to convince him to accept Zhang Fei [5]'s offer.

"This foolish bird! They have already told you like that, but you still keep on doubting." Boitata immediately released a bit of her sovereign aura to suppress Lei Que, but Zhang Fei [5] right away slapped her butt really hard. "Ouch!"

"Don't be too conceited." Zhang Fei [5] immediately squatted in front of Lei Qiu and showed him the three beast pills. "These pills are truly precious, and I am the only person who has them in this universe. They will temper your body, increase your talent, and help your beast rank increase. However, I will only give them to those closest to me, so you should think about it seriously.
Whether you want to continue to be lonely and die alone on this planet, or you want to become strong and see the vastness of the universe with us, the choice is in your hands now."

Although Lei Que was doubtful about the effects of the pills, the presence of Boitata and the others convinced him enough that Zhang Fei [5] could help him become strong, leading him to ultimately choose to accept his offer. "All right, I will be your contract beast."
"That's good."

After that, Zhang Fei [5] immediately made a contract with the thunderbird, and a golden bird tattoo appeared on his forehead for a moment before disappearing again, indicating that the contract between them had been established.
Afterwards, Zhang Fei [5] gave the three beast pills, five basic pills, and a Yang Purifying Pill to Lei Que. "You can swallow them later, and I will send you into my beast space together with them."
"Yes, Master." Zhang Fei [5] then sent all the contracted beasts into his beast space.
[Ding]
[The Beast Feature has been upgraded.]

After he had had his fill of having fun with Orith for two whole weeks, and the succubus duchess was also satisfied with it, Zhang Fei [4] decided to talk to her about Balena. "Why do you want that woman? Is it because she's hot? Anyway, she's much stronger than me, so I won't be able to help you defeat her if she attacks you, and she'll probably kill us once you set her free."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei[4] chuckled at that. "I knew that she was strong, but I've been talking to her since the three of you went to the demon emperor city a month and a half ago. Furthermore, I've listened to all her stories, and I know that she killed those demons because they attacked her first. If I were in her position, I would definitely kill them too, so I don't think she's a bad woman."
Orith sighed softly before nodding at Zhang Fei [4]. "You're right, they did attack that woman first, and we captured her because she attacked us first."

"Naturally, she attacked you guys because you were protecting her assaulters, and she wouldn't have done that if the circumstances were different, right?" Orith did not refute Zhang Fei [4]. "Even though she's not as beautiful or sexy as you, she's much prettier and sexier compared to your subordinates.
Moreover, her demon power is truly strong, and it can help my demon rank to reach the duke rank as soon as possible, so I want her by my side."

"All right, you can have that woman." Orith immediately brought Zhang Fei [4] down from the bed and pulled him out of the room without getting dressed. "Even if you think she is a good woman, you must not remove the demon-sealing artifact from her just in case something unexpected happens, and you can control her more easily."

A while later, they had arrived at Balena's prison room, so Zhang Fei [4] immediately removed the blindfold and the ball from her eyes and mouth. The sight of his naked body, especially his lower body, flushed the female demon whale's cheeks. "Orith has agreed to release you at my request, but she won't let me remove the demon-sealing artifact from you, so you must stay in this tower.
Otherwise, the other demons might do bad things to you, especially since you won't be able to use your demon abilities."

"I'm fine with that." Balena immediately agreed with Zhang Fei [4], especially since he had long told her about his plans for her, and she just needed to wait for the right time for him to take her away from the tower.
Balena immediately fell into Zhang Fei's arms after he removed all the chains from her hands and feet, especially considering how many years she had spent chained there.
Even though she was naked, Balena no longer cared about it, especially since Zhang Fei [4] had seen her body too many times in the past month and a half.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately carried Balena in his arms. "Is there an empty room for her, Orith?"

"No need for that." Orith then hugged Zhang Fei [4]'s waist and led him out of the underground. "There is a long sofa in my room, and she will submit to you faster if she often watches us having sex, so bringing her to live with us is the best choice."
Balena raised her eyebrows slightly after hearing that, but she didn't have any other choice because her demon power was still sealed, so she didn't say anything to refute Orith.

'It's okay; you don't have to worry about that. I will never touch you without your permission, and I will immediately send you away somewhere else if the opportunity arises.' Once they arrived at Orith's room, Zhang Fei [4] immediately laid Balena down on the long sofa and gave her two pills without the succubus duchess' knowledge.
'Swallow them; you will recover quickly, and you can move freely later.'
'Thank you.' Balena immediately swallowed the two pills before closing her eyes, especially since it had been too long since she had been able to rest in such a comfortable place.
Orith suddenly approached Zhang Fei [4] and pulled him onto the bed. "Aren't you going to have some fun with her right away?"

"No." Zhang Fei [4] refused with a shake of his head. "I like her, but I'm not interested in having sex with women because of coercion, so I'll wait for her to fall for me first. Instead, I want to have sex with you again, especially since my demon rank is still far from the duke rank."
"Hahaha." Orith laughed in satisfaction and mounted Zhang Fei [4]'s lower body. "Anyway, I just got news that Yhrer has returned to the Incubus tower, and he might come here to see me soon."
"I thought he was dead in the dead forest, but it turns out he's still alive and has returned to this city."
"Are you afraid that he'll steal me away from you?"

"Why should I be afraid of that?" Zhang Fei [4] asked back as he squeezed Orith's breasts. "Moreover, you said yourself that he is weak and can't satisfy you, and you are much more satisfied having sex with me, so I don't need to worry that you will leave me, right?"
Orith smiled and nodded to Zhang Fei [4]. "Don't worry, I will never leave you, and I will kick Yhrer's ass if he dares to come here."

After that, the two quickly engaged in their sexual activities, but Balena was not the least bit disturbed by Orith's moans, especially since she had already fallen into a deep sleep and had a sweet dream.
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]

As soon as the notification appeared, Zhang Fei immediately stopped his cultivation and opened his eyes, only to find the sun had already risen and the women were preparing some food for them. He immediately summoned his two clones out of the training space, especially since they still had to find many long logs and stones to build their residence.

Two hours later, they had finished their breakfast, and Zhang Fei immediately led all the men into the forest again. However, all the women, with the exception of Zhang Chen, Dou Luotian, and Xu Ling'er, decided to join them in order to speed up their work.

However, Zhang Fei prohibited some of them from entering the forest, and instead, he assigned those with the earth element to do other things, such as leveling the land, digging a well, creating waterways, and so on.
To do all that, they naturally needed help from those with the water element, so Zhang Lin, Angela, and some women did not enter the forest.

Zhang Fei assigned the women and contracted beasts with wind elements such as Zefyr, Qing Yi, You Bai, and several of them to transport long logs and rocks to the location that would become their residence. Although their size was quite large, it was not a big problem for them, especially since their wind techniques made their weight much lighter.

When the sun began to set again, Zhang Fei immediately asked them all to rest and continue their work tomorrow, especially since the atmosphere in the forest began to change and some of the women who were not working had prepared dinner for them.
However, Zhang Fei himself did not rest, but instead, he led his two clones to fight the beasts in the deepest area of the forest in order to complete the second daily quest.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 New Feature And Items
paragraphs: [Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the soul realm or above.]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
"Open it, Mei."
[You gained 50.000 female essence.]

Just like yesterday, Zhang Fei's two clones immediately entered the training space after they finished the daily quest, and he casually walked back to his group. "Hey, Mei, what new features have I received after the Beast feature upgrade?"
[Hehehehe! You'll definitely like them, Master. Boitata and the others will gain strength more quickly, and you will find it easier to fight your enemies. Anyway, I'll show them to you now.]
[Beast Feature]
1. Soul Connect II: By using it, the Master can increase his personal power by 75% of the Beast's power, and vice versa.
2. Mind Connect: The Master can see and hear what beasts see and hear, and both can communicate with each other from great distances.

3. Beast Space II: A special space for beasts. If the beasts stay in it, they can recover their qi quickly, and all the wounds they suffered during battle can also heal very quickly. Time flow: 2 times faster. affect their lifespans.
4. Soul Link: Similar to the Soul Connect, the host can borrow the power of all the beasts in the Beast Space. The greater the number of beasts, the higher the power that the host can borrow.

Zhang Fei was satisfied after reading all the features for the beasts, but what interested him most was the new feature, the soul link. "Hahaha! The new feature is really interesting, and there are eight beasts in my beast space now. Moreover, many of them still don't have contract beasts, so I have to find them contract beasts that match their elements.

It doesn't matter if they aren't divine beasts because I can help them, but it would be better if I could find divine beasts for them. Unfortunately, looking for divine beasts is like looking for a needle in the sea, and it will require hard work and a long time to find them.
Although Tianguo is a divine beast, his cultivation level exceeds my current capabilities, making it impossible for me to subdue him at this time."
[Ding]
[The system has been upgraded to level 5.]
[Two new features are now available.]
[The shop system has been upgraded.]
"Oh? It's unusual for the system to take two days to upgrade. What are the two newest features of the system, Mei? Have all the shops been upgraded?"

[The first feature is the Qi Amplifier, which will increase the amount of Yang and Yin Qi you absorb by twofold. The second feature, Soul Resonance, aids in accelerating your soul power during manual or dual soul cultivation while also bolstering your defense against soul technique attacks.]

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "The Qi Amplifier has great benefits if I dual cultivate with them in the training space, especially with the help of the two-times time flow inside. The soul resonance is also the same, but their soul power is still not as strong as Shang Yingyue's. If I bring her in there, my soul power will definitely break through faster, but I won't do such a stupid thing.
Although she is a good woman, she is still a member of the Shang Clan, and our relationship is not very close. Therefore, there is still a possibility that she will betray me for her clan."

[Well, that's true. Human nature is changeable, and many of them don't hesitate to betray their families. Murong Qianying is the daughter-in-law of the Shang Clan, and Shang Huaiqiang is the patriarch of the clan, but she and the others are planning to overthrow him.
Shang Yingyue may be very nice to you and treat you well now, but she might change her mind and turn against you after she finds out about your advantages.]
"Yeah, you're right. That's why I won't do it now, but I might bring her there after I get to know her better."
[As for the shop system, all the shops have been upgraded, and there are many new items now, including beast pills.]
Zhang Fei looked excited after hearing that, especially since he himself could also become stronger if Boitata and the others became strong. "What are those beast pills?"
[I will buy them according to the number of beasts in your side, so you can give them to them directly, master.]
"Yes, you can buy them immediately and also purchase one set for me."
{You got Beast Vitality Pill x15}
{15,000 Lower Grade Beast Core has been deducted from your balance.}
{You got Beast Soul Pill x15}
{7500 Intermediate Grade Beast Core has been deducted from your balance.}
{You got Beast Bloodline Pill x17}
{1,700,000 beast essence has been deducted from your balance.}

"Holy shit! The beast bloodline pill is truly expensive! Each pill costs a hundred thousand beast essences!" Zhang Fei screamed in shock after reading that, especially since the number of beast women on his side was not that many, and their female essence was not that strong either.
As for the beast cores, he didn't think much about it because he would continue hunting beasts, and all his women could help him. "Show me their description, Mei."
[Beast Vitality Pill: A pill that fortifies the vitality of beasts, increasing their endurance, stamina, healing speed, and resilience in battle.]
[Beast Soul Pill: A pill to strengthen the souls of beasts, allowing them to break through soul barriers and evolve into a higher form.]
[Beast Bloodline Pill: A pill to purify the bloodline of beasts, enhancing their essences.]

Zhang Fei's eyes immediately lit up as soon as he read the description of the three pills, and his mind instantly wandered, imagining something. "Hahaha! That naughty serpent's stamina is not as strong as her lustful nature, and the beast vitality pill will help her improve it. Xueyi and Yu'er are not much different from her, so they won't get tired easily when dual cultivating with me."
[Perverted Master!]

"Hehehehe!" Zhang Fei laughed evilly in response to Mei. "The beast soul pill is also beneficial, as it can accelerate their breakthrough in soul power. However, the best is the beast bloodline pill, and I can evolve faster. Anyway, are there any new pills for my human women?"
[There are some new pills for them, such as Yin-Yang Enhance Pill, True Lineage Pill, and some others.] Mei immediately displayed their descriptions.

Zhang Fei was particularly intrigued by the Yin-Yang Enhance Pill after reading its description, as it would double the amount of their Yin and Yang Qi. If they used the pill, their cultivation could increase even faster, but it was not without a drawback because they could only use it once a month.

Moreover, he was the one who benefited the most because he had the Qi amplifier feature, but it was not a big deal to them either, especially since he could share his Qi with them through harem sharing.
As for the True Lineage Pill, Zhang Fei was also interested in it, but he had no intention of using it now because it was related to his future offspring, and he still didn't want to have children.

Before long, Zhang Fei had returned to their campsite, and he immediately summoned the female beasts out of the beast space. He also asked the beast women or those with beast bloodlines, such as Shen Xueyi, Shen Yu, Shen Huang, Shen Xinya, Zhang Yue, Zhang Lingxue, Luo Yu, and Han Xuenai, to gather.

Zhang Fei immediately took out the pills and distributed them to all the beast women. However, he only gave the Beast Bloodline Pill to Zhang Yue and Zhang Lingxue, as they were not beasts and only possessed their bloodlines.
Unlike the other women who were waiting for Zhang Fei's explanation regarding the three pills, Boitata immediately sat cross-legged and swallowed them without the slightest hesitation.
Boitata's behavior caused Zhang Fei to shake his head, and the other women excitedly swallowed the three pills, especially after he explained their effects to them.
Zhang Fei, being a heavenly fox, also swallowed all three pills, which provided significant benefits to him.

A while later, all of them had finished swallowing their pills, and they looked truly satisfied with their effects, but the three pills raised more questions in their minds about Zhang Fei and his secrets. However, his expression made it clear that he was still unwilling to reveal his secrets to them, and he sent all the beasts, except for Boitata, back to the Beast Space.
"Do you have pills for the other sisters, husband?" Zhang Lingxue asked after Shen Huang and Sheng Xinya left them.
{You got Yin-Yang Enhance Pill x1}
{10,000 green jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

After Mei bought the pill, Zhang Fei immediately took it and showed it to them before explaining its effects, making them eager to give it a try. "Unfortunately, we can't use it every time we dual cultivate, and we can only use it once a month, but it's not a big deal for us since we have my training space.
Anyway, you guys can take a rest now because we have to finish building our residence as soon as possible, so we will work harder tomorrow."
After everyone had gone to rest, Zhang Fei went to another area, summoned the thunderbird, and instructed it to swallow the three pills first.
After Lei Que finished swallowing the three pills, Zhang Fei asked him to use his lightning to attack him, which shocked him. "Master, you-"

"All right, you don't have to worry about me. I don't have the lightning element, but I have the lightning body technique, and I need your lightning to practice it." Zhang Fei then gestured toward the distance, specifically toward the Cyanwood Mountain. "See that place? The lightning law strengthens those lightnings, and I'll take you there one day in the future.
That's why I have to increase my body strength as soon as possible, or I won't be able to withstand their attacks, and I will definitely be reduced to ashes."

Lei Que's expression was filled with enthusiasm as he looked towards the Cyanwood Mountain. After all, he was a thunderbird beast, and lightning was his natural element, so he himself also wanted to go there to strengthen himself. He then turned to Zhang Fei and posed the question. "Master, what do you mean by lightning law?"
Zhang Fei immediately opened both of his palms, and two different flames right away appeared on both of them, but Lei Que seemed confused to differentiate between the two.

"The flame on my left palm is my ordinary flame, and I have strengthened the flame on my right palm using the fire law." Zhang Fei then threw both of them toward two large trees not far from them, causing them to explode instantly.

"The fire law enhanced my flame quite significantly, even though it is still in the initial stage, and its explosive power is about two times stronger than the ordinary one. Unfortunately, I don't know anything about the lightning law yet, so I can't teach you about it.
However, we will be able to learn about it after we go to the top of that mountain, but you have to help me to strengthen my body first, and you can use your lightning to attack me."
Even though he had said that, Lei Que still hesitated to attack him, so Zhang Fei immediately took out a dagger before slashing his arm long enough to bleed.

Lei Que was completely shocked by Zhang Fei's actions, but his expression turned to surprise when he saw his wound quickly heal itself. "As you can see, I have rapid healing ability, so you really don't need to worry about me. Moreover, I still have my light element and healing pills, and I can recover much faster if I use them."

In the end, Lei Que agreed to Zhang Fei's wishes, and he attacked him with his lightning directly. However, he did not attack him with his full strength at once; instead, he gradually increased the power of his lightning attacks, causing him to grimace continuously as he endured the pain from each attack.

Although the two of them were quite far away from their campsite, Shen Huang and the other senior cultivators could still hear Zhang Fei's cries of pain, so they decided to check on him. They were completely shocked to see Lei Que continuously attacking him, but none of them moved from their spots to help him, as they could see that he himself wanted the thunderbird beast to attack him.
'This kid is truly insane! He pushed himself too hard by practicing using such extreme methods.'

Since Zhang Fei's clones were connected to him directly, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Zhang Fei [4], who lived in the Wasteland Realm and the Netherworld Realm, also experienced the pain. The situation of the two caused Shang Yaolin, Shang Xinyu, and Orith to worry about them.

Unlike Orith, who had often seen Zhang Xiaolong [3] in pain for no apparent reason, Shang Yaolin and Shang Xinyu were confused by his situation, especially since no one attacked him, but he continued to be in pain. He ended up telling the two women the same story he had told the succubi duchess a while ago, but the two women still couldn't calm down seeing him like that.

Shang Yaolin and Shang Xinyu wanted to invite Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue to check on him, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] insisted on forbidding them from calling the two, and he threatened to secretly leave if they called them.
Shang Yaolin and Shang Xinyu eventually chose to give in to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s prohibition, and they continued to accompany him through his pain, which lasted all night.
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the soul realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]

In the morning, they started their activities to collect materials for the construction of their residence, and Zhang Fei divided them into several groups as before. They were really excited to do everything because they couldn't wait to start their new adventure in the realm, and they could only do so after the construction of their residence was completed.

On the natural races' island, Oliver and the others had arrived at the first town, but the town was not very big due to its remote location, and the majority of the natural races there only had cultivation in the ten mortal realms.

Even so, they met one or two cultivators with cultivation in the quasi-divine realm, but they did not encounter any major problems in that city, and the situation there was very conducive. After all, natural races are known as peace-loving races, and the townspeople treat them kindly and warmly, even though they are new arrivals there.
In the underwater city, Zuhe thoroughly enjoyed exploring the city and made a new friend named Aqua, who shares the same race as her.

Like the previous days, Zhang Fei not only worked to collect materials, but he also cultivated and fought with beasts to complete the daily quests, and he also trained his body with the help of the thunderbird beast. Meanwhile, his other clones also focused on their respective activities by practicing in the training space, having sex, and dual soul cultivating.

Imperceptibly, a week passed quickly. Once they had gathered enough materials, they began building their new residence, first constructing the main house for Zhang Fei and the main members of his harem, before moving on to the construction of the other residences. Zhang Fei [5], who lived on earth, bought many other materials, such as iron, nails, and so on, for the construction of their residence.

chapters.title: Chapter 503 Enter Seclusion Again
paragraphs: On earth.
Huang Rong, Yang Lu'er, Hong Yao, Qiu Mei Fang Chen, and Ren Xia had just landed in Paris to prepare a branch of the Sky Jade Shop in that country.

The fashion designer, Zhou Ling, who was also one of Zhang Fei's sex partners, awaited them at the airport. However, she did not come by herself; she was accompanied by a young woman with shoulder-length pink hair and a pinkish-white formal dress elegantly draped with her slim but tall body, about 6'7".

The woman's appearance is truly flawless, and her face was as beautiful as an unblemished angel that not even words can describe, not containing even the slightest hint of arrogance; instead, she exudes a noble and graceful aura that adds to her charm. She has snowy white skin and a pair of beautiful, calm pink eyes that are as soothing as pink cherry blossoms.

Her pink cherry-colored lips have the luster of a smooth seashell. Her elegant eyebrows are crescent-shaped to match the beautiful pink color of her hair. The light smile that graced her lips was as heartwarming as the smell of incense in a gentle breeze.

"Are they the friends you mentioned to me, Zhou Ling?" The young woman asked in a soft and hypnotic voice as her gentle gaze fell on Huang Rong and the other five women, who were walking out from inside while pulling many suitcases.
Zhou Ling nodded to the woman. "They are the ones, Jiang Yinghua. Huang Rong is one of the leading women in my country, and her influence is second only to a few people, including Wang Zetian."

Jiang Yinghua nodded slightly, but there was a strange glimmer in her eyes when she looked at them. 'At first, I was perplexed as to how Zhou Ling could possess the scent of a demon in her body, but it transpires that she is not alone, particularly as I can also detect the same demon scent from those six women, indicating their connection to a single demon.'

When Huang Rong and the others arrived in front of them, Zhou Ling immediately introduced them to Jiang Yinghua. "She is also a fashion designer like me, but her name is much more famous than mine, and all her designs are very much enjoyed by many people, especially those rich people."
Since she had previously explained to Jiang Yinghua the identities of the six women, Zhou Ling did not introduce them to her. Instead, she led them directly to leave the airport in several cars.

Unknown to them, two old men followed their group flying in the air, but no one could detect or see the two of them. After all, they were the strong cultivators and Zhang Fei's slaves, Pang Gui and Mo Zifeng.
Before they left for the country, Huang Rong had already informed Zhang Fei [5] about their departure plan, so he deliberately picked up his two slaves from the Sky Jade Realm to protect them.

The situation on Earth was not as peaceful as it seemed on the surface, and extraordinary events could suddenly occur there without warning, especially since people from the Tian Realm were eyeing the human realm.

Along the way, Huang Rong and the others kept talking about their preparations for the Sky Jade Soup branch, but Jiang Yinghua kept watching them with many questions in her mind regarding the identity of the demon beside them. 'For now, I will observe them from their side and wait for the demon before making my next move.'

They first went to Huang Rong's house in the country to drop their belongings, but they didn't rest there. Instead, Zhou Ling immediately led them to the building that they had prepared some time ago.
Huang Rong did not forget to contact her trusted people who had already left for the country to begin initial preparations, and she asked them to meet her at the building.

When they arrived there, Huang Rong and the others could see that the building was ready for use with many shelves neatly arranged on the first floor, and the second floor was also given many shelves to store their stock of products. As for the third floor, she wanted to use it as an office, but she and Yang Lu'er would not handle the shop directly.
Instead, she handed over the shop's affairs to Hong Yao, Qiu Mei, Fang Chen, and Ren Xia.

In addition to her plans to put up large-scale advertisements, Huang Rong tasked Zhou Ling to spread the news about their branch store to all her acquaintances, and she did not hesitate to ask for help from Jiang Yinghua, who neither agreed nor refused her requests.

Regarding their stock of goods, Huang Rong didn't have to worry about them, as Zhang Fei [5] had previously told her that he would send them on his own, leaving her only to handle the necessary permits. She also did not need to worry about that, especially since he had already asked Wang Zetian to help him take care of everything by using his influence when he sent them back to earth last time.
After everything was done, Huang Rong and the others went back to her house to rest, but not before calling Zhang Fei [5] to let him know about their preparations.

On the other hand, Zhou Ling went to take care of her personal work as a fashion designer, and she parted ways with Jiang Yinghua, who chose to keep an eye over Huang Rong's house from a distance, especially since she was sure that the demon would soon come to them.
In the Netherworld Realm

Zilvora, the spider demon queen, walked around the succubi tower area with an irritable expression, particularly because she was still angry that Zhang Fei [4] had refused to assist her in rescuing the other demon kings and queens from the dead forest.
She was forced to rescue and send them back to their respective places by herself, and it took her quite a long time since each of them lived in different areas.

Zilvora immediately frowned when she saw two succubi shamelessly having fun with a dog demon, who was none other than Zhou Yun. "Tch! These perverted demons! They are no different from those lustful incubi."

However, Zilvora was shocked when she entered the tower, as all the succubi inside were not wearing clothes. Her expression became even more angry when she heard them discussing Zhang Fei [4]. paragraphs: On a small, uninhabited island in the middle of the ocean, Zhang Fei was already sitting cross-legged in preparation to break through to the Earth Realm. He did not break through immediately and looked at the clear sky above him, as their warning about his breakthrough kept ringing in his mind. 'Do you think I will face lightning tribulation, Mei?'

[That might happen, Master. You may have been a good guy in the past, but the current you is completely different from the old you. Since your transformation into a demon and cultivator, you have committed numerous evil deeds, and your bad karma continues to accumulate as you progress.

Although you have helped many people, you have also caused a tremendous deal of suffering, and the number of people who have died as a direct or indirect result of your actions is simply too many. However, you don't need to worry too much about that, especially since you've been training with Lei Que for the past few weeks, and your body has become more accustomed to lightning strikes.
Besides, you also have your regenerative healing factor, so I'm sure that you'll be fine.]

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. The Earth Realm sits at the middle level of the ten mortal realms, marking a significant turning point in mortal cultivation and the beginning of my true cultivation life. My body, soul, and core must absorb the purest energy from the earth to strengthen and purify them. Mei, I will start now, so you must watch this area to the farthest distance.'
[Leave it to me, master.]

Once he was fully prepared, Zhang Fei immediately released his cultivation soul and four cultivation cores before starting to absorb the energy from the earth. He not only absorbed it into his body but also channeled it into his soul and four cores, causing them to vibrate violently before emitting a faint light that continued to brighten as his absorption accelerated.

On the edge of the island, Shen Xueyi, Shen Yu, Liu Hua, Liu Qingyu, Zhang Lingxue, Ye Lian, and Boitata continued to watch the sky with anxiety filling their hearts, waiting to see whether Zhang Fei's breakthrough to the Earth Realm would trigger a lightning tribulation or not.

To their surprise, something unexpected suddenly happened: Zhang Fei's cultivation soul, which was a combination of his three souls, unexpectedly separated from each other. His human soul immediately closed his eyes and crossed his legs, while his heavenly fox soul stared at the sky with arrogance in his light blue eyes, and his lust demon soul was more nonchalant about his breakthrough.

Soon, Zhang Fei's human soul radiates a strong red aura; his heavenly fox soul radiates a pure white aura; and his lust demon soul radiates a dark and terrifying aura. His fire core gradually glowed redder, his light core glowed whiter, his darkness core glowed blacker, and his wind core glowed greener.
Shen Xueyi arched her eyebrows in response. "This is bad; his breakthrough might arouse the curiosity of the powerful cultivators of this realm, so we should prepare for any eventuality."
"We can't possibly face them with our current cultivation, mother." Shen Yu spoke with a panicked expression.

Liu Qingyu nodded in agreement with that. "Fei'er said that the cultivation of the five emperors has reached the seven divine realms, and their cultivation should already be at 5-Moon Divine Expansion. Since the Xian Kingdom is the closest to our location, Emperor Xian Feng might come here if he senses his breakthrough."

"Even though Feng Yao said that Emperor Xian is a good person, we still have to be careful of him. Our husband is not an ordinary cultivator; his three souls and four cores are outside his body now, and he might attack her after he sees his lust demon and heavenly fox souls." Liu Hua added as she looked at Zhang Fei.

Boitata crossed her arms over her chest and looked away, towards the Xian Kingdom. "No matter what, we must protect our husband, and we will fight against that human emperor if he tries to attack us."
Ye Lian did not say anything, but her sword had already appeared in her left hand, and her right hand was holding its hilt very tightly.

Zhang Lingxue immediately spoke to them. "I will go to our husband's clones first, so I can return to the Sky Jade Realm to pick up Big Sis Yao. If he protects her, I'm sure Emperor Xian Feng won't dare to do anything to her, especially since he is much stronger than her."

After they agreed, Zhang Lingxue rushed back to their residence in that realm, and Zhang Fei's clone immediately sent her back to the Sky Jade Realm. However, Feng Yao refused her request and said that Zhang Fei should be responsible for his own safety, or he would continue to rely on others, and he would never be able to face enemies who were much stronger than Emperor Xian Feng.

Although Zhang Lingxue was disappointed with Feng Yao's decision, she did not force her to go to the Nine Stars Realm. Unlike his wife, Zhang Fei's clone had already guessed that she would not be willing to do that, so he didn't think too much about her rejection.

Instead, he summoned the thunderbird out of his beast space and asked Lei Que to go to the island with his wife, especially since his original body would probably need his help if he were to experience lightning tribulation.

Liu Qingyu and the others also felt disappointed after Zhang Lingxue told them about Feng Yao's rejection, but they didn't say anything about it and continued to wait for Zhang Fei to complete his breakthrough.

Meanwhile, on a palace balcony, a young man with a tall and muscular body stood there while looking into the distance with his senses directed toward that location. However, his appearance was truly unusual, with two large blue horns similar to dragon horns on the sides of his head, and two blue wings similar to dragon wings on his back.

The young man has a quite handsome but serious face, short blue hair, and two fierce eyes with blue pupils. He wore no upper clothes, but his lower body was covered in beast skin, and his hands were covered by a pair of gauntlets.
On the young man's shoulder there was a small blue dragon, and it made a strange roar in his ears.

"Haha." The young man laughed and rubbed the dragon's head. "You're right, Long Hai. That kid is a mythical beast, but he's not a dragon like us. Instead, he's a mythical fox beast, precisely the heavenly fox race. I don't know his reason for coming to this realm, but I can't wait to meet him.

It's a pity that his strength is still too low, so the current him is not my opponent, and you can defeat him easily. However, he is not an ordinary heavenly fox, and he is an anomaly because he has three souls: a human soul, a fox soul, and a demon soul. That's why I believe he will improve much faster than the other living beings, and he might surpass me in the near future.
Once he becomes truly strong, I will invite him to spar with me."
"What are you talking about, husband?" Suddenly, a young woman with a similar appearance to him asked as she walked towards the young man.

The young woman has white hair that falls down to her hips, but her horns are white, the same color as her hair, and her golden eyes make her pretty face even prettier. Her figure is as tall as her husband; she has attractive curves combined with wide hips and prominent buttocks, and a long white dress covered her body, highlighting her flawless body.

Long Huang, the emperor of the Beast Kingdom, immediately turned to his wife and told her about Zhang Fei's presence in their realm. "Baiyun, try examining that kid with your senses, and you will definitely be surprised to see him. Maybe he will become my greatest rival in the future, but he still needs a long time to be able to match me, let alone surpass me."

"Oh?" Long Baiyun looked surprised at her husband's expression when he talked about Zhang Fei, so she immediately spread her senses towards the location. "How can that be, husband? How can he possess three souls and four cores simultaneously? His three souls are the human soul, the fox-beast soul, and the demon soul.
Some cultivators possess dual elements, but I have never met anyone who possesses both light and darkness elements at the same time, especially since the two contradict each other."

"His fox beast soul is clearly a heavenly fox, so it is natural that he has the light element." Long Baiyun raised her eyebrows after Long Huang mentioned the race. "As for his demon soul, I am certain it's a lust demon, as I have encountered that demon race before. I don't know how he can have three souls, but I can see that he is actually a full-fledged human."
"Could it be that he inherited his heavenly fox soul and lust demon soul from someone else?"
Long Huang shook his head in rebuttal. "At first, I had the same thoughts as you, but his three souls are not inheritances; they are his true souls."
"Hmm?" Long Baiyun once again turned toward Zhang Fei's location. "Do you think those people will feel his presence?"

"Haha." Long Huang laughed instead. "I can sense his presence because of his heavenly fox aura, and if it weren't for that, I wouldn't be able to sense him, so I'm sure the others won't be able to sense his presence. However, his location is very close to the Xian Kingdom, so Xian Feng might have sensed his presence by now.
Fortunately, his character is similar to mine, so I'm confident that he won't make a move on him, and instead he will wait for him to approach him."
Long Baiyun nodded in agreement before asking her husband a question. "What if we invite that kid to come to our kingdom?"

"No need." Long Huang then hugged Long Baiyun's waist and led him inside. "We don't need to establish a relationship with him now; let him gain experience outside, as it will be more beneficial for him. I'm sure he has already noticed our existence in this realm, and he will come to us sooner or later. I hope he has become formidable by then, so I can spar with him and fight him with all my might."
Long Baiyun sighed softly as she shook her head. "You really never change, and you always want to fight with opponents stronger than you."

"Hahaha." Long Huang laughed out loud. "I am a dragon, so it is natural that I thirst for battle, right? Moreover, there are not many of them who can match my strength, except for Xian Feng, Xian Lianghua, Huangfu Shou, and Ximen Changtian. Even so, they are still inferior to me, so I hope to find opponents stronger than them, and I believe that kid is the one."
"I know that kid is special, but I feel like your confidence in him is a bit too high.

He's just about to break through to the Earth Realm, so he won't be able to reach your level that quickly, and you'll probably have to wait at least fifty years to fight him." Long Huang didn't say anything in response to his wife's words, instead smiling to himself, leaving Long Baiyun even more perplexed by his confidence.
"Since you have so much confidence in him, I will wait for him to come to our kingdom, and I hope he lives up to your expectations."
"That kid won't live up to my expectations for him, but he'll exceed them."

Above the sky of the Xian Kingdom, a middle-aged man was standing side by side with a middle-aged woman. They wore royal attire, and the aura that radiated from their bodies carried dignity and integrity. The two were the Emperor and the Empress of the kingdom, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang.
As soon as Zhang Fei began his breakthrough, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang immediately noticed his presence, so they right away left their palace to check on him.

"I believe he is the only living being possessing three souls and four cultivation cores." Shi Qingzhuang softly spoke as she continued to watch Zhang Fei with a look of admiration. "However, I am confused as to how he could have a beast soul and a demon soul, even though it is clear that he is an ordinary human like us."

"Wife, he's not the only living creature with more than one soul." Shi Qingzhuang immediately turned to Xian Feng. "There is someone in this realm who has two souls, remember? Unfortunately, his second soul was not a good one; it influenced and transformed him into a complete evil being.
He got his second soul from an inheritance in the Star Tower, so I think that kid might be the same as him, and he also got his two souls from other inheritances."

"I see." Shi Qingzhuang nodded understandingly. "That guy wasn't that evil back then, but he succumbed to the influence of his second soul, which was a demon soul. Do you think that kid will become like him in the future? After all, he also has a demon soul like him, so I think he might also become evil in the future."

"The future of living creatures depends on their respective characters, and I myself am not a fortune teller, so I don't know whether that kid will become evil or not." Xian Feng then looked up at the sky, which was gradually starting to darken. "A lightning tribulation, huh? That kid must have accumulated a lot of bad karma, and the heavens want to test him now."
"Aren't we going to do something about that kid? Since he provoked a lightning tribulation, he should be a bad person, right?"

"Hahaha." Xian Feng laughed at his wife's remarks. "Wife, the lightning tribulation does not determine a person's character; there are various reasons for it to occur. Furthermore, you can see for yourself that the people by his side are not bad people, and they seem to be loyal to him."
Shi Qingzhuang nodded in agreement. "Well, that's true. If I think about it, those women should be his wives, and the rest of them should be their families."

"That's why we don't need to take any action against that kid; we just need to observe his progress for the time being." Xiang Feng suddenly smiled faintly and threw an artifact, which immediately shot towards Zhang Fei's location, and it quickly formed a transparent barrier around the area. "This way, that guy won't be able to sense his presence, and he can break through peacefully.
Since he lives in our territory, I believe he will come to our kingdom sooner or later, and I will invite him to talk later."
*Rumble... Rumble...*

Liu Qingyu and the others became tense as the sky darkened and lightning rumbled repeatedly above, especially since they feared that Zhang Hai would have to undergo the lightning tribulation came true. Unfortunately, they could do nothing to help him, and he had to go through his lightning tribulation by himself.
Unlike them, Zhang Fei didn't look the least bit worried about facing his lightning tribulation, and a faint smile appeared on his face as his body rose into the sky.
[Master, get ready; your lightning tribulation is about to begin, and those lightnings are much stronger than Lei Que's lightning.]
Zhang Fei didn't say anything in response to Mei, but instead, he transformed himself by combining his three forms as one. Additionally, he simultaneously released his human, beast, and demon auras.
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*
Instantly, a lightning bolt shot down from the sky and struck Zhang Fei directly, and his expression was completely filled with pain, causing him to spit out a mouthful of blood from his mouth.

Meanwhile, on a palace balcony, a young man with a tall and muscular body stood there while looking into the distance with his senses directed toward that location.
However, his appearance was truly unusual, with two large blue horns similar to dragon horns on the sides of his head, and two blue wings similar to dragon wings on his back.
The young man has a quite handsome but serious face, short blue hair, and two fierce eyes with blue pupils.
He wore no upper clothes, but his lower body was covered in beast skin, and his hands were covered by a pair of gauntlets.
On the young man's shoulder there was a small blue dragon, and it made a strange roar in his ears.
"Haha." The young man laughed and rubbed the dragon's head.
"You're right, Long Hai.
That kid is a mythical beast, but he's not a dragon like us.
Instead, he's a mythical fox beast, precisely the heavenly fox race.
I don't know his reason for coming to this realm, but I can't wait to meet him.
It's a pity that his strength is still too low, so the current him is not my opponent, and you can defeat him easily.
However, he is not an ordinary heavenly fox, and he is an anomaly because he has three souls: a human soul, a fox soul, and a demon soul.
That's why I believe he will improve much faster than the other living beings, and he might surpass me in the near future.
Once he becomes truly strong, I will invite him to spar with me."
"What are you talking about, husband?" Suddenly, a young woman with a similar appearance to him asked as she walked towards the young man.
The young woman has white hair that falls down to her hips, but her horns are white, the same color as her hair, and her golden eyes make her pretty face even prettier.
Her figure is as tall as her husband; she has attractive curves combined with wide hips and prominent buttocks, and a long white dress covered her body, highlighting her flawless body.
Long Huang, the emperor of the Beast Kingdom, immediately turned to his wife and told her about Zhang Fei's presence in their realm.
"Baiyun, try examining that kid with your senses, and you will definitely be surprised to see him.
Maybe he will become my greatest rival in the future, but he still needs a long time to be able to match me, let alone surpass me."
"Oh?" Long Baiyun looked surprised at her husband's expression when he talked about Zhang Fei, so she immediately spread her senses towards the location.
"How can that be, husband?
How can he possess three souls and four cores simultaneously?
His three souls are the human soul, the fox-beast soul, and the demon soul.
Some cultivators possess dual elements, but I have never met anyone who possesses both light and darkness elements at the same time, especially since the two contradict each other."
"His fox beast soul is clearly a heavenly fox, so it is natural that he has the light element." Long Baiyun raised her eyebrows after Long Huang mentioned the race.
"As for his demon soul, I am certain it's a lust demon, as I have encountered that demon race before.
I don't know how he can have three souls, but I can see that he is actually a full-fledged human."
"Could it be that he inherited his heavenly fox soul and lust demon soul from someone else?"
Long Huang shook his head in rebuttal.
"At first, I had the same thoughts as you, but his three souls are not inheritances; they are his true souls."
"Hmm?" Long Baiyun once again turned toward Zhang Fei's location.
"Do you think those people will feel his presence?"
"Haha." Long Huang laughed instead.
"I can sense his presence because of his heavenly fox aura, and if it weren't for that, I wouldn't be able to sense him, so I'm sure the others won't be able to sense his presence.
However, his location is very close to the Xian Kingdom, so Xian Feng might have sensed his presence by now.
Fortunately, his character is similar to mine, so I'm confident that he won't make a move on him, and instead he will wait for him to approach him."
Long Baiyun nodded in agreement before asking her husband a question.
"What if we invite that kid to come to our kingdom?"
"No need." Long Huang then hugged Long Baiyun's waist and led him inside.
"We don't need to establish a relationship with him now; let him gain experience outside, as it will be more beneficial for him.
I'm sure he has already noticed our existence in this realm, and he will come to us sooner or later.
I hope he has become formidable by then, so I can spar with him and fight him with all my might."
Long Baiyun sighed softly as she shook her head.
"You really never change, and you always want to fight with opponents stronger than you."
"Hahaha." Long Huang laughed out loud.
"I am a dragon, so it is natural that I thirst for battle, right?
Moreover, there are not many of them who can match my strength, except for Xian Feng, Xian Lianghua, Huangfu Shou, and Ximen Changtian.
Even so, they are still inferior to me, so I hope to find opponents stronger than them, and I believe that kid is the one."
"I know that kid is special, but I feel like your confidence in him is a bit too high.

He's just about to break through to the Earth Realm, so he won't be able to reach your level that quickly, and you'll probably have to wait at least fifty years to fight him." Long Huang didn't say anything in response to his wife's words, instead smiling to himself, leaving Long Baiyun even more perplexed by his confidence.
"Since you have so much confidence in him, I will wait for him to come to our kingdom, and I hope he lives up to your expectations."
"That kid won't live up to my expectations for him, but he'll exceed them."
Above the sky of the Xian Kingdom, a middle-aged man was standing side by side with a middle-aged woman.
They wore royal attire, and the aura that radiated from their bodies carried dignity and integrity.
The two were the Emperor and the Empress of the kingdom, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang.
As soon as Zhang Fei began his breakthrough, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang immediately noticed his presence, so they right away left their palace to check on him.
"I believe he is the only living being possessing three souls and four cultivation cores." Shi Qingzhuang softly spoke as she continued to watch Zhang Fei with a look of admiration.
"However, I am confused as to how he could have a beast soul and a demon soul, even though it is clear that he is an ordinary human like us."
"Wife, he's not the only living creature with more than one soul." Shi Qingzhuang immediately turned to Xian Feng.
"There is someone in this realm who has two souls, remember?
Unfortunately, his second soul was not a good one; it influenced and transformed him into a complete evil being.
He got his second soul from an inheritance in the Star Tower, so I think that kid might be the same as him, and he also got his two souls from other inheritances."
"I see." Shi Qingzhuang nodded understandingly.
"That guy wasn't that evil back then, but he succumbed to the influence of his second soul, which was a demon soul.
Do you think that kid will become like him in the future?
After all, he also has a demon soul like him, so I think he might also become evil in the future."

"The future of living creatures depends on their respective characters, and I myself am not a fortune teller, so I don't know whether that kid will become evil or not." Xian Feng then looked up at the sky, which was gradually starting to darken.
"A lightning tribulation, huh?
That kid must have accumulated a lot of bad karma, and the heavens want to test him now."
"Aren't we going to do something about that kid?
Since he provoked a lightning tribulation, he should be a bad person, right?"
"Hahaha." Xian Feng laughed at his wife's remarks.
"Wife, the lightning tribulation does not determine a person's character; there are various reasons for it to occur.
Furthermore, you can see for yourself that the people by his side are not bad people, and they seem to be loyal to him."
Shi Qingzhuang nodded in agreement.
"Well, that's true.
If I think about it, those women should be his wives, and the rest of them should be their families."

"That's why we don't need to take any action against that kid; we just need to observe his progress for the time being." Xiang Feng suddenly smiled faintly and threw an artifact, which immediately shot towards Zhang Fei's location, and it quickly formed a transparent barrier around the area.
"This way, that guy won't be able to sense his presence, and he can break through peacefully.
Since he lives in our territory, I believe he will come to our kingdom sooner or later, and I will invite him to talk later."
*Rumble...
Rumble...*

Liu Qingyu and the others became tense as the sky darkened and lightning rumbled repeatedly above, especially since they feared that Zhang Hai would have to undergo the lightning tribulation came true.
Unfortunately, they could do nothing to help him, and he had to go through his lightning tribulation by himself.
Unlike them, Zhang Fei didn't look the least bit worried about facing his lightning tribulation, and a faint smile appeared on his face as his body rose into the sky.
[Master, get ready; your lightning tribulation is about to begin, and those lightnings are much stronger than Lei Que's lightning.]
Zhang Fei didn't say anything in response to Mei, but instead, he transformed himself by combining his three forms as one.
Additionally, he simultaneously released his human, beast, and demon auras.
*Zap...
Zap...
Zap...*
Instantly, a lightning bolt shot down from the sky and struck Zhang Fei directly, and his expression was completely filled with pain, causing him to spit out a mouthful of blood from his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 509 The Earth Realm III
paragraphs: In the wasteland realm, precisely inside a cave in the eastern region. Zhang Xiaolong [3] was lying on the ground as he endured the pain from the lightning strike his true body had just experienced, and quite a bit of blood was flowing from his mouth. "Damn it! The lightning strike just now is truly painful, and my lightning tribulation seems to have not stopped yet.
Fortunately, Shang Yaolin and Shang Xinyu are still busy with their affairs, so I was able to come to this place to hide."

[Master, it seems you have to face a few more lightning strikes, so you'd better hold on. Moreover, your regenerative healing factor and lightning element instantly heal your wounds, so I'm sure that you can get through it even if their attacks are extremely painful.]

Indeed, the pain in my body gradually subsided due to the combined effects of both. I hope the heavens don't strike me with too much lightning at once, or I'll really die." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then closed his eyes to focus on recovering his body, especially since it would also affect his real body.

In the succubi tower, Orith continued to pay attention to Zhang Fei [4], who was stabilizing his injuries. Although she was not surprised to see him in such pain, she was still curious about the origin of his pain, especially since she did not see anyone or anything injuring him.
"Hey! Orith! What actually happened to this kid? Why is he often in pain for no apparent reason?"

Orith immediately turned to Zilvora, who was still tied up by Zhang Fei [4]'s ropes. "I myself am confused about it, especially since Elion has never been willing to explain to me the truth, and he only told me that his pain was the result of his old injuries."
"Old injuries?" Zilvora looked at Zhang Fei [4] with a puzzled expression. "Where did you actually find this kid? How could he have the same ability as that fake demon emperor?"

Orith shook her head at Zilvora. "Elion came to this city by himself, but he told me that he came from a small demon village in the eastern region. As for his ability, he probably got it after devouring a demon beast."
"Can he really devour a demon beast?"

"I've witnessed him devour demon beasts several times, so it can't be wrong." Orith then looked at Zhang Fei [4] again. "In fact, he has many other abilities, and each of them comes from different demon races."

Zilvora frowned as she stared at Zhang Fei [4] because she had never heard of a demon who could gain the abilities of other demons by devouring them. "Hey, let me go now! You two have kept me here for days!"

"Haha." Orith laughed and refused Zilvora with a shake of her head. "My queen, you've been watching us have sex for days, right? Aren't you interested in having sex with him? Even though we've been having sex for days on end, he's not the least bit tired, and you'll definitely be very satisfied to do it with him."
"Tch! I'm not a shameless lust demon like you!" Despite her words, Zilvora had been tempted to have sex with Zhang Fei for a long time, but her pride as a demon queen prevented her from doing so.
*Knock... Knock...*
"Lady Orith, Lord Yhrer has come here to see you."

Orith frowned upon hearing the report from one of her subordinates. "Tell Yhrer that I do not wish to meet him, and also tell him that I am accompanying Queen Zilvora. If he dares to insist on meeting me, then she will punish him severely, including killing him."

Zilvora was annoyed that Orith used her name to scare Yhrer, but she didn't say anything about it. She was more interested in Zhang Fei [4], and she wanted to find out about his secrets, but she obviously couldn't bother him now. 'If I look closely, this kid is not bad, and he has many abilities.
If his demon rank reaches the king rank, he will definitely surpass me and the others, and he might even reach the emperor rank before us.'

In the Nine Stars Realm, Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] ceased their activities and concentrated on healing their injuries, particularly since the original Zhang Fei still had to face the upcoming lightning attack.
Zhang Chen, who was very worried about her grandson, did not help the others to build their residence, and she just sat among his clones while wiping their sweat.

Zhang Fei himself was still floating high in the sky with his eyes closed, but he continued to channel the lightning he had absorbed from the previous attack into his three souls and four cores to strengthen them, and he did not stop channeling his light element to heal his body.
However, Zhang Fei was not alone there, and the thunderbird was already below him because he had almost lost his balance after being hit by the first lightning attack.

Moreover, Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation would be useful to him, so Lei Que decided to help him by supporting his body. Since he had a high affinity for lightning elements, the thunderbird could see that the heavens were brewing stronger lightning to attack his master. 'What exactly has my master done? Why are the heavens testing him so hard?'

Below them, Boitata and the others were anxiously awaiting the next attack from Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation. They sensed that the upcoming attack would be more powerful than the previous one, and they were genuinely concerned that he might not be able to withstand it.

Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, who were watching Zhang Fei from a distance, also looked tense. Although they still didn't know him, his three souls and four cores were more than enough to convince them that he was not an ordinary cultivator, and it would be a shame if he died because of his lightning tribulation.

An hour had elapsed, yet Zhang Fei's next lightning tribulation had not yet descended. Instead, the lightning in the sky continued to strengthen, and the rumbling became louder, which caused all of them to become even more tense.

Unbeknownst to them, a small beast's figure similar to a cat appeared behind the clouds, but it did not have a real body, and its body was made of lightning as if it were lightning itself. It gazed at Zhang Fei for some time before turning its attention to his lightning tribulation, but it remained motionless and patiently waited for his lightning to descend.
*Zap... Zap... Zap...*

Two hours later, the second lightning finally descended from the sky at full speed before striking and electrocuting Zhang Fei and the thunderbird at the same time, causing both of them to scream in pain.
"Argh!"
*Scree!*
*Splurt*

Immediately, Zhang Fei vomited copious amounts from his mouth, and the lightning's burns turned his entire body black, causing him to collapse onto the thunderbird's back. His five clones also suffered the same, and all of them experienced excruciating pain in their respective places.

Even though he was in so much pain and his consciousness was slowly fading, Zhang Fei tried hard to channel the lightning into his three souls and four cores as quickly as possible, especially since it would be a waste if he fell unconscious before doing so.
[Ding]
[Congratulations! The host's cultivation broke through to 1 Star Earth Realm.]
[Congratulations! The host's Heavenly Body Tempering has been upgraded to level three.]
[Congratulations! The host's Lightning Body Technique has been upgraded to intermediate level.]
Unlike Zhang Fei, the thunderbird did not suffer the slightest injury because of his lightning element, and Lei Que absorbed the lightning into his body to strengthen himself.
Once Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation vanished, the sky brightened once more, and the small lightning beast gazed at him for a while before swiftly leaving the area.

In the distance, Xian Feng and Shi Qinzhuang were also relieved to see that Zhang Fei had successfully survived his lightning tribulation, even though his condition was not that good, and they immediately returned to their palace, waiting for him to come to their kingdom.
After he finished absorbing it, Lei Que brought Zhang Fei to land in front of the seven women, and they were completely panicked seeing their husband's condition.
Zhang Lingxue quickly moved to check on Zhang Fei's condition, and she immediately forced him to swallow some healing pills that he had given her in the past.
"It's okay, I'm still alive, so you guys don't have to worry about me." Zhang Fei immediately returned his three souls and four cores into his body before falling unconscious.
Despite Zhang Fei's words, the seven women's hearts remained unrelieved, and the thunderbird swiftly escorted them to their residence location.

Despite experiencing extreme pain, Zhang Fei's two clones fared better than his original body because the lightning did not directly strike them. One of them immediately sent him and all his wives into the training space. Elmyra, the elf leader, also joined them, allowing him to recover faster due to the difference in time flow.

Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] chose to stay outside and continue building their residence while recovering from their condition, particularly considering the significant amount of time they had previously wasted.

Liu Qingyu, Ru Xue, and Elmyra were treating Zhang Fei with their light elements, and his other wives were standing around the bed while keeping an eye on him. However, they were no longer as tense or panicked as before because his regenerative healing factor continued to work on its own, and his external injuries were gradually healing, causing his burns to slowly disappear.

A few hours later, Zhang Fei's body had returned to normal, but he was still unconscious. Despite this, his condition had stabilized, prompting Liu Qingyu and Ru Xue to immediately withdraw their light qi and exhale in relief. "I didn't expect the second lightning strike to be so powerful, and it was even stronger than when Boitata broke through a few months ago.

Fortunately, our husband has his two body cultivation technique, and he has also been training with Lei Que for the past few weeks. However, what helped him the most was his healing ability, and he would have died if not for that."

Elmyra nodded in agreement with Liu Qingyu. "I don't know where he got his healing ability from, but it's really strong, and it can even operate on its own even when he's unconscious, which helps him preserve his life."

"For now, our husband's condition has completely stabilized, and we just need to wait for him to wake up." Ru Xue added. "Rather than waiting here, I think it would be better if we go back out, and we can help them build our residence."
"How can we get out of this place? Only our husband can open the exit portal, remember?"

"Hahaha! Isn't that easy, Xueyi?" Boitata asked with a laugh. "They are humans, but we are beasts, and we can go in and out of his beast space easily. That's why we just need to get in there, and his clones can hear us, so one of them can take us out."

After that, Boitata immediately entered the beast space and contacted one of Zhang Fei's clones, and the exit portal right away opened in front of them shortly after, so they rushed back to the Nine Stars Realm to help the others.

However, Zhang Yue did not join them, and she preferred to accompany her little brother. Moreover, her ice element was useless to help them, and their numbers were already large enough to continue building their residence.

Zhang Yue immediately lay down beside Zhang Fei, hugged him, and kissed his lips. "Fei'er, I know you want to be strong to protect all of us, but I'm really afraid that something will happen to you if you keep pushing yourself this hard. I hope you can take better care of yourself, or I will be miserable if I lose you."

On Earth, Huang Rong and the six women were already ready in their new shop, and they looked excitedly waiting for the time to arrive. After Zhang Fei [5] sent them items from the Sky Jade Realm a few days ago, all the shelves inside were already filled, and the warehouse on the second floor was also filled with a large amount of stock, allowing them to start opening their shop.

Regarding the advertisements for the new shop and products, Huang Rong didn't need to create new ones; instead, she opted to utilize the same ones that were previously used to promote everything in their country.

Unlike them, Jiang Yinghua curiously looked at each product on the shelves, especially since all of them were not available on Earth and only they had them. 'Where did they get all these items? These items are definitely not demon items, but they are something else, and their effects are also more significant than those available in this realm.
Moreover, the demon still hasn't appeared, even though I've been watching Huang Rong's house for several days, but they suddenly got their stocks.'
*Clang*

Jiang Yinghua immediately turned towards the entrance, and she saw Huang Rong approaching Zhang Fei [5], who had just arrived. She raised her eyebrows as the other six women approached him, and their expressions filled with excitement. 'A human?
At first, I thought their lover was a demon because of the demon scent on their bodies, but he was clearly a human because I couldn't feel any demon scent or aura from his body.'
"Why is your face so pale?" Yang Lu'er inquired as she touched Zhang Fei [5]'s face.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head and pulled Yang Lu'er's hands down. "I just finished doing something strenuous, so my condition isn't at its peak right now. However, you guys don't have to worry about me, and I only need to rest for a few days to fully recover. So, how are the preparations for the opening of our new shop going?
"Everything is ready, and I have also distributed advertisements to several TV stations and news media, so we can open our shop whenever we want."
"That's good! We will open our shop today, and I hope the results will meet our expectations." Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Jiang Yinghua before narrowing his eyes. "Who is that woman?"
"Jiang Yinghua is my friend, and she is also a fashion designer like me." Zhou Ling immediately explained.
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. 'Scan her, Mei.'
[All right.]
Name: Jiang Yinghua
Age: 5000+ Years Old
Gender: Female
Race: Winged Race
Rank: Top Level [Power]
Element: Light [Peak Stage]
Physique: Superior Winged Race
Abilities: angelic form, angelic wings, angelic protection, angelic force manipulation, physics manipulation, healing, purification, demonic slayer, and so on.
Strong: Light
Weak: Darkness

Zhang Fei [5] was not too surprised to read Jiang Yinghua's status, especially since he had already sensed a familiar aura from her. 'As expected, she is indeed a member of the Tian Realm, but I didn't expect her rank to be the Power of the top level. Her strength is on par with the Amaris Twins, but she's still weaker than Orith.'

[Master, this woman is still stronger than the current you, and she is not an ordinary winged race like Chiel, but she has evolved once. Furthermore, her angelic protection prevents your lust demon abilities from affecting her, so you should proceed with caution when dealing with her.
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately walked over to Jiang Yinghua, making Huang Rong and the others think that he was interested in her. 'Can we talk somewhere else, Miss Angel?'
Jiang Yinghua was genuinely shocked when she heard Zhang Fei [5]'s voice in her head, and he was able to recognize her identity despite her disguise.
Jiang Yinghua didn't say anything and followed Zhang Fei [5], who was already making his way to the top floor. 'Who exactly is he? How did he recognize my identity?'

"What is the meaning of your question?" Jiang Yingyua asked with a frown.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at Jiang Yinghua. "Miss, you don't have to pretend to be stupid in front of me; I'm sure you yourself already know about the ambitions of your race members regarding the human realm, right? You don't have to be confused about how I know that because I have heard it from several members of your race, the Throne wants to rule the Diyu Realm.
However, he lacks confidence in defeating the demons, so he plans to shift his target to the human realm, even considering the possibility of targeting the Xian realm."
"Did the Rebel members contact you?" Jiang Yinghua couldn't help but think about that, especially considering their persistent efforts to thwart the Throne and other winged races's plans.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Jiang Yingyua. "Some of them contacted me, but I won't reveal their identities to you, and I just want to know whose side you're on."

"I'm not on anyone's side, and I have my own side." Zhang Fei [5] did not believe Jiang Yinghua's answer. "Apparently, those people didn't give you all the information about us. In fact, there are three parties in our realm, and you already know the other two.

As for my side, we have no interest in invading the other realms, but we also have no interest in stopping the Throne because we don't have the ability to do so, and we are more focused on securing our safety if the war breaks out in four realms."
"So, if you have no interest in invading this human realm, what are you doing here?"
"Shouldn't my reasons be obvious to you?"

Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow for a moment before nodding, especially since he himself used almost the same method by using all his clones. "You are here to monitor their movements, and you will immediately notify your people if the worst happens, so they can immediately make plans to save themselves."
"Yes." Jiang Yinghua did not deny that. "Who exactly are you? You are not an ordinary human, or else the rebels wouldn't have come to you."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately released his light element, surprising the female winged race. "As you can see, I am a human, but I am not an ordinary human, and I am a human cultivator."

Zhang Fei's light element left Jiang Yinghua stunned for a while. "How could this be? According to the records in the heaven's library, cultivators and the others have disappeared from the four realms since ancient times, and many of our ancestors disappeared along with them."

"So, it's true that there are records about cultivators and others in the heaven's library, huh?" Jiang Yinghua nodded to Zhang Fei [5] and shared some information with him. "Do you know the reason for their disappearance from the four realms?"

However, some books mention an extraordinary calamity that occurred in the distant past, nearly destroying the four realms, without specifically mentioning the calamity.
Some of my seniors suspected that their disappearance was related to the calamity, but they couldn't find any evidence to confirm their suspicions."
'Do you have any information about that calamity, Mei?'
[Master, there is no record of the calamity in the system.]
