"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at Jiang Yinghua's question. "To tell you the truth, I was born and grew up in this realm, and I was able to become a cultivator because of my fortunate encounter with someone."

Zhang Fei [5] just smiled in response. "This is our first meeting, and we don't know each other very well, so I can't possibly tell you all my secrets, right? However, I can tell you that I have a good relationship with the demons in the Diyu Realm, and some of them are my women."
"Why do you have a relationship with the demons?"

"You know what? You, the winged race, are the most hypocritical race in this universe. paragraphs: Yhrer looked furious after he returned from the succubi tower, especially after Orith rejected him. If it weren't for the spider queen, I would have dragged that bitch to this tower, and I would have locked her up here for the rest of her life."

"Lord." Yhrer immediately looked at one of his subordinates. "Elion is still in the succubi tower, and Lady Orith might not be willing to see you because of his presence. How about we get rid of him? If he disappears, I'm sure she won't reject you anymore. However, we can only do that after the spider queen leaves, or else she will come to our tower and punish us."
"Do you have any ideas to get rid of that brat without Orith knowing?"

The male demon nodded to Yhrer. "Lord, you have quite a close relationship with Lord Cain, and he has many demon hunters under him, so I think you can ask for help in getting rid of Elion. That way, Lady Orith won't be suspicious of you, and she won't suspect that his subordinates are the ones who help you to get rid of him."
"Cain, huh?" Yhrer murmured softly before vanishing from the sight of his subordinates.
In mere seconds, Yhrer had arrived at the northern mansion and rushed inside, but Cain stopped him before he could get inside.
"What are you doing in my mansion?" Yhrer glanced at Yu Xixuan and Lu Xin with a lustful gaze. "They are my women, so I warn you not to mess with them, or you will suffer the consequences."
'This bastard! He was lucky to get these two women before me.' Yhrer immediately announced his arrival to Cain, causing him to frown. "Can you help me with that?"

"No." Cain's blatant refusal made Yhrer frown. "You may not know it yet, but Elion is my business partner, and he is far more important than you, so I will never help you get rid of him. If you want to get rid of him, you can ask other demons for help, but I can tell you that your plan will end with your death, so you better think it over carefully.
Anyway, I still have important matters to attend to, so I will leave you now."

Without waiting for Yhrer's response, Cain immediately took the two women away, causing the angry incubus lord to become even angrier. "If his father wasn't a demon king, I would have killed him long ago! What does he mean when he says that my efforts will lead to my death? My subordinates told me that that demon brat is only an earl rank demon, so he can't possibly fight a duke rank demon like me.

Tch! That bastard must be boasting about his partner's strength; I don't believe that he's capable of killing me! For now, I need to find someone else who can assist me in getting rid of him. Elijah is my top choice, so I'm going to see him now."
"Master, can Zhang Fei handle Yhrer?"

Cain immediately turned to Lu Xin. "Do you think Yhrer has the ability to do that? Zhang Fei is capable of holding a demon queen, such as Zilvora, in the succubi tower for over a week, and he also possesses the ability to move between realms. Moreover, he also has a good relationship with Lord Arbeola; even my father respects that old demon tree very much, even though he is much stronger than him."
"I see." Lu Xin nodded in understanding. "Anyway, master, we have gathered quite a few demon items for Zhang Fei, but he hasn't yet taken them."

"It's okay, you don't have to think about it, and you can order my subordinates to collect more demon items." After that, Cain informed Zhang Fei [5] about Yhrer, and he also told him that the incubus lord might ask for help from other demons to get rid of him.
"Where have you been, Long'er?" Shang Yaolin immediately asked Zhang Xiaolong [3], who had just arrived in their room.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled, transformed back into his adult form, and immediately led Shang Yaolin to the bathroom to soak in the wooden tub. "I just came from the eastern ocean to look for those precious stones, but I only found a few of them, so I will go there again tomorrow morning to look for more."

"I see." Shang Yaolin nodded in understanding and turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Anyway, my mother will come to this realm to visit me in two weeks, and she will probably stay here for a few days. As for Aunt Xinxin, she's currently in another realm with her mother, so she can't come to this realm to instruct you further on body cultivation."

'Murong Qianying, huh?' It's been almost three months since she returned to the Red Sun Realm, so I should take advantage of her next visit to do something against her.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then replied to Shang Yaolin. "It would be good if your mother came here, so you guys can spend some time together.
I really can't wait to learn more about the body cultivation path, but I can't do anything right now, so I'll wait for Aunt Xinxin to come to this realm again."

"Yes, I miss her too, so I'll ask her to stay with us later." Shang Yaolin then asked. "Are you going to see Sister Yingyue after this? She told me that she'll be returning to our realm for a week, so I think you should make the most of your time with her, especially since you won't be able to dual soul cultivate with her for a week."

"I'll go see Senior Sister Yingyue after this, but I want to have some fun with you first, Big Sis." Shang Yaolin smiled upon hearing that, as he also wanted to have some fun with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Anyway, where's Sister Xinyu? Why didn't she come back with you?"
"Oh! I forgot to tell you about Xinyu; she returned to our realm together with Shang Xiaoyin and the others earlier. She'll only be going home for a few days, and she'll be back in this realm soon.

Since they're not here, we can go to that secret place and cultivate there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] agreed with the idea, but he immediately put it aside and started having fun with Shang Yaolin, who was already falling for him more and more.

After he fully recovered, Zhang Fei immediately brought Zhang Yue out of the training space, and they joined the others to continue the construction of their residence. He then informed his wives and family members about Zhang Yue's desire to hold their wedding ceremony and his decision to marry them all according to custom.
At first, they did not think much of it, but they eventually agreed with Zhang Fei's wishes, and they decided to hold their wedding after their residence was completed.

After he discussed with the others, Zhang Fei decided to pick up quite a number of people from the Sky Jade Realm to speed up the construction of their residence, especially people from the Zhang, Chu, Liu, and Ye Clans. Moreover, Xian Feng also had no intention of disturbing them, and he even protected him when he broke through before, so he dared to make such a decision.

Since there were quite a lot of them, Zhang Fei sent his first and second clones into the training space to start training in sixteen times gravity, and he himself focused on helping the others as he did the two daily quests that appeared every day.

Two weeks later, their residence was finally completed with the construction of the last house, so there were several large houses for all of them to live in now. The area around their houses was surrounded by tall and thick stone walls with a wide moat surrounding the front of the wall, and they also built a large bathhouse divided into two behind their houses.

One large house in the middle was the main residence, where Zhang Fei and all his official wives lived. A simple small house behind the main house was built especially for Zhang Chen. People from the Earth and the Sky Jade Realm also had their own houses, which were located slightly away from the main house.

As for the disciples from the Yin-Yang Pavilion, Zhang Fei built one house especially for them, but it was located a little far away from the other houses, particularly since some of them were too crazy when dual cultivating with their respective partners.
Additionally, he also built several other houses in preparation if he brought other people from the Sky Jade Realm, so they would stay in one area and it would be easier to protect them.

Zhang Fei originally planned to build a building for his new organization near their residence, but Liu Hua said that it would be better if they looked for one in the Xian Kingdom, so they could monitor the situation and gather information more easily by disguising their organization as a shop.

After settling everything, Zhang Fei sent the members of the three clans back to the Sky Jade Realm and used his nine cloud steps to bring Zhang Lin to another location. Meanwhile, his other wives, Zhang Chen, and the others immediately arranged their personal belongings in their new homes.

After some time, Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin arrived near the south gate of the Xian Kingdom, especially since he wanted to check out the situation in the kingdom. As for the other towns and villages, he didn't care much about them because they were too small, and he couldn't find anything interesting there.
"Why did you suddenly bring me here, Big Brother?" Zhang Lin asked while looking at Zhang Fei with a confused look.
Zhang Fei smiled and hugged his little sister's waist. "Happy birthday, Lin. You're 18 now, so you can be my wife. However, we'll start dual cultivating after our wedding, okay?"

"Hehehehe." Zhang Lin laughed happily and hugged Zhang Fei. "I thought you forgot my birthday because you were too busy, Big Brother. I've been looking forward to this day for several years, so I really can't wait to be your wife.
All right, we will get married first before we're starting our dual cultivation, but we will spend our honeymoon for a week without interference from my other sisters, okay?"
"Sure! I will tell them about your wish, so we will be alone for a week." Zhang Fei then took his little sister's hand and led her toward the south gate of the Xian Kingdom.
However, the leader of the gate guards immediately stopped them, and he matched Zhang Fei's face with a painting in his hand, which was a painting of his face.
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly, not expecting Xian Feng to give his painting to the gatekeeper of his kingdom, but he was able to guess his intention.

The leader of the gate guards nodded repeatedly after confirming that the two faces were identical, but he asked Zhang Fei to further confirm his identity. "Young master, did you come from the newly built small village in the southernmost area of this kingdom?"

'Hmm? Xian Feng truly deserves to be an Emperor and a powerful cultivator; he can even monitor me without being detected by the system.' Zhang Fei promptly acknowledged the man with a nod. "Yes, I do come from that village, and I just arrived in this kingdom to look around."

The leader of the gate guards immediately took out a golden plaque before handing it to Zhang Fei. "Young Master, you can take this plaque to the Tianzhu building in the center of the kingdom, and someone will meet you there."

"I see." Zhang Fei immediately accepted the plaque and asked Mei to inspect the building, but a powerful formation blocked her. Even so, he could guess that the person waiting for him was Xian Feng, especially since only he and his wife knew about him. "Thank you, Senior. I will go to that building to meet that person right now."
"Let one of my men lead you there, especially since our kingdom is very big and vast."

Since he wanted to see the areas of the kingdom first, Zhang Fei decided to decline the man's offer, and he brought his little sister into the kingdom. Zhang Lin was nervous because she was aware that the person who invited them was the emperor of the Xian Kingdom, and he was one of the strongest cultivators in the Nine Stars Realm.

After they left, one of the soldiers questioned his leader. "Leader, why does our Emperor give so much attention to that weak young man? He not only forbade us from approaching the new village but also invited him to meet him personally."

"Do you want to die?" The leader of the gate guards asked with narrowed eyes, causing his subordinates to break out in a cold sweat. "As gate guards, we must obey our Emperor's orders without question, or else he will punish us and our families."
"Yes... Yes..."

"Whoah!" Zhang Lin's mouth gaped into a big O shape after they entered the Xian Kingdom because it was simply too vast, and it was several times larger compared to the Heavenly Sword City. Although the buildings inside were still far inferior to those on earth, they were significantly more advanced compared to the buildings in the Sky Jade Realm.

The population of the kingdom was truly numerous, but the roads still felt spacious because they had pedestrian areas on each side of the road like on earth. The residents mostly walked to move from one place to another because Emperor Xian forbade them from flying within the kingdom area, but they could see various types of tame beasts used to pull carriages.
However, not everyone could use beasts in the city, and only those with high status were allowed to use them.

The clothes worn by the residents of the kingdom were made of high-quality fabrics, which could not be found in the Sky Jade Realm. They also used some other materials, such as beast skins, for their clothes.

Based on the conversations of the people around them, they learned that the kingdom was neatly divided into several districts, separating areas for commerce, entertainment, markets, arts, and several others. The Tianzhu building was located in the central area of the kingdom, which is an arts district.

In the center, slightly to the north, a magnificent palace towers high into the sky, and it is built using stones, gold, and many other precious materials. The palace is surrounded by a high fortress that separates it from the other areas inside the kingdom, and there is so much defense equipment on top of the fort, including a transparent barrier.
They could see a special landing area for flying artifacts at the top of the palace, but only emperors and empresses from other kingdoms could land there.
"Big brother! This kingdom is simply too marvelous!" Zhang Lin expressed her admiration. "With this much space, I think we'll need a few days to be able to check all the areas."

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with his little sister. "However, I'm not interested in all the districts, and I'm only interested in the market and commerce districts, so we'll check those two districts first before going to meet that person."
"Eh?" Zhang Lin turned to Zhang Fei in surprise. "Are you really going to let that person wait for us?"

"Feng Yao said that he is a good person, but we still have no relationship with him, at least for now." Zhang Fei immediately led his little sister to the market districts, especially since he wanted to check out the items there. "Moreover, I don't want to bow down to anyone, even if he is the Emperor.
We would be too conspicuous if we went to see him directly, so we will see him after we check out the two districts."

"Whoah!" Zhang Lin's mouth gaped into a big O shape after they entered the Xian Kingdom because it was simply too vast, and it was several times larger compared to the Heavenly Sword City.
Although the buildings inside were still far inferior to those on earth, they were significantly more advanced compared to the buildings in the Sky Jade Realm.
The population of the kingdom was truly numerous, but the roads still felt spacious because they had pedestrian areas on each side of the road like on earth.

The residents mostly walked to move from one place to another because Emperor Xian forbade them from flying within the kingdom area, but they could see various types of tame beasts used to pull carriages.
However, not everyone could use beasts in the city, and only those with high status were allowed to use them.
The clothes worn by the residents of the kingdom were made of high-quality fabrics, which could not be found in the Sky Jade Realm.
They also used some other materials, such as beast skins, for their clothes.

Based on the conversations of the people around them, they learned that the kingdom was neatly divided into several districts, separating areas for commerce, entertainment, markets, arts, and several others.
The Tianzhu building was located in the central area of the kingdom, which is an arts district.
In the center, slightly to the north, a magnificent palace towers high into the sky, and it is built using stones, gold, and many other precious materials.
The palace is surrounded by a high fortress that separates it from the other areas inside the kingdom, and there is so much defense equipment on top of the fort, including a transparent barrier.
They could see a special landing area for flying artifacts at the top of the palace, but only emperors and empresses from other kingdoms could land there.
"Big brother!
This kingdom is simply too marvelous!" Zhang Lin expressed her admiration.
"With this much space, I think we'll need a few days to be able to check all the areas."
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with his little sister.
"However, I'm not interested in all the districts, and I'm only interested in the market and commerce districts, so we'll check those two districts first before going to meet that person."
"Eh?" Zhang Lin turned to Zhang Fei in surprise.
"Are you really going to let that person wait for us?"

"Feng Yao said that he is a good person, but we still have no relationship with him, at least for now." Zhang Fei immediately led his little sister to the market districts, especially since he wanted to check out the items there.
"Moreover, I don't want to bow down to anyone, even if he is the Emperor.
We would be too conspicuous if we went to see him directly, so we will see him after we check out the two districts."

paragraphs: In the Tianzhu building, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang stood side by side on the balcony as they observed Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin using their senses. Behind them, a young man and a young woman stood, exchanging confused glances, their confusion heightened by the two's attitudes.
Based on their facial features, the young man and the young woman were twins, and both of them had handsome and beautiful faces.
The young man has shoulder-length black hair, black eyes, a sharp chin, and a not-so-muscular figure. His inner clothing is white, and his outer clothing is blue.

Under the young woman's beautiful black hair resided a small oval face. Her eyes were big, with a slight hint of blue. Her luscious red lips are quite sexy and tempting. Her white and blue dress perfectly fits her extremely proportional body, which is neither too slender nor too full.
Her D-Cup chest alone is enough to make any man drool, not to mention her jade-like skin, hourglass waist, wide wips, and soft buttocks.

"Husband, he knew that you were the one who invited him, yet he chose to ignore your invitation and kept you waiting, which reminded me of when we were young." Shi Qingzhuang spoke with a soft smile on her face. "Back then, my father also invited you to talk, but you ignored him for most of the day.
Even after you arrived at my clan, you didn't directly meet him, instead choosing to sneak into my room. He was truly furious at that time, and he desperately wanted to kick you out of our clan."
"Hahahaha!" Xian Feng laughed loudly as he hugged his wife's waist. "Perhaps my actions in the past became my karma today, and that kid is my karma."

"Father! Mother! Who exactly is the man you are talking about?" The young woman could no longer hold back her curiosity, especially since her parents still hadn't told her and her brother about Zhang Fei.
The young man also asked them. "Is that man a powerful cultivator, Father? Why did you specifically invite him here? You even asked us to leave our training to meet him."

Xian Feng immediately turned to them. "Xianqin and Xianwu, I don't know his name yet, but I can tell you two that he is not an ordinary cultivator. Actually, I accidentally discovered him when I sensed his breakthrough into the Earth Realm. We witnessed his breakthrough from beginning to end, and he was truly exceptional."
"The Earth Realm?" Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu exchanged confused looks because Zhang Fei's cultivation was too low in their eyes. "What makes him special, Father?"
Xian Feng shook his head at them. "I won't tell you two about it for his safety, especially since that evil guy will hunt him down if news about him leaks to his ears."

"Your father is right." Shi Qingzhuang joined in the conversation because their children seemed annoyed with her husband's secrecy. "Judging from his bone age, he is only 20 years old, but his cultivation has already reached 1-Star Earth Realm. That's why we won't reveal too much about him to anyone, including the two of you."

"Huh?" Shi Qingzhuang's words caused Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu's jaws to drop, especially since it took them over thirty years to reach that stage. "Are you serious about that, Mother? Is he really only 20 years old? How could he reach that stage so quickly?"

"He is a dual cultivator." Both of them immediately looked at Xian Feng with frowns. "It is true that the dual cultivation path can make our cultivation increase faster than normal cultivators like us, but his cultivation speed exceeds the other dual cultivators because of some of his advantages.
However, the current him is still too weak, and he will not be able to protect himself if people know too much about him, so I hope you two keep his presence a secret."
Xian Feng's words made Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu even more curious about Zhang Fei. "Where is he now? The two of us will go see him right now."

"You two will meet him when he arrives here later, so you just need to wait patiently." Xian Feng then looked far away again and monitored Zhang Fei, who had arrived at the market district. "Hmm? Do you think he is also an alchemist, wife?"

"I don't think so." Shi Qingzhuang denied with a shake of her head. "His fire element is indeed strong enough for him to become an alchemist, but he doesn't seem to have any interest in alchemy, and he only seems interested in those herbs. However, I guess that one of those women is an alchemist, and he probably wants to buy those herbs for her. Do you want to help him buy them?
He doesn't seem to have enough coins to buy them."

"No." Xian Feng rejected his wife's idea immediately. "Even though I don't know him yet, I can see that his character is similar to mine, so I'm sure that he won't like it if we help him without having any relationship between us."
Shi Qingzhuang nodded in agreement with her husband, but she immediately called someone and instructed him to begin preparing a small banquet while they waited for Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin to arrive.

On the other hand, Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu kept looking out and spreading their senses toward the market district, but they naturally couldn't find Zhang Fei because Xian Feng hadn't even shared his image with them, so they could only blindly guess about him.

Zhang Fei, who was looking at those herbs, let out a heavy sigh. According to Zhang Lingxue, some of the herbs in the alchemy shop were useful for their cultivation, but their prices were too high, and he did not have the coins to buy them.

Zhang Fei could have used jewels to buy them, but he was still unfamiliar with the situation in the kingdom. Moreover, Feng Yao told him that only cultivators with high status could have jewels, and he was a newcomer, so it was impossible for him to take them out to buy them.

Zhang Fei then took Zhang Lin to leave the shop to go look at other shops, but Mei suddenly reminded him. [Master, there are 38 daily gift packs that you haven't opened yet; do you want me to open them now?]
'Yeah, open them.'
[You gained 150.000 Qi.]
[You gained 350.000 beast essence.]
[You gained 200.000 female essence.]
[You obtained 20,000 bronze coins.]
[You obtained 1,000 silver coins.]
[You obtained 10 gold coins.]
[You obtained 1 Blood Essence Pill.]
[You obtained 1 Sunfire Liquid.]
[You obtained 1 Golden Lotus Paste.]
Despite obtaining a small amount of Qi, female essence, beast essence, and coins, Zhang Fei was still satisfied with them. 'What are the benefits of those three items, Mei?'
[Blood Essence Pill: A pill that boosts the user's strength for a short period, enhancing physical abilities and battle prowess by 20%.]
[Sunfire Liquid: A liquid containing the essence of the sun's fire, boosting the user's fire element techniques by 10%]
[Golden Lotus Paste: A medicinal paste made from the petals of the Golden Lotus, used to treat severe external wounds.]

Zhang Fei nodded slightly after reading the effects of the three. 'The effects of the blood essence pill and the sunfire liquid are not bad, and I can use them if I am in a pinch. As for the golden lotus paste, I think it is useless for me because I have my passive healing ability, and I also still have my light element to speed up my healing, so I will give it to my grandmother later.'

After that, Zhang Fei took Zhang Lin to see some other shops that sold materials for making artifacts, arrays, weapons, and others. Although he couldn't buy any items for now, he at least had a better understanding of the prices and quality of items in the Xian Kingdom, and he was able to draw up plans for his new shop.

After that, they searched the area for an empty building suitable for his new shop but found that all the buildings in the market district were already occupied. They then proceeded to the commerce district to survey the area, only to find that all the buildings in the district were also occupied by vendors.
Seeing Zhang Fei continuing to think seriously about his plans, Zhang Lin immediately spoke to him. "Big brother, why don't we open a restaurant like in the Sky Jade Realm?

I think that would be easier than us having to compete with materials sellers in the market district or finished goods sellers in the commerce district, especially since we don't have materials or items that are good to sell, and the best items you have are those two pills. If we sell our dishes, I'm sure that they will sell much better in this kingdom."

"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Fei then thought again before continuing. "If we wanted to open a restaurant here, then the best choice would be to bring Yan Zhu here, especially since she has often cooked our dishes."
Zhang Lin nodded in agreement with that. "Big Sis Zhu's cooking is really delicious, and I really enjoy eating her dishes, so I'm sure she can help us to develop our restaurant faster."
"I'll meet Yan Zhu later." Zhang Fei then pulled Zhang Lin toward the central area. "Let's go; we'll meet that person now."
A while later, they had arrived at the Tianzhu building, and an old man immediately escorted them to the top floor, where Xian Feng, Shi Qingzhuang, and their two children were waiting for them.

The people in the building were curious about the identities of Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin, but the old man prohibited them from asking any questions. He also instructed them to remain silent, lest Xian Feng punish them.

Xan Feng's two children were surprised as the two walked into their room, and Xian Xianwu stared at Zhang Lin in fascination. Unlike her brother, Xian Xianqin seemed to have no interest in Zhang Fei, and she was more curious about his cultivation speed and strength.
Upon noticing Xian Xianwu, Zhang Fei immediately wrapped an intimate hug around Zhang Lin's waist, causing him to laugh awkwardly and scratch his head.

A slight smirk appeared on Zhang Fei's face in response to Xia Xianwu's awkwardness, but he and Zhang Lin immediately cupped their hands toward Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang. "Please forgive me for keeping you two waiting, Emperor Xian and Empress Shi."
Xian Feng shook his head and pointed at the two chairs in front of them. "Please sit down first, so we can talk in a relaxed situation."

'This Emperor is really a chill person, huh?' They immediately sat down in front of each other, but Zhang Fei glanced at Xian Xianqin before asking Xian Feng a question. "Why did you invite me here, Emperor?"

"For starters, I want to know the names of both of you, and I know for sure that you guys are not residents of this realm, so I want to know your realm of origin." Xian Feng then pointed to his two children. "My son is Xian Xianwu, and my daughter is Xian Xianqin. As you can see, they are twins."

"I see." Zhang Fei then introduced himself and his little sister. "My name is Zhang Fei, and the woman next to me is one of my wives, Zhang Lin. As for our origin realm, we come from the Sky Jade Realm, one of the realms in the lower realms."

Zhang Fei's confession about his relationship stunned Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu, as he introduced Zhang Lin as one of his wives, implying that he had multiple wives. However, they are confused about their relationship because they have the same surname, but they don't interrupt their conversation with their parents.

"Do you guys really come from the lower realms? How can you reach these middle realms when your cultivation is still at the level of the ten mortal realms?" Shi Qingzhuang asked. "Usually, cultivators from the lower realms can only ascend to the middle realms after they reach the seven divine realms, and they will be sent to random realms by the laws of their respective realms."

"Empress, I know that you and the Emperor have been watching us for several weeks, so you two already know more or less about my abilities, right?" Shi Qingzhuang and Xian Feng nodded to Zhang Fei. "I heard about this Nine Stars Realm from one of my acquaintances who came from these middle realms, and she told me quite a lot about the situation in this realm.

Since our cultivation was too slow in our home realm, I decided to bring them to this realm, and I chose to build our residence in your kingdom's territory because she told me that your kingdom is the safest compared to the other four."

"Hahaha!" Xian Feng laughed at Zhang Fei's last sentence. "I don't know the identity of your acquaintance, but she is right that my kingdom is the safest, and the most dangerous is the Huangfu Kingdom, especially since their Emperor is such an evil guy."
Zhang Fei nodded to Xian Feng. "She told me about Emperor Huangfu Shou's character, so I naturally will not bring my wives and family members to live in the Huangfu Kingdom."
"Why did you choose to live so far south?" Shi Qingzhuang asked Zhang Fei again. "Wouldn't it be better if you lived in a city nearby this city?"

"Empress, I have indeed obtained a lot of information about this realm and your Xian Kingdom, but we only arrived here about a month and a half ago. Moreover, our cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms; even your two children can kill us like ants with their current cultivation, so I can't possibly bring them to live in the nearby town.
Additionally, they don't like town life and prefer to live in remote places, and the majority of them like the sea, so I decided to build our residence near the southern ocean."
"Then, what is your plan for coming to the capital?"

Zhang Fei immediately explained to them. "As you have seen before, my family members are very large, and I have to be responsible for all of them, so I plan to open a business. That's why I came to the capital to look for a building, but all of them are already full. Even if there is an empty building, I don't have the coins to rent it, so I thought of preparing another plan for us."
"What kind of business do you want to open?"

"A restaurant." Zhang Fei's answer surprised the four people. "Several of my wives and family members have good cooking skills, and we also have a restaurant in our home realm, so I decided that way."
"How-"

"Please forgive me, Empress, but I have to decline your offer because I don't want to depend on anyone, and we still don't have a good relationship." Zhang Fei then took out a red jewel. "In our home realm, we don't use coins for transactions, and we always use jewels for everything.

However, the situation in this realm is different from there, and my acquaintances told me that only people with high status can have them. If you wanted to help us, I would appreciate it if you could exchange my jewels for coins, so I can find a building here and open our restaurant."

Shin Qingzhuang turned to Xian Feng, who immediately spoke to Zhang Fei. "If you really want it that way, I will help you exchange your jewels for coins. In this realm, 1 red jewel is worth 1,000,000 bronze coins. 1 green jewel is worth 1000 silver coins, and 1 blue jewel is worth 1 gold coin.
As for the building, I have one big empty building, and you can rent it for 1,000,000 bronze coins per month, or you can buy it for 100,000 gold coins."
'100,000 gold coins? Doesn't that mean the building only costs 100,000 blue jewels?' Zhang Fei then asked Xian Feng. "Can I see the building first, Emperor?"
"Sure." Xian Feng then turned to his daughter. "Xianqin, you can show them the building."

"Xianqin, you can show them the building."

paragraphs: "You should stay here, Xianwu."
Xian Xianwu immediately turned to his parents. "Why did you stop me? Don't tell me that you want to bring my sister closer to that man."

"Yes." Xian Feng's blatant answer took Xian Xianwu by surprise. "I do want Xianqin to get closer to Zhang Fei, but I will not force her to have a close relationship with him, and she can make her own decisions in the future. I can see that you have an interest in Zhang Lin, and he doesn't like that, so you shouldn't follow them."

Xian Xianwu rubbed his nose and sat back down. "Father, you are wrong about that; I have no interest in Zhang Lin, and I was only momentarily fascinated by her. Furthermore, I already have Yao Yin in my life, so I have no intention of pursuing other women."
"Speaking of Yao Yin, I haven't seen her in a while; is she still busy in the sect now?"

"Yes, Mother." Xian Xianwu nodded to Shi Qingzhuang. "Yao Yin has yet to break through to the quasi-divine realm, and she is disappointed with herself, so she locked herself in her cultivation cave to focus on her breakthrough."

Shi Qingzhuang nodded in understanding. "Yao Yin's talent is not exceptional, and her cultivation is significantly slower than that of her sisters and brothers, yet her character is much better than theirs. She wholeheartedly loves you, so I hope you won't disappoint her. How about you marry her after she breaks through to the quasi-divine realm?
You guys have been together for decades, and we've been wanting grandchildren for a long time, but you two have always delayed your marriage for the sake of your cultivation."

"Honestly, I wanted to formalize our relationship as soon as possible, but she asked me to wait for her cultivation to break through to the quasi-divine realm first." Xian Xingwu released a heavy sigh before continuing. "Unfortunately, she failed to reach that stage for many years, causing delays in our marriage.
However, I'm sure that she will break through to that stage soon, so you can start preparing for our wedding then."

"I will meet Brother Yao and Sister Mu later, and we will arrange your marriage with Yao Yin after she successfully breaks through." Shi Qingzhuang then turned to her husband. "Do you think Zhang Fei will bring them to join the sects in our realms?"

Xian Feng shook his head immediately. "They are dual cultivators, and the only dual cultivation sect is located in the Huangfu Kingdom. He already knows about the dire situation in the Huangfu Kingdom, so I don't think he will bring them there. Even so, he can still bring them to other sects, such as our Xian Imperial Sect.

Unfortunately, their cultivation is still below the heaven realm, and they may feel oppressed there. His other option is to allow them to join minor sects, where they can gain experience until their cultivation reaches the heaven realm."

"Why don't we try to invite Zhang Fei to join our sect?" Xian Feng turned to his wife with a raised eyebrow. "We've seen his soul cultivation before, and his soul power has already reached the half-perfection stage of the soul core. Even though our son's cultivation has reached the quasi-divine realm, his soul power is still at the earthly soul level.
That's why I'm sure that he's not only a dual cultivator, but he's also a soul cultivator, so joining our sect is a good opportunity for him."

"Eh?" Xian Xinwu gasped in shock after hearing his mother's words. "Has Zhang Fei's soul power really reached the half-perfection stage of the soul core, Mother? Didn't he come from the lower realms? How did he cultivate his soul so quickly? Moreover, he is only 20 years old, and his cultivation has just broken through to the Earth Realm, but his soul power is already that high."
"That's why we told you two that Zhang Fei is an exceptional cultivator.

Two weeks ago, he faced two lightning tribulations during his breakthrough to the Earth Realm, and his condition was really bad at that time." Xian Feng's answer caused Xian Xianwu's eyes to widen and his mouth to gape, especially since he himself knew that lightning tribulations were extremely terrifying, and he had seen cultivators die from them many times.

"At first, we thought that he would die, but he managed to survive, and he was even able to recover in two weeks despite his severe injuries, which means that he had also trained his body as a body cultivator."
"Even though it's faint, I can also feel the sword energy within Zhang Fei's body, so it's likely that he's also learned the sword path." Shi Qingzhuang added to her husband's words.

Xian Xianwu was completely shocked after hearing that, especially since threading his path on one path of cultivation was already too difficult for him, yet he now heard of someone threading his path on four different paths of cultivation at the same time. "If Zhang Fei is that skilled, it means he has extraordinary talent, so I agree with my mother if you invite him to join our sect, Father."

"I will discuss this matter with him first, but I won't force him to join our sect." Xian Feng then contacted his minister and ordered him to bring enough bronze, silver, and gold coins. Besides, he also asked him to bring the documents of the building, especially since he was sure Zhang Fei would like it.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei leisurely walked behind Xian Xianqin and Zhang Lin, who seemed to be having a good time talking to each other. After all, both of them were women, and the princess of the Xian kingdom was not a haughty woman despite her high status, so they were able to get closer faster.

Their closeness raised many questions in the minds of those who passed by them, especially since Zhang Lin was still wearing clothes from the Sky Jade Realm, and the materials were not as good as those in the Nine Stars Realm.
The situation in all realms was basically the same, and there were so many people who always looked at others only by their clothes, so they felt that she was not worthy to be close to Xian Xianqin.

Nevertheless, no one dared to comment on their closeness, but they kept glancing at Zhang Lin with disgust and condescension. Likewise when they saw Zhang Fei, but he didn't care about their glances one bit, and he enjoyed his time while looking at the goods in every shop they passed.
Zhang Fei abruptly stopped walking when he spotted an item inside a shop, and he sensed a strong water element emanating from it. "Lin'er, come here."

The two women immediately stopped walking and approached Zhang Fei, who pointed to a bracelet. Zhang Lin's eyes lit up when she saw the bracelet with a shape similar to a dragon, but her expression changed after she saw the price because it was too expensive at one hundred million bronze coins, and they didn't have that many coins yet.

"That bracelet is a boost and protection artifact, the sea dragon bracelet, and its grade is heaven grade." Zhang Lin immediately turned to Xian Xianqi. "According to the story, it is imbued with the power of a sea dragon, which can increase the attack power of water techniques.

Besides, it will automatically generate a water shield if the user is attacked, but it can only withstand attacks from cultivators with maximum cultivation in the heaven realm, so it will be useless against attacks from cultivators with cultivation above that realm."

Zhang Lin nodded in understanding and looked at the sea dragon bracelet again, but she immediately grabbed Zhang Fei's hand and took him away. "Forget it, brother. The bracelet is nice, but it's too expensive, so we better focus on opening our restaurant first."

Zhang Fei didn't say anything to answer his little sister, but he directly spoke to Xian Xianqi through telepathy. 'Princess, please help me book the bracelet so I can buy it after I talk to your parents again.'
After hearing that, Xian Xianqi immediately entered the shop and talked to the owner about the sea dragon bracelet, and after that, she then led them to the building owned by her father.

Soon, they reached the building, but Zhang Fei was taken aback by its strategic road location and its spacious two-story design. Moreover, it still had a garden at the back, so he thought that one hundred thousand gold coins was simply too cheap. "Princess, is this building really only worth one hundred thousand gold coins?"

"My father decides the prices of the buildings in this kingdom, and he has already given you that price, so you don't need to refuse him." Xian Xianqi then asked. "Are you interested in this building? If you are interested in buying it, then we can go back to my father now, so he can order people to prepare the documents."
Zhang Fei didn't want to owe a favor to Xian Feng, but he decided to accept it. "Yes, I will buy this building, and I will open my restaurant in a few days."
"Let's go back then." Xian Xianqi immediately led them away.

However, Zhang Lin immediately pulled Zhang Fei to her side and whispered to him. 'Are you interested in Princess Xianqi, Big Brother? She doesn't seem to like you, and her dislike of you is probably because you are a dual cultivator.'

Zhang Fei smiled faintly as he looked at Xian Xianqi's back. 'She's quite pretty and attractive, but I haven't thought about approaching her yet. For now, I just want to start our restaurant in this kingdom as soon as possible, especially since there are so many valuable items here, so I want to buy them to increase our cultivation faster.'
'Hehe.' Zhang Lin giggled and whispered again. 'If you use your demon charm or demon pheromone on him, I'm sure Princess Xianqi will fall for you right away.'

After they returned to the Tianzhu building, Zhang Fei immediately agreed to the price given by Xian Feng earlier and paid it with one hundred thousand blue jewels. In addition, he also exchanged ten thousand red jewels, a thousand green jewels, and five hundred blue jewels for coins.
Zhang Fei could exchange more than that, but he still needed jewels to purchase items in the shop system, and he didn't want to draw too much attention to himself.
After everything was settled, Xian Feng immediately asked Zhang Fei. "Do you guys have plans to join sects?"

"I intend to join a sect in this realm, but the Moonlight Pavilion is located in the Huangfu Kingdom, so I'm still thinking about whether I will join there or not." Zhang Fei then turned to Zhang Lin for a moment before continuing. "As for Lin'er and the others, their cultivation is insufficient to join the major sects, as the minimum requirement is the Heaven Realm.
Therefore, I will let them stay in our residence and train in the nearby forest."
"Did you also study the soul cultivation path, the body cultivation path, and the sword cultivation path?"
Xian Xiaqin immediately turned to Zhang Fei in shock, especially since she was previously with him and Zhang Lin, so she had just found out about this matter.

Zhang Fei was not surprised when Shi Qingzhuang inquired about his status as a soul and body cultivator, but he was taken aback by her inquiry about his status as a sword cultivator. "Empress, I did study the three paths of cultivation, but I didn't focus on the sword cultivation path, and I learned it from some of my wives who were sword cultivators."
"I see." Shi Qingzhuang nodded in understanding before turning to her husband.

Xian Feng immediately stood up and moved away from the table. "Zhang Fei, I am curious about your raw strength, so I hope you are willing to show it to me, and you can attack me with all your strength."
"All right." Zhang Fei immediately stood in front of Xian Feng and channeled all his strength into his right fist. "Get ready, Emperor."
"Attack me on the stomach now."
*Bam*
Zhang Fei's single punch instantly pushed Xian Feng back several steps, and his expression showed some pain.
Unlike their parents, who had more or less expected the power of Zhang Fei's attack, Xian Xianqi and Xian Xianwu looked at him in amazement and shock at the same time.

Although he did not use anything to protect him, Xian Feng was still a cultivator with cultivation in the seven divine realms, and Zhang Fei's cultivation was only in the earth realm, so the difference between them was like heaven and earth, yet his punch still forced him back several steps. "Damn! Your punch is truly strong and hard!

According to my calculations, the power of your attack is already equivalent to a cultivator at the cultivation level of the sovereign realm or even the saint realm. If you punch a cultivator who is at your level or below you, I'm sure they will immediately die on the spot."

'My attack power multiplied quite a lot after both of my body techniques broke through to the next stage.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered before replying to Xian Feng. "To be honest, I myself am not sure about the strength of my attack, Emperor. However, I have a master in the body cultivation path, and she repeatedly beats me mercilessly with all her strength.
She even uses her lightning element whenever she beats me, and her attacks always cause me pain."

"Lightning? Does that mean you're studying a body technique related to lightning?" Zhang Fei nodded at Xian Feng, which made him realize something. "Don't tell me that your other reason for coming to this realm is to train in the Cyanwood Mountain, especially since the lightning element there is the strongest among the realms I've been to before."

"You are right, Emperor. My master told me about the Cyanwood Mountain, and she asked me to practice my body cultivation technique there." Zhang Fei's answer shocked them once again, and they thought that his master was truly insane by asking him to train on that mountain.

"I will not be going there anytime soon because my current body strength will not be able to withstand the lightning attacks strengthened by the lightning law, and I will die into ashes if I get hit by one attack."

Xian Feng took a deep breath after hearing that, and he immediately patted Zhang Fei's shoulder. "That's good! We cultivate to become strong in order to protect those closest to us, but we must know when to retreat and when to advance, and we must always be aware of our limits.

The current you is much stronger than other cultivators at your level, but the lightning in the Cyanwood Mountain is on a different level. If you want to go there to train, I suggest you wait until your cultivation breaks through to the heaven realm first. Anyway, what's your master's name? I don't understand her mindset, and she was truly reckless by asking you to train on that mountain."
"Thank you for your advice, Emperor. However, my master forbade me from revealing her identity to anyone, but she came from one of the planets of these middle realms."

Xian Feng was disappointed by Zhang Fei's response, but instead of probing further, he asked another question. "Are you interested in joining our Xian Imperial Sect? Our sect is not a dual cultivation sect, but our sect is more general, and you can learn many things there, including soul and body cultivation paths."

Zhang Fei fell into deep thought after hearing Xian Feng's offer, but he was much more interested in joining the dual cultivation sect, especially since he needed more Yin Qi after his cultivation broke through to the Earth Realm. Additionally, he also needed female and beast essences for his two other forms, but he couldn't possibly use his demon or beast forms in the Xian Imperial Sect.
"Let me think about your offer first, Emperor."
"All right, you can think about it first, and you can contact me directly if you decide to join our sect." Xian Feng then gave a plaque to Zhang Fei, which was the plaque of his sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 514 Leviathan's Tear
paragraphs: After they finished talking with Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, Zhang Fei immediately took Zhang Lin to leave the Tianzhu building, but Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu hurriedly followed them.
"Why did you two follow us, Prince and Princess?"

Xian Xianwu answered Zhang Fei first. "I was curious about how you train your body cultivation and soul cultivation, so I hope to see you train. Anyway, I want to apologize for my previous behavior. I was simply fascinated by Zhang Lin, but I had no desire to approach her or do anything else."

'This guy is not bad, and his character is similar to his father.' Zhang Fei muttered in his heart after he used his demon eyes to examine Xian Xianwu's soul for a brief moment. "It's okay; you don't need to mention it anymore, Prince. Then, what about you, princess?"
"I still want to talk to your wife, and I haven't been to other areas for a long time, so I want to see your residence." Xian Xianqin hurriedly hugged Zhang Lin's arm and led her to the south gate.

"You can follow them first, Prince. I want to buy the sea dragon bracelet first." Xian Xianwu immediately followed Xian Xianqin and Zhang Lin to the south gate, and Zhang Fei went to the previous shop to buy the bracelet.
When he arrived there, Zhang Fei immediately went to the shop owner to pay for the sea dragon, but a man suddenly snatched it from the owner's hand, causing him to frown.

The owner immediately stopped Zhang Fei when he tried to talk to the man. 'Young master, he is Prince Huangfu Lian, and Emperor Huangfu is a sadistic man. He does not hesitate to do anything to anyone who dares to oppose his royal family, so you should not find trouble with him.'
'Huangfu Lian, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered in his heart as he read the prince status after Mei displayed it for him, and his cultivation was in the quasi-divine realm like the Xian siblings.

"Hey, Owner! I want this bracelet for my fiancée, and you can send someone to collect the cost from my father." Huangfu Lian glanced at Zhang Fei for a moment before snorting coldly and leaving the shop.
"Are you just going to let him go like that, Uncle?"

The shop owner let out a heavy sigh in response. "Young master, I dare not do anything to Prince Huangfu, let alone collect the cost of the bracelet from his father. Emperor Xian has always protected us, but Emperor Huangfu has many methods to eliminate us without leaving a trace.

Back then, some merchants went to Huangfu Kingdom to collect the items brought by Prince Huangfu, but they never returned, and their families disappeared overnight. The bracelet is indeed expensive, but it is not worth the lives of me and my family, so I would rather let it go.
Anyway, if you are interested in a water element artifact, I still have one item that has a better effect than the sea dragon bracelet, and your wife might like it."
"Can I see it first, Uncle?"
"Wait here for a moment; I'll get it for you."

While waiting for the owner, Zhang Fei kept a close eye on Huang Lian's movements using his map, and he discovered him in another shop with two women, Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying. 'Those two women must be his women, right? Since that bastard dared to snatch the sea dragon bracelet from me, I will snatch them from him sooner or later.'
[Hahaha! Somehow I feel sorry for those two women, especially since they don't know anything, but you want to involve them in your affair with Huangfu Lian, Master.]
'As long as I can teach that bastard a lesson, I will use any means to do so.' Zhang Fei then looked at the shop owner, who walked out with a blue box. "What is that item, Uncle?"

"Hahaha! This is my best water element artifact." The shop owner immediately opened the box, revealing a small blue orb resembling a tear inside. "I got this heaven-grade Leviathan's Tear from a merchant in another realm, and its effects are more or less similar to the sea dragon bracelet.
However, it has another effect that allows the user to control and command aquatic beasts, so I'm sure your wife will like it."
"How much is it, Uncle?"
"One hundred and twenty million bronze coins."

"I will buy this Leviathan's Tear for my wife, Uncle." Zhang Fei decided without hesitation and paid for it all at once before hurriedly storing it in his inventory. "Uncle, I still need artifacts for other elements, and I will open a restaurant in this kingdom soon, so I hope you can meet me there if you have them."
"Are you planning to open your restaurant in Emperor Xian's private building?"

Zhang Fei nodded at the shop owner. "I've bought the building from Emperor Xian, Uncle. I'll open my restaurant in a few days, and you can come as my special guest during the opening. You won't be able to find dishes like ours in this realm, so I'm sure you'll like them. Anyway, my name is Zhang Fei, and I'm a newcomer to this realm."

"A newcomer, huh?" The shop owner muttered and nodded. "You can call me Old Man Duan; my name is Duan Lingtian. Once I get other artifacts, I will definitely contact you at your restaurant, and I will come there to taste your dishes."
"All right, I will wait for your arrival on opening day, Old Duan."

Duan Lingtian continued to look at Zhang Fei, who was walking away from the shop. "I don't know how he can have a relationship with the royal family even though he is a newcomer, but this is the first time I have met someone who walks on four different cultivation paths at once.

Moreover, a dual cultivator usually doesn't care much about other paths, but I can see that his experiences in the other three paths are quite significant, especially the body and soul cultivation paths. As for his experiences in the sword cultivation path, it's still too minimal, but it can still be developed if that old guy is willing to train him in that path.
Unfortunately, his cultivation is still in the 1-Star Earth Realm, so he can't join the Xian Imperial Sect to meet him."

As he was on his way to the south gate, Zhang Fei once again met Huangfu Lian. He ignored the prince and walked away from them, but he did not forget to use his demon charm on the two women by the prince's side. 'Both women are not pretty at all, and their bodies are not special either, but I will still use them to destroy that bastard.'
As soon as Zhang Fei's demon charm took effect, the two women's hearts began to pound, but they dared not look for him, especially since Huangfu Lian would punish them if he discovered their actions.

Before long, Zhang Fei had arrived outside the south gate, where Zhang Lin and the Xian siblings were waiting for him. He then gave the box containing the Leviathan's Tear to his little sister. "It's your birthday present."

Zhang Lin eagerly opened the box, but her first reaction was looking at her big brother, as the item was not the sea dragon bracelet. Xian Xianqin also looked at Zhang Fei in confusion, particularly since he had previously asked her to book the bracelet but he purchased another item instead.
Zhang Fei immediately explained to them that Huangfu Lian snatched the sea dragon bracelet from him, and the prince was much stronger than him, so he decided to buy another item.
"That bastard! He always does as he pleases! I'll contact my father now, so he can help you get the bracelet back."

"No need." Zhang Fei immediately stopped Xian Xianqin. "I may not be able to defeat him right now, but I am confident that I will defeat him in the future, and I will take the bracelet back by myself. Moreover, this Leviathan's Tear has a similar effect to the bracelet, but it has another effect of controlling aquatic beasts, so this is much better.
Anyway, you just need to drip your blood on it, and it will be yours, Lin'er."

"Thank you, Big Brother." Zhang Lin immediately bit her thumb and dripped some of her blood onto the Leviathan's tears, causing it to glow blue for a while before entering her forehead, forming a tear symbol on her forehead. She then stretched her palm forward and used her water element to create a small whirlpool, and it became stronger by about 20%. "Hehe! I really like the effect!
I will try its other effects once we return to our residence."
"How about we use my flying artifact? We can get there faster."
"No need, Prince." Zhang Fei immediately enveloped them all with his aura before taking them away from the place using his Nine Cloud Steps.

After arriving not far from their residence, the Xian brothers and sisters experienced immediate shock. After all, the distance between their kingdom and the southern area was quite far, requiring them to use a flying artifact for at least two days.
However, Zhang Fei, with his cultivation still in the Earth Realm, could transport them there in just a few minutes, demonstrating that his speed had already surpassed even their father's.

"You guys don't need to be confused like that because I am a body cultivator. I have been practicing using heavy methods for a very long time, which has not only increased my body strength but also my speed. Zhang Fei then led Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu into their residence, and he introduced them to all his wives, partners, and family members.

Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu were completely shocked to learn that Zhang Fei had dozens of official wives and partners, and they finally understood why his cultivation speed was able to surpass that of other dual cultivators. However, they are also amazed at their relationship, especially since they all live harmoniously in one place, and they are truly proud to be his women.

Shen Xueyi and the others were also shocked by the presence of Xian Xianqi and Xian Xianwu, especially since Zhang Fei had only been to the capital for a day, but he had already established relationships with their prince and princess.
Zhang Fei then turned to Xian Xianwu. "You want to see me practice my body cultivation path, right, prince? I will show it to you now, but you may not be used to seeing my training methods."
"It's okay; I'm accustomed to seeing my seniors train using harsh methods, so I have no problem with that."
"Let's go then." Zhang Fei immediately led Xian Xianwu to the back area of their residence, but he certainly would not show his training space to strangers like him.
Xian Xianqin decided to follow them because she was curious about Zhang Fei's method of body training. She brought Zhang Lin along so she could watch him practice while conversing with her.

Zhang Fei took off his top as soon as they arrived, leaving Xian Xianqin in awe of his naked torso, especially since his body, including his six abs, was already perfectly formed. 'This kid! I think he's the only dual cultivator who has such a strong body! It's no surprise that he has so many wives and partners!'

Even Xian Xianwu was also amazed to see Zhang Fei, and he laughed wryly after comparing his own body with his. 'His body is not inferior to my father, but he is still much younger than him, so he can still improve his body strength.'

Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin were surprised when Zhang Fei summoned the thunderbird, but they could immediately guess his training method. As they expected, Lei Que immediately attacked his master using his full lightning power, and his lightning was quite strong for a beast of his level.
Even so, Zhang Fei no longer felt the pain he used to, especially after he was struck twice by lightning from his lightning tribulation, which was much stronger than Lei Que's lightning.

Watching Zhang Fei train, Xian Xianwu kept clenching his fists tightly as his spirit boiled. For decades, he felt that he had trained so hard, but his efforts so far were still incomparable to his. 'This guy is truly insane! I don't know whether I can afford to use such extreme methods to train my body or not.'
'Hey, Lin'er. Does he always train using such rigorous methods?' Xia Xianqin asked Zhang Lin, but her gaze never left Zhang Fei's figure.

Zhang Lin nodded before telling Xia Xianqin. 'Big Sis, you are wrong if you think his current training is very extreme; he has done more extreme training before, and the training given by his master is also very harsh, causing him to be in pain every day.'
'What kind of training could be more extreme than that?'

'Have you ever thought about training against gravity before?' Xian Xianqin shook her head at Zhang Lin. 'My brother once trained with weights around eight times heavier gravity, and he had trouble moving for a few days while doing it, so you shouldn't be surprised if his speed already surpasses yours or anyone else's.'
Xian Xianqin turned to Zhang Lin with wide eyes. 'How can he train in eight times heavier gravity?'

'His master took him to another realm with extremely heavy gravity, and he trained there for months.' Naturally, Zhang Lin wouldn't reveal Zhang Fei's training space to others without his permission, so he made up the story with a straight face. 'I don't know for sure about that realm, especially since his master didn't explain it to him in detail.
However, she is not an ordinary cultivator, and she is not actually a cultivator from the middle realms; she comes from the upper realms.'
'Are you serious about that?' Xian Xianqin asked in shock. 'How could he meet a cultivator from the upper realms?'

'Big Sis, I'm not lying to you, and his master really did come from the upper realms.' Zhang Lin then proceeded to explain the situation to Xia Xianqi. 'Actually, this Nine Stars realm is not my big brother's first realm, but he once went to another realm called the Wasteland realm, and he met his master there. However, we have never met his master, and he has never told us her name.'

Xian Xiaqin then returned her gaze to Zhang Fei again. 'Since he has a cultivator from the upper realms as his master, I'm sure he will be able to surpass me quickly, and he might even surpass my father in the future. Anyway, are you guys going to stay in this realm for a long time?'

Zhang Lin answered Xian Xiaqin with a nod. 'My big brother told us that we won't go anywhere until our cultivation reaches the seven divine realms, so we will stay in this realm for many years to come. Once we reach that stage, he will take us to the upper realms to start our new lives there, so our cultivation can be faster.'

'I see.' Xian Xianqin then lifted her legs and hugged them. 'My grandfather should be in the upper realms by now, but he hasn't returned since he ascended there, so I don't know how he is or which realm he lives in. My father has always dreamed of following him there, but he has difficulty breaking through to the divine manifestation realm.

Moreover, the situation on this island was not completely safe with the existence of the Huangfu Kingdom, and there were still the two demon kingdoms on the other island, so he gave up his desire to look for him in order to protect our kingdom.'

Zhang Lin immediately turned to Xian Xianqin. 'At first, I thought that the royal members of all the kingdoms in this realm would be very arrogant, but you and your family are completely different from my thoughts, Big Sis.'

'Among the five human kingdoms, the Huangfu Kingdom is the most arrogant. Emperor Huangfu Shou has always dreamed to be the sole ruler, but my father and the other three emperors have repeatedly thwarted his ambitions.' Zhang Lin herself had heard about it from Zhang Fei based on Feng Yao's story.
'However, that evil emperor still does not want to give up on his ambitions, and a great war might erupt on this island one day in the future.'

chapters.title: Chapter 515 Meeting Zhu Yan
paragraphs: "Oh? Have you been waiting for so long, Yhrer?"
"Damn you, Elijah!" Yhrer cursed at the vampire lord. "I've been waiting for you for more than a week, but you just woke up from your slumber today."

"Hahaha." Elijah laughed in response to that. "What can I do? My injuries from the guardian's attack were too severe, and I had to sacrifice many demons to recover. What do you want from me? Why did you wait for me so long?"

Yhrer immediately told Elijah about the situation, but he did not tell the vampire lord about Zilvora's presence in the succubi tower, nor did he tell him about Zhang Fei [4]'s relationship with Cain. "It's not that I can't defeat him, but I don't want Orith to find out about my actions, so I need your help to get rid of that brat."

"An Earl rank demon, huh? That's too easy for me, but you know that I won't do it for free, right?" Yhrer nodded to Elijah. "In that case, I'll help you get rid of that brat, so I want my payment to be ready as soon as possible."
"All right, I will prepare it right away, and you can pick it up at my tower after you get rid of that brat." After that, the Incubus Lord and the Vampire Lord rushed off to Lust City.

On the throne, Zhang Fei [4] smiled to himself as he paid attention to the movements of the Incubus Lord and the Vampire Lord through the map system. He immediately informed Orith, who was on his lap, about the two duke demons.

"I may not be able to fight Yhrer and Elijah, but this tower has its own barrier. They won't be able to penetrate it, so they won't be able to attack you." Orith then gave Zhang Fei [4] an idea. "Since that idiot incubus lord isn't in his tower, I think it would be better if we attacked them first, and his subordinates won't be able to fight us."
"Does the Incubi Tower also have a barrier?"
"The fake demon emperor gave us the same barrier, but only Yhrer can activate it, so this is a good chance for us to get rid of them." Orith said.
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "Yhrer will arrive in this city in a few days, so we will do it right away. However, we won't do it alone; we will seek assistance from other demons."
"Who?"
"Cain."
"Eh?" Orith was surprised to hear that name from Zhang Fei [4]'s mouth. "Since when did you have a relationship with Lord Cain? Did you know that he was the son of King Oxgroth?"

Zhang Fei [4] shook his head in response. "I already knew that his background was not ordinary, but I just found out today that he is the son of King Oxgorth. Anyway, I have been in contact with him since you went to the dead forest a few months ago, and our relationship is quite good, so I am sure he will help me."

"If your relationship with Lord Cain is good, his subordinates can get rid of them without us having to move ourselves." Orith then embraced Zhang Fei [4]'s neck. "Anyway, why haven't you eaten Balena yet? Her demon power is stronger than mine, and I can see your relationship with her is getting better every day, so she can help you evolve faster."

"My relationship with Balena has indeed gotten better over the past three and a half months, but her status in her home realm is unusual. That's why I'm not rushing her, but I'm sure she'll fall for me sooner or later." Zhang Fei [4] then brought Orith down from the throne.
"Rather than her, I'm more impatient with Zilvora because we've locked her up for almost a month, but her mentality is simply too strong."

Orith immediately pulled Zhang Fei [4] out of the throne room. "She's been drinking your cum for the past two weeks, and she's getting more and more eager to drink it, so I'm sure she won't refuse if you want to have fun with her now. However, we should go see Cain first, so he can act quickly to get rid of Yhrer's subordinates."

A few minutes later, Yang Ye and Su Qingshi had arrived there, and Zhu Hongtao immediately told them about Zhang Fei [5]'s offer to bring them to the Nine Stars Realm, which shocked them. They wanted to go to that realm too, but since he didn't offer it, they didn't say anything.
"Hongtao, that's a good opportunity for the three of you, so you don't need to consider it anymore and bring them to that realm with him."

"Moreover, the two of you will always be part of this sect, and you guys can come back here after you've become truly strong. At that time, we will hand this sect over to you, and you can lead us to become better again." Su Qingshi added.
"Yes, Sect Master Ye and Elder Su." Zhu Hongtao then took his wife and daughter to tidy up their things in the sect.

"Who is she? Why doesn't she have any cultivation?" Su Qingzhi suddenly asked Zhang Fei [5] as she glanced at Jiang Yinghua. Yang Ye also looked at the female winged race, especially since he was certain that she had profound veins.

Jiang Yinghua remained silent due to her fear of Yang Ye and Su Qingzhi. Although she wasn't a cultivator like them, she could still sense that the two were stronger than her, even though they weren't as strong as the Throne.

"Her name is Jiang Yinghua, and she is curious about this realm, so I brought her here to take a look." Zhang Fei [5] immediately stopped Su Qingzhi when she wanted to ask about the female angel again. "I will bring her back to our home realm after this, so you won't see her again."
Su Qingzhi could understand the meaning behind Zhang Fei [5]'s words. "Does that mean you have decided to stay in the Nine Stars Realm forever?"

"You are wrong, Elder Qingzhi." Zhang Fei [5] answered by shaking his head. "Like this Sky Jade Realm, the Nine Stars Realm will be another stepping stone for me. Once our cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms, I will bring them to the upper realms.
However, I might bring them back to this realm again someday in the future, especially since many of them have strong attachments to this realm."
"The upper realms, huh?" Su Qingzhi muttered softly. "You guys are still young now, and the road ahead of you is still very long, so you must make good use of every opportunity in front of you."

"That's for sure, Elder." Zhang Fei [5] then informed Yang Ye and Su Qingzhi about the disciples, and they expressed no objection to his plan to bring them along. Instead, they were pleased with his decision, as it meant their sect would have many powerful cultivators once they returned to their realm.

Sometime later, Zhu Hongtao had already brought his family back to the guest hall, and the four previous disciples had also arrived there with a female disciple, who was none other than Luo Feng's partner, Li Feifei. Wasting no time, Zhang Fei [5] sent the nine people to the Nine Stars Realm directly, and he asked Ye Lian to take care of them, especially since she was the closest to them.

After he discussed some other matters with Yang Ye and Su Qingzhi, Zhang Fei [5] directly brought Jiang Yinghua back to the Chu Clan, waiting for his subordinates to deliver all the items. "Do you believe me now? Although they were much younger than you, they were much stronger than you.
There are still many cultivators stronger than them in this realm, and most of them are people in my inner circle."

"Honestly, I was frightened by the presence of those two, so I didn't say anything before. According to history books, cultivators were indeed strong, but I didn't expect that they would be that strong." Jiang Yinghua then stretched both of her hands forward. "See? I've never felt so terrified that I can't stop shaking, even though we're back here."

"Yang Ye and Su Qingzhi are still much weaker compared to the cultivators from the Nine Stars Realm." Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Jiang Yinghua. "Those people can kill me before my eyes can blink, so I have to be on guard all the time. Even so, I'm not too afraid of them, and their presence actually spurs my spirit to become even stronger."
"Doesn't that mean that people from the upper realms are even stronger?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Jiang Yinghua. "I have met many cultivators from the upper realm, and my master in the body cultivation path is one of them. Any of them can wipe out the four realms without breaking a sweat, but they are restricted by a special rule, so they cannot come to the lower realms."

"I see." Jiang Yinghua then turned to the group of women who had just arrived, and they immediately handed over various items in large quantities to Zhang Fei [5]. "No wonder your products sell well on earth; it turns out they are all cultivator items. However, they are likely to arouse the jealousy of many people, particularly the owners of large companies in similar fields.
Sooner or later, they will probably use their power and authority to destroy your business."

"No matter they are cultivators, ordinary humans, demons, or winged races, I will destroy anyone who dares to find trouble with me." After he stored all the items in his inventory, Zhang Fei [5] immediately brought Jiang Yinghua back to earth.

When they arrived there, Zhang Fei [5] immediately handed over all the items to Huang Rong and the others. On the other hand, Jiang Yinghua directly contacted the people on her side, and she asked their representatives to go to the human realm specifically to meet him.

Murong Qianying had already arrived at the Wasteland Realm and was sitting opposite her daughter. She still hadn't said anything, but her eyes kept looking at her second daughter with a serious gaze, especially since she had heard about her relationship with Zhang Xiaolong [4] from her eldest daughter.
Moreover, his yang qi inside Shang Yaolin's body was so dense, which meant that they had been intimate with each other too often. "Have you succeeded in controlling that kid yet?"
"Mother, I don't want to control Long'er." Shang Yaolin's answer caused Murong Qianying to frown. "We like each other, and-."

"Fool!" Murong Qianying shouted angrily. "Feelings are not important! You must control him, and you must make him completely obey you! If you don't control him, he might turn against us, and we will be the ones to bear the loss."
"But-"

"No but!" Murong Qianying immediately interrupted Shang Yaolin. "If you can't control him, then I will bring him to our realm, and I will use the most cruel methods to control him, such as turning him into a soulless puppet."
Shang Yaolin's face turned pale, and she certainly didn't want Zhang Xiaolong [3] to turn into a soulless puppet, but she herself was at a loss to fight Murong Qianying.

"Are you sure you want to do that, Aunt?" Murong Qianying immediately turned to Murong Mengying, who had just arrived. "Senior Huan Di already knows about that kid, and he is very interested in him. He even asked Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue to guide him on the soul cultivation path, given his exceptional talent on the path. What do you think will happen if he finds out about your plans?
Our Murong Clan is indeed strong, but our status is nothing in his eyes. If you do that to that kid, your desire to overthrow Shang Huaqiang will end along with our clan."

After Murong Mengying mentioned Huan Di's name, Murong Qianying's expression turned panicked; not even her father and ancestor dared to go against the Soul Emperor, and he only needed to say one word for their Murong Clan to completely vanish.

Murong Mengying smiled faintly at her aunt's reaction. "Rather than you doing something detrimental like that, it would be better if you left this matter to Yaolin. They like each other, and they have also been intimate many times.
Even if she doesn't control Long'er, he will be part of our clan and your son-in-law, and you can ask him to help you overthrow Shang Huaqiang when he becomes truly powerful in the future."

Murong Qianying really didn't like that method, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a heavenly fox, and a heavenly fox had high self-esteem, so she was sure that she would never submit to them. That's why she wanted to have complete control over him, but she realized that the situation had changed after Huan Di took an interest in him.
"You're right, I can't possibly use such a method, or our clan will perish."

"Hehe." Murong Mengying giggled at that. "It's good that you realize that, Aunt. Although I never liked our clan, I am still a part of them, so I don't want them to be destroyed because of your decision."
After Murong Mengying disappeared, Murong Qianying directly spoke to her second daughter. "I leave Long'er's affairs to you, and you must use all means to make him bow down to you."
"Yes, Mother."

In the distance, Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was hiding using his invisibility ability, smiled evilly after listening to their conversation. 'Don't worry, I will make you and your daughter submit to me completely, and you two will become my slaves for the rest of your life.'
It was already evening when Zhang Fei finished his training with Lei Que, and they had already prepared a banquet for the completion of their residence, so he invited the Xian siblings to join them.

During the dinner, the Xian siblings kept listening to their conversation, and both were deeply impressed by their closeness, especially since there was no seniority between them, making them really close. However, they were confused by the presence of Zhu Yan and the other eight people, especially since they hadn't seen them among them before.
Zhang Fei then questioned the Xian siblings. "Do you two have any good formation array master acquaintances?"
