chapters.title: Chapter 517 Duan Zhao - Fa Zhen Mentioned
paragraphs: "Are you thinking about creating a formation array to protect this place?"

Zhang Fei nodded to Xian Xianwu. "There are numerous powerful cultivators in this realm, and their strength surpasses that of any of us, including the two of you. Actually, I am a formation array master, but my knowledge in this field is still limited, and my current protective array can only withstand attacks from the heaven realm cultivators.
Therefore, I need a stronger array to ensure their safety, particularly when I'm not around."
"Huh?" The Xian siblings were shocked to hear Zhang Fei's confession that he was also a formation array master. "Don't tell me that you also studied alchemy and blacksmithing."

"Princess, I am actually interested in both of them, but I am fully aware of my abilities, and I will never be able to learn all of them at once." Zhang Fei then pointed at Zhang Lingxue. "For now, Lingxue is the only alchemist among us, but Ying'er and Qing'er have started learning about alchemy from her.
I want to forge equipment for them, so I am eager to learn blacksmithing, but I am unable to find a suitable master to teach me."

"If you are interested in blacksmithing, I know someone who can help you. He may not be the best blacksmith in this realm, but his blacksmithing skills are not to be underestimated, and he can forge equipment at the celestial grade and above." Xian Xianwu then showed his white fan to Zhang Fei.
"Even though this Taifeng fan looks like an ordinary fan, it is a celestial grade, and he forged it especially for me."
"Can I see it, Prince?" Xian Xianwu directly handed his fan to Zhang Fei, who immediately observed it seriously. "This fan can increase your wind attacks by around 30%, right?"

"Yes." Xian Xianwu nodded to Zhang Fei. "Not only does it enhance the power of my wind attacks, but it also boosts my speed by approximately 25%. Unfortunately, my speed will only increase for five minutes, but it is more than enough to help me escape if I encounter serious danger.
Anyway, you can go see Senior Duan Zhao in Heian town if you want to learn about blacksmithing, which is near the border of this area with the Yun Kingdom."
'How do you think Duan Zhao's blacksmithing abilities compare to Tie Xuan, Mei?'

[Master, Tie Xuan and his Tie Clan come from the upper realms, so his blacksmithing abilities should be superior. However, I think there's no harm in learning about blacksmithing from Duan Zhao for the time being, especially since you don't want to be in a relationship with that guy yet.]

Zhang Fei nodded and returned the white fan to Xian Xianwu. "I will try to meet Senior Duan Zhao, but I won't be going there any time soon, and I want to focus on opening my restaurant first. Then, what about the formation array master?"

"There is a renowned formation array master in our kingdom, but he is too eccentric and materialistic." Zhang Fei looked at Xian Xianqin with raised eyebrows. "Senior Fa Zhen is one of the best in this realm, but his character is unpredictable, and his behavior is also a bit weird.

He created the formation arrays that protect our kingdom, but he demanded a large sum of money from our father, despite our father having provided all the necessary materials. Our father decided to fulfill his request because there were only five formation array masters in this realm, and he didn't want him to move to other kingdoms, especially since it would be a loss for us.
That's why you have to prepare a lot of money if you want to ask him to create a protective formation in this residence, or he will kick you out of his shop directly."
"I don't have much money right now, so I'll reconsider going to see Senior Fa Zhen." Zhang Fei then asked them. "Why didn't Emperor Xian ask the other four for help?"

Xian Xianqin glanced at Elmyra first before answering Zhang Fei. "Two of them are members of the natural races, and they don't like to interact with humans like us. One of them lives in the Huangfu Kingdom, and he is Emperor Huangfu's slave, so he won't help anyone else."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "Then, who is the last person?"

"Emperor Ximen Changtian, the demon emperor of the Ximen Kingdom." Xian Xianqin's answer not only shocked Zhang Fei but also the rest of the people. "That's why my father can't possibly ask him for help in creating protective formations in our kingdom, especially since he is our archenemy.
Compared to Emperor Huangfu, his cruelty is on a whole different level, and he never hesitates to sacrifice other living beings to fulfill his ambitions."
"What did Emperor Ximen Changtian do in this realm, Big Sis?"

Xian Xianqin chose not to answer Zhang Lin's question, especially since Ximen Changtian's actions were not only too terrifying for her but also for the entire Nine Stars Realm, so she did not want to discuss the matter. Xian Xianwu also shook his head at them as a sign of refusal, convincing them that the demon emperor's actions were too terrifying.
Since they chose to keep their mouths shut, Zhang Fei did not force them to explain. "Do you two want to return to the capital now?"
"Yes." Both of them answered simultaneously. "We have to meet our master tomorrow, so we should go back now."

Xian Xianqin suddenly spoke to Zhang Fei. "Anyway, these dishes are really delicious, and I have never eaten such delicious dishes before. Even the chefs in our palace cannot cook dishes as delicious as you two, so I am sure that your restaurant will be flooded with customers once you open."

"She will be our chef, and her cooking is the best in our home realm." The Xian siblings immediately turned to Zhu Yan, who smiled at them. "Anyway, I hope you two will not tell anyone else about us or our residence, except for Emperor Xian and Empress Shi. We only want a quiet life, so we do not want to deal with too many people."

"Don't worry, we won't tell anyone else, including our master." After they said goodbye to them, Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu immediately shattered their returning jade, and both of them disappeared from their residence in an instant.
Zhang Fei then asked them. "Have you guys started preparing for our wedding?"
"Since we are just going to hold a traditional wedding ceremony, we don't need too much preparation, and we can do it in two days." Zhang Chen replied to Zhang Fei.

"All right, I will marry them in two days." Zhang Fei then looked at the nine people who had just joined them today. "I will send you guys to my private training ground, and I want you to train there seriously for a while, so you can catch up with them. However, Zhu Qianzhi cannot join you because the training will be hard, and her body won't be able to withstand the burden."
The five disciples looked excited and looked forward to it, especially since Ye Lian had already shown her progress to them before, so they wanted to do the same training as her to catch up with her.
Zhu Hongtao turned to Qin Zheng, who seemed hesitant about leaving their daughter behind. "There are so many people here, so he won't be lonely, and we can focus on strengthening ourselves."

Zhu Qianzhi joined in speaking to Qin Zheng. "Mother, you have postponed your cultivation for many years due to my health issues, but I am now fully healthy, so you can stop worrying about me and focus more on yourself from now on."

"Haha." Ye Lian suddenly laughed before moving behind Zhu Qianzhi and hugging her from behind. "Sister Zheng, we will accompany Qianzhi while you and Brother Hongtao train inside my husband's training ground, so you can train in peace, and your abilities will improve greatly after you complete your training."
Qin Zheng released a soft sigh and nodded in agreement to them. "All right, I entrust our daughter to you while my husband and I train there."

After that, Zhang Fei sent them all into his training space. In addition, he also sent all the partners of his two clones in there because the Qi he needed to break through to the 2-Star Earth Realm was simply too much, and the amount was two times more than when he broke through to that stage.

paragraphs: Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh as he put on a disappointed face. "Senior, I know my protective array is very weak, but it's still better than nothing, right? Fa Zhen suddenly pulled out a paper that contained the method for creating a simple formation array and handed it to Zhang Fei. "Learn it first, and I will get the materials needed to create it in the back."

Honestly, I still have doubts about your ability in formation arrays, but your bone age and cultivation make me think otherwise, so I want to test your abilities by creating one."

Fa Zhen nodded to Zhang Fei. "You're right; this Yin-Yang Harmony Array is indeed specialized for dual cultivation, and you are a dual cultivator. Anyway, this formation will not be a waste even if you create it here, especially since it is a portable formation array, so you can move it wherever you like."
"Huh? A portable formation array?"

"Haven't you heard of that?" Zhang Fei shook his head at Fa Zhen, especially since Di Xingjie and Di Xiong never told him there was a portable formation array. "Sigh! I seem to be getting senile; I forgot that you don't have a master in formation array. Your protective array is included in the embedded array type, and you will not be able to move it again once you create it, so you must create it in the right place. Another type is a single-use array, which can only be used once, and most of them are attack or trap arrays."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding of the latter type, especially since he still had the bloodmoon devouring array, and it was a single-use array.

"Actually, there are still a few other types of arrays, but we won't talk about them now." Fa Zhen then pushed the five materials toward Zhang Fei. "For now, I want you to create the Yin-Yang Harmony Array, and I want to witness it firsthand. If you can create it in one try, I will help you create a protective array for your residence.
As for the effect, you'll find out when you dual cultivate in it, and I dare to guarantee that you and your partner will really like the effects."

Zhang Fei's eyes lit up after he heard that, especially since he really needed a protective array for their residence. Moreover, the Xian sibling had told him yesterday that Fa Zhen was materialistic, and their father had to spend a large sum of money to hire his services.

"No problem, Senior Sister. My soul power has almost broken through to the perfection stage of the soul core, and I believe it can break through by cultivating my soul manually." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then sat down beside Qiao Liangren. "Aren't you going to cultivate your soul, Senior Brother?"
"Not today." Qiao Liangren observed Zhang Xiaolong [3] for a brief moment before posing a question. "Has your cultivation broken through to the Earth Realm?"

Your aura is definitely not that of a cultivator in the soul realm, but rather in the earth realm, so I guessed it that way." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding and took off his ring, so Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue could sense his current cultivation, but he quickly put it back on or other cultivators would notice.
"So my guess was right; you really have broken through to the Earth Realm."

"You're a freak, Long'er!" Shang Yingyue said with a squeal. "I gave you the ring about a month and a half ago, and your cultivation just broke through to the 7-Star Soul Realm, but your cultivation has already reached the earth realm now."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed the back of his head. "Senior Sister Yingyue, you yourself already know that Aunt Qianying and Aunt Xinxin gave me so much Yin Qi from the female members of their clans, and they are too strong for my current level. If they didn't give them to me, my cultivation wouldn't be able to improve this fast."

Shang Yingyue nodded in understanding, but she was unaware that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had not yet used those Yin Qi and was still reserving them for urgent purposes. "All right, I have to go back now, so you two can talk together."
After Shang Yingyue descended from the mountaintop, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately questioned Qiao Liangren. "Senior brother, have you ever heard of the abyssal demon?"

Qiao Liangren then explained to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "The abyssal demon is not an ordinary demon but rather a demon summon that arises from intense demon power. Usually, it will appear once every five hundred years, and I have seen it appear on the southern island once.

Unfortunately, my current strength is insufficient to compete with the powerful demons on the southern island."

"Being born as a mixed race like you must be troublesome. Since you are a demon fox, you must increase your demon power. Compared to a human cultivator like me, a demon cultivator is much stronger, especially since their physique is different from humans." Qiao Liangren then looked towards the south. "I understand your desire to get the abyssal demon heart, but you better not go to that island.

"Do you know about his demon race, Senior Brother?"

"No." Qiao Liangren then told Zhang Xiaolong [3] another thing. "My master will come to this realm in a month, and he wants to examine you. He hopes you can increase your soul power to the early stage of the earthly soul level before he arrives in this realm, or he will not appear before you."

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s expression turned ecstatic after hearing that, and he naturally did not want to waste the opportunity to meet the Soul Emperor. "All right, I will try my best to reach that level before Senior Hun Di arrives in this realm. I will start cultivating my soul now, Senior Brother."
"Yes."

Sensing that, Zhang Yue also released more of her Yin Qi into Zhang Fei's body, making the result of the merging of their Yin and Yang Qi become denser and thicker.

Although he was surprised by Zhang Yue's action, Zhang Fei remained calm so as not to cause any disturbance in their dual cultivation. 'Her control over her Yin Qi is getting better and better; I believe she will sooner or later surpass Shen Xueyi and the others.
Moreover, her Yin Qi became colder the more she mastered her ice phoenix techniques, and her ice element seems to be reaching advanced stage soon.'
Zhang Fei decided to use the Qi from his six prisoners to speed up Zhang Yue's cultivation and help her break through.
After all, he still needed to stabilize his cultivation before he could break through to the 2-Star Earth Realm, and the amount of their Qi that had accumulated in the Yin-Yang Space was very large.
Moreover, all his wives are different from him, especially since he has many official wives and partners by his side.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]

When the two notifications appeared, Zhang Fei stopped releasing his Yang Qi, especially since he had been doing it for six hours non-stop based on outside time or twelve hours non-stop based on the time inside the training space.

Moreover, Zhang Yue's cultivation had already reached the 10-Star Realm thanks to the Qi he had shared with her through the harem sharing, and she still had to prepare herself before breaking through to the Soul Realm.
Zhang Yue immediately opened her eyes and kissed Zhang Fei.
"Soon, my cultivation will break through to the Soul Realm, and we can start dual soul cultivation after that."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei then lifted his big sister from his lap, making a lot of his cum flow out of her pussy after their genitals separated.
"Your cultivation broke through too fast because I used my prisoners' Qi to help you, so stabilize it for now and I'll help the others."
"All right, I will start to stabilize my cultivation now."
After that, Zhang Fei returned to his room and summoned Qing Yi, Zhong Yan, Tang Ziyu, Lillea, and Janette, whose cultivation was still below the Soul Realm.
The five of them were already approaching the soul realm, so he wanted to help them reach that stage first.
Like when he dual cultivated with Zhang Yue, Zhang Fei did not have intense sex with them, but they just sat on his lap in the lotus position in turns.
All of them released their Yin and Yang Qi, so he could still get their Yin Qi while helping them by using the harem sharing.
Since Zhang Fei had to marry all of them in the morning, he only dual-cultivated with Qing Yi, Zhong Yan, and Tang Ziyu until their cultivation reached the 10-star core realm.

Meanwhile, Lillea and Janette had reached that stage some time ago, so he wanted to help them break through to the 1-Star Soul Realm, and they could form their cultivation souls after breaking through to that stage.
In the succubi castle, Zilvora was completely exhausted after having sex with Zhang Fei [4] for two whole days, but she looked so satisfied with it.

Zhang Fei [4] himself was satisfied because Zilvora's female essence was simply too powerful for the current him; not even Orith's female essence could compare to hers, let alone his female demon partners from the Diyu Realm. 'Show my status, Mei.'
Cultivation:
> 1 Star Earth Realm [Qi: 700,000/2,500,000]
Soul Cultivation
> Soul Core: Half-Perfection Stage
Body Cultivation:
> Skin Refining Stage
Demon Rank:
- Marquis Rank [Female Essence: 10,055,300/18,000,000]
Beast Rank:
- 5 Tails [Beast Essence: 4,900,000/10,000,000]
[Master, your demon rank can rise to the Duke rank if you have sex with Zilvora for the next few days, and you will evolve into a lust demon lord after that.
However, the Yin Qi from your six prisoners in the Yin-Yang Space has begun to diminish, particularly due to the significant amount of energy you expended to assist Zhang Yue and the others.
I think your fifth clone should stop dual soul cultivating with them for the time being to harvest their Yin Qi again, so it will be ready when you can break through to the 2-Star Earth Realm.
Additionally, all the people from earth have been training using the battle simulation feature for a few months, so it is time for them to use the results of their training in actual combat.]
'Yeah, you're right.
All this time, all of them have been staying in the training space, so they have no experience in actual combat.
Moreover, they can't train in level four of the gravity feature before breaking through to the Earth Realm first, so I'll ask them to gain experience in real combat by fighting the beasts.

That way, they can protect themselves when I'm absent; Hua'er and the others can help them with that.' Zhang Fei [4] then questioned the AI. 'Do you think the amount of female essence I need for my demon rank to advance to the Archduke rank will be even greater?'
[That's for sure, Master.
However, I can't say for sure how much female essence you need for your demon rank to rise to Archduke rank, so you should raise it to Duke rank first.
The best choice for you now is Balena, and her female essence is probably equivalent to Zilvora, so you should try to woo her from now on.]
'Then, what about the Abyssal Demon Heart in the Wasteland Realm?
When will it appear on the southern island?'
[According to the system's estimation, the Abyssal Demon will appear in a year, and you must defeat it in order to take its heart.
Anyway, I've looked up some information about the Abyssal Demon Heart in the system, and I think it's best if you don't use it.
It can indeed increase your demon power several times over, but it will also make your demon trait and soul stronger, and you will probably lose your humanity if you use it.]
'Losing my humanity, huh?

No matter what, I have to get the Abyssal Demon Heart first, and I'll think about it again whether I should use it or not.' After he got dressed, Zhang Fei [4] then left the room and went to meet Orith, who was with Balena in the throne room.
"Are you done having fun with Queen Zilvora?" Orith inquired immediately upon Zhang Fei's arrival.
Zhang Fei [4] nodded to the succubus duchess.
"I've had enough fun with Zilvora, so I want to do something else now while I wait for Elijah to come to this city."
"Do you want to fight against those demon beasts again?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [4] then asked.
"What if I remove those demon sealing artifacts from Balena?
She has no other place to stay in this realm, and you two are also closer now, so I think it's fine, right?
That way, she can help us capture the vampire lord, and I will devour him."
Orith looked at Balena for a while before removing those demon sealing artifacts from her, surprising the female demon whale.
"I trust Elion, and he trusts you, so I follow his wishes."
"Yeah." Balena then accepted the clothes Orith gave her and put them on right away, even though she felt uncomfortable with them, especially since they were too sexy.
"I haven't been locked up in a dungeon for a long time, and my fighting skills must have been dulled by now, so I'll join you to fight those demon beasts."
"I'll join you too, guys."
Mei immediately helped Zhang Fei [4] search for the location of the demon beasts whose strength was equal to his current strength.
Once she gave him the information, he swiftly escorted the two female demons from the succubi tower to their destination while also keeping a close watch on Elijah's movements.
In the Shang Clan residence, Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was sleeping between the two women, continued to think of ways to do something to Murong Qianying.
After all, Shang Yumei had told her about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s abilities, so Murong Qianying kept her guard up against him.
Despite appearing to be in deep sleep, Mei felt her senses locking onto him, leaving him feeling helpless.
In the end, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to leave the room and went to the mountaintop, where Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue were having a serious talk.
"Long'er, we can't dual soul cultivate for the next few days." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Shang Yingyue in confusion.
"My husband and daughter are in my private quarters now, and they will be staying here for quite some time, so I must accompany them."
"No problem, Senior Sister.

My soul power has almost broken through to the perfection stage of the soul core, and I believe it can break through by cultivating my soul manually." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then sat down beside Qiao Liangren.
"Aren't you going to cultivate your soul, Senior Brother?"
"Not today." Qiao Liangren observed Zhang Xiaolong [3] for a brief moment before posing a question.
"Has your cultivation broken through to the Earth Realm?"
"Eh?" Shang Yingyue was taken aback upon hearing this, as Zhang Xiaolong [3] had always worn the concealment ring she had previously gifted him.
"Has your cultivation really reached the earth realm now, Long'er?"
"How did you know that, Senior Brother?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] curiously asked.
"Even though you have concealed your cultivation by using the concealment ring, I can still faintly sense your aura.

Your aura is definitely not that of a cultivator in the soul realm, but rather in the earth realm, so I guessed it that way." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding and took off his ring, so Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue could sense his current cultivation, but he quickly put it back on or other cultivators would notice.
"So my guess was right; you really have broken through to the Earth Realm."
"You're a freak, Long'er!" Shang Yingyue said with a squeal.
"I gave you the ring about a month and a half ago, and your cultivation just broke through to the 7-Star Soul Realm, but your cultivation has already reached the earth realm now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed the back of his head.
"Senior Sister Yingyue, you yourself already know that Aunt Qianying and Aunt Xinxin gave me so much Yin Qi from the female members of their clans, and they are too strong for my current level.
If they didn't give them to me, my cultivation wouldn't be able to improve this fast."
Shang Yingyue nodded in understanding, but she was unaware that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had not yet used those Yin Qi and was still reserving them for urgent purposes.
"All right, I have to go back now, so you two can talk together."
After Shang Yingyue descended from the mountaintop, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately questioned Qiao Liangren.
"Senior brother, have you ever heard of the abyssal demon?"
Qiao Liangren then explained to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"The abyssal demon is not an ordinary demon but rather a demon summon that arises from intense demon power.
Usually, it will appear once every five hundred years, and I have seen it appear on the southern island once.
However, it did not appear for long because the senior demons on the island immediately killed it, and they used its heart to increase their demon power.
Are you thinking about getting its heart?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not hide his intentions from Qiao Liangren.
"I once heard from my mother that the abyssal demon heart could increase my demon power several times over, so I wanted to get one.
Unfortunately, my current strength is insufficient to compete with the powerful demons on the southern island."
"Being born as a mixed race like you must be troublesome.
Since you are a demon fox, you must increase your demon power.
Compared to a human cultivator like me, a demon cultivator is much stronger, especially since their physique is different from humans." Qiao Liangren then looked towards the south.
"I understand your desire to get the abyssal demon heart, but you better not go to that island.
One of the senior demons on that island has a cultivation of 5-Moon Divine Fusion; even I am not his opponent, so you will definitely die in his hands if you want to compete with him for it."
"Do you know about his demon race, Senior Brother?"
"No." Qiao Liangren then told Zhang Xiaolong [3] another thing.
"My master will come to this realm in a month, and he wants to examine you.
He hopes you can increase your soul power to the early stage of the earthly soul level before he arrives in this realm, or he will not appear before you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s expression turned ecstatic after hearing that, and he naturally did not want to waste the opportunity to meet the Soul Emperor.
"All right, I will try my best to reach that level before Senior Hun Di arrives in this realm.
I will start cultivating my soul now, Senior Brother."
"Yes."
At dawn, Zhang Fei had already brought all his women out of the training space, especially since he was going to marry them.

When they arrived at their residence, Zhang Chen and the others had already prepared a small altar with some simple things on it, especially since they were only going to hold a traditional wedding ceremony.
Unlike his wedding with the Chu Sisters and Ru Xue, Zhang Fei and all his women did not wear wedding dresses or excessive makeup, and they only wore their best clothes to carry out the ceremony.
They didn't do it one by one, but they did it at the same time with Zhang Chen, Zhang Long, Yang Yudie, Ye Yuan, and Yang Yudie sitting in the parents' chairs.
After their wedding ceremony, Zhang Fei immediately informed them of his plan for them to train against the beasts.

Even though they were surprised by his sudden decision, they immediately agreed to follow his plans because they had been training in the training space for a long time, so they wanted to prove the results of their training.
The disciples of the Yin-Yang Pavilion and the Heavenly Sword Sect decided to join them, mainly because they would face a more difficult situation in the Nine Stars Realm.
Zhang Fei asked his seniors and senior wives to guide Qing Yi and the people from Earth in their training, but he did not join them.
Instead, he went to the capital with Zhu Yan.

chapters.title: Chapter 521 Yun Shang - Guo Xuehua
paragraphs: Shi Qingzhuang was sitting on the balcony with a middle-aged woman, her black hair tied up in a bun, a small yet luxurious tiara adorning her head, and two side bangs falling down to her cheeks. The woman's face was not inferior to the Empress of the Xian Kingdom, but her body was slightly inferior to hers, especially her chest.
"Why do you keep looking at the commerce district, Sister Qingzhuang? Is there anything interesting in that district?"
Shi Qingzhuang turned to the woman and nodded. "There's something interesting there, Sister Guo Xuehua. However, I won't tell you about it now, and you can see for yourself in a few days."

Guo Xuehua, the Empress of the Yun Clan, raised her eyebrows at Shi Qingzhuang's secrecy. She then spread her senses to the commerce district, but she couldn't find anything interesting there, leaving her wondering. 'What exactly is she hiding from me? It's unusual for her to act like this, so it must be something interesting.' "Anyway, where are Xianwu and Xianqin?
Why don't I see them in this palace?"

"Their master summoned them to meet him, so they returned to our Xian Imperial Sect since yesterday, but they should be back in a few days." Shi Qingzhuang turned to ask. "What about Yun Feng and Yun Xi? Have they broken through to the seven divine realms?"

"Haish! You shouldn't ask that." Guo Xuehua replied with a heavy sigh. "Just like your children, my children still haven't managed to break through to the seven divine realms. They told me over and over again that they had already touched the final barrier, but they felt that something was preventing them from passing through it.
Not only them, but the other younger generations at their level also said the same thing, which made me think there was a change in the world law, preventing them from breaking through."
Sister Qinzhuang raised her eyebrows at that, especially since her two children also said the same thing. "A change in the world law? How is that possible?"

"There." Guo Xuehua pointed northeast, precisely toward the Cyanwood Mountain. "Unlike you with your light element, I have the lightning element, and my understanding of the lightning law is quite good. In the past, lightning at the mountaintop was weaker, but the lightning law is getting stronger every year.
I went there a few months ago, but I can't get close to that place anymore even with my current understanding of the lightning law, which means it has gone beyond my understanding.

I have discussed the matter with Xian Lianghua, but he himself has no answer about it because members of the natural races with the lightning element are also unable to approach that place, so he suspects that the lightning law there is the cause of the world law to undergo some changes."
"Does that mean the lightning law in our realm has overpowered the other elemental laws?"

Guo Xuehua shook her head at Shi Qingzhuang in denial. "Actually, it's still just Xian Lianghua's guess, and he hasn't found any evidence for it. Moreover, the elemental laws of all realms are created in balance, so none of them can overpower the others. Overpowering one element will destroy its balance, causing the other elemental laws to gradually fade away.
Why don't you try using your light element? Your light element will become weaker if the light law disappears from our realm."

"My understanding of the law of light is not as high as your understanding of the law of lightning." Shi Qingzhuang then extended both of her palms forward, and two balls of light appeared above them, but one of them was much brighter than the other. "My light element is still as strong as ever, so there should be no change in the light law in our realm.
Then, why do they have difficulty breaking through to the seven divine realms?"

"No one knows the answer." Guo Xuehua then looked up at the sky. "The world law is different from the elemental laws, and no living creature has ever been able to understand it. The only conclusion I can draw is that it declines over time, particularly due to the overwhelming number of cultivators in our realm.
Moreover, the condition of our realm continues to change for the worse because of our actions, and it will probably become a dead realm if the world law completely disappears."
"Aren't your thoughts about it a bit too extreme?"

Guo Xuehua turned to Shi Qingzhuang and inquired. "Did you forget that there are some dead realms in these middle realms? In the past, those realms had their own civilizations, but their conditions continued to deteriorate, and they slowly moved towards death before dying out completely, forcing their inhabitants to migrate to other realms."

"You are right." Shi Qingzhuang nodded repeatedly as she recalled the existence of those realms. "In fact, my ancestors came from one of those dead realms, and they decided to move to this Nine Stars Realm because the condition of their realm kept getting worse. Anyway, are you thinking about accepting a disciple, Sister Xuehua?"

"Hahaha." Guo Xuehua laughed quite loudly, causing her breast to bounce around. "I'm not someone who is good at teaching others; even our master said so, remember? I didn't even teach my two children about cultivation; instead, I left them under my brother's guidance, so I would never take a disciple. Who is the person you are referring to? Why do you want that person to be my disciple?"

"You will meet that person in a few days, and I believe you will change your mind after meeting him." The mysterious smile on Shi Qingzhuang's face caused Guo Xuehua to frown. "I can tell you that he recently passed his lightning tribulation, and he experienced it twice at once."
"Huh? Two lightning tribulations at once?" Shi Qingzhuang nodded at Guo Xuehua. "What did he do to deserve such a harsh test from the heavens?"

Shi Qingzhuang shook her head in response. "You might think that he is an evil person because of his lightning tribulations, but my husband and I can see that he is not evil. He has many loyal people by his side, and all of them are good people because our children have already visited his residence two days ago."

"How did he survive his two lightning tribulations? Does he have the lightning element?" Guo Xuehua asked in a curious manner as she propped her chin. "A single lightning tribulation was already so terrifying, yet he experienced it twice at once."

"He doesn't have the lightning element, but based on my children's stories, he learned a lightning body technique." Guo Xuehua was surprised to hear Shi Qingshuang's answer, especially since she knew that to learn such a technique requires the lightning element.

"My husband and I witnessed his lightning tribulation with our own eyes, and I can tell you that it was truly powerful, but he did not fall unconscious after he was struck by the first lightning. Instead, he absorbed the lightning to strengthen his body, core, and soul. Likewise after he was struck by the second lightning, and he only fell unconscious after absorbing all the lightning."
Guo Xuehua's expression looked genuinely curious after hearing that. "Are you sure I can meet him in a few days?"
"He will open a restaurant in this capital in a few days, so I will take you there to meet him, and you can check him out yourself."
Guo Xuehua then stood up. "All right, we will meet him in a few days, but we should join our husbands now."
Shi Qingzhuang immediately followed Guo Xuehua, and they soon arrived at another area, where Xian Feng was speaking with the Emperor of the Yun Kingdom, Yun Shang.

Unlike Xian Feng, who looked like a fighter, Yun Shang looked more like a scholar, but he also looked like a drunkard. Even so, the aura that radiated from his body was like a calm cloud above the sky, but his drunken eyes looked fierce.
Guo Xuehua immediately massaged her forehead when she saw her husband. "Husband, I have forbidden you to drink too much arrack, but you never listen to me."

"Haha." Yun Shang laughed upon hearing that. "Wife, you know that I can never get drunk, no matter how much arrack I drink, so you don't need to mind it, right? Anyway, Brother Feng told me about a young man, but he still hides his identity from me, so I think we should stay in this kingdom for a few days to meet him."

Both women immediately sat down beside their respective husbands, and Guo Xuehua spoke to her husband directly. "Sister Qingzhuang also told me the young man, and I was curious about him, so I wanted to stay here for a few days."
"In that case, we will stay here for a few days and let my brother take care of our kingdom for a while."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei and Zhu Yan were discussing the restaurant, from the dishes to the waitresses and other things. "Do you think the five of them are enough to help you? Or do you still need help from other people?"

Zhu Yan took some time to think before responding to Zhang Fei. "The five of them are actually enough to help me, but we are foreigners in this realm. Moreover, you want to use them for your new organization, and they will probably go out often to do certain things, so I think we should find some female workers in this realm.
Additionally, you could create a large number of flyers and distribute them throughout the capital prior to the restaurant's opening."

"All right, I will do that, and I will pay some people to spread them." Zhang Fei suddenly had another idea and took out some beast meat. "How about you cook some dishes? The kitchen utensils and seasonings are already in the kitchen, and I will use my wind element to spread the aroma to various areas.
I am confident that the aroma of your dishes will pique people's curiosity, and their curiosity will grow once I distribute the flyers, so they will fill our restaurant during the opening day."

Zhu Yan immediately agreed with that and took those beast meats to the kitchen, and he began to prepare to cook some dishes. Mei suddenly informed Zhang Fei about something. [Master, I previously detected two powerful senses scanning this area, and I traced the source to the Xian Palace.]

Zhang Fei immediately opened the map and checked the Xian Palace; he found the two Emperors and Empresses of the two kingdoms gathered in one place. 'Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua should be the Emperor and Empress of the Yun Kingdom in the west. I'm sure the two senses from before belonged to them, which means Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang told them about me.'

[They seem to be very close to each other, master. Moreover, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang clearly have no ill intentions towards you, or else the dots on their names would not be green but red.] Zhang Fei did not refute Mei, especially since the dots on the names of people who were hostile towards him were always red.
[Maybe they have a special reason for telling Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua about you, and you will probably find out about their intentions on the opening day of your restaurant.]

'Yeah, you're right. I'll wait for their arrival on the opening day, and we'll find out whether Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua will be hostile to me or not by then.' Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something. 'Mei, open the two easy gift packs from the previous two easy quests, and also the daily gift pack from yesterday.'
[All right.]
[You gained 50.000 beast essence.]
[You obtained 1 Huanying Mask. Grade: Heaven.]
[You obtained 1 Hongxi Dagger. Grade: Heaven]
'Oh?' Zhang Fei was slightly surprised to get two items, which were from the two easy gift packs. 'Show their description, Mei.'
[Huanying Mask: The user can conceal his or her aura completely when wearing this mask, and the mask will not be visible to others.]
[Hongxi Dagger: This dagger can steal Qi from opponents with every attack to restore the user's Qi.]

Zhang Fei immediately took the two pieces of equipment and put on the Huanying mask. 'This mask's material is incredibly light, and it doesn't feel like I'm wearing one. As for this dagger, I'll try its effects later, and I hope the amount of Qi it steals is large enough, so I won't run out of Qi when fighting my enemies.'

Zhang Fei suddenly smelled the aroma of cooking from the kitchen because Zhu Yan had started cooking, so he immediately stored the two pieces of equipment and followed her there. As originally planned, he used his wind element to spread the aroma of his cooking as far as possible, hoping to tempt the residents of the Xian Kingdom.

As Zhang Fei expected, people started to gather in front of the building, but none of them dared to approach or check inside with their senses, especially since they knew that it was a private building belonging to the royal family, leaving them wondering about the source of the cooking aroma.
"It seems your plan worked, Zhang Fei." Zhu Yan spoke after she heard the commotion from outside.
As he watched those people from the map, Zhang Fei nodded to Zhu Yan. "After this, you can cook some other dishes and let them wonder more about your cooking."
"All right."

As time passed, the number of people gathered in front of the building continued to increase, particularly after Zhu Yan began cooking additional dishes. Just like in the Sky Jade Realm, the people in the Nine Stars Realm never used spices like on earth to cook their food, so the aroma of her dishes was different from what they usually ate.

Seeing so many people gathered there, the guards were forced to move to disperse the crowds because their actions were making the area too crowded, and one of them immediately reported the problem to the Xian Palace.

Xian Feng, through one of his ministers, ordered the guard to let the people gather there. He did that on purpose because he was aware of Zhang Fei's intentions, and he wanted to show him that they were on his side.

After Zhu Yan had completed her cooking and tidying up, Zhang Fei promptly used his warp portal to send her back to their residence, particularly considering the lingering crowd in front of the building.

Zhang Fei himself did not return there, but instead, he used his invisibility to leave the place. He then went to look around the shops in the commerce and market districts to buy some items, especially the herbs that Zhang Lingxue needed to concoct pills.
"Hmm?" As soon as Zhang Fei entered his alchemy shop, the old man immediately looked at him. "What can I do for you, young master?"

"Senior, my wife is an alchemist, and she wants to concoct some pills, so I want to buy some herbs." Zhang Fei then mentioned some herbs that Zhang Lingxue wanted, and the owner wrote them down one by one. "Do you have them, Senior?"

The old man nodded to Zhang Fei. "I have some of these herbs in stock, but I'm running low on some others, and you'll have to wait at least three days for my new stock to arrive. Sorry if I'm being presumptuous, but can you tell me your wife's alchemist rank?
All these herbs are clearly not ingredients for concocting basic or intermediate rank pills, but rather high rank pills, which can only be concocted by alchemists from the Alchemy Union."

'Alchemy union?' Zhang Fei inwardly wondered. "Forgive me, Senior. I have no knowledge about alchemy, and I have never asked my wife about her rank in alchemy. Anyway, can you tell me about the alchemy union?"

"My understanding of the law of light is not as high as your understanding of the law of lightning." Shi Qingzhuang then extended both of her palms forward, and two balls of light appeared above them, but one of them was much brighter than the other.
"My light element is still as strong as ever, so there should be no change in the light law in our realm.
Then, why do they have difficulty breaking through to the seven divine realms?"
"No one knows the answer." Guo Xuehua then looked up at the sky.
"The world law is different from the elemental laws, and no living creature has ever been able to understand it.
The only conclusion I can draw is that it declines over time, particularly due to the overwhelming number of cultivators in our realm.
Moreover, the condition of our realm continues to change for the worse because of our actions, and it will probably become a dead realm if the world law completely disappears."
"Aren't your thoughts about it a bit too extreme?"
Guo Xuehua turned to Shi Qingzhuang and inquired.
"Did you forget that there are some dead realms in these middle realms?

In the past, those realms had their own civilizations, but their conditions continued to deteriorate, and they slowly moved towards death before dying out completely, forcing their inhabitants to migrate to other realms."
"You are right." Shi Qingzhuang nodded repeatedly as she recalled the existence of those realms.
"In fact, my ancestors came from one of those dead realms, and they decided to move to this Nine Stars Realm because the condition of their realm kept getting worse.
Anyway, are you thinking about accepting a disciple, Sister Xuehua?"
"Hahaha." Guo Xuehua laughed quite loudly, causing her breast to bounce around.
"I'm not someone who is good at teaching others; even our master said so, remember?
I didn't even teach my two children about cultivation; instead, I left them under my brother's guidance, so I would never take a disciple.
Who is the person you are referring to?
Why do you want that person to be my disciple?"
"You will meet that person in a few days, and I believe you will change your mind after meeting him." The mysterious smile on Shi Qingzhuang's face caused Guo Xuehua to frown.
"I can tell you that he recently passed his lightning tribulation, and he experienced it twice at once."
"Huh?
Two lightning tribulations at once?" Shi Qingzhuang nodded at Guo Xuehua.
"What did he do to deserve such a harsh test from the heavens?"
Shi Qingzhuang shook her head in response.
"You might think that he is an evil person because of his lightning tribulations, but my husband and I can see that he is not evil.
He has many loyal people by his side, and all of them are good people because our children have already visited his residence two days ago."
"How did he survive his two lightning tribulations?
Does he have the lightning element?" Guo Xuehua asked in a curious manner as she propped her chin.
"A single lightning tribulation was already so terrifying, yet he experienced it twice at once."

"He doesn't have the lightning element, but based on my children's stories, he learned a lightning body technique." Guo Xuehua was surprised to hear Shi Qingshuang's answer, especially since she knew that to learn such a technique requires the lightning element.
"My husband and I witnessed his lightning tribulation with our own eyes, and I can tell you that it was truly powerful, but he did not fall unconscious after he was struck by the first lightning.
Instead, he absorbed the lightning to strengthen his body, core, and soul.
Likewise after he was struck by the second lightning, and he only fell unconscious after absorbing all the lightning."
Guo Xuehua's expression looked genuinely curious after hearing that.
"Are you sure I can meet him in a few days?"
"He will open a restaurant in this capital in a few days, so I will take you there to meet him, and you can check him out yourself."
Guo Xuehua then stood up.
"All right, we will meet him in a few days, but we should join our husbands now."
Shi Qingzhuang immediately followed Guo Xuehua, and they soon arrived at another area, where Xian Feng was speaking with the Emperor of the Yun Kingdom, Yun Shang.
Unlike Xian Feng, who looked like a fighter, Yun Shang looked more like a scholar, but he also looked like a drunkard.
Even so, the aura that radiated from his body was like a calm cloud above the sky, but his drunken eyes looked fierce.
Guo Xuehua immediately massaged her forehead when she saw her husband.
"Husband, I have forbidden you to drink too much arrack, but you never listen to me."
"Haha." Yun Shang laughed upon hearing that.
"Wife, you know that I can never get drunk, no matter how much arrack I drink, so you don't need to mind it, right?
Anyway, Brother Feng told me about a young man, but he still hides his identity from me, so I think we should stay in this kingdom for a few days to meet him."
Both women immediately sat down beside their respective husbands, and Guo Xuehua spoke to her husband directly.
"Sister Qingzhuang also told me the young man, and I was curious about him, so I wanted to stay here for a few days."
"In that case, we will stay here for a few days and let my brother take care of our kingdom for a while."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei and Zhu Yan were discussing the restaurant, from the dishes to the waitresses and other things.
"Do you think the five of them are enough to help you?
Or do you still need help from other people?"
Zhu Yan took some time to think before responding to Zhang Fei.
"The five of them are actually enough to help me, but we are foreigners in this realm.
Moreover, you want to use them for your new organization, and they will probably go out often to do certain things, so I think we should find some female workers in this realm.
Additionally, you could create a large number of flyers and distribute them throughout the capital prior to the restaurant's opening."
"All right, I will do that, and I will pay some people to spread them." Zhang Fei suddenly had another idea and took out some beast meat.
"How about you cook some dishes?
The kitchen utensils and seasonings are already in the kitchen, and I will use my wind element to spread the aroma to various areas.
I am confident that the aroma of your dishes will pique people's curiosity, and their curiosity will grow once I distribute the flyers, so they will fill our restaurant during the opening day."
Zhu Yan immediately agreed with that and took those beast meats to the kitchen, and he began to prepare to cook some dishes.
Mei suddenly informed Zhang Fei about something.
[Master, I previously detected two powerful senses scanning this area, and I traced the source to the Xian Palace.]

Zhang Fei immediately opened the map and checked the Xian Palace; he found the two Emperors and Empresses of the two kingdoms gathered in one place. 'Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua should be the Emperor and Empress of the Yun Kingdom in the west.
I'm sure the two senses from before belonged to them, which means Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang told them about me.'
[They seem to be very close to each other, master.

Moreover, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang clearly have no ill intentions towards you, or else the dots on their names would not be green but red.] Zhang Fei did not refute Mei, especially since the dots on the names of people who were hostile towards him were always red.
[Maybe they have a special reason for telling Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua about you, and you will probably find out about their intentions on the opening day of your restaurant.]
'Yeah, you're right.

I'll wait for their arrival on the opening day, and we'll find out whether Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua will be hostile to me or not by then.' Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something. 'Mei, open the two easy gift packs from the previous two easy quests, and also the daily gift pack from yesterday.'
[All right.]
[You gained 50.000 beast essence.]
[You obtained 1 Huanying Mask.
Grade: Heaven.]
[You obtained 1 Hongxi Dagger.
Grade: Heaven]
'Oh?' Zhang Fei was slightly surprised to get two items, which were from the two easy gift packs. 'Show their description, Mei.'
[Huanying Mask: The user can conceal his or her aura completely when wearing this mask, and the mask will not be visible to others.]
[Hongxi Dagger: This dagger can steal Qi from opponents with every attack to restore the user's Qi.]
Zhang Fei immediately took the two pieces of equipment and put on the Huanying mask. 'This mask's material is incredibly light, and it doesn't feel like I'm wearing one.
As for this dagger, I'll try its effects later, and I hope the amount of Qi it steals is large enough, so I won't run out of Qi when fighting my enemies.'
Zhang Fei suddenly smelled the aroma of cooking from the kitchen because Zhu Yan had started cooking, so he immediately stored the two pieces of equipment and followed her there.
As originally planned, he used his wind element to spread the aroma of his cooking as far as possible, hoping to tempt the residents of the Xian Kingdom.

As Zhang Fei expected, people started to gather in front of the building, but none of them dared to approach or check inside with their senses, especially since they knew that it was a private building belonging to the royal family, leaving them wondering about the source of the cooking aroma.
"It seems your plan worked, Zhang Fei." Zhu Yan spoke after she heard the commotion from outside.
As he watched those people from the map, Zhang Fei nodded to Zhu Yan.
"After this, you can cook some other dishes and let them wonder more about your cooking."
"All right."
As time passed, the number of people gathered in front of the building continued to increase, particularly after Zhu Yan began cooking additional dishes.
Just like in the Sky Jade Realm, the people in the Nine Stars Realm never used spices like on earth to cook their food, so the aroma of her dishes was different from what they usually ate.

Seeing so many people gathered there, the guards were forced to move to disperse the crowds because their actions were making the area too crowded, and one of them immediately reported the problem to the Xian Palace.
Xian Feng, through one of his ministers, ordered the guard to let the people gather there.
He did that on purpose because he was aware of Zhang Fei's intentions, and he wanted to show him that they were on his side.

After Zhu Yan had completed her cooking and tidying up, Zhang Fei promptly used his warp portal to send her back to their residence, particularly considering the lingering crowd in front of the building.
Zhang Fei himself did not return there, but instead, he used his invisibility to leave the place.
He then went to look around the shops in the commerce and market districts to buy some items, especially the herbs that Zhang Lingxue needed to concoct pills.
"Hmm?" As soon as Zhang Fei entered his alchemy shop, the old man immediately looked at him.
"What can I do for you, young master?"

"Senior, my wife is an alchemist, and she wants to concoct some pills, so I want to buy some herbs." Zhang Fei then mentioned some herbs that Zhang Lingxue wanted, and the owner wrote them down one by one.
"Do you have them, Senior?"
The old man nodded to Zhang Fei.
"I have some of these herbs in stock, but I'm running low on some others, and you'll have to wait at least three days for my new stock to arrive.
Sorry if I'm being presumptuous, but can you tell me your wife's alchemist rank?
All these herbs are clearly not ingredients for concocting basic or intermediate rank pills, but rather high rank pills, which can only be concocted by alchemists from the Alchemy Union."
'Alchemy union?' Zhang Fei inwardly wondered.
"Forgive me, Senior.
I have no knowledge about alchemy, and I have never asked my wife about her rank in alchemy.
Anyway, can you tell me about the alchemy union?"

chapters.title: Chapter 522 Alchemy Union
paragraphs: "Young master, my name is Lian Jinshu, and I am a representative of the alchemy union." The old man then took out a badge with the symbol of an alchemy furnace and some writings on it. "The alchemy union is spread across all the planets within the middle realms, and our organization controls the marketing of all alchemy products.

If alchemists want to sell their alchemy products to the public, then they must register as our members, and we will assess whether their products are marketable or not. If their products are marketable, we will issue a certificate enabling them to sell them, and vice versa."

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly after hearing that, especially since it was similar to the requirements on earth, but each country on earth has their own authority to issue marketable certificates unless they want to sell their products in other countries.

However, the alchemy union is more difficult than the countries on earth because there are so many planets in the middle realms, and they completely control the market for alchemy products. "As long as we don't sell pills or anything else to the public, it's fine if we don't join the alchemy union, right?"

"Yes." Lian Jinshu nodded to Zhang Fei. Alchemists can use pills or anything for themselves or their families, but they must join with us to trade them. If they sell their products without our permission and our higher-ups find out about it, then they will send people to arrest them for trial.
If their mistakes are too serious, then they won't be able to do alchemy again for the rest of their lives, and they will face more severe punishment if they violate the higher-ups' decision."

Zhang Fei was furious after hearing that, especially since he had plans to sell pills and others in the Xian Kingdom, but he was now faced with excessive regulations. He felt that the alchemy union's actions to capture alchemists who did not have permission to sell their products were too excessive, let alone prohibiting them from practicing alchemy for the rest of their lives.
"Does that mean the royal family can't sell alchemy products either?"

"No." Lian Jinshu then explained to Zhang Fei again. "The alchemy union is an independent organization that specializes in supervising alchemists and alchemy products, and we are not tied to any kingdom, so the royal family must adhere to our rules. If they don't follow our rules, we'll stop supplying alchemy products to their kingdom."
'Such a selfish and authoritarian organization, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he pondered new plans to sell alchemy products. "Does my wife have to register with the alchemy union?"

"As long as your wife doesn't intend to sell alchemy products, she doesn't need to register with the alchemy union." Lian Jinshu's answer relieved Zhang Fei. "However, it would be beneficial for her to register as a member of our organization, particularly as it would provide her with numerous advantages.

She could meet other alchemists with excellent alchemy skills to further develop herself in the field, and she would have access to several things, such as getting extremely rare ingredients, selling her products freely, and many other benefits.
After all, the price of alchemy ingredients and products is not cheap; even extremely rare herbs and high-ranking products can cost millions or hundreds of millions of gold coins."

Zhang Fei naturally already knew about it; even the basic pills in the system shop cost him so many jewels, let alone the usable pills, the beauty restoring pill, the youthful retaining pill, and those beast pills. That's why he wanted to set up an alchemy shop with Zhang Lingxue as his alchemist, so he collected more money in a short time. 'Tch!

The alchemy union thinks too highly of themselves and acts arbitrarily.' "If I may ask, where is the main headquarters of that organization? Who is the leader? Does the alchemy union have representatives in every kingdom?"

"To be honest, we don't know who our leader is, but he is the most skilled alchemist in the middle realms, and only our superiors are aware of his identity." Lian Jinshu's answer made Zhang Fei feel that the alchemy union was too mysterious. "Our main headquarters is in the Shrouded Sky Realm, which is directly adjacent to the outermost planet of the upper realms.

As for our representatives, we have one representative in each of the human kingdoms, except for the Huangfu Kingdom. However, we do not have representatives in the beast kingdom, the natural races' kingdom, or the two demon kingdoms."

'Heh! They still know their limits, huh? The beast emperor and the elf emperor seem to be stronger than the leader of the alchemy union, so they can't force their will on them. As for the two demon emperors, they are probably afraid of dying in their hands, so they don't dare to find trouble with them.' Zhang Fei then questioned Lian Jinshu once more. "Have you heard of the Huo Clan, Senior?
They are an alchemist clan, and I heard that their abilities in alchemy are unrivaled."

Lian Jinshu immediately searched for information about the Huo Clan in his memories, but he remembered for sure that he had never heard of that clan in the alchemy world of the middle realms. "Are you sure that the clan is an alchemist clan? If they are an alchemist clan, I have definitely heard of them before."

'Old foolish! The Huo Clan is an alchemist clan from the upper realm, so you have never heard of their name in these middle realms, and their abilities are far superior to your punny alchemy union.' Zhang Fei made a sarcastic remark to himself. "They are indeed an alchemist clan, but they might not be members of your organization, so you might not be aware of them.

Thank you for your information, Senior. My wife and I do not wish to be tied to any organization, and we will not sell her products to the public, so she will not join your organization. Regardless, we need those herbs to aid our cultivation, so I hope you can provide them for us."

Lian Jinshu put on a disappointed face before speaking. "It's a pity that a talented alchemist like your wife, who can concoct high-rank pills, is unwilling to join us. However, that is your choice, and I can understand it. Do you want to buy the herbs that are already available? Or do you want to wait for other herbs and buy them all at once?"
"I'll wait for the other herbs and buy them all at once, so I'll come to see you again in a week."
"All right." Lian Jinshu nodded and put away the list of herbs. "I will collect them first, and you can buy them at that time."
"Thank you, Senior."

After Zhang Fei left, Lian Jinshu immediately took out a communication device and ordered someone to follow him. "Where did that kid and his wife actually come from? Why have I never heard of a high-ranking alchemist in this kingdom before? The best alchemist in this realm lives in the Bai Kingdom, but I know all her disciples, and his wife shouldn't be one of them.
Forget it; I will wait for information from that guy, and I will know his wife's identity soon."

Zhang Fei naturally noticed Lian Jinshu's actions, so he continued to monitor his map as he looked at another shop, which was a forging materials shop. 'That old fool underestimates me! I will wait for the person he ordered to follow me.'
"Are you interested in blacksmithing, Kid?" The owner of the forging shop, a middle-aged man with a tall and large stature, suddenly asked Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei immediately looked at the man. "Honestly, I am interested in blacksmithing, Senior. Unfortunately, I don't have a mentor to teach me in that field, so I have no knowledge about it."

"Come in." After he led Zhang Fei to enter his shop, the middle-aged man immediately turned around and examined his body, starting from his shoulders, arms, and several other parts. "You are a body cultivator in the skin refining stage, correct?"

"Yes, Senior. I haven't been a body cultivator for a long time, so my level of body cultivation is currently low." Zhang Fei immediately introduced himself to the middle-aged man. "My name is Zhang Fei. How should I address you, Senior?"

"My name is Gang Zhishou, but people call me Old Gang, the Iron Hands, so you can call me the same as them." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, and Gang Zhishou immediately continued his assessment. "Your bone age indicates that you are still 20 years old, and while your body cultivation is still in its early stages, your physique is more refined than some body cultivators I know.
With your current physique, you should be able to learn blacksmithing, but it is not easy to learn, and you need great perseverance and imagination."
"I comprehend the concept of perseverance, but how does imagination relate to blacksmithing, Old Gang?" Zhang Fei inquired, his expression bewildered.

"Hahaha." Gang Zhishou laughed and led Zhang Fei toward one of the walls. "As you can see, each weapon or equipment has different models. If you don't use your imagination to forge them, all of your equipment will have the same shape, making them less attractive to buyers.

Although their functions are basically the same, everyone definitely wants to have their own unique characteristics, so they won't buy weapons or other equipment that are similar to other people. Moreover, the weapons and equipment used by men and women differ, necessitating the imagination and understanding of each person's physical characteristics; only then can one become a skilled blacksmith."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Do you know Senior Duan Zhao, Old Gang?"
"Oh?" Gang Zhishou turned to Zhang Fei in surprise. "Have you met my master before?"

"Is Senior Duan Zhao really your master?" Gang Zhishou nodded to Zhang Fei. "Actually, I have never met him, but I heard his name from Prince Xianwu. In fact, I thought about going to see him, but he lives too far from this capital, and I still have to prepare for the opening of my restaurant. That's why I delayed going to see him, but I didn't expect to meet his disciple here."
"Are you close friends with Prince Xianwu?"

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at Gang Zhishou. "I only met Prince Xianwu once, but I could see that he was different from the other princesses, and he told me many things, one of which was about Senior Duan Zhao."

"I see." Gang Zhishou nodded in understanding and patted Zhang Fei's shoulder. "If you want to meet my master to learn about blacksmithing, then you should forget about your intentions, especially since he has long decided not to take a new disciple.
Instead, I can teach you if you are interested in learning it, and I got all my knowledge from him, so it's the same whether you learn from me or my master."

"Yes, Old Gang! I want to learn blacksmithing from you." Zhang Fei immediately decided on it without thinking twice. In fact, he wanted to learn blacksmithing from Tie Xuan, especially since he came from the upper realms. However, he had no desire to join his Tie Clan, so he gave up on his intention. "Should I address you as my master?"

"No need." Gang Zhishou responded with a dismissive shake of his head and guided Zhang Fei to the backyard of his shop. "Having a disciple is really a hassle for me, so I'm not interested in having one." Moreover, my master allows me and his other disciples to share his blacksmithing techniques with people who truly have an interest in blacksmithing.
Seeing your genuine interest in blacksmithing, I decided to teach you."

Suddenly, Gang Zhishou pulled out five iron hammers of varying sizes from his storage ring and dropped them onto the ground, producing several loud bangs. One of them caused Zhang Fei to be stunned, especially since its size was so big and heavy that it made the ground beneath it dip.

Gang Zhishou then took the smallest hammer and showed it to Zhang Fei. "Even though the size of the hammer is small, my master forged it using special materials, and they weigh 250 pounds. Before I begin teaching you blacksmithing, I want you to practice swinging each hammer one by one, without relying on your cultivation, until you can swing them effortlessly."
Zhang Fei immediately received the smallest hammer from Gang Zhishou's hand, but the weight of 250 pounds was not a problem for him, and he right away swung it again and again.

Gang Zhishou didn't seem surprised by that, especially since he had already checked Zhang Fei's physique before, and he would be disappointed if he couldn't swing the smallest hammer. "Try swinging the second hammer; it weighs 500 pounds."

Zhang Fei immediately returned the hammer in his hand to Gang Zhishou and picked up the second hammer from the ground, and he also found no difficulty in swinging it repeatedly. "This hammer may be quite heavy for others, but it still feels light to me, Old Gang."

"Try the third hammer." Zhang Fei immediately followed Gang Zhishou's order, and he once again swung the 750-pound hammer without any difficulty, especially since he was already used to the level four gravity feature. 'I don't know how he trained himself, but his physique and raw strength are stronger than I had previously expected.

Back then, it took me two years to be able to adapt to the weight of the third hammer, but he was able to swing it in one try.' "Try the fourth hammer, but you don't need to force yourself, especially since it weighs 1000 pounds."

"All right." After he put down the third hammer, Zhang Fei immediately tried to lift the fourth hammer, but Gang Zhishou's expression tensed up. 'It should be easy for me to lift it, but it would be better if I held myself back for now.'

Gang Zhishou let out a sigh of relief in his heart when he saw Zhang Fei struggling to lift the fourth hammer, and he immediately stopped him. "All right, the weight of the hammer is still too heavy for you now, so you can stop. Moreover, your ability to swing a 750-pound weight is already good, and you can start learning blacksmithing."

Gang Zhishou then touched Zhang Fei's forehead and shared a forging technique with him. "For the time being, I want you to read and study the Thousand Ways of Forging first, and you can come to me again in a week."
"Are you planning to be away for a week, Old Gang?"
Gang Zhishou nodded to Zhang Fei. "My previous master summoned me to meet him, so I have to go to Heian town right now, or he will punish me."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed hearing that. "Is Senior Duan Zhao a tough person?"

Gang Zhishou let out a heavy sigh as he nodded his head at Zhang Fei. "My master is the strictest and harshest person I have ever met. Even after I became independent, he would not hesitate to punish me if I was late answering his summons, and his punishments were really harsh, so I have to leave now.
Anyway, you can bring the fourth hammer with you, so you can try lifting and swinging it at home later."
Zhang Fei immediately put the hammer into the storage ring. "All right, I will study everything first, and I will see you again in a week."
After he put away the other hammers, Gang Zhishou immediately led Zhang Fei out of his shop, and he hurriedly left the capital afterward.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was walking towards the south gate, examining his map, when he noticed a man following him from a distance. 'That guy must be Lian Jinshu's subordinate, and his cultivation is at the 5-Star Earth Realm. Hey! Let's see if you can follow me!'
