"All right." Lian Jinshu nodded and put away the list of herbs.
"I will collect them first, and you can buy them at that time."
"Thank you, Senior."
After Zhang Fei left, Lian Jinshu immediately took out a communication device and ordered someone to follow him.
"Where did that kid and his wife actually come from?
Why have I never heard of a high-ranking alchemist in this kingdom before?
The best alchemist in this realm lives in the Bai Kingdom, but I know all her disciples, and his wife shouldn't be one of them.
Forget it; I will wait for information from that guy, and I will know his wife's identity soon."
Zhang Fei naturally noticed Lian Jinshu's actions, so he continued to monitor his map as he looked at another shop, which was a forging materials shop. 'That old fool underestimates me!
I will wait for the person he ordered to follow me.'
"Are you interested in blacksmithing, Kid?" The owner of the forging shop, a middle-aged man with a tall and large stature, suddenly asked Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei immediately looked at the man.
"Honestly, I am interested in blacksmithing, Senior.
Unfortunately, I don't have a mentor to teach me in that field, so I have no knowledge about it."
"Come in." After he led Zhang Fei to enter his shop, the middle-aged man immediately turned around and examined his body, starting from his shoulders, arms, and several other parts.
"You are a body cultivator in the skin refining stage, correct?"
"Yes, Senior.
I haven't been a body cultivator for a long time, so my level of body cultivation is currently low." Zhang Fei immediately introduced himself to the middle-aged man.
"My name is Zhang Fei.
How should I address you, Senior?"
"My name is Gang Zhishou, but people call me Old Gang, the Iron Hands, so you can call me the same as them." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, and Gang Zhishou immediately continued his assessment.
"Your bone age indicates that you are still 20 years old, and while your body cultivation is still in its early stages, your physique is more refined than some body cultivators I know.
With your current physique, you should be able to learn blacksmithing, but it is not easy to learn, and you need great perseverance and imagination."
"I comprehend the concept of perseverance, but how does imagination relate to blacksmithing, Old Gang?" Zhang Fei inquired, his expression bewildered.
"Hahaha." Gang Zhishou laughed and led Zhang Fei toward one of the walls.
"As you can see, each weapon or equipment has different models.
If you don't use your imagination to forge them, all of your equipment will have the same shape, making them less attractive to buyers.
Although their functions are basically the same, everyone definitely wants to have their own unique characteristics, so they won't buy weapons or other equipment that are similar to other people.

Moreover, the weapons and equipment used by men and women differ, necessitating the imagination and understanding of each person's physical characteristics; only then can one become a skilled blacksmith."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"Do you know Senior Duan Zhao, Old Gang?"
"Oh?" Gang Zhishou turned to Zhang Fei in surprise.
"Have you met my master before?"
"Is Senior Duan Zhao really your master?" Gang Zhishou nodded to Zhang Fei.
"Actually, I have never met him, but I heard his name from Prince Xianwu.
In fact, I thought about going to see him, but he lives too far from this capital, and I still have to prepare for the opening of my restaurant.
That's why I delayed going to see him, but I didn't expect to meet his disciple here."
"Are you close friends with Prince Xianwu?"
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at Gang Zhishou.
"I only met Prince Xianwu once, but I could see that he was different from the other princesses, and he told me many things, one of which was about Senior Duan Zhao."
"I see." Gang Zhishou nodded in understanding and patted Zhang Fei's shoulder.
"If you want to meet my master to learn about blacksmithing, then you should forget about your intentions, especially since he has long decided not to take a new disciple.
Instead, I can teach you if you are interested in learning it, and I got all my knowledge from him, so it's the same whether you learn from me or my master."
"Yes, Old Gang!
I want to learn blacksmithing from you." Zhang Fei immediately decided on it without thinking twice.
In fact, he wanted to learn blacksmithing from Tie Xuan, especially since he came from the upper realms.
However, he had no desire to join his Tie Clan, so he gave up on his intention.
"Should I address you as my master?"
"No need." Gang Zhishou responded with a dismissive shake of his head and guided Zhang Fei to the backyard of his shop.

"Having a disciple is really a hassle for me, so I'm not interested in having one." Moreover, my master allows me and his other disciples to share his blacksmithing techniques with people who truly have an interest in blacksmithing.
Seeing your genuine interest in blacksmithing, I decided to teach you."
Suddenly, Gang Zhishou pulled out five iron hammers of varying sizes from his storage ring and dropped them onto the ground, producing several loud bangs.
One of them caused Zhang Fei to be stunned, especially since its size was so big and heavy that it made the ground beneath it dip.
Gang Zhishou then took the smallest hammer and showed it to Zhang Fei.
"Even though the size of the hammer is small, my master forged it using special materials, and they weigh 250 pounds.
Before I begin teaching you blacksmithing, I want you to practice swinging each hammer one by one, without relying on your cultivation, until you can swing them effortlessly."
Zhang Fei immediately received the smallest hammer from Gang Zhishou's hand, but the weight of 250 pounds was not a problem for him, and he right away swung it again and again.
Gang Zhishou didn't seem surprised by that, especially since he had already checked Zhang Fei's physique before, and he would be disappointed if he couldn't swing the smallest hammer.
"Try swinging the second hammer; it weighs 500 pounds."
Zhang Fei immediately returned the hammer in his hand to Gang Zhishou and picked up the second hammer from the ground, and he also found no difficulty in swinging it repeatedly.
"This hammer may be quite heavy for others, but it still feels light to me, Old Gang."

"Try the third hammer." Zhang Fei immediately followed Gang Zhishou's order, and he once again swung the 750-pound hammer without any difficulty, especially since he was already used to the level four gravity feature. 'I don't know how he trained himself, but his physique and raw strength are stronger than I had previously expected.

Back then, it took me two years to be able to adapt to the weight of the third hammer, but he was able to swing it in one try.' "Try the fourth hammer, but you don't need to force yourself, especially since it weighs 1000 pounds."

"All right." After he put down the third hammer, Zhang Fei immediately tried to lift the fourth hammer, but Gang Zhishou's expression tensed up. 'It should be easy for me to lift it, but it would be better if I held myself back for now.'
Gang Zhishou let out a sigh of relief in his heart when he saw Zhang Fei struggling to lift the fourth hammer, and he immediately stopped him.
"All right, the weight of the hammer is still too heavy for you now, so you can stop.
Moreover, your ability to swing a 750-pound weight is already good, and you can start learning blacksmithing."
Gang Zhishou then touched Zhang Fei's forehead and shared a forging technique with him.
"For the time being, I want you to read and study the Thousand Ways of Forging first, and you can come to me again in a week."
"Are you planning to be away for a week, Old Gang?"
Gang Zhishou nodded to Zhang Fei.
"My previous master summoned me to meet him, so I have to go to Heian town right now, or he will punish me."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed hearing that.
"Is Senior Duan Zhao a tough person?"
Gang Zhishou let out a heavy sigh as he nodded his head at Zhang Fei.
"My master is the strictest and harshest person I have ever met.
Even after I became independent, he would not hesitate to punish me if I was late answering his summons, and his punishments were really harsh, so I have to leave now.
Anyway, you can bring the fourth hammer with you, so you can try lifting and swinging it at home later."
Zhang Fei immediately put the hammer into the storage ring.
"All right, I will study everything first, and I will see you again in a week."
After he put away the other hammers, Gang Zhishou immediately led Zhang Fei out of his shop, and he hurriedly left the capital afterward.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was walking towards the south gate, examining his map, when he noticed a man following him from a distance. 'That guy must be Lian Jinshu's subordinate, and his cultivation is at the 5-Star Earth Realm.
Hey!
Let's see if you can follow me!'

chapters.title: Chapter 523 Lian Jinshu's Subordinates
paragraphs: 'Who exactly is this kid? Why do the kingdom guards seem to respect him? Although his cultivation is four minor levels below mine, his speed surpasses mine, and I have to use my cultivation just to keep up with him.' The man wondered to himself as he followed Zhang Fei out of the Xian Kingdom through the southgate.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei leisurely walked along the path ahead of him, not using any of his cultivation or movement techniques. However, the pressure of the sixteen times heavier gravity that his two clones had endured for a full month had a significant impact on him.

His normal speed has already surpassed many strong cultivators, and if he uses his movement techniques, even a cultivator as strong as Xian Feng may not be able to keep up with him, let alone an earth cultivator like the man.
[Do you intend to do something to that guy, Master? Why did you deliberately lure him to a quiet place?]

'Don't you know all my thoughts, Mei? Why are you still asking me?' Zhang Fei's answer left the AI speechless. 'I don't know whether that guy is part of the alchemy union or not, but Lian Jinshu definitely doesn't have good intentions towards me, and he might report my presence to his organization. That's why I need someone to keep an eye on him; that guy is my best choice for now.'

After he walked quite far from the Xian Empire and arrived at an empty place, Zhang Fei immediately stopped walking and looked in a certain direction. "I hate it when people stalk me the most, so you should come out now, or I'll force you out."
The man was shocked to hear that, but he still didn't want to come out or answer Zhang Fei. Instead, he took out his communication device.

Before the man had time to contact someone, Zhang Fei suddenly moved in front of him and snatched his communication device. Without giving him a chance to react, he kicked his chest, propelling him backward.

'Fuck! The power of his kick really hurts!' The man cursed to himself as he landed on the ground before staggering backward, but Zhang Fei had already moved in front of him and kicked his chest once again. "Guah!"
*Bam*

The man repeatedly rolled back on the ground before jumping up and stabilizing himself. He rubbed his chest in pain and stared at Zhang Fei with a shocked expression. 'Shit! My cultivation is higher than his, but I can't keep up with his speed. Moreover, he clearly held back his strength, but his punch was truly painful.'
"What did Lian Jinshu order you to do to stalk me?" Zhang Fei then took out the Hongxi dagger and pointed at the man. "You better answer me now, especially since I'm an impatient person."
Instead, the man pulled out a red spear, which had a long chain and a sword at its end. He immediately unleashed his full strength and dashed toward Zhang Fei.
*Clang*
Zhang Fei immediately blocked the spearhead with his dagger, but the man swiftly pulled his spear back before thrusting it at him several times at once.
Unfortunately, the man's movements were like slow motion in Zhang Fei's eyes, so he was able to parry all of his attacks without breaking a sweat.

Suddenly, the man leaped high into the air, and three of his clones appeared in different directions. The four of them dived towards Zhang Fei before thrusting their spears at him, but their attacks passed through his body and plunged straight into the ground.
*Bam*

"You're really stubborn, huh?" Hearing Zhang Fei's voice from behind startled the man, causing him to try to jump away. However, he immediately slashed the hongxi dagger at his calves, causing both of them to bleed.

'Shit!' The man staggered as he landed in the distance, his expression filled with pain as he looked at his calves. 'His dagger must be a high level artifact, or it wouldn't have been able to penetrate my qi protection.'

Zhang Fei smiled faintly after he experienced the effects of the hongxi dagger, especially since it stole quite a lot of the man's qi, even though he only attacked him with a normal attack.'Hey! I love the effect!'
'Damn it! I have to run away from him, or he'll kill me!' The moment the man pulled out his returning jade, Zhang Fei sprang into action, snatching it and his red spear. "You-"

"Argh!" After the hongxi dagger pierced his right shoulder, the man screamed in pain, but Zhang Fei immediately kicked him backwards, pulling the dagger out of his shoulder and causing blood to spurt from it.
*Swish*
Zhang Fei immediately threw the man's red spear at him, and it penetrated his right thigh directly, causing him to fall backwards onto his back.

"Argh!" Zhang Fei didn't stop there, but instead, he jumped onto the spear's tip, causing it to penetrate the man's right thigh deeper until it penetrated the ground beneath him. "Argh! Stop... stop... please...."

Zhang Fei glared coldly at the man as he released his killing intent, causing him to tremble in horror. "I told you from the start that I was an impatient person, and you only needed to tell me the purpose of Lian Jinshu ordering you to stalk me, but you were too stubborn and attacked me first."

"He... he ordered me to look for information about your wife, and he asked me to bring her to him if I had the chance." The man's answer caused Zhang Fei's face to darken, especially since he hated it the most when people targeted anyone among his wives or family members. "Young master... please... spare me... I'm just carrying out my master's orders."
"Spare you?" Zhang Fei asked with narrow eyes. "Do you think I will spare you after you target my wife?"
"Young master, I-" Zhang Fei didn't give the man a chance to beg. He jumped down, strangled his neck, and immediately used the life-force absorption against him. "Argh!"

Since he still needed the man, Zhang Fei didn't kill him and stopped immediately when he looked so weak after losing a lot of his life force. He then touched his chest, implanted the demon slave mark into his soul, and altered some of his memories to ensure his loyalty to him.

"Argh!" The man screamed in pain again after he pulled the spear out of his thigh, but Zhang Fei immediately gave him some healing pills to heal his wounds, which he swallowed all at once. "Thank... thank you, master."
"What's your name? Why did Lian Jinshu ask you to bring my wife to him?"

"Situ Yi." The man immediately sat on the ground while enduring the pain in his shoulder and thigh. "Master, the Alchemy Union has ordered Lian Jinshu to bring all the best alchemists to join them, and he will receive good rewards if he succeeds in doing so."
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows at that statement. "So the alchemy union often recruits alchemists by force?"
"Yes." Situ Yi nodded to Zhang Fei. "They want to monopolize the alchemy products market, so they want the best alchemists to join them, even by force."
"Tch! They're just greedy humans!" Zhang Fei irritably muttered. "Are you also part of the alchemy union? How many people are in your group?"

Situ Yi hurriedly answered him. "Master, I am part of the alchemy union, but I do not have any status within the organization, and I am only part of the guard group. Every representative of the organization was given five guards, so there are still four others besides me in the capital."
"Only five?" Situ Yi nodded to Zhang Fei again. "Where do they live? Who is the strongest among them? What is that person's cultivation level?"

"Master, we don't stay in one place; we spread out on every side of the capital and disguise ourselves as workers." Situ Yi's answer surprised Zhang Fei a little. "Actually, I am the weakest among them, and the strongest among us is Huan Ya because her cultivation has reached the quasi-divine realm."
Zhang Fei's expression became serious after he heard that, especially since Huan Ya was too strong for him. "Quasi-divine realm, huh? What about the strength of the other three?"

"Dugu Yun's cultivation is at the 10-Star Saint Realm, Li Sanxi's cultivation is at the 10-Star Ancestor Realm, and Xiu Tian's cultivation is at the 10-Star Heaven Realm. They all use artifacts to disguise their cultivation, so Emperor Xian won't suspect them."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei was shocked, as he didn't expect that the alchemy union would give Lian Jinshu five powerful guards, and their cultivation had reached the peak of each level. However, he was also confused by his decision to send Situ Yi. "If the four of them were that powerful, why did he send you to follow me? Won't it be better if he sent one of them?"

Situ Yi shook his head and proceeded to explain. "The alchemy union has strict rules, and Lian Jianshi can only send us according to the strength of our target. Since your cultivation is at the 1-Star Earth Realm, he sent me to tail you. However, he has the authority to order us to move together in certain situations, especially when powerful cultivators surround our target."
"Does that mean Huan Ya rarely makes a move?"

"Yes." Situ Yi nodded in response. "Over the years, Huan Ya has only made a move once because her target is an alchemist with cultivation in the quasi-divine realm, and she managed to capture that person with her unique ability."
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly. "Unique ability?"
"Master, I don't know about Huan Ya's ability, so I can't explain it to you."
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh. "Go back! Report to Lian Jinshu that Emperor Xian's subordinates are protecting me, and they're the ones who attacked you."
"Eh?" Situ Yi was surprised to hear that.

"I won't explain it to you in detail, but I do have a relationship with Emperor Xian, his wife, and their two children." After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately used his Nine Cloud Steps and disappeared from Situ Yi's sight.

"I didn't expect that my master would have a relationship with the royal family, and Lian Jinshu had made a fatal mistake by offending him." Situ Yi immediately picked up his spear and stood up. "Sigh! If my master hadn't given me healing pills, my wounds wouldn't have healed this quickly."

Some time after Situ Yi left the place, two old men appeared, exchanged a brief glance, and then burst out laughing. "That kid is really cunning, Old Feng! He deliberately used the name of the royal family to protect himself."

Old Feng nodded in agreement with his friend. "Old Wen, the people from the alchemy union are still too strong for him, so he has no choice but to do that. However, I am truly curious as to how he managed to increase his speed to such a high level, as my senses can't keep up with his movements."

"That kid is no ordinary cultivator; even with our cultivation in the 1-Moon Divine Expansion, he can deceive our senses." Old Wen then sighed softly. "No wonder our emperor was eager to bring him to his side; he even asked the two of us to protect him and his family. I think we don't need to make too many moves, and he should be able to fight against heaven realm cultivators."

"You're right." Old Feng replied while nodding. "With his current speed, I'm sure that cultivators with cultivation at the quasi-divine realm won't be able to catch up to him, so he should be able to escape if those bunch of brats chase after him. However, his wives probably won't be able to escape from them, so we should focus on protecting them."
"Let's go back; we have to report this matter to our Emperor." The two old men immediately disappeared from the place again.

Zhang Fei had already arrived at their residence and sat opposite Zhang Lingxue; he explained to her about Lian Jinshu and the alchemy union. "I made a blunder by going to that old man's shop, and those people will definitely keep targeting us from now on.

I have ordered Situ Yi to report to him that Emperor Xian's people are protecting us, but I don't think they will be deterred by that, so we should always be on guard against them. As for my plan to open an alchemy shop, I think I should cancel it, or else we will face the people of that organization head-on."

"I think that's the best choice, so we don't need to add any more enemies." Zhang Lingxue then gave her idea. "Since the presence of representatives from the alchemy union prevents us from opening an alchemy shop in the Xian Kingdom or other human kingdoms, what do you think about opening one on one of the other islands?"
"Other islands?"

"Yes." Zhang Lingxue nodded to Zhang Fei. "I have the Fire Phoenix bloodline, so I think I can go to the Beast Kingdom. Moreover, we have your teleportation devices, so I can go back and forth between the two islands freely. Additionally, you can contact Senior Oliver and the others in the kingdom of the natural races and ask them to gather information about the alchemy shops within that kingdom.
If there aren't many shops there, we might be able to open one, and we can leave the shop management to them."

"Your plan to open an alchemy shop in the natural races' kingdom is plausible, but I'm not sure about the beast kingdom." Zhang Fei then pulled Zhang Lingxue onto his lap. "You do have the Fire Phoenix bloodline, but you are still an ordinary human. Meanwhile, Long Huang and his wife are true dragons, and your bloodline will be useless against them.
We do need a lot of money to buy various best resources for our cultivation, but your safety is the most important to me, so I will not take the risk of sending you there."

"Hehe." Zhang Lingxue giggled and kissed Zhang Fei for a brief moment. "All right then, I won't go to the beast kingdom; instead, I will focus on my alchemy in our residence. After you get those herbs, I will concoct some pills that are suitable for us. Anyway, you should contact Senior Oliver and the others right now, and I will help the others with their training again."

After Zhang Lingxue left, Zhang Fei immediately contacted Oliver and the others to discuss the matter with them, but they told him that they had not yet gone to the big towns, and they were still staying in a small town near the edge of the island. Even so, they did not reject his plan, and they told him they would try to do it as soon as possible.

After cutting off communication with them, Zhang Fei immediately contacted Hu Yue through the harem feature, and the female fox told her that Hu Dong was getting impatient to take her as his wife. 'That damn guy! How dare he think of taking my lovely fox as his wife! I will come over and skin him alive if he dares to force you to marry him, and I will use his skin to make a bag!'

{Hehe! You don't have to worry too much about Hu Dong; he wouldn't dare to force me to marry him with his cultivation still below mine.} Hu Yue was then silent for a while before asking Zhang Fei. {Are you interested in my mother?}
'Didn't I tell you before that I was interested in Lili? Unfortunately, your mother rejected me, but I didn't want to force her to accept me.'
{In that case, you have to think of something, especially since Hu Gao told my mother that he would take her as his wife soon.}
Zhang Fei's face darkened after hearing that. 'Yue'er, I'll go there right now, so tell your mother to meet me outside.'
{All right, I will inform her straight away.}

"The alchemy union has strict rules, and Lian Jianshi can only send us according to the strength of our target.
Since your cultivation is at the 1-Star Earth Realm, he sent me to tail you.
However, he has the authority to order us to move together in certain situations, especially when powerful cultivators surround our target."
"Does that mean Huan Ya rarely makes a move?"
"Yes." Situ Yi nodded in response.
"Over the years, Huan Ya has only made a move once because her target is an alchemist with cultivation in the quasi-divine realm, and she managed to capture that person with her unique ability."
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly.
"Unique ability?"
"Master, I don't know about Huan Ya's ability, so I can't explain it to you."
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh.
"Go back!
Report to Lian Jinshu that Emperor Xian's subordinates are protecting me, and they're the ones who attacked you."
"Eh?" Situ Yi was surprised to hear that.

"I won't explain it to you in detail, but I do have a relationship with Emperor Xian, his wife, and their two children." After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately used his Nine Cloud Steps and disappeared from Situ Yi's sight.
"I didn't expect that my master would have a relationship with the royal family, and Lian Jinshu had made a fatal mistake by offending him." Situ Yi immediately picked up his spear and stood up.
"Sigh!
If my master hadn't given me healing pills, my wounds wouldn't have healed this quickly."
Some time after Situ Yi left the place, two old men appeared, exchanged a brief glance, and then burst out laughing.
"That kid is really cunning, Old Feng!
He deliberately used the name of the royal family to protect himself."
Old Feng nodded in agreement with his friend.
"Old Wen, the people from the alchemy union are still too strong for him, so he has no choice but to do that.
However, I am truly curious as to how he managed to increase his speed to such a high level, as my senses can't keep up with his movements."
"That kid is no ordinary cultivator; even with our cultivation in the 1-Moon Divine Expansion, he can deceive our senses." Old Wen then sighed softly.
"No wonder our emperor was eager to bring him to his side; he even asked the two of us to protect him and his family.
I think we don't need to make too many moves, and he should be able to fight against heaven realm cultivators."
"You're right." Old Feng replied while nodding.
"With his current speed, I'm sure that cultivators with cultivation at the quasi-divine realm won't be able to catch up to him, so he should be able to escape if those bunch of brats chase after him.
However, his wives probably won't be able to escape from them, so we should focus on protecting them."
"Let's go back; we have to report this matter to our Emperor." The two old men immediately disappeared from the place again.
Zhang Fei had already arrived at their residence and sat opposite Zhang Lingxue; he explained to her about Lian Jinshu and the alchemy union.
"I made a blunder by going to that old man's shop, and those people will definitely keep targeting us from now on.
I have ordered Situ Yi to report to him that Emperor Xian's people are protecting us, but I don't think they will be deterred by that, so we should always be on guard against them.
As for my plan to open an alchemy shop, I think I should cancel it, or else we will face the people of that organization head-on."
"I think that's the best choice, so we don't need to add any more enemies." Zhang Lingxue then gave her idea.

"Since the presence of representatives from the alchemy union prevents us from opening an alchemy shop in the Xian Kingdom or other human kingdoms, what do you think about opening one on one of the other islands?"
"Other islands?"
"Yes." Zhang Lingxue nodded to Zhang Fei.
"I have the Fire Phoenix bloodline, so I think I can go to the Beast Kingdom.
Moreover, we have your teleportation devices, so I can go back and forth between the two islands freely.
Additionally, you can contact Senior Oliver and the others in the kingdom of the natural races and ask them to gather information about the alchemy shops within that kingdom.
If there aren't many shops there, we might be able to open one, and we can leave the shop management to them."
"Your plan to open an alchemy shop in the natural races' kingdom is plausible, but I'm not sure about the beast kingdom." Zhang Fei then pulled Zhang Lingxue onto his lap.
"You do have the Fire Phoenix bloodline, but you are still an ordinary human.
Meanwhile, Long Huang and his wife are true dragons, and your bloodline will be useless against them.
We do need a lot of money to buy various best resources for our cultivation, but your safety is the most important to me, so I will not take the risk of sending you there."
"Hehe." Zhang Lingxue giggled and kissed Zhang Fei for a brief moment.
"All right then, I won't go to the beast kingdom; instead, I will focus on my alchemy in our residence.
After you get those herbs, I will concoct some pills that are suitable for us.
Anyway, you should contact Senior Oliver and the others right now, and I will help the others with their training again."

After Zhang Lingxue left, Zhang Fei immediately contacted Oliver and the others to discuss the matter with them, but they told him that they had not yet gone to the big towns, and they were still staying in a small town near the edge of the island.
Even so, they did not reject his plan, and they told him they would try to do it as soon as possible.

After cutting off communication with them, Zhang Fei immediately contacted Hu Yue through the harem feature, and the female fox told her that Hu Dong was getting impatient to take her as his wife. 'That damn guy!
How dare he think of taking my lovely fox as his wife!
I will come over and skin him alive if he dares to force you to marry him, and I will use his skin to make a bag!'
{Hehe!

You don't have to worry too much about Hu Dong; he wouldn't dare to force me to marry him with his cultivation still below mine.} Hu Yue was then silent for a while before asking Zhang Fei. {Are you interested in my mother?}
'Didn't I tell you before that I was interested in Lili?
Unfortunately, your mother rejected me, but I didn't want to force her to accept me.'
{In that case, you have to think of something, especially since Hu Gao told my mother that he would take her as his wife soon.}
Zhang Fei's face darkened after hearing that. 'Yue'er, I'll go there right now, so tell your mother to meet me outside.'
{All right, I will inform her straight away.}

chapters.title: Chapter 524 Revisit The Moon Fox's Sub-Realm
paragraphs: Situ Yi was already at the alchemy shop and reported everything based on Zhang Fei's instructions, but Lian Jinshu seemed doubtful about it because Xian Feng had never interfered in the alchemy union's affairs before.
*Clang*

Lian Jinshu immediately looked at the old man who had just arrived in the shop in surprise, but he quickly came out from behind the counter and saluted him. "What brings you to my place all of a sudden, Minister Yang?"

"Old Lian, I have come to deliver my Emperor's orders." Minister Yang's answer made Lian Jinshu tense. "Emperor Xian forbids you from approaching Zhang Fei and his family because he is a friend of the imperial family, and he will not hesitate to punish you if you send people to attack them once again.
He doesn't want to cause problems with the Alchemy Union, but he has firmly stated that he will protect anyone who has a good relationship with his family."
'Damn it! I didn't expect that brat to actually be related to Emperor Xian and his family.' Lian Jinshu mumbled to himself, his teeth clenched.

Minister Yang then looked at Situ Yi, causing him to subconsciously take a few steps back. "Emperor Xian assigned Old Wen and Old Feng to protect Zhang Fei and his family, and they previously beat that guy just to give you a little warning. He also ordered them to kill anyone who had evil intentions toward them, including the guards from the alchemy union.
That's why you should reconsider your actions and stay away from them, or else you and all your subordinates will die."

Lian Jinshu's body stiffened after hearing that, but Minister Yang didn't say anything else and immediately left the shop. 'Bastard! How dare that shitty Emperor threaten me! I will definitely report this matter to my organization!' "Go back to your place and wait for my next order!"
"Yes."

After Situ Yi's departure, Lian Jinshu pulled out a communication device. However, he hesitated to use it due to his familiarity with Xian Feng's character and his unwavering commitment to protecting Zhang Fei and his family, even if it meant fighting the alchemy union.

After thinking things through, Lian Jinshu still contacted his higher-ups, but their reply was beyond his expectations as they asked him not to disobey Xian Feng's orders. After all, Xian Kingdom was one of the big kingdoms in the Nine Stars Realm, and its population was very large, so they didn't want to lose the alchemy market in the kingdom.
He couldn't help but sigh at this situation and promptly proceeded to prepare the herbs in accordance with Zhang Fei's orders.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had returned to the Sky Jade Realm and made his way to the central region, specifically to the portal that led to the Moon Fox's sub-realm. However, he frowned when the portal opened, especially since it was not Hu Lili who walked out from inside but Hu Qiaomu. "Master, Lili is with Hu Gao right now, preventing her from coming out to see you, so Yue'er asked me to see you."
Zhang Fei immediately took out the Huanying Mask and put it on, and he also activated his invisibility before pulling Hu Qiaomu's hand, bringing her back inside.

In a few seconds, they had already arrived in front of Hu Yue's seclusion cave, which shocked Hu Qiaomu. "How could your speed be this fast, Master? Even if Hu Gao used his full speed, he still wouldn't be able to catch you."
"Open the stone door." After she opened it, Zhang Fei hurriedly carried Hu Qiaomu inside and canceled his invisibility. "Yue'er, I'm here."
Hu Yue smiled at Zhang Fei's arrival, but she was also curious as she couldn't sense his aura. "How can you suppress your aura so neatly? This way, Hu Gao's subordinates won't be able to detect you."

"You may not be able to see it, but I'm wearing a mask right now, and it completely conceals my aura." Hu Yue immediately stood up and touched Zhang Fei's face, and she could feel the mask, even though it was invisible to her eyes. "I got it by chance in the Nine Stars Realm, so I don't have to worry about infiltrating this sub-realm anymore." 'Buy three sets of the new beast pills, Mei.'
[Yes, master.]
{3,000 Lower Grade Beast Core has been deducted from your balance.}
{You got Beast Vitality Pill x3}
{3,000 Lower Grade Beast Core has been deducted from your balance.}
{You got Beast Soul Pill x3}
{1500 Intermediate Grade Beast Core has been deducted from your balance.}
{You got Beast Bloodline Pill x3}
{300,000 beast essence has been deducted from your balance.}

Zhang Fei immediately handed two sets of pills to Hu Yue, one set for her and another set for Hu Lili. Since Hu Qiaomu was on his side now, he decided to give her a new set of beast pills, and he also gave her the previous three pills.
Hu Qiaomu was delighted to receive those pills, especially since she had heard about their effects from Hu Yue and Hu Lili, but she was still curious about the three new pills.

Hu Yue also seemed curious about those pills, so Zhang Fei explained to them directly about the effects of each pill. "All right, you two can swallow them now, and I will teach you something else after Hu Lili comes back."

Both women immediately sat cross-legged and began to swallow their pills one by one. On the other side, Zhang Fei sat on a stone chair, monitoring Hu Lili's location with a serious look, but he could see that she and Hu Gao were seated slightly apart. 'That old fox! I really want to kill him right now, but alas, my cultivation is still at 1-Star Earth Realm.
I can't possibly face him and his subordinates with my current strength, and I must at least reach the 10-Star Heaven Realm first.'

Hearing that, Mei wanted to say something to Zhang Fei, but she dropped her intention because her master had already been affected by his arrogance as a heavenly fox, so he wanted to destroy Hu Dong and Hu Gao with his own ability.

A while later, Hu Yue had finished swallowing the three pills, so she immediately stood up and sat on Zhang Fei's lap, embracing his neck and pressing their foreheads together. "All your pills are too amazing, and Hu Dong will never be able to beat me with my current state. He will never be able to force me to marry him, and I will embarrass him on the day of the fight to determine our partner."

"Haha." Zhang Fei then retrieved a large quantity of another type of pill and several bottles filled with his Yang Qi, which he then handed to Hu Yue. "This pill is a Qi Essence Pill, and it will increase the speed of your Qi absorption. I have a better pill, but you can only take it if you dual-cultivate with me. Unfortunately, we can't do that right now, as they might detect my presence.
You can use them when I'm not by your side, and your cultivation will definitely break through to 2-Star Sovereign Realm faster than your expectations."

Hu Yue immediately stored everything in her storage ring. "Anyway, my mother's cultivation has already broken through to the 2-Star Sovereign Realm, and they can help her break through to the 3-Star. If she and Aunt Qiaomu reach that stage, they will be as strong as Hu Gao, so we have nothing to fear from him.
Unfortunately, there are too many members of our race who are loyal to him, making it impossible for us to openly oppose him."

"It's okay, you guys don't need to fight Hu Gao for now, and I will get rid of him in the future." Zhang Fei then touched Hu Yue's forehead, imparting the Yin-Yang Soul Refining art and the Sun-Moon Harmony Sutra to her.

After Hu Qiaomu finished swallowing her pills, Zhang Fei also imparted his two dual cultivation techniques and the soul cultivation technique to her. He also made sure to give her yang qi and the Qi Essence Pill, as he believed that her faster cultivation would be more beneficial to him.

Suddenly, they heard the stone door roll to the side, prompting them to turn towards the exit, where they found Hu Lili stunned, particularly after seeing Zhang Fei. She quickly came back to her senses, went inside, and closed the stone door again. "What are you doing here?"
"Didn't I come here especially for you?"

"What do you mean by that?" Zhang Fei immediately put Hu Yue down from his lap and moved in front of Hu Lili, making her take a step back. However, he immediately restrained her, held both her hands above her head, and pushed her against the stone door. "What are you doing? Are you going to force me to be your partner? Let my hands go! Yue'er is here!"
Hu Yue shook her head and spoke to Hu Lili. "Mother, I have told you many times that I don't mind if you become my partner, so you don't need to mind me."

"Did you hear that? Yu'er doesn't mind that, but you still want to use her as your excuse to reject me." Hu Lili wanted to argue with Zhang Fei, but his lips had suddenly sealed hers. Despite this, he kissed her briefly before separating their lips a minute later. "If I wanted to force you to be my partner, I could have done so at our first meeting, remember?
However, I don't want you to accept me out of force; instead, I want you to accept me based on your own feelings. Therefore, I will wait for you to open your feelings and accept me."

Hu Lili was shocked when Zhang Fei imparted the Yin-Yang Soul Refining Art and the Sun-Moon Harmony Sutra to her, especially after she read the description of those soul techniques. As for the Flawless Yin-Yang Art, he already imparted it to her when he came to their sub-realm the first time.

After Zhang Fei let go of Hu Lili, Hu Yue immediately handed the three new beast pills to her mother. "Aunt Qiaomu and I have already swallowed them, so you can swallow them now, and Fei will teach us how to cultivate our souls."
"All right." Hu Lili immediately sat cross-legged after receiving the three pills from her daughter, and she swallowed them one at a time for a considerable period.

After Hu Lili finished, Zhang Fei then explained to the three women about the soul cultivation technique in detail, which surprised them. After all, none of the cultivators in the Sky Jade Realm knew about the soul cultivation path, and some of them knew about it because of him.

"Although the Yin-Yang Refining Soul Art is a dual soul cultivation technique, the three of you can still absorb Qi from the air into your souls to cultivate them manually, but the effect will not be as fast as dual soul cultivating with me."
"Can we try dual soul cultivation now, Fei?"
"Sure." Zhang Fei immediately transformed into his half-fox form and sat in front of Hu Lili, with the two women sitting on either side of him. He then brought three of his five foxtails to them.

"You guys can hold them and release your souls." Immediately, the three women released their souls and grasped Zhang Fei's tails, with their own souls also grasping the tails of his soul. He then brought them into an invisible state, or Hu Gao's subordinates would notice his presence.
"You guys don't need to hold yourselves back; just channel your Yin Qi into my soul as much as possible, and I will channel my Yang Qi into the souls of the three of you at the same time."

The three women seemed hesitant to do that, but Zhang Fei assured them that it wasn't a problem for him because he and his clones were already used to doing dual soul cultivation with five women at once, so they followed his instruction and channeled their Yin Qi into his soul as much as possible.

Unlike them, Zhang Fei divided his Yang Qi into their souls and channeled it slowly, especially since the three of them were not yet soul cultivators. Even so, they were already quite experienced in cultivation, so they could understand his previous explanation. Gradually, their Yang and Yin Qi began to swirl within each other's souls, and their movements intensified with each passing second.

An hour later, the three women have officially stepped foot onto the soul cultivation path, and their soul power is at the half-perfection stage of the mortal soul level. However, they continued their dual soul cultivation because the situation outside was still safe, and they only stopped after their soul power reached the half-perfection stage of the mortal soul level.

Zhang Fei and the three women immediately halted the flow of their Yin and Yang Qi, then returned their souls to their bodies. Their soul power increased several times over, leaving them looking extremely satisfied.
"This way, the soul power of the three of you is stronger than Hu Gau and the rest of your race, but you must continue cultivating your souls, and the best time for you to do so is at night."
The three women naturally understood that. Hu Yue then asked Zhang Fei. "Are you going back to the Nine Stars Realm now?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei then lifted Hu Yue to her feet, embraced her, and gave her a deep kiss. "I promised to take Lin'er as my wife tonight, and she should have finished her training by now, so I must return there to fulfill my promise to her. Anyway, I'll come here at least once a week, and I'll help the three of you to increase your soul power.
As for Hu Gao's mark in your soul, I will try asking my two seniors in soul cultivation about it, and they might have a method to remove it."

Hu Yue nodded with a smile, particularly because the mark left by Hu Gao in her soul prevented her from staying by Zhang Fei's side. She sincerely hoped that he could remove it as soon as possible. "You should go back now, or Zhang Lin will wait for you for too long."

After Zhang Fei disappeared from their sight, Zhang Yue immediately sat down with her mother and Hu Qiaomu again. "I think we should focus on cultivating the soul for the time being, especially since our soul power is still at the bottom level. As for our cultivation, we can increase it by using his yang qi."
"Yeah, I agree with you." Hu Qiaomu replied while nodding.
As for Hu Lili, she still felt a dilemma about cultivating using Zhang Fei's yang qi, but she eventually agreed with her daughter. "Let's continue cultivating our souls."

When Zhang Fei arrived at their residence, he saw that most of his wives were completely exhausted after they fought with the beasts since morning, and their bodies were covered in their blood, so he asked them to take a rest.

Since he still had two daily quests, Zhang Fei summoned his first and second clones out of the training space so they could complete them faster before returning to dual cultivate with their respective partners.

Zhang Fei immediately took Zhang Lin into the cloud mansion in the training space, especially since dual cultivation by using the effects of the Yin-Yang Harmony Array would be more beneficial to them.
"Big Brother! You wait here first, okay? I'll take a shower to clean my body first, and we'll do it after."

"All right." As he waited for Zhang Lin to take a bath, Zhang Fei decided to take out the 1000-pound hammer from his storage ring, and he was able to lift it with ease. "Training under the pressure of sixteen times gravity not only increased my speed several folds, but my raw strength also increased significantly.

If I can adapt to the pressure of thirty-two times gravity, then no cultivator in the middle realms can match my speed. Unfortunately, I can only train under that pressure after my cultivation reaches the quasi-divine realm, so it's still a long way off."

Before long, they had arrived at the fortress, and Shang Xinyu hurriedly led Zhang Xiaolong [3] to Shang Yingyue's private quarters, where she was talking with her husband and daughter. Shang Yingyue's husband, Wu Xueming, was also the same age as her. However, his cultivation was on par with Qiao Liangren at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm. "Is he the kid you were talking about before, wife?"

"What brings you here, Long'er?"

"Eh?" Shang Yingyue was surprised by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s question. "Why do you ask that? As far as I can remember, there is no mark in your soul, so I think you don't need to think about it."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Shang Yingyue. "I just recalled my parent's friend in the lower realms; he mentioned that someone had planted a mark on his soul. He was really kind to us, so I wonder if soul cultivators like us can remove the mark or not. Actually, my parents have tried to remove it, but they are not soul cultivators, so they can't do it."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into thought after hearing that. "How can we do that, Senior Sister?"

"Isn't it easy?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Shang Yingyue in confusion. "At first, both of you must release your souls. Then, you can use your soul mark to attack the mark inside his soul. If the mark is truly ordinary, your soul mark can destroy it easily. However, you will fail if it is not an ordinary mark, and you may suffer a backlash from it."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded repeatedly as a sign of understanding. "Unfortunately, I live in this realm now, and the blue polar realm is very far away in the lower realms, so there's no way I can go there to help him. Even so, I won't give up on helping him, and I'll go to that realm again after I become truly strong."

"Hahaha! I like your mindset, kid." Wu Xueming suddenly laughed and ruffled Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hair. "I don't know about your family's closeness to that person, but we are humans with feelings, and we are much better than beasts or demons, so we should know how to repay those who are kind to us."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Wu Xueming. "Yes, Senior Brother. I will always repay those who are kind to me, and I will take revenge on anyone who hurts me or my family. Unfortunately, my enemies are too strong; even my parents couldn't fight them, and they fell into their hands. That's why I must continue to improve my cultivation and soul, and I will take revenge on those people in the future."

"You are still young now, and you still have a long time ahead of you. From what my wife has told me about your talent and the fact that you are the youngest cultivator to reach the Earth Realm, I believe you will become powerful.

At that time, people will find it difficult to oppose you, and you will have the ability to exact revenge on your enemies." Wu Xueming, with a serious look, reminded Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Even so, you must not let hatred and vengeance blind your eyes and heart, and you must not kill indiscriminately. Otherwise, you will be no different from them, and you will turn into a cold-blooded killer."
Once again, Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Wu Xueming. "Senior Brother! Senior Sister! I won't disturb your time any longer, so Big Sis Xinyu and I will head back right now."
After they left, Wu Xueming immediately spoke to his wife. "Even though he is half demon, he is not bad, and he seems to be better than many humans."

"Yeah." Shang Yingyue nodded in agreement. "In a month, my master will arrive in this realm, and he came here specifically for Long'er. He once said he wouldn't take a new disciple, but he might change his mind after meeting him."

Wu Xueming immediately carried his daughter. "That kid would be very lucky if Senior Hun was willing to accept him as his disciple, and if your stories about him were true, I think he might be able to match or even surpass him."

Shang Yingyue smiled in response to that. "Long'er is indeed talented, and he might be able to surpass my master in the soul cultivation path. However, he is still in the early stages now, and he still needs to pass many obstacles to be able to do so."
"Can I play with Long'er?" Wu Lianzhi suddenly asked them.
Wu Xueming and Shang Yingyue nodded to their daughter. "It's getting late now, so we should rest now, and we'll take you to Long'er's place tomorrow."
"I know."
"What are you thinking about, Long'er?" Shang Xinyu suddenly asked because Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s expression was so serious.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head at Shang Xinyu. "I was just thinking about my parents' friend, Big Sis. Anyway, are you going to that secret place again tonight?"

"Yes." Shang Xinyu then told Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "My body cultivation will soon reach the muscle rebirth stage, so I plan to enter seclusion there for a period of time, and I will return once I have successfully broken through.

He noticed Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi's presence in another building, but he didn't pay them much attention and let them watch him from afar.

Meanwhile, Gang Zhishou was sitting with three other people, one of whom was a middle-aged woman. Unlike most women, she had short black hair with a man's cut, and her muscular body was clearly visible to the naked eye.

Another middle-aged man sat in front of them while listening to Gang Zhishou's story, and he was their master in blacksmithing, Duan Zhao. Despite his young appearance, he was actually very old, and he had lived for several thousand years.

Gang Zhishou then spoke. "Master, I saw that he had a high interest in blacksmithing, and his physique was not inferior to senior blacksmiths like us, so I imparted the thousand ways of forging to him."

Duan Zhao nodded in understanding to Gang Zhishou. "If he can effortlessly lift and swing a 750-pound hammer at his current body cultivation level, which is still at the skin refining stage, he clearly has a bright future in blacksmithing. Therefore, I have no objections to you teaching him the technique.
If he has already broken through to the flesh tempering stage, I am sure he can lift and swing the 1000-pound hammer."

Unfortunately, Duan Zhao still didn't know that Zhang Fei had no problem lifting and swinging the 1000-pound hammer with his current body cultivation level, which was thanks to all his body technique and demon physique.

"However, the body cultivation path differs from the ordinary cultivation path; I don't believe he can reach the flesh tempering stage so quickly, Master." Another middle-aged man with a bald head spoke skeptically.

Another middle-aged man with spiky red hair nodded in agreement. "I agree with Lu Zhong, master. We are body cultivators, but it takes us about 2 to 3 years to reach the flesh tempering stage, so I also doubt that kid can reach that stage so quickly."

"Hey, Ah Hu! Didn't you and Lu Zhong hear what Zhishou said earlier about that kid?" The middle-aged woman asked while shaking her head. "That kid is only 20 years old, but his cultivation has already reached the 1-Star Earth Realm, so he is a genius compared to old folks like us.

If my guess is correct, he has not been a body cultivator for too long, so his body cultivation level is lagging behind his cultivation level. If he had started both at the same time, I'm sure his body cultivation level would have at least reached the meridian cleansing stage or even the bone forging stage."

"Xian Xian is right." Duan Zhao said with a nod. "There are so many geniuses in this Nine Stars realm, but none of them can reach the Earth realm by the time they are 20 years old. Most of them reach that stage by the age of 25, and some of them reach it after they are 30, so that kid is a genius among geniuses.
No wonder Prince Xuanwu tried to get close to him, and he probably did it on Emperor Xian's orders."
"Do you think Emperor Xian wants to draw Zhang Fei to his side, Master?" Gang Zhishou asked.

Duan Zhao immediately nodded in agreement. "A talent like Zhang Fei rarely appears in this realm, so I'm sure the five Emperors will be attracted to his talent. Emperor Xian is most fortunate because that kid appeared in his kingdom first, so he has a greater chance of winning him over and bringing him to his side."

"Master, I heard that Emperor Yun is in this kingdom now." Duan Zhao immediately turned to Ah Hu, especially since he was operating in the Yun Kingdom. "As I recall, he and Emperor Xian had a very close relationship, and they were like blood brothers. Do you think he will introduce Zhang Fei to him?"

"That might happen." Duan Zhao then gave it some thought. "Emperor Xian and Emperor Yun had long wanted to unite their two kingdoms, but the other emperors opposed their plans because their overall strength would surpass their kingdoms, and they were afraid that the two would suppress them."

"Is it possible to unite the two kingdoms, Master?" Lu Zhong asked Duan Zhong. "Even though their relationship is very close, I believe that Emperor Yun and Emperor Xian must have their own ambitions, so I do not believe that their plan will succeed.
Even if their plan succeeds, I don't think it will last for a long time, and their union will undoubtedly collapse again, causing their relationship to turn bad."

"I agree with you, Zhong." Xian Xian then spoke to their master. "Emperor Xian and Emperor Yun are like two suns, and a kingdom cannot be ruled by two Emperors at once, so one of them will have to give in to the other, but I'm not sure either of them is willing to do that. Moreover, they still have their own loyal people, and they would never be willing for the two kingdoms to unite."

Duan Zhao let out a heavy sigh. "Forget it; we don't need to interfere in the affairs of those kingdoms, and we only need to watch the situation from behind. If the situation is favorable, then it's fine for us to get involved, but vice versa.
Anyway, I asked the four of you to come here because someone from the blacksmith union contacted me a few days ago, and he told me that our next opponents have been determined."
"Who are our next opponents, Master?" All four of them asked this question simultaneously.

"Our next opponents are people from the Divine Flame Realm." Duan Zhao's answer made their expressions turn serious. "Our match against them will determine our rankings within the organization, and we will enter the top 10 if we succeed in defeating them.

If we succeed in achieving this, we will receive better facilities from the organization, which will be excellent for the development of the four of you in blacksmithing. That's why I want you guys to focus on preparing yourselves to fight them, and you must show them that we are not inferior to them. If any of you lost to them, I will give that person a harsh punishment."
Xian Xian, Lu Zhong, Ah Hu, and Gang Zhishou trembled at Duan Zhao's threats, especially since he was never merciful when giving them punishment.
"Xian'er, Zhong'er, and Hu'er.

I want the three of you to bring your disciples in that match, especially since I'm sure that the people from the Divine Flame Realm will also bring their juniors, so they can compete in blacksmithing against them." The three of them nodded in agreement, but Duan Zhao then turned to Gang Zhishou, causing him to laugh awkwardly, especially since he didn't have a disciple.

"I know you don't like training others, but you still have to choose at least one disciple to be your successor. I think Zhang Fei is your best choice, so you should talk to him about this matter, and he shouldn't mind if you want to take him as his disciple."

Gang Zhishou couldn't help but sigh in his heart, especially since he was never interested in taking a disciple. "I didn't ask where Zhang Fei lives, and I already told him that I will be gone for a week, so I will wait for him to come to me to discuss this matter, Master."

Duan Zhao immediately stood up and walked out, so the four of them right away followed behind him. "It's been a long time since you guys became independent, and I have prepared something new for you."

The four of them exchanged glances with each other as they wondered in their hearts, but they didn't have to wait long because Duan Zhao immediately threw four large hammers to the ground, and their weight caused the ground beneath them to sink downward.

"I forged them using Nethersteel and Sunsteel, and both are some of the heaviest forging materials I have ever encountered." Xian Xian, Lu Zhong, Ah Hu, and Gang Zhishou took a deep breath after hearing the two materials. "As for the handles, I used Goldenash Wood, so they each weigh 5000 pounds."

"5000 pounds?" They claimed to be in shock. "Master, do you really want us to swing this hammer now? Didn't you ask us to prepare ourselves to fight those from the Divine Flame Realm? The heaviest weight we've ever lifted was 2500 pounds, and this hammer is twice that weight."

"It seems that your strength has gone rusty, Hu'er." Duan Zhao then lifted one of the hammers and began swinging it. "See? This hammer is too light even for an old man like me, and you are thousands of years younger than this old man. Don't you feel ashamed of this old man?"

Ah Hu was speechless to his master. In contrast, Lu Zhong, Xian Xian, and Gang Zhishou immediately tried to lift their hammers. In the end, he joined his three friends, but they had a hard time lifting them even after using their cultivation.
Duan Zhao shook his head at the sight of his four disciples in such trouble, but he didn't say anything and left them.

After she was sure that her husband understood everything, Zhang Lingxue immediately took out an alchemy furnace and some herbs. "Fei'er, I will show you how to concoct the most basic pill, so you must pay close attention."
"All right."

chapters.title: Chapter 529 Alchemy Feature
paragraphs: Zhang Lingxue began by cutting the stalk of one of the herbs until only the stem was left, and for the second herb, she only took the youngest part. She then proceeded with the third herb, cutting and cleaning the roots until they were completely clean. For the final two herbs, she simply cleaned them without making any changes.

"Do you understand?" Zhang Fei nodded at her, and Zhang Lingxue started heating her alchemy furnace using her fire qi. "To process herbs, each one requires a different method. Some herbs must be processed on shallow heat; some require medium heat, but some require high heat.
Since your control of the fire element is perfect, I'm sure you won't have any difficulty doing it, but you must remain fully concentrated in processing each ingredient."

Zhang Lingxue then started to process the herbs one by one while explaining to her husband the detailed process, and Zhang Fei only asked if he didn't understand the process. Given that the pill was the most basic, it took her only ten minutes to concoct it. She immediately opened her furnace and took out two white pills from it.

Zhang Fei immediately picked up one of the pills and looked at it seriously. "Lingxue, I've never asked you before because I wasn't interested in alchemy to begin with, but what is your alchemist rank? What about pill ranks?"

"Haha." Zhang Lingxue laughed at that. "Fei'er, these two pills are only intermediate grade, and their grade cannot be higher, especially since they are both rank-1 pills. Anyway, there are 10 ranks in alchemy: apprentice, master, grandmaster, king, emperor, ancestor, saint, venerable, celestial, and God. According to Big Sis Yao, my alchemist rank is the king rank, while hers is the sovereign rank.
Pill ranks consist of ten ranks, and each rank has five different grades: normal, intermediate, advanced, superior, and god."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked at Zhang Lingxue and raised his eyebrows, especially since the pills in the system shop only had four grades: normal, intermediate, advanced, and superior. "God grade pill? What kind of pill is that?"

Zhang Lingxue shakes her head in response. "I've never seen a god-grade pill myself, and I've only heard about it from Big Sis Yao, but I'm sure she's not lying to me. Moreover, she came from the upper realms, and the alchemy there is much more advanced than the lower or middle realms.

Anyway, she told me that there are only two alchemists who can concoct god-grade pills there, and they refer to them as Alchemy God and Goddess, especially since they are the only alchemists who have reached god-rank."
"Eh? Only two people have reached the god-rank alchemy level?" Zhang Fei asked in surprise.

paragraphs: "What exactly happened to him, mother?" Shang Yaolin inquired as she observed the black ball engulfing Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s body.

"This kid is a half-demon beast, and a demon beast is no different from cultivation beasts, so he is undergoing his evolution process right now. However, I don't understand their evolution process, so we can only wait for him to finish." Murong Qianying then turned to her second daughter. "Is having sex with him using the unorthodox method that satisfying?"

Murong Qianying's question made Shang Yaolin smile awkwardly because Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s actions greatly aroused her, so she forgot that her mother was right beside them, and she even watched them have anal sex from start to finish. "I felt weird the first time we did it, but since we did it every day with Long'er, I've gotten used to it and enjoyed it. However, I can't compare it to real sex, especially since I've never done it before."

"I have never used such a method to have sex with your father, so I don't know what it feels like, but I can say that real sex is really amazing." Shang Yaolin was stunned to hear Murong Qianying say that. "Unfortunately, this kid is still too small, so you can't do it with him yet, and you still have to wait a few years for that."
Shang Yaolin immediately massaged her forehead. "Mother, I'm not in a hurry to do that, and I will do it with Long'er after we get married in the future."

Murong Qianying chose not to comment on it, but she was aware that her second daughter had completely fallen for Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Although she didn't like it, she couldn't do anything to him because Hun Di had an interest in him, and he might take her as his last disciple. She herself had considered Murong Mengying's words a few days ago, and she believed that accepting their relationship would be beneficial for her Murong Clan. 'Sigh! I hope my eldest daughter comes back soon, and I also hope she has found the courage to face him.'

"Mother." Murong Qianying raised her eyebrows at Shang Yaolin. "Are you still thinking of bringing Big Sis closer to Long'er? At first, I didn't know about the relationship between them, but he already told me that he already did it with her. She ran away and went to another realm because she was afraid of him, especially his dual cultivation technique."

"Yes." Murong Qianying immediately admitted it. "Since we can't control him using other means because of Hun Di, and you are obviously unable to make him bow down to you, so I'll let Yumei get close to him. You two can marry him in the future, and he will be completely loyal to us."
Shang Yaolin clenched her fists tightly as she really didn't want to share Zhang Xiaolong [3] with other women, including her big sister. "Mother-"

"Stop." Murong Qianying stopped Shang Yaolin directly. "You are a descendant of my Murong Clan, so you should help our clan flourish, and this kid can bring our clan to our glory. Moreover, you and Yumei are blood sisters, so it doesn't matter if you two share a husband."

'Sigh! I'm afraid Long'er will favor my big sister over me, especially since her physique is much better than mine.' Shang Yaolin muttered in her heart as she thought of various ways to win Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s attention. 'No matter what, I must not lose to her, and I must become his first wife, so he will pay more attention to me than her.'
*Crack*
Murong Qianying and Shang Yaolin immediately turned towards the door, and they saw Shang Yingyue coming in with her daughter, Wu Lianzhi.
Wu Lianzhi was stunned when she saw the black ball, but he then turned to his mother. "What is that, Mother?"
Shang Yingyue raised her eyebrows slightly. "Long'er seems to be in the process of evolving now."
"Oh!" Wu Lianzhi nodded in understanding, as her mother had informed her that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a beast who had transformed into a human. "Will the process take a long time?"

"How long has he been starting the process?" Shang Yaoling immediately told Shang Yingyue. "Since the process has just begun, I am uncertain when it will finish, and it probably will take several days or several months."

Wu Lianzhi looked disappointed to hear that, especially since her father would be bringing her back to their realm in a few days. "Mother, you have to pick me up after Long'er finishes evolving, okay?"
"Okay, I'll pick you up as soon as he finishes." After that, Shang Yingyue bade farewell to the two women and brought her daughter to her private quarter.
On the other hand, Murong Qianying and Shang Yaolin continued to wait for Zhang Xiaolong [3] to complete his evolution while they conversed about other topics.

On earth, Zhang Fei [5] had returned to Zhang Chen's house, especially since Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi had been watching him from afar, and he could not possibly evolve under their watch. As for Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2], they underwent their evolution process inside the portable mansion.

Meanwhile, in the Nine Stars Realm, Xian Xianqin was completely taken aback after finishing her spar with Liu Hua and the others, particularly when she saw the black ball that engulfed Zhang Fei. She already knew that some of his women were demons, but she did not expect that he himself was a demon.

"Emperor Xian and Empress Shi watched him break through to the Earth Realm before, so they already knew about his demon soul and darkness element, but they chose not to reveal it to you and your brother." Xian Xianqin immediately turned to Liu Hua. "In fact, our husband is the most unique living being in this universe, especially since he is a pure human, but he is also a full-fledged demon."

"A pure human and a full-fledged demon?" Xian Xianqin seemed to have difficulty comprehending it because she had never met someone who had two identities, and she had never sensed demon aura from Zhang Fei's body before.

Zhang Lin suddenly hugged Xian Xianqin's arm. "Big sis, we trust you, so I hope you don't talk about this matter to anyone except your parents. In fact, my big brother still has another identity, and they already know it."

"Another identity?" Zhang Lin immediately told Xian Xianqin about Zhang Fei's fox-beast identity, which shocked her further. "What actually happened to him? How could he have three different identities in one body? I couldn't sense his demon or beast aura before, and I might never have realized that he was a demon if I hadn't seen him like this."

Liu Qingyu directly answered her. "I can only tell you that Fei'er had an accident and died for a while, but someone miraculously revived him. However, he came back to life not only as a human, but he also became a demon and a beast. As for that person's identity, he himself does not know it, so we do not know about it either."

Xian Xianqin was completely shocked by all the facts about Zhang Fei, but she found it difficult to believe that someone could bring the dead back to life, especially since there were no records of such a thing. "What exactly is happening to him now? Why is his body wrapped in that black ball?"
"His demon form is evolving to the next stage, and he will become even stronger after this."

Xian Xianqin nodded her head slightly. "Does that mean he has all the abilities of his three forms? The physique of demons and beasts is much stronger than our humans, and he can even knock my father backwards with just a single punch, so I thought like that."

"Yeah, you're right about that." Shen Xueyi replied with a nod. paragraphs: Upon their arrival at the building, Zhu Yan promptly briefed Zhang Fei about her plans for the restaurant's opening tomorrow morning. "Since you've already planned everything, I'll follow yours. Unfortunately, I haven't had time to make flyers because of my evolution, so the number of diners probably won't be as many as we originally estimated."

"I can help you with that." Zhang Fei immediately turned to Xian Xianqin. "Hey! I'm their princess, remember? I can arrange for some guards to announce the opening of your restaurant, saving you the trouble of creating flyers or any other promotional materials. However, I won't do it for free, and I want to enjoy Zhu Yan's cooking every day."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei and Zhu Yan laughed at that, especially since Xian Xianqin was already addicted to eating Earth dishes. "It is acceptable; you are welcome to dine here on a daily basis, and I will serve you my best dishes. However, you should control your appetite, or you'll get fat if you eat too much."

If Zhang Fei had made that statement, Xian Xianqin would have been infuriated, but since she and Zhu Yan were both women, she responded to it casually. "Your dishes are too tempting to my appetite, so I will eat as much as I want. Moreover, I can burn the fat with qi, so I will never get fat."
"All right, you can come here anytime." Zhu Yan then turned to Zhang Fei. "Are you going to bring all of them here for the opening of this restaurant?"

Zhang Fei rejected Zhu Yan's question with a shake of his head. "You already know that their beauty can topple kingdoms, and those guys will try to get closer to them, so I won't look for trouble by bringing them here. However, I will bring Hua'er and the Wen Twins here so the three of them can start taking care of other things."

Zhu Yan herself was actually jealous of the beauty of all of Zhang Fei's wives, and she wanted to be as beautiful as them. However, she realized that beauty would only bring disaster, so she forgot her desires and chose a peaceful life. "I've asked those women to come here at dawn, so I'll prepare everything from now on, and we'll open this restaurant as soon as the capital's residents start their activities."
After that, Zhang Fei brought Xian Xianqin out of the building, and Zhu Yan started making final preparations for the restaurant's opening.
"What's the name of your restaurant?"
"The Sky Jade Restaurant."
"Isn't that the name of your home realm?"

"Actually, the Sky Jade Realm is not my home realm, and I come from another realm where there is no qi or cultivators." Xian Xianqin turned to Zhang Fei with surprise. "That realm has special meaning to me because I started my cultivation path there, and I met most of my wives there, so I will always consider it my home realm."
"I see." Xia Xianqin nodded in understanding and asked again. "Then what is your home realm like? How can you become a cultivator if there is no Qi there?"

"Princess, we've only known each other for a month and a half, and you're not part of my extended family, so I can't possibly tell you all my secrets, right?" Zhang Fei smiled as he watched Xian Xiaqin pout, making him itch to devour her luscious and rosy lips. "However, you've heard that I've died before, and the person who killed me brought me back to life as my current self, right?"
"Yes."

Zhang Fei then continued. "That person also left something for me so I could go to the Sky Jade Realm to start my path of cultivation, and my life has undergone so many changes since then. All those changes made me better, or else we wouldn't be able to talk like this now."

"Since you were able to bring those people from the Sky Jade Realm to this realm, I'm sure you can come back to your true home realm, right? Can you take me there?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows in response. "I've been to several planets in the middle realms, but I've never been to a planet in the lower or upper realms. Since you came from the lower realms, I want to look over the planets there."

"I won't take you there now, but I might take you there in the future." Zhang Fei's refusal disappointed Xian Xianqin, but she was aware that their relationship was still ordinary, so she felt it was natural that he didn't want to reveal his secrets to her. "Anyway, can you tell me about the Star Tower? How did it exist in this realm? Did the ancestors build it?"
"The Star Tower, huh?" Xian Xianqin muttered softly. "How about we talk at the royal palace? The tower has many stories, and we can talk about it there."

Zhang Fei actually didn't want to get too close to the Xian royal family, but he still needed more information about the Nine Stars Realm; even Feng Yao had never told him about the Star Tower. "Do you have a private place to talk? I don't want the palace people to know I'm there."
"We can talk in front of my room, and no one will disturb us."
Hearing that, Zhang Fei immediately teased Xian Xianqin. "Are you going to invite me to your room, Princess?"

"Hey!" Xian Xianqin immediately shouted at Zhang Fei. "I'm a woman, and you're a man, remember? Moreover, you said that we haven't known each other for long, and you're still a stranger to me, so I won't invite you to my room."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed and took Xian Xianqin's hand. "Show me your room; I'll take you there directly."

After Xian Xianqin showed him the location of her room, Zhang Fei immediately took her there by teleporting several times. However, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang immediately noticed his presence, but they had no intention of disturbing them.

Upon arriving at the balcony, Zhang Fei immediately peeked into Xian Xianqin's room, but the princess blocked his view right away and closed the curtains. "Hehe! You're too late because I've seen all of your room, but I didn't expect that a princess like you would have such a simple bedroom."

"I am always busy in the sect and taking care of some royal affairs every day, and I can only find peace in my room, so I don't want to busy myself with useless things." After that, the two sat opposite each other on empty chairs on the balcony, and Xian Xianqin began to tell Zhang Fei about the Star Tower. "Actually, our ancestors did not build the tower, and it suddenly appeared in this realm about ten thousand years ago. Since then, countless cultivators have tried to challenge it, but none of them have succeeded in completing it, so no one knows for sure about its mysteries. Only a few, including my ancestors, have managed to reach the fourth floor."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked toward the location of the star tower. "How could such a tall tower suddenly appear in this realm? What is the true purpose of that tower?"

"No one knows how the tower appeared in this realm." Xian Xianqin then continued her explanation. "Even though the tower only looks that big from the outside, the inside is much larger than people imagine, and each floor is like another world. Before we challenge the tower, we must measure our raw strength through the stone obelisk in front of the tower to determine our eligibility to challenge it, and we can start challenging it if our names enter the top 100 rankings."
"Top 100 rankings?"

"Yes." Xian Xianqin nodded to Zhang Fei. "If we can't reach the top 100 rankings, we will never be able to challenge it, and the array in the tower will stop us if we insist on challenging it. Even so, we have no time limit for measuring our raw strength, so we can do it over and over again. In fact, my brother and I failed to enter the top 100 rankings about fifty times, but we finally managed to enter and challenge it."
"How far have you two gone up the tower?" Zhang Fei curiously asked.

"The first floor." Zhang Fei was taken aback by Xian Xiaqin's response, mainly because she and Xian Xianwu's cultivation had reached the quasi-divine realm, yet they were unable to pass the first floor. "You don't have to be so shocked, especially since the tower is not an ordinary tower. On the first floor, we will be faced with random challenges, and we must complete ten challenges to be able to go up to the second floor. Furthermore, each challenge is extremely difficult; even those cultivators in the seven divine realms often fail to pass them."
"Even cultivators in the seven divine realms can fail to pass the first floor." Xian Xiaqin nodded to Zhang Fei. "What exactly are those challenges?"

Xian Xianqin let out a heavy sigh before revealing the information to Zhang Fei. "One of the challenges is facing our demon heart, and it is one of the two toughest challenges on the first floor. The second toughest challenge is fighting with other cultivators because we can't choose our opponents, and it is determined randomly by the tower."
"What do you mean by our demon heart?" Zhang Fei asked in confusion.

"All living beings have their regrets and fears, and both will become our demon hearts if we sink too deep into them." Zhang Fei nodded slightly as he thought about it. "Moreover, the stronger the cultivators, the stronger their demon hearts will be. According to my father, we need extraordinary peace to be able to overcome our demon hearts, but for us to be able to get such peace is not as simple as turning the palm of our hand, especially if our regrets and fears haunt us too deeply."
"Did you fail because of your demon heart?"

Zhang Fei's question caused Xian Xianqin's expression to darken, and she fell silent for a considerable amount of time as she contemplated whether or not to tell him. A few minutes later, she let out a deep breath and revealed the truth.
