paragraphs: "Why do you keep looking at my face like this, Big Sis? Has my face changed a lot?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked while pressing Shang Yaolin's hand on his cheek.

Murong Qianying, who lay beside them, continued to observe Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face. Even though he didn't activate his enhanced demon charm, his evolution into a lust demon lord had already increased his natural charm, and it would increase even more if he activated his ability.

Shang Yaolin nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "You have become more handsome after you evolved, and I'm glad to have you by my side. Other women will definitely go crazy for you if they see your face, and they will undoubtedly flock to you."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave Shang Yaolin a quick peck on the lips. "I am happy to have you by my side, Big Sis. As for those women, you don't need to think about them because they will never see my adult figure, so that they won't be interested in a little kid like me."
"What about Xinyu? Aren't you interested in her?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] acknowledged this with a nod. "I am indeed interested in Big Sis Xinyu, but she isn't interested in me yet, and she is more interested in improving her body cultivation."
Shang Yaolin then curled up in Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s embrace. "You must be exhausted from your three-day evolution process, and it's almost midnight, so we should rest now."
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] hugged Shang Yaolin back, but his eyes glanced at Murong Qianying and activated his enhanced demon charm, instantly causing her heart to flutter.

'You could hold yourself back from my charm before, but I've evolved now, and my charm has increased.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly remembered one of his new abilities, and he immediately used his sexual perception on Murong Qianying. Immediately, a blue screen materialized before his eyes, displaying her sexual data. 'Oh? I didn't expect her to be a masochist like Orith, and she likes it the most when a man dominates her in bed. Let's see how long you can withstand my charm, and I'm confident you will succumb to me in no time.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes to rest, but Murong Qianying kept watching him from the side. She slowly lowered her gaze to his naked torso, but she swallowed her saliva when she noticed a bulge under his trousers.

'This brat! His fox-demon bloodline is really troublesome! His charm has increased after his evolution, his body has become stronger and more perfect, and his dick appears to have grown bigger than before.' Murong Qianying immediately closed her eyes to calm herself down. Still, the effects of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s enhanced demon charm had already affected her mind, making it difficult for her to do so. 'Tch! Should I return to my realm now? If I continue to stay here with them, I won't be able to control myself anymore.'
After carefully considering it, Murong Qianying decided to leave their room. She did not return to the Red Sun Realm, but she went somewhere else to calm herself down.

At the succubus tower, Orith kept nodding as she smiled in satisfaction at Zhang Fei [4]'s change after his evolution. Meanwhile, Balena seemed confused with herself because his charm kept drawing her closer to him, but she eventually decided to leave them alone.

"Haha." Orith laughed as Balena left. "After observing that woman for the past three days, I can conclude that she has already started to fall for you. However, her pride as a princess is too strong, so she chooses to suppress her feelings."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [4] concurred because he could see it from Balena's eyes, but he still didn't think about approaching her, especially since he knew for sure about the burden in her heart. "Anyway, I want to try some of my new abilities."
Zhang Fei[4] immediately got off the bed, but Orith lay there on her stomach, waiting for him to show his new abilities.

In an instant, Zhang Fei [4]'s body was enveloped in a black aura as he used the demonic force manipulation ability, which still affected Orith a bit. Since their demon ranks were equal, the succubus duchess didn't feel overwhelmed by it, but the effect would be different if he used it against demons with lower ranks. "This demonic force is really good, but it's useless against other demons of the same rank or higher."

"Haha." Orith giggled at that. "Demon rank is our weakness, especially since it would be difficult for us to fight demons with higher ranks. However, you are different from other demons; you can even fight Elijah without much difficulty, so I think you won't have any difficulty fighting archduke or archduchess demons now either."

Back then, Zhang Fei [4] was not confident in fighting demons one rank above him, but the situation was different after he perfectly adapted to sixteen times heavier gravity, making him more confident in fighting them.

Zhang Fei [4] then used the familiar manipulation, and a small figure immediately appeared beside him. "Hmm? This familiar is quite unique, and it is bound to me like a master and servant, so I can use it to monitor other demons without fear of injury. If I remember correctly, Yhrer also has this ability, right?"
"Yes." Orith nodded to Zhang Fei [4]. "Back then, Yhrer used his familiar to monitor us, but I immediately destroyed it. So what are your other new abilities?"
Zhang Fei [4] smiled and grabbed Orith's head. "My other new abilities are related to sex, so I can only show them to you when we have sex."
"Let's do it now!" However, Orith suddenly felt that her sexual drive had dropped drastically. "Eh? Can you adjust other people's sex drives now?"

Orith immediately dragged Zhang Fei [4] onto the bed, mounted his lower body, and inserted his genitalia into her body. "Mhm! Your dick is bigger too! I've been fasting from sex for three days due to your evolution, so we will have sex for three whole days."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei's second clone was preparing to do alchemy inside the portable mansion, especially since he had bought a lot of ingredients from Lian Jinshu three days ago. Moreover, he was still a beginner at alchemy, so he wanted to increase his rank as soon as possible. In this way, Zhang Lingxue wouldn't have to appear in public frequently, and he would step in to ensure her safety.

Even though the three alchemy recipes she had obtained from the system were rank 1, Feltia [2] didn't want to rush into concocting them all at once, and he started from the One Star Yang Pill, which was the easiest and most useful of them. Before he started concocting the pill, he used the concocting simulation technique to simulate the process first so he didn't have to waste many ingredients.

After he successfully simulated the pill concoction process correctly, Feltia [2] used the repeating simulation technique to repeat the process again and again. After he was completely sure of the results, he immediately took the heaven creation furnace out and started concocting the pill. He deliberately concocted several batches at once because the number of his wives and partners was too numerous.

After he used up all the ingredients to concoct the one-star pill, Feltia [2] moved on to the other two recipes. He also used both alchemy techniques to simulate their processes before concocting them.

Xian Xianqin, who was sitting on a chair with her hand supporting her chin, was shocked when the wind element began to envelop Zhang Fei's body.
However, Xian Xianqin was even more shocked as Zhang Fei's wind element strengthened and spiraled upwards, forming a sizable wind vortex and sucking in the objects around them.

'He... He... Don't tell me he has mastered the wind law!' Xian Xianqin immediately stood up and stammered in her heart, and her eyes widened as she looked at Zhang Fei. 'This guy is so absurd! He's only been studying it for three hours but already mastered it.'

However, Xian Xianqin didn't know that Zhang Fei was deliberately slowing himself down. He could master it faster because he and his clone studied it simultaneously, and the flow of time in the training ground was two times faster than outside.

Xian Xianqin immediately looked back when she sensed the others' presence, but Xian Feng immediately put his index finger to his mouth, signaling her not to speak. The other three, Shi Qingzhuang, Yun Shang, and Guo Xuehua, gazed at Zhang Fei with astonished expressions.
'Is he the one you talked about a few days ago, Sister Qingzhuang?'
Shi Qingzhuang nodded to Guo Xuehua. 'Do you believe me now? This kid has a bright future and might bring significant changes to this realm, so my husband and I want to pull him to our side.'

'You're right.' Guo Xuehua nodded in agreement. 'He's only 20 years old, but his cultivation has already reached 1-Star Earth Realm, and it looks like he'll reach 2-Star soon. Learning the elemental laws was never easy, but he managed to master the wind law in just two hours, and he might become the youngest cultivator to break through to the seven divine realms in the future. However, he's still too weak now, and Huangfu Shou will send his assassins to kill him if he finds out about his existence, so we have to protect him for now.'

Yun Shang also had the same thoughts as his wife; he was certain that Huangfu Shou would kill Zhang Fei if he discovered his existence. Moreover, the evil cultivators in their realm were not only Emperor Huangfu, but there were also the two demon emperors, and they would not possibly allow a cultivator with such talent to develop, especially since he would be a threat to them. 'Brother Feng, this kid's talent surpassed all the geniuses in our realm, and he might be able to lead us all to be better in the future. We must protect him at all costs, or else those evil guys will kill him if they know of his existence.'

'You are right.' Xian Feng then told Yun Shang. 'However, this kid is different from all the young generations in this realm, and he clearly does not want to rely on anyone. He kept his distance from us even though I had shown him we were on his side. I believed he would avoid us if I forced him to join us, so I instructed Old Wen and Old Feng to protect him, especially those closest to him, secretly.

Yun Shang nodded in understanding because he was like that and had no interest in relying on others, especially since it would only make him weak. 'I will also send two of my trusted men to protect him secretly, especially since I am worried that Huangfu Shou and the two demon emperors will discover his existence.'

chapters.title: Chapter 536 Learn Blacksmithing
paragraphs: After he returned to their residence, Zhang Fei immediately gathered several women and beasts who possessed light and wind elements in the Cloud Mansion, and he taught them the method to master the light and wind laws.
The light element possessors are Liu Qingyu, Ru Xue, Xu Ling'er, and Chu Xing.
The wind element possessors are Qing Yi, Mu Lingshu, Lin Dong'er, Mei Xiang, Zefyr the wind fairy, and You Bai the wind weasel.
As for his women with the fire element, Zhang Fei had long taught them the method to learn the fire law given to him by Feng Yao, and all of them had mastered it at the initial stage.

Zhang Fei's first clone also taught his partners, who possessed both elements, about their laws. Meanwhile, his second clone taught both methods to his family members and the families of all his wives. Naturally, he did not forget the people from the Yin-Yang Pavilion Sect and the Heavenly Sword Sect, and all of them were truly delighted with his treatment of them.

After they had understood both methods, Zhang Fei asked them to try to study the laws of the two elements themselves. He immediately went out of the training space to meet Liu Hua and the Wen Twins, who were preparing the signboard for their restaurant. Meanwhile, his first and second clones went straight to the forest to kill beasts, and he let his third clone take care of the other daily quests later.
"Do you like it?" Liu Hua immediately inquired as Zhang Fei arrived beside them.
"The combination of black, red, and white is very nice, so I like it." Zhang Fei then questioned the Wen Twins. "Are the five of them ready?"

"Yes." Wen Xuan was the first to answer. "They have been training very hard since we left for this realm, and they have also perfectly adapted to eight times gravity, so they will be fine when they stay in the capital."
"Are we going to start our operations directly, Fei?" Wen Yuan asked.

Zhang Fei shook his head. "For the time being, I want the five of them to acclimate themselves to the situation in the capital. They can begin by memorizing all the important locations in the capital, and I want them to gather information about all the important figures, regardless of whether they support or oppose the kingdom."
"Does that mean you will side with the kingdom?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed before rubbing Wen Xuan's cheek. "Do you think I'll side with them? Xian Feng and his family are indeed good, and they've helped us a lot. However, I don't want to side with anyone because this realm is more complicated than in our realm, especially with so many kingdoms here. Although the situation in the capital seems calm, I'm sure there are many rats hiding in it, such as Lian Jishun and the five guards from the alchemy union. They might not have made any moves yet, but they might be planning to overthrow the royal family, and war could break out at any time in this kingdom. I don't care about their affairs, and our safety is the most important thing to me. That's why I want us to be independent, and the demon fox group will be the watcher, so I can immediately take action if danger threatens us."

Since there were no kingdoms in the Sky Jade Realm, the Wen Twins had no understanding of the situation and relationships between the kingdoms. However, they had heard from the earthlings that there were countless kingdoms there in the past, and they thought that Zhang Fei would be more knowledgeable about all of that, so they immediately agreed with him.

Liu Hua suddenly asked Zhang Fei. "When are you going to bring the rest of the demon fox group here? We are about to start our operation, so I think you can bring more of them, especially since they still have to train in your training space first before they can carry out tasks in this realm."
"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei then asked Mei to open the gate leading to the Sky Jade Realm. "Let's go; we will choose twenty of them for now, and they will immediately start their training."

Immediately, the four of them returned to the Sky Jade Realm and made their way to Hua Luo, where Liu Hua selected the twenty best women among them. After that, Zhang Fei sent them into his training space, and he asked the Wen Twins to guide them in their training.
As planned, Zhang Fei only took Liu Hua and the five members of the demon fox group to the capital, leaving them in the restaurant with Zhu Yan after he put up the signboard.

After that, Zhang Fei headed to the commerce district to visit Fa Zhan, who had been waiting for his arrival for a week. He immediately handed an invitation to the old man. "Senior, my restaurant will open in three hours, so you can go there directly at that hour, and I have prepared a special place for you."

Fa Zhen nodded before handing him a storage ring, and Zhang Fei immediately checked the contents, which were materials for creating formations in his residence and training space. "They are indeed materials for creating basic and intermediate arrays, but their quantity is quite a lot, and the total is five hundred million bronze coins."
'Hey! Their prices are much cheaper than if I bought them in the Sky Jade Realm.' Zhang Fei immediately paid Fa Zhen the amount. "Then, what about your promise, Old Man?"
Fa Zhen's lips twitched after Zhang Fei mentioned that. "After I taste your restaurant's dishes, you can lead me directly to your residence, and I will set up a protective array there."
"In that case, I'll go to see Old Gang now, he just informed me that he's already returned to the capital."
"Hmm?" Fa Zhen raised his eyebrows. "Do you know Gang Zhishou?"

Zhang Fei nodded to the old man. "I want to learn about blacksmithing, and Old Gang is willing to help me with that. In fact, he has already imparted his blacksmithing technique to me, and I have already mastered the basics."

"All right, you can go now, and I will wait for you in your restaurant." As he watched Zhang Fei leave his shop, Fa Zhen pondered quietly. "How did that brat manage to win Xian Feng's attention? He even sent Yang Caojing to me and asked me to install the best protective array for his residence, and he also has a relationship with Old Duan's best disciple."
A while later, Zhang Fei arrived at the blacksmith shop and noticed Gang Zhishou's gloomy expression. "What happened, Old Gang? Is there anything wrong? Why are you so gloomy?"
"Nothing happened." Gang Zhishou then sighed softly before telling Zhang Fei about the blacksmith union and the match with the blacksmiths of the Divine Flame Realm.
Zhang Fei himself had not started his path in the blacksmithing, so he did not have much information about it or the people in the field. "Are their abilities higher than yours, Old Gang?"
"Yes." Gang Zhishou nodded in response. "Those people are the best blacksmiths in the middle realms, and the people from the blacksmith union often prioritize them, so I'm not sure we can beat them."

"A collusion and nepotism, huh?" Zhang Fei was naturally not surprised by that, especially since such things were too common in all countries on Earth. "Old Gang, I believe you shouldn't dwell too much on them, and instead, focus on putting in your best effort to win the competition. As long as you've done your best, it doesn't matter if you lose because they cheated, and it won't lower your pride as a blacksmith."
"Yeah." Gang Zhishou then asked him. "How was your training with the 1000-pound hammer? How was your understanding of the basics of forging techniques?"

"I'll show it to you." Zhang Fei immediately took out the 1000-pound hammer and swung it with ease, causing Gang Zhishou's eyes to widen in shock. "I initially felt heavy when lifting it, but after swinging it for a few days, I quickly got used to it, and I have also grasped all the basics of that technique."
"Do you really understand all the basic techniques?" After Zhang Fei nodded, Gang Zhishou immediately led him to his forging room. "Show me your fire control."

Zhang Fei immediately reached out to the forging furnace and used his fire element, which shocked Gang Zhishou again. "Old Gang, I've been used to controlling my fire for a long time, so this isn't too difficult for me. Furthermore, blacksmithing and alchemy share a similar approach to controlling fire, and I am an alchemist."
Gang Zhishou turned to Zhang Fei with a silly look, causing him to laugh. "Are you really an alchemist? Since when did you become one?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed while rubbing the back of his head. "I became an alchemist a week ago, and I am still an apprentice alchemist. However, I have been practicing my fire control since I started my cultivation path, so I can understand the degree of fire heat that I should use in blacksmithing and alchemy more easily."

"I see." Gang Zhishou nodded in understanding. "You're right, there are similarities between alchemy and blacksmithing in terms of controlling fire. However, you will frequently use extremely high heat for forging, particularly because most metals have a high resistance to fire. If the fire is too weak, tempering some of the metals will be difficult. Meanwhile, different levels of heat are required when concocting pills, particularly because each herb has a different resistance to fire."
"Some herbs need low heat, some need medium heat, and some others need high heat."

Gang Zhishou then took out his last hammer, which weighed 2000 pounds. "I know this hammer is still too heavy for you, but I want you to start trying to lift it. If you can swing it before the competition, I will take you to watch it, and you will meet many talented young blacksmiths there."
"When will the competition take place?"
"In two months."

Zhang Fei then held the hammer handle. "I don't really want to show it now, Old Gang. However, I'm really interested in the blacksmithing competition, and I want to participate in it. For that, I have to first step into the field of blacksmithing, so I'll show it to you now."

"What-" Gang Zhishou swallowed his question back as he froze in his spot, especially since Zhang Fei was able to lift the 2000-pound hammer. He was even more shocked as soon as he started swinging the hammer, and he didn't even break a sweat doing it. "How... how can you lift such a heavy weight with your current body cultivation level?"

Since he still regarded Gang Zhishou as an outsider, Zhang Fei naturally wouldn't tell him the truth. "Honestly, I started tempering my body long before I became a body cultivator, and I achieved this by lifting various weights. In addition, I tempered my body using various types of beasts' blood, which has made it much stronger than other body cultivators at my level.
"What kind of beasts' blood did you use to forge your body?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at Gang Zhishou. "I don't know because my master in body cultivation prepared it for me, and she didn't tell me what kind of beast blood she used."
"She? Is your master really a female body cultivator?"
Zhang Fei then told him. "My master is Hong Xinxin, but you may not be familiar with her name, as she prefers to spend her time in her training place rather than appearing in public."
Gang Zhishou nodded repeatedly. "You're right; I've never heard of her name, but my sister disciple may have heard of it. Do you really want to participate in that blacksmithing competition?"

Zhang Fei immediately put on a determined look. "Old Gang, I want to forge weapons and equipment for my family, so I have been looking forward to becoming a blacksmith for a long time. However, I have never forged any equipment before, so I want to start learning how to do so. I plan to participate in the competition once I am truly ready."

Hearing that, Gang Zhishou immediately took out a metal from his storage ring, and he right away heated up his forging furnace. "This thunderstrike alloy is the easiest material I have, and I will show you firsthand how to forge a weapon using it, so you should pay close attention to the manufacturing sequence."
"Yes."

Gang Zhishou immediately heated the alloy inside the forging furnace after it reached full temperature, but he only did this for a few minutes because the alloy's fire resistance was weak, causing it to soften quickly.

Gang Zhishou immediately picked up his hammer and began to forge the alloy, while Zhang Fei continued to watch from the side with great seriousness, especially considering his lack of experience in blacksmithing.

In the process, Gang Zhishou heated the alloy a few times as he continued to hammer it until it became a sword blade, neither too thick nor too thin. Once he had hammered it enough, he immediately dipped it in special water to dissipate the heat faster, and he began to sharpen the edges until they were really sharp. Of course, the process didn't end there; he polished it with a special liquid to make it shiny enough, and he also used several materials to make the handle.

In just an hour and a half, Gang Zhishou had finished forging the sword, but his expression looked disappointed because the material and shape were nothing special compared to the other swords he had forged. "You can't use this sword for fighting because the material is too ordinary, but it's enough to teach you the basics of blacksmithing."

"Let me see it, Old Gang." Gang Zhishou immediately handed the sword to Zhang Fei, but it broke when he tried to bend it. "Haha! I didn't expect this sword to be this weak, and it broke immediately even though I didn't use much force."

Gang Zhishou then took out some of the alloy and handed it over. They told Zhang Fei. "You can try to forge your first sword using these alloys, and I will teach you how to forge weapons with better materials after you successfully forge one."

"Old Gang, I think I'll do it later." Zhang Fei immediately put away those alloys. "Today is the opening day of my restaurant, and I want to invite you to eat there. I dare to guarantee that you will like the dishes cooked by my chef friend."

Gang Zhishou was surprised to hear that, but he immediately agreed, so Zhang Fei swiftly led him to his restaurant. On the way there, they saw many guards running around announcing the opening hours of the restaurant, and they did so under Xian Xianqin's orders.

When they arrived there, many people had already gathered in front of the restaurant, and they were neatly lined up because many guards were blocking them from approaching the building before the opening.
"Old Fa?" Gang Zhishou was surprised by Fa Zhen's presence there. "Do you also know Zhang Fei?"

Fa Zhen nodded to Gang Zhishou. "I know him because he came to my shop to buy materials for making formation arrays, and he invited me here to taste his dishes. However, I didn't expect that you also knew him, and you even taught him about blacksmithing."

"I met him when he was looking for forging materials in my shop, and I could see his enthusiasm for blacksmithing, so I decided to teach it to him." Gang Zhishou immediately turned to Zhang Fei. "Are you also a formation array master?"
Zhang Fei smiled and nodded to Gang Zhishou. "Before I learned alchemy and blacksmithing, I had already learned about formation arrays, but I was still a beginner in that field."

Seeing and listening to the three of them, the crowd seemed curious about Zhang Fei's identity. After all, they knew that Fa Zhen and Gang Zhishou were difficult to approach even by the royal family, but he could be so familiar with the two of them, leaving them wondering.
A guard suddenly shouted from a distance. "Move! Make a way for Emperor Xian and Empress Shi!"

sentences.text: After he returned to their residence, Zhang Fei immediately gathered several women and beasts who possessed light and wind elements in the Cloud Mansion, and he taught them the method to master the light and wind laws.
The light element possessors are Liu Qingyu, Ru Xue, Xu Ling'er, and Chu Xing.
The wind element possessors are Qing Yi, Mu Lingshu, Lin Dong'er, Mei Xiang, Zefyr the wind fairy, and You Bai the wind weasel.
As for his women with the fire element, Zhang Fei had long taught them the method to learn the fire law given to him by Feng Yao, and all of them had mastered it at the initial stage.
Zhang Fei's first clone also taught his partners, who possessed both elements, about their laws.
Meanwhile, his second clone taught both methods to his family members and the families of all his wives.
Naturally, he did not forget the people from the Yin-Yang Pavilion Sect and the Heavenly Sword Sect, and all of them were truly delighted with his treatment of them.
After they had understood both methods, Zhang Fei asked them to try to study the laws of the two elements themselves.
He immediately went out of the training space to meet Liu Hua and the Wen Twins, who were preparing the signboard for their restaurant.
Meanwhile, his first and second clones went straight to the forest to kill beasts, and he let his third clone take care of the other daily quests later.
"Do you like it?" Liu Hua immediately inquired as Zhang Fei arrived beside them.
"The combination of black, red, and white is very nice, so I like it." Zhang Fei then questioned the Wen Twins.
"Are the five of them ready?"
"Yes." Wen Xuan was the first to answer.
"They have been training very hard since we left for this realm, and they have also perfectly adapted to eight times gravity, so they will be fine when they stay in the capital."
"Are we going to start our operations directly, Fei?" Wen Yuan asked.
Zhang Fei shook his head.
"For the time being, I want the five of them to acclimate themselves to the situation in the capital.

They can begin by memorizing all the important locations in the capital, and I want them to gather information about all the important figures, regardless of whether they support or oppose the kingdom."
"Does that mean you will side with the kingdom?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed before rubbing Wen Xuan's cheek.
"Do you think I'll side with them?
Xian Feng and his family are indeed good, and they've helped us a lot.
However, I don't want to side with anyone because this realm is more complicated than in our realm, especially with so many kingdoms here.
Although the situation in the capital seems calm, I'm sure there are many rats hiding in it, such as Lian Jishun and the five guards from the alchemy union.
They might not have made any moves yet, but they might be planning to overthrow the royal family, and war could break out at any time in this kingdom.
I don't care about their affairs, and our safety is the most important thing to me.
That's why I want us to be independent, and the demon fox group will be the watcher, so I can immediately take action if danger threatens us."
Since there were no kingdoms in the Sky Jade Realm, the Wen Twins had no understanding of the situation and relationships between the kingdoms.

However, they had heard from the earthlings that there were countless kingdoms there in the past, and they thought that Zhang Fei would be more knowledgeable about all of that, so they immediately agreed with him.
Liu Hua suddenly asked Zhang Fei.
"When are you going to bring the rest of the demon fox group here?
We are about to start our operation, so I think you can bring more of them, especially since they still have to train in your training space first before they can carry out tasks in this realm."
"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei then asked Mei to open the gate leading to the Sky Jade Realm.
"Let's go; we will choose twenty of them for now, and they will immediately start their training."
Immediately, the four of them returned to the Sky Jade Realm and made their way to Hua Luo, where Liu Hua selected the twenty best women among them.
After that, Zhang Fei sent them into his training space, and he asked the Wen Twins to guide them in their training.
As planned, Zhang Fei only took Liu Hua and the five members of the demon fox group to the capital, leaving them in the restaurant with Zhu Yan after he put up the signboard.
After that, Zhang Fei headed to the commerce district to visit Fa Zhan, who had been waiting for his arrival for a week.
He immediately handed an invitation to the old man.
"Senior, my restaurant will open in three hours, so you can go there directly at that hour, and I have prepared a special place for you."
Fa Zhen nodded before handing him a storage ring, and Zhang Fei immediately checked the contents, which were materials for creating formations in his residence and training space.
"They are indeed materials for creating basic and intermediate arrays, but their quantity is quite a lot, and the total is five hundred million bronze coins."
'Hey!
Their prices are much cheaper than if I bought them in the Sky Jade Realm.' Zhang Fei immediately paid Fa Zhen the amount.
"Then, what about your promise, Old Man?"
Fa Zhen's lips twitched after Zhang Fei mentioned that.
"After I taste your restaurant's dishes, you can lead me directly to your residence, and I will set up a protective array there."
"In that case, I'll go to see Old Gang now, he just informed me that he's already returned to the capital."
"Hmm?" Fa Zhen raised his eyebrows.
"Do you know Gang Zhishou?"
Zhang Fei nodded to the old man.
"I want to learn about blacksmithing, and Old Gang is willing to help me with that.
In fact, he has already imparted his blacksmithing technique to me, and I have already mastered the basics."
"All right, you can go now, and I will wait for you in your restaurant." As he watched Zhang Fei leave his shop, Fa Zhen pondered quietly.
"How did that brat manage to win Xian Feng's attention?
He even sent Yang Caojing to me and asked me to install the best protective array for his residence, and he also has a relationship with Old Duan's best disciple."
A while later, Zhang Fei arrived at the blacksmith shop and noticed Gang Zhishou's gloomy expression.
"What happened, Old Gang?
Is there anything wrong?
Why are you so gloomy?"
"Nothing happened." Gang Zhishou then sighed softly before telling Zhang Fei about the blacksmith union and the match with the blacksmiths of the Divine Flame Realm.
Zhang Fei himself had not started his path in the blacksmithing, so he did not have much information about it or the people in the field.
"Are their abilities higher than yours, Old Gang?"
"Yes." Gang Zhishou nodded in response.
"Those people are the best blacksmiths in the middle realms, and the people from the blacksmith union often prioritize them, so I'm not sure we can beat them."
"A collusion and nepotism, huh?" Zhang Fei was naturally not surprised by that, especially since such things were too common in all countries on Earth.
"Old Gang, I believe you shouldn't dwell too much on them, and instead, focus on putting in your best effort to win the competition.
As long as you've done your best, it doesn't matter if you lose because they cheated, and it won't lower your pride as a blacksmith."
"Yeah." Gang Zhishou then asked him.
"How was your training with the 1000-pound hammer?
How was your understanding of the basics of forging techniques?"
"I'll show it to you." Zhang Fei immediately took out the 1000-pound hammer and swung it with ease, causing Gang Zhishou's eyes to widen in shock.
"I initially felt heavy when lifting it, but after swinging it for a few days, I quickly got used to it, and I have also grasped all the basics of that technique."
"Do you really understand all the basic techniques?" After Zhang Fei nodded, Gang Zhishou immediately led him to his forging room.
"Show me your fire control."
Zhang Fei immediately reached out to the forging furnace and used his fire element, which shocked Gang Zhishou again.
"Old Gang, I've been used to controlling my fire for a long time, so this isn't too difficult for me.
Furthermore, blacksmithing and alchemy share a similar approach to controlling fire, and I am an alchemist."
Gang Zhishou turned to Zhang Fei with a silly look, causing him to laugh.
"Are you really an alchemist?
Since when did you become one?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed while rubbing the back of his head.
"I became an alchemist a week ago, and I am still an apprentice alchemist.
However, I have been practicing my fire control since I started my cultivation path, so I can understand the degree of fire heat that I should use in blacksmithing and alchemy more easily."
"I see." Gang Zhishou nodded in understanding.
"You're right, there are similarities between alchemy and blacksmithing in terms of controlling fire.
However, you will frequently use extremely high heat for forging, particularly because most metals have a high resistance to fire.
If the fire is too weak, tempering some of the metals will be difficult.
Meanwhile, different levels of heat are required when concocting pills, particularly because each herb has a different resistance to fire."
"Some herbs need low heat, some need medium heat, and some others need high heat."
Gang Zhishou then took out his last hammer, which weighed 2000 pounds.
"I know this hammer is still too heavy for you, but I want you to start trying to lift it.
If you can swing it before the competition, I will take you to watch it, and you will meet many talented young blacksmiths there."
"When will the competition take place?"
"In two months."
Zhang Fei then held the hammer handle.
"I don't really want to show it now, Old Gang.
However, I'm really interested in the blacksmithing competition, and I want to participate in it.
For that, I have to first step into the field of blacksmithing, so I'll show it to you now."
"What-" Gang Zhishou swallowed his question back as he froze in his spot, especially since Zhang Fei was able to lift the 2000-pound hammer.
He was even more shocked as soon as he started swinging the hammer, and he didn't even break a sweat doing it.
"How... how can you lift such a heavy weight with your current body cultivation level?"
Since he still regarded Gang Zhishou as an outsider, Zhang Fei naturally wouldn't tell him the truth.
"Honestly, I started tempering my body long before I became a body cultivator, and I achieved this by lifting various weights.
In addition, I tempered my body using various types of beasts' blood, which has made it much stronger than other body cultivators at my level.

Zhang Fei shook his head at Gang Zhishou.

"She?
Is your master really a female body cultivator?"
Zhang Fei then told him.

Gang Zhishou nodded repeatedly.

Do you really want to participate in that blacksmithing competition?"
Zhang Fei immediately put on a determined look.

chapters.title: Chapter 537 Lightning Pond
paragraphs: The crowd began whispering when they saw Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, especially since they didn't come alone. Instead, they came together with the Emperor and Empress of the Yun Kingdom, with their two children following behind.
Several important people in the Xian Kingdom, such as Yang Caojing, Old Wen, and Old Feng, also came with them.

Although Fa Zhen and Gang Zhishou were already aware of Zhang Fei's relationship with the royal family of the Xian Kingdom, they still harbored many questions about it. After all, the royal family had never attended the opening of a business, let alone the owner, who was still young and had no status in their kingdom.

Behind the crowd, Lian Jinshu stared at Zhang Fei angrily because the Xian royal family cared so much about him, and Xian Feng even sent Yang Caojing to threaten him. 'This little bastard! I still don't understand how he managed to have a good relationship with them!'

Ignoring their gazes, Xian Xianqin immediately ran towards the restaurant, briefly glancing at Zhang Fei. However, she didn't say anything to him and entered the restaurant directly, further confusing the crowds about his relationship with the royal family.

Zhang Fei smiled faintly when he noticed two faint red hues on Xian Xianqin's cheeks, and he immediately cupped his hands in front of his important guests. "Welcome to my Sky Jade Restaurant, Emperor Xian, Empress Shi, and Prince Xian."
"Our children have told us about the deliciousness of your restaurant's dishes, so we came here purposefully to taste them ourselves." Shi Qingzhuang said with a smile.

Unlike his wife, Xian Feng immediately introduced the Emperor and Empress of the Yun Kingdom to Zhang Fei. "Brother Yun and Sister Guo happened to come to this kingdom, so we asked them to join us to taste your dishes."
"The presence of the two of you is an honor for me, Emperor Yun and Empress Guo." Zhang Fei said as he cupped his hands to them.
"Hahaha!" Yun Shang laughed and patted Zhang Fei's shoulder. "Since we come from a faraway place, you should treat us with your best dishes."

Zhang Fei nodded to Yun Shang. "Emperor Yun, all the dishes in my restaurant are the best, and we use the finest ingredients, from beast meat and vegetables to cook them. All our prepared wine and drinks are also of the best quality, so you won't be disappointed when you enjoy them."

"That's great! I'll enjoy everything." Guo Xuehua said with a broad smile. "Anyway, my husband and I would like to speak with you before we return to our kingdom today, so I hope you are willing to spare some time to talk to us."

The crowds were perplexed by Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua's attitude toward him, particularly considering their status as the Emperor and Empress of the Yun Kingdom. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was a mere youngster with no status, and his cultivation was too low to be their equal, but they spoke to him as if he was on their level.

Zhang Fei had expected that, so he immediately agreed to Gui Xuehua's request. "All right, I will accompany you two to talk later, but we have to go in now, or these people will have to wait a long time."
Zhang Fei then led the people from both kingdoms into his restaurant, followed by Fa Zhen and Gang Zhishou. He had asked Zhu Yan to prepare a special table so they would not mix with those commoners.

The crowd, especially the men, were instantly captivated by Liu Hua, who walked out from inside. Despite her natural beauty, Zhang Fei's two pills enhanced her allure, and her body was among the best of all his wives.

However, Liu Hua ignored their stares and instructed their employees to ignite the firecrackers they had previously prepared before speaking to those people. "Welcome to our restaurant. Our chef has prepared many special dishes you have never tasted before for today's opening, and we are sure you will enjoy them. Due to our limited space, some of you will have to wait outside, or the situation inside will be too cramped."

Following the announcement from the guard of the Xian Kingdom, Liu Hua immediately returned inside and instructed the female servants to guide the people into their restaurant. Despite this, she still directed them to maintain control over the situation, mainly because the number of visitors exceeded their expectations.
Since he had been expecting their arrival, Zhang Fei had asked Zhu Yan to cook different dishes for the families of the two kingdoms, and he had selected the meat of the best beasts for the dishes.
Xian Feng, Yun Shang, Shi Qingzhuang, and Guo Xuehua thoroughly enjoyed the Earth dishes, which were richer in taste and aroma than any cuisine from the cultivation world.
Yang Caojing, Fa Zhen, Gang Zhishou, and the others also enjoyed the dishes in front of them. They even ate them as if they had not eaten for several days.

The diners were initially disappointed because Zhang Fei served them dishes that were different from those eaten by the people of the two kingdoms. Still, they eventually enjoyed every dish he prepared, especially since the taste was as delicious as theirs.

During their meal, they don't talk about heavy things; they only talk about light things. Even so, Xian Feng set up a soundproof barrier around them so other people couldn't eavesdrop on their conversation.

Zhang Fei could feel someone's hostile gaze toward him, and he could naturally recognize that person, who was none other than Lian Jishu. However, he raised his eyebrows slightly when he saw the woman by the old man's side, and the system's scan showed that she was Huan Ya, the leader of the old man's five guards.

Despite her old age, Huan Ya still looked very young, and she was no less pretty than Xian Xianqin except for her cultivation, which was still below hers. She deliberately left her long, dark purple hair loose down to her waist, clipping the sides with black butterfly clips, and her two-side long bangs fell to her medium breasts. She looks pretty attractive in a sleeveless and tight dark purple dress, with two long dark purple gloves covering her hands up to her elbows and a high slit at the bottom of the dress that accentuates her long and slender legs.

As Huan Ya's dark purple eyes emitted a dim light, Zhang Fei suddenly sensed a strange sensation. The system notified him that she had attempted to charm him with her technique, but it didn't have much effect on him. With a faint smile, he activated his enhanced demon charm in retaliation against her, causing her heart to beat irregularly as soon as his charm took effect. 'What a fool! She doesn't know my identity as a lust demon lord, yet she tried to charm me with her meager charm technique.'

Zhang Fei immediately ignored Huan Ya and continued his conversation with his guests, explicitly discussing his plans. He informed them that he had planned to open an alchemy shop, but he abandoned his idea because he didn't want to get in trouble with the alchemy union.

However, the four people were shocked to hear that he was an alchemy apprentice; even Xian Xianqin, who had spent some time in his residence, did not know about it, especially since he only did alchemy in his training space. They were even more shocked when he told them that he was also a low-level formation array master, and he still wanted to learn about blacksmithing from Gang Zhishou.

Two hours later, the people from both kingdoms had finished their meal, and Zhang Fei immediately followed them back to the Xian royal palace. He asked Fa Zhen and Gang Zhishou to wait for him at the restaurant, especially since he wouldn't chat with them for too long.
Xian Xianwu also left the restaurant for the sect, but Xian Xianqin and the two old guards stayed there to ensure the safety of Zhang Fei's wife and friends.

"Did you learn the lightning body cultivation technique?" When they arrived at the palace, Guo Xuehua immediately questioned Zhang Fei. "Sister Qingzhuang informed me that you came to this realm to train in the Cyanwood Mountain, but the lightning element there is truly powerful due to its strengthening by the lightning law."

Zhang Fei softly sighed as Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang revealed numerous details about him to the emperor and empress of the Yun Kingdom. "Empress Guo, I don't have the lightning element, but my master said it doesn't matter if I learn her technique, especially since the other effects of her technique are still useful. However, I still need help from powerful lightning to reach the highest level, and lightning in Cyanwood Mountain is the best choice for me. Even so, I will not act rashly to go there with my current strength and cultivation, especially since that lightning will instantly turn me into ashes."

Guo Xuehua immediately stretched her right palm forward, and a purple lightning ball appeared above it. However, it quickly turned dark purple, and Zhang Fei immediately realized she had already comprehended the lightning law. "You must have guessed it, right? Even though I have comprehended the lightning law to the intermediate stage, I still can't get close to the peak of Cyanwood Mountain, so you should reconsider your desire to train your body there. Even if your lightning body cultivation technique has reached the highest level and your cultivation has reached the seven divine realms, you won't be able to approach the peak."

Zhang Fei frowned as his eyes remained glued to the lightning ball above Guo Xuehua's palm, but he did not doubt her words in the slightest because he was already aware of the power of the elemental laws. "Is there anything to help me get closer to that place, Empress Guo?"

"No." Guo Xuehua immediately pulled her lightning element back. "I have used many artifacts to protect myself, including a divine-grade artifact. Unfortunately, they were destroyed when lightning struck them, and I have not dared to approach that place since then. I have discussed the matter with Xian Lianghua. Still, the elf emperor also has no solution to approach it, especially since some natural races with a high affinity for the lightning element cannot go there."

"Even the natural races can't get close to that place, huh?" Guo Xuehua nodded to Zhang Fei with a serious look. "Honestly, my master has checked the mountain several times, but she can't get close to the peak, especially since lightning storms often occur there. At first, I thought the natural races could help me get there, but I must rethink everything since they can't help me."
"Huh?" Guo Xuehua, Yun Shang, Xian Feng, and Shi Qingzhuang looked at Zhang Fei in shock. "Who is your master? Why have we never heard anyone else going to the Cyanwood Mountain?"

"My master is Hong Xinxin, but she lives in another realm, and she told me that she had indeed been to that mountain several times." The four of them looked at Zhang Fei curiously, but instead, he looked at Xian Feng and said something else. "Emperor Xian, I know you sent your sister to the Wasteland Realm to investigate my background, but I advise you to call her back immediately, or she will face danger there."
The emperor and empress of the Xian Kingdom were genuinely shocked that Zhang Fei knew about it, especially since they did not tell anyone, including their children.
"Brother Xian, don't clans from other realms use the Wasteland realm as a punishment ground?" Yun Shang directly questioned Xian Feng.

"You are right, Brother Yun." Xian Feng then asked Zhang Fei. "What do you mean that my sister will encounter danger there? We know many evil people are there, but I don't think Changyue will encounter danger there, especially since she has excellent concealment technique."

"Emperor Xian, you have never entered that realm directly, right?" Xian Feng nodded to Zhang Fei. "Unlike you, I have lived there for several months, so I understand the situation there better than you. The truth is, the cultivators in that realm originate not from these middle realms but from the upper realms, and their strength surpasses that of the four of you."
"Are you serious about that?" Xian Feng asked in shock; even the other three looked shocked by Zhang Fei's information.

"If I wanted to lie to you, I wouldn't have asked you to call your sister back, right?" Xian Feng was not a fool, so he immediately followed Zhang Fei's words by contacting Xian Changyue via a long-distance communication device, and he strictly ordered her to return to their realm directly. "Even if your sister had such an excellent concealment technique, the people there would be able to detect her presence. Moreover, not only do humans live in that realm, but there are also beast, demihuman, and demon races. The other four races might not do anything to her, but the demon races are different, and they might capture her as soon as she enters that realm."

Xian Feng let out a sigh. "Thank you for your warning, Zhang Fei. Does that mean your master also came from the upper realms? I heard from Xianqin that you met her there, so I thought she should be part of them."

"My master did come from the upper realms, and her home realm is the Red Sun Realm. However, I have never been to that realm, especially since she immediately returned there after I officially became a body cultivator, so I can't tell you anything about that realm." The four people exchanged looks of shock, especially since they had never been to the upper realms, let alone meet cultivators from there. "As for how I got to that realm, the story is too complicated, so I don't want to waste my time explaining everything."

They sighed heavily as they were curious about it, but they did not force Zhang Fei to explain it to them. Instead, Guo Xuehua handed him a token, and he accepted it with a slight raise of his eyebrows. "The lightning in the Cyanwood Mountain is too strong even for me, so you should not go there, or you will die in vain. Instead, you can go to my Guo Clan in the Yun Kingdom and show them this token. I will inform them about you, and they will allow you to train in our lightning pond."
"Lightning pond?" Zhang Fei gave Gu Xuehua a confused look, primarily since he had never heard of such a thing. 'Mei, try to find the location.'
[Yes, Master.]

Guo Xuehua immediately explained to Zhang Fei, "I don't know how the lightning pond was formed, but it was formed after a lightning phenomenon occurred in that place. My Guo Clan has always focused on the lightning element; we decided to move our clan to that area. Although the lightning there is weaker than in Cyanwood Mountain, it is still stronger than in other areas, and it has helped us increase our lightning cultivation."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and put away the token. "Thank you, Empress Guo. Unfortunately, I still want to learn other things, especially blacksmithing. That's why I won't be going there now but will go there in the future."
Guo Xuehua nodded to Zhang Fei. "All right, you can do whatever you want for now, and you can go directly to my clan to practice your lightning body technique."
