Several important people in the Xian Kingdom, such as Yang Caojing, Old Wen, and Old Feng, also came with them.
Although Fa Zhen and Gang Zhishou were already aware of Zhang Fei's relationship with the royal family of the Xian Kingdom, they still harbored many questions about it.
After all, the royal family had never attended the opening of a business, let alone the owner, who was still young and had no status in their kingdom.
Behind the crowd, Lian Jinshu stared at Zhang Fei angrily because the Xian royal family cared so much about him, and Xian Feng even sent Yang Caojing to threaten him. 'This little bastard!
I still don't understand how he managed to have a good relationship with them!'
Ignoring their gazes, Xian Xianqin immediately ran towards the restaurant, briefly glancing at Zhang Fei.
However, she didn't say anything to him and entered the restaurant directly, further confusing the crowds about his relationship with the royal family.
Zhang Fei smiled faintly when he noticed two faint red hues on Xian Xianqin's cheeks, and he immediately cupped his hands in front of his important guests.
"Welcome to my Sky Jade Restaurant, Emperor Xian, Empress Shi, and Prince Xian."
"Our children have told us about the deliciousness of your restaurant's dishes, so we came here purposefully to taste them ourselves." Shi Qingzhuang said with a smile.
Unlike his wife, Xian Feng immediately introduced the Emperor and Empress of the Yun Kingdom to Zhang Fei.
"Brother Yun and Sister Guo happened to come to this kingdom, so we asked them to join us to taste your dishes."
"The presence of the two of you is an honor for me, Emperor Yun and Empress Guo." Zhang Fei said as he cupped his hands to them.
"Hahaha!" Yun Shang laughed and patted Zhang Fei's shoulder.
"Since we come from a faraway place, you should treat us with your best dishes."
Zhang Fei nodded to Yun Shang.
"Emperor Yun, all the dishes in my restaurant are the best, and we use the finest ingredients, from beast meat and vegetables to cook them.
All our prepared wine and drinks are also of the best quality, so you won't be disappointed when you enjoy them."
"That's great!
I'll enjoy everything." Guo Xuehua said with a broad smile.
"Anyway, my husband and I would like to speak with you before we return to our kingdom today, so I hope you are willing to spare some time to talk to us."
The crowds were perplexed by Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua's attitude toward him, particularly considering their status as the Emperor and Empress of the Yun Kingdom.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was a mere youngster with no status, and his cultivation was too low to be their equal, but they spoke to him as if he was on their level.
Zhang Fei had expected that, so he immediately agreed to Gui Xuehua's request.
"All right, I will accompany you two to talk later, but we have to go in now, or these people will have to wait a long time."
Zhang Fei then led the people from both kingdoms into his restaurant, followed by Fa Zhen and Gang Zhishou.
He had asked Zhu Yan to prepare a special table so they would not mix with those commoners.
The crowd, especially the men, were instantly captivated by Liu Hua, who walked out from inside.
Despite her natural beauty, Zhang Fei's two pills enhanced her allure, and her body was among the best of all his wives.
However, Liu Hua ignored their stares and instructed their employees to ignite the firecrackers they had previously prepared before speaking to those people.
"Welcome to our restaurant.
Our chef has prepared many special dishes you have never tasted before for today's opening, and we are sure you will enjoy them.
Due to our limited space, some of you will have to wait outside, or the situation inside will be too cramped."
Following the announcement from the guard of the Xian Kingdom, Liu Hua immediately returned inside and instructed the female servants to guide the people into their restaurant.
Despite this, she still directed them to maintain control over the situation, mainly because the number of visitors exceeded their expectations.
Since he had been expecting their arrival, Zhang Fei had asked Zhu Yan to cook different dishes for the families of the two kingdoms, and he had selected the meat of the best beasts for the dishes.
Xian Feng, Yun Shang, Shi Qingzhuang, and Guo Xuehua thoroughly enjoyed the Earth dishes, which were richer in taste and aroma than any cuisine from the cultivation world.
Yang Caojing, Fa Zhen, Gang Zhishou, and the others also enjoyed the dishes in front of them.
They even ate them as if they had not eaten for several days.
The diners were initially disappointed because Zhang Fei served them dishes that were different from those eaten by the people of the two kingdoms.
Still, they eventually enjoyed every dish he prepared, especially since the taste was as delicious as theirs.
During their meal, they don't talk about heavy things; they only talk about light things.
Even so, Xian Feng set up a soundproof barrier around them so other people couldn't eavesdrop on their conversation.
Zhang Fei could feel someone's hostile gaze toward him, and he could naturally recognize that person, who was none other than Lian Jishu.
However, he raised his eyebrows slightly when he saw the woman by the old man's side, and the system's scan showed that she was Huan Ya, the leader of the old man's five guards.
Despite her old age, Huan Ya still looked very young, and she was no less pretty than Xian Xianqin except for her cultivation, which was still below hers.
She deliberately left her long, dark purple hair loose down to her waist, clipping the sides with black butterfly clips, and her two-side long bangs fell to her medium breasts.

She looks pretty attractive in a sleeveless and tight dark purple dress, with two long dark purple gloves covering her hands up to her elbows and a high slit at the bottom of the dress that accentuates her long and slender legs.
As Huan Ya's dark purple eyes emitted a dim light, Zhang Fei suddenly sensed a strange sensation.
The system notified him that she had attempted to charm him with her technique, but it didn't have much effect on him.
With a faint smile, he activated his enhanced demon charm in retaliation against her, causing her heart to beat irregularly as soon as his charm took effect. 'What a fool!
She doesn't know my identity as a lust demon lord, yet she tried to charm me with her meager charm technique.'
Zhang Fei immediately ignored Huan Ya and continued his conversation with his guests, explicitly discussing his plans.
He informed them that he had planned to open an alchemy shop, but he abandoned his idea because he didn't want to get in trouble with the alchemy union.

However, the four people were shocked to hear that he was an alchemy apprentice; even Xian Xianqin, who had spent some time in his residence, did not know about it, especially since he only did alchemy in his training space.
They were even more shocked when he told them that he was also a low-level formation array master, and he still wanted to learn about blacksmithing from Gang Zhishou.
Two hours later, the people from both kingdoms had finished their meal, and Zhang Fei immediately followed them back to the Xian royal palace.
He asked Fa Zhen and Gang Zhishou to wait for him at the restaurant, especially since he wouldn't chat with them for too long.
Xian Xianwu also left the restaurant for the sect, but Xian Xianqin and the two old guards stayed there to ensure the safety of Zhang Fei's wife and friends.
"Did you learn the lightning body cultivation technique?" When they arrived at the palace, Guo Xuehua immediately questioned Zhang Fei.
"Sister Qingzhuang informed me that you came to this realm to train in the Cyanwood Mountain, but the lightning element there is truly powerful due to its strengthening by the lightning law."
Zhang Fei softly sighed as Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang revealed numerous details about him to the emperor and empress of the Yun Kingdom.
"Empress Guo, I don't have the lightning element, but my master said it doesn't matter if I learn her technique, especially since the other effects of her technique are still useful.
However, I still need help from powerful lightning to reach the highest level, and lightning in Cyanwood Mountain is the best choice for me.
Even so, I will not act rashly to go there with my current strength and cultivation, especially since that lightning will instantly turn me into ashes."
Guo Xuehua immediately stretched her right palm forward, and a purple lightning ball appeared above it.
However, it quickly turned dark purple, and Zhang Fei immediately realized she had already comprehended the lightning law.
"You must have guessed it, right?
Even though I have comprehended the lightning law to the intermediate stage, I still can't get close to the peak of Cyanwood Mountain, so you should reconsider your desire to train your body there.
Even if your lightning body cultivation technique has reached the highest level and your cultivation has reached the seven divine realms, you won't be able to approach the peak."

Zhang Fei frowned as his eyes remained glued to the lightning ball above Guo Xuehua's palm, but he did not doubt her words in the slightest because he was already aware of the power of the elemental laws.
"Is there anything to help me get closer to that place, Empress Guo?"
"No." Guo Xuehua immediately pulled her lightning element back.
"I have used many artifacts to protect myself, including a divine-grade artifact.
Unfortunately, they were destroyed when lightning struck them, and I have not dared to approach that place since then.
I have discussed the matter with Xian Lianghua.
Still, the elf emperor also has no solution to approach it, especially since some natural races with a high affinity for the lightning element cannot go there."
"Even the natural races can't get close to that place, huh?" Guo Xuehua nodded to Zhang Fei with a serious look.
"Honestly, my master has checked the mountain several times, but she can't get close to the peak, especially since lightning storms often occur there.
At first, I thought the natural races could help me get there, but I must rethink everything since they can't help me."
"Huh?" Guo Xuehua, Yun Shang, Xian Feng, and Shi Qingzhuang looked at Zhang Fei in shock.
"Who is your master?
Why have we never heard anyone else going to the Cyanwood Mountain?"

"My master is Hong Xinxin, but she lives in another realm, and she told me that she had indeed been to that mountain several times." The four of them looked at Zhang Fei curiously, but instead, he looked at Xian Feng and said something else.
"Emperor Xian, I know you sent your sister to the Wasteland Realm to investigate my background, but I advise you to call her back immediately, or she will face danger there."
The emperor and empress of the Xian Kingdom were genuinely shocked that Zhang Fei knew about it, especially since they did not tell anyone, including their children.
"Brother Xian, don't clans from other realms use the Wasteland realm as a punishment ground?" Yun Shang directly questioned Xian Feng.
"You are right, Brother Yun." Xian Feng then asked Zhang Fei.
"What do you mean that my sister will encounter danger there?
We know many evil people are there, but I don't think Changyue will encounter danger there, especially since she has excellent concealment technique."
"Emperor Xian, you have never entered that realm directly, right?" Xian Feng nodded to Zhang Fei.
"Unlike you, I have lived there for several months, so I understand the situation there better than you.
The truth is, the cultivators in that realm originate not from these middle realms but from the upper realms, and their strength surpasses that of the four of you."
"Are you serious about that?" Xian Feng asked in shock; even the other three looked shocked by Zhang Fei's information.

"If I wanted to lie to you, I wouldn't have asked you to call your sister back, right?" Xian Feng was not a fool, so he immediately followed Zhang Fei's words by contacting Xian Changyue via a long-distance communication device, and he strictly ordered her to return to their realm directly.
"Even if your sister had such an excellent concealment technique, the people there would be able to detect her presence.
Moreover, not only do humans live in that realm, but there are also beast, demihuman, and demon races.
The other four races might not do anything to her, but the demon races are different, and they might capture her as soon as she enters that realm."
Xian Feng let out a sigh.
"Thank you for your warning, Zhang Fei.
Does that mean your master also came from the upper realms?
I heard from Xianqin that you met her there, so I thought she should be part of them."
"My master did come from the upper realms, and her home realm is the Red Sun Realm.

However, I have never been to that realm, especially since she immediately returned there after I officially became a body cultivator, so I can't tell you anything about that realm." The four people exchanged looks of shock, especially since they had never been to the upper realms, let alone meet cultivators from there.
"As for how I got to that realm, the story is too complicated, so I don't want to waste my time explaining everything."
They sighed heavily as they were curious about it, but they did not force Zhang Fei to explain it to them.
Instead, Guo Xuehua handed him a token, and he accepted it with a slight raise of his eyebrows.
"The lightning in the Cyanwood Mountain is too strong even for me, so you should not go there, or you will die in vain.
Instead, you can go to my Guo Clan in the Yun Kingdom and show them this token.
I will inform them about you, and they will allow you to train in our lightning pond."
"Lightning pond?" Zhang Fei gave Gu Xuehua a confused look, primarily since he had never heard of such a thing. 'Mei, try to find the location.'
[Yes, Master.]
Guo Xuehua immediately explained to Zhang Fei, "I don't know how the lightning pond was formed, but it was formed after a lightning phenomenon occurred in that place.
My Guo Clan has always focused on the lightning element; we decided to move our clan to that area.
Although the lightning there is weaker than in Cyanwood Mountain, it is still stronger than in other areas, and it has helped us increase our lightning cultivation."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and put away the token.
"Thank you, Empress Guo.
Unfortunately, I still want to learn other things, especially blacksmithing.
That's why I won't be going there now but will go there in the future."
Guo Xuehua nodded to Zhang Fei.
"All right, you can do whatever you want for now, and you can go directly to my clan to practice your lightning body technique."

chapters.title: Chapter 538 Installing Formation Arrays
paragraphs: After discussing other things, Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua immediately left the Xian royal palace because they had stayed in the Xian Kingdom for a few days to meet Zhang Fei.
"May I ask about the Star Tower, Emperor?"
Xian Feng nodded to Zhang Fei. "What do you want to know about it?"
"What is the main requirement to challenge it? Do I have to join a sect to be able to challenge it?"

"Everyone can challenge the tower freely, so you don't need to join any sect for that." Zhang Fei was relieved to hear Xian Feng's answer. "There will be some team challenges starting from the second floor, so joining a sect will be more beneficial. Even so, you can find a new team there, especially since many rogue cultivators are eager to challenge the tower, but random teams may yield varying results. After all, everyone has a different character, and we are unaware of their true nature. They can be friends, but they can also be hidden enemies, and you risk losing your opportunities if they turn against you."

Zhang Fei did not deny Xian Feng's opinion, but he also had his own opinion. "Emperor, you are not wrong, but you forget that those closest to us can also betray us. It is difficult to know the character of random people, especially since many are like two-faced foxes. They often act kind in front of us, but they harbor jealousy and greed in their hearts. However, people we don't know often become our best friends, and people we know very well often stab us in the back. I had a bad experience with that because my big brother betrayed me and tried to kill me, so I killed him and his friends with my own hands. Meanwhile, I got to know the people in my residence after I became a cultivator, and most of them have helped me deal with all my problems."

Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang were shocked by Zhang Fei's confession about his big brother, but they did not deny that such a thing could happen in their lives. "So, do you intend to challenge the tower by yourself?"

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at them. "Naturally, I will bring all my wives and family to challenge the tower, but I want to confirm the situation first, so I need more information about everything."

Xian Feng nodded understanding and explained. "From the human side, you should be wary of the people from the Huangfu Kingdom, but you must not forget the people from the Bai and Zhou Kingdoms. They are not as vicious as the people from the Huangfu Kingdom, but they are still vicious, so you must always be careful of them, especially the members of their royal families."
"The Bai and Zhou royal families?"

"Although I have not found any concrete evidence, I have often received news that the Bai royal family has a relationship with the Huangfu royal family, especially their first prince, Bai Chongxi." Xian Feng then took out a scroll and handed it to Zhang Fei. "This is a report on the Zhou royal family's involvement with the Ximen Kingdom, and you should already know the identity of Ximen Changtian, right?"

Zhang Fei nodded at him because Feng Yao had already told him quite a lot about all the kingdoms in the Nine Stars Realm. "Ximen Changtian is the Demon Emperor of the Ximen Kingdom, and his cultivation is at the 5-Moon Divine Expansion. The demon races split into two because his younger brother's intentions were not in line with his. Ximen Gongfu chose to establish the Dark Demon Kingdom, and his cultivation was at the 4-Moon Divine Expansion Realm."

"Ximen Gongfu's cultivation has now reached the 5-Moon Divine Expansion, and the demons under his command are significantly stronger than those of the Ximen Kingdom. He is far more vicious than Ximen Changtian and has the highest ambition to rule over this realm. Fortunately, we still have the beast and natural races by our side, so he never managed to fulfill his ambition." Zhang Fei frowned immediately after remembering Xian Xiaqing's story about her best friend. "Honestly, I still regret what happened to Qian Ying, but we had no choice but to let her fall into their hands."

Zhang Fei chose not to comment on it and instead read the writing on the scroll, but he then looked at Xian Feng with a shocked expression. "If you and the other emperors already know about the Zhou Kingdom's involvement with Ximen Changtian, why haven't you taken action against them?"

"Do you think we don't want to take action against the Zhou Kingdom?" Xian Feng then pointed north. "The Zhou Kingdom is in the north, and we must pass through the Huangfu Kingdom if we want to attack them. Huangfu Shou is our eternal enemy, and he will mobilize his troops to stop our troops. Our troops will travel too far and too long if we go around the Bai Kingdom, so our best choice is to go through the Yun Kingdom. However, the border between that kingdom and the Zhou Kingdom is too difficult to pass, and there are some powerful beasts in the seven divine realms that inhabit that area."
When they first came to the Nine Stars Realm, Zhang Fei inspected the area from the air, so he knew the truth of Xian Feng's words.

Xian Feng then continued his explanation. "Zhou Xiaochuan's cultivation is on par with mine and Brother Yun's in the 5-Moon Divine Expansion, but he is stronger than us because he has already touched the barrier to the Divine Manifestation Realm and will probably break through to that stage soon. Even if the two of us join forces to fight him, we won't necessarily win against him, and he still has several cultivators in the 4-Moon Divine Expansion under him. Moreover, they have proven to have a relationship with Ximen Changtian, and the demons under them are far stronger than our forces, so they will die in vain if we go to war with them."
"What about the beast and natural races? Are they going to take action?"

Xian Feng shook his head at Zhang Fei. "The beast and natural race kingdoms are the first and second strongest in this realm, but they are very selfish and don't care about human affairs. They will not initiate a war against the Zhou Kingdom and will only take action if others threaten their kingdoms. Anyway, you don't need to think about that because it is our responsibility as the natives of this realm so that you can focus more on yourself and the people closest to you."

"Honestly, I don't care about the affairs between all the kingdoms, but I won't keep quiet if any of them seek trouble with me, especially if they want to harass the people closest to me." Zhang Fei then looked in several directions before continuing. "The current me is indeed not their opponent, but that doesn't mean I can't fight them back, and I will eliminate anyone who has malicious intentions towards my family. For now, one person has done that, and I will do something to him soon, but I will not do it openly, and I will use other methods to destroy him."

Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang immediately exchanged glances, as they already knew the identity of the person, who was none other than Lian Jinshu. "The alchemy union is powerful, so you must be very careful in your actions against him, lest they will come here to attack you, and you will not be able to do anything to protect them."
"Thank you for your advice." Zhang Fei then faced them again and returned the scroll to Xian Feng. "Fa Zhen and Old Gang are waiting for me at the restaurant, so I must return now."

Following Zhang Fei's disappearance, Shi Qingzhuang promptly questioned her husband. "How did he discover that you sent Changyue to the Wasteland Realm? With his current cultivation, he shouldn't be able to observe us from such a distance, and we would have noticed it right away if he was watching us."

Unfortunately, Shi Qingzhuang still did not know Zhang Fei that well. Moreover, almost all of his wives and family did not even know about the system's existence except for Zhang Lin, and it was too easy for him to monitor anyone in the realm without having to do it himself.

"I don't know how he managed to do it, and I was shocked when he told us about Changyue. However, we were fortunate that he told us the real situation in the realm, or my sister would have faced great trouble if she met the cultivators from the upper realms, especially those demon races." Xian Feng then turned his face toward the location of the Sky Jade Restaurant. "That kid was truly decisive in protecting himself and his family, and he even dared to kill his big brother with his own hands, something even I wouldn't dare to do."

Shi Qingzhuang sighed heavily and hugged her husband's arm. "I know you still regret your big brother's choice to defect to the demons, but it happened too long ago, and we can't change it. He will undoubtedly attack us again sooner or later, and we may have to make the difficult decision of killing him then."
"Yeah." Xian Feng then led his wife back into the palace, and they discussed several other things.
When he returned to the restaurant, Zhang Fei could not find Lian Jinshu and Huan Ya there, and Liu Hua told him they had left immediately after finishing their meal.

Zhang Fei immediately approached the two men waiting for him. "Old Gang, is it possible to build a blacksmith's workshop in my residence? It's okay for me to practice at your place, but building one in my residence would be better for me to practice blacksmithing daily."

"Building a blacksmith's workshop is not difficult, so it's fine if you want to build one." Gang Zhishou replied with a nod. "If you want that, we can go back to my shop first to get some spare equipment, so all you need to do is build the furnace and start practicing immediately."
"All right, we'll go to your shop first, then I'll take you two to my residence."

Gang Zhishou promptly guided them to his shop, and once he had taken everything, the three departed the Xian Kingdom through the south gate. Upon arrival, Fa Zhen immediately questioned Zhang Fei. "Where is your residence located? How far is it from this capital?"
"My residence is in the far south, and it will take two to three days if we go there using a flying artifact."

Fa Zhen frowned upon hearing that, especially since it would take too long. However, he and Gang Zhisou suddenly sensed Zhang Fei's aura surrounding them. Before they could ask him, he had already taken them away using his Nine Cloud Steps.

Sometime later, they arrived in front of Zhang Fei's residence, and the two men looked at him with expressions full of shock. After all, his cultivation was far below theirs, with their cultivation being in the seven divine realms, but he could transport them to such a far distance in just a few minutes.

Fa Zhen immediately took a deep breath after returning to his senses. "No wonder Xian Feng and Yun Shang were so eager to get close to you; you have extraordinary abilities despite your young age and low cultivation."

"Hahaha." Gang Zhishou laughed as he patted Zhang Fei's shoulder. "Old Fa will help you build the formations, and I will help you build the forging furnace. I hope you can forge some equipment before the competition day, and I will take you there so that you can compete against the younger generation of the Divine Flame Realm."
Zhang Fei nodded in response. "Don't worry; I will train hard in these two months to fully prepare for the competition."
"That's good! I hope we will win the competition because the rewards will benefit us."

"What formations do you wish to establish in your residence? Since I'm here now, I'll help you set them all up at once, and I'll return to the capital afterward." Zhang Fei immediately handed over some of his materials to Fa Zhen, and he also told him all the formations he wanted to use to protect his residence. "All right, leave them to me, but you must watch me when I set them up so you'll understand the process better."

"That's for sure!" Zhang Fei then called one of them to bring the Zhishou Gang into their residence, and the old blacksmith was quite shocked to see the inside, especially after seeing the number of people inside. "Can we start now, Old Fa?"

Fa Zhen nodded to Zhang Fei before surveying the surroundings of the residence. "Three of them are attack formations, so we can't set them up in one place. I'll set up the Five Elements Convergence Array and the Misty Phantom Array here, and you can trap and attack enemies from the front. As for the Thousand Sword Array and the Hundred Illusion Array, I will set both of them in the back area, and both can prevent enemies from trying to infiltrate from there. Installing the Nine Dragons Sealing Formation Array in the east and the Frozen Heaven Array in the west is more suitable."
Since Fa Zhen was more senior and experienced in formation arrays, Zhang Fei immediately agreed with his decision. "What about the Qi Gathering Formation?"

"Your Qi Gathering Array is just a basic array, and I will replace it with the Heavenly Qi Convergence array. It is a high intermediate array, and its effect is 10x stronger than yours." Zhang Fei's eyes lit up after hearing that, and he asked Fa Shen for the method to create that array, especially since he also wanted to make one in his training space. "Let's start now; I still have a lot of other things to do."

Since most were only intermediate formation arrays, it was not difficult for a high-level array master like Fa Zhen to set them up. In less than two hours, he had already successfully set up two formations in Zhang Fei's residence. After that, he continued to set up the two formations for the east and west areas, and it only took him a little over an hour to set them up.

Zhang Fei then took Fa Zhen to the back of his residence, and he immediately set up the two formations as initially planned. After he had set up both of them, he set up the Heavenly Qi Convergence Array, covering the entire area of the residence so that everyone inside did not need to gather in one place to cultivate, and they could cultivate from their rooms.

After installing everything, Fa Zhen installed the Golden Defensive Formation Array, his best protective formation array. Its creation was much more complicated than all previous formations, and it took quite a long time to prepare everything.
Zhang Fei closely observed Fa Zhen as he prepared the formation. 'This formation is his best formation, huh? I guess Xian Feng asked him to use it.'

Once the preparations were complete, Fa Zhen immediately instructed Zhang Fei to arrange the materials in various corners of his residence as per his instructions, and he immediately proceeded with the creation process once all the materials had been placed in their respective positions.

A golden dome enveloped the residence five hours later, indicating that the defensive formation was perfectly installed. Observing Fa Zhen's extreme exhaustion from exerting so much Qi to create the formation, Zhang Fei promptly gave him some Qi recovery pills, shocking the old array master. "Old Fa, please keep them a secret, or Lian Jinshu will report it to the alchemy union, and those people will come here to bother me."
"I know." Fa Zhen nodded in response. "Since everything is settled, I will return to the capital immediately."

"Do you think we don't want to take action against the Zhou Kingdom?" Xian Feng then pointed north.
"The Zhou Kingdom is in the north, and we must pass through the Huangfu Kingdom if we want to attack them.
Huangfu Shou is our eternal enemy, and he will mobilize his troops to stop our troops.
Our troops will travel too far and too long if we go around the Bai Kingdom, so our best choice is to go through the Yun Kingdom.
However, the border between that kingdom and the Zhou Kingdom is too difficult to pass, and there are some powerful beasts in the seven divine realms that inhabit that area."
When they first came to the Nine Stars Realm, Zhang Fei inspected the area from the air, so he knew the truth of Xian Feng's words.
Xian Feng then continued his explanation.

"Zhou Xiaochuan's cultivation is on par with mine and Brother Yun's in the 5-Moon Divine Expansion, but he is stronger than us because he has already touched the barrier to the Divine Manifestation Realm and will probably break through to that stage soon.
Even if the two of us join forces to fight him, we won't necessarily win against him, and he still has several cultivators in the 4-Moon Divine Expansion under him.
Moreover, they have proven to have a relationship with Ximen Changtian, and the demons under them are far stronger than our forces, so they will die in vain if we go to war with them."
"What about the beast and natural races?
Are they going to take action?"
Xian Feng shook his head at Zhang Fei.
"The beast and natural race kingdoms are the first and second strongest in this realm, but they are very selfish and don't care about human affairs.
They will not initiate a war against the Zhou Kingdom and will only take action if others threaten their kingdoms.
Anyway, you don't need to think about that because it is our responsibility as the natives of this realm so that you can focus more on yourself and the people closest to you."

"Honestly, I don't care about the affairs between all the kingdoms, but I won't keep quiet if any of them seek trouble with me, especially if they want to harass the people closest to me." Zhang Fei then looked in several directions before continuing.
"The current me is indeed not their opponent, but that doesn't mean I can't fight them back, and I will eliminate anyone who has malicious intentions towards my family.
For now, one person has done that, and I will do something to him soon, but I will not do it openly, and I will use other methods to destroy him."
Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang immediately exchanged glances, as they already knew the identity of the person, who was none other than Lian Jinshu.
"The alchemy union is powerful, so you must be very careful in your actions against him, lest they will come here to attack you, and you will not be able to do anything to protect them."
"Thank you for your advice." Zhang Fei then faced them again and returned the scroll to Xian Feng.
"Fa Zhen and Old Gang are waiting for me at the restaurant, so I must return now."
Following Zhang Fei's disappearance, Shi Qingzhuang promptly questioned her husband.
"How did he discover that you sent Changyue to the Wasteland Realm?
With his current cultivation, he shouldn't be able to observe us from such a distance, and we would have noticed it right away if he was watching us."
Unfortunately, Shi Qingzhuang still did not know Zhang Fei that well.

Moreover, almost all of his wives and family did not even know about the system's existence except for Zhang Lin, and it was too easy for him to monitor anyone in the realm without having to do it himself.
"I don't know how he managed to do it, and I was shocked when he told us about Changyue.

However, we were fortunate that he told us the real situation in the realm, or my sister would have faced great trouble if she met the cultivators from the upper realms, especially those demon races." Xian Feng then turned his face toward the location of the Sky Jade Restaurant.
"That kid was truly decisive in protecting himself and his family, and he even dared to kill his big brother with his own hands, something even I wouldn't dare to do."
Shi Qingzhuang sighed heavily and hugged her husband's arm.
"I know you still regret your big brother's choice to defect to the demons, but it happened too long ago, and we can't change it.
He will undoubtedly attack us again sooner or later, and we may have to make the difficult decision of killing him then."
"Yeah." Xian Feng then led his wife back into the palace, and they discussed several other things.
When he returned to the restaurant, Zhang Fei could not find Lian Jinshu and Huan Ya there, and Liu Hua told him they had left immediately after finishing their meal.
Zhang Fei immediately approached the two men waiting for him.
"Old Gang, is it possible to build a blacksmith's workshop in my residence?
It's okay for me to practice at your place, but building one in my residence would be better for me to practice blacksmithing daily."
"Building a blacksmith's workshop is not difficult, so it's fine if you want to build one." Gang Zhishou replied with a nod.
"If you want that, we can go back to my shop first to get some spare equipment, so all you need to do is build the furnace and start practicing immediately."
"All right, we'll go to your shop first, then I'll take you two to my residence."
Gang Zhishou promptly guided them to his shop, and once he had taken everything, the three departed the Xian Kingdom through the south gate.
Upon arrival, Fa Zhen immediately questioned Zhang Fei.
"Where is your residence located?
How far is it from this capital?"
"My residence is in the far south, and it will take two to three days if we go there using a flying artifact."
Fa Zhen frowned upon hearing that, especially since it would take too long.
However, he and Gang Zhisou suddenly sensed Zhang Fei's aura surrounding them.
Before they could ask him, he had already taken them away using his Nine Cloud Steps.
Sometime later, they arrived in front of Zhang Fei's residence, and the two men looked at him with expressions full of shock.
After all, his cultivation was far below theirs, with their cultivation being in the seven divine realms, but he could transport them to such a far distance in just a few minutes.
Fa Zhen immediately took a deep breath after returning to his senses.
"No wonder Xian Feng and Yun Shang were so eager to get close to you; you have extraordinary abilities despite your young age and low cultivation."
"Hahaha." Gang Zhishou laughed as he patted Zhang Fei's shoulder.
"Old Fa will help you build the formations, and I will help you build the forging furnace.
I hope you can forge some equipment before the competition day, and I will take you there so that you can compete against the younger generation of the Divine Flame Realm."
Zhang Fei nodded in response.
"Don't worry; I will train hard in these two months to fully prepare for the competition."
"That's good!
I hope we will win the competition because the rewards will benefit us."
"What formations do you wish to establish in your residence?

Since I'm here now, I'll help you set them all up at once, and I'll return to the capital afterward." Zhang Fei immediately handed over some of his materials to Fa Zhen, and he also told him all the formations he wanted to use to protect his residence.
"All right, leave them to me, but you must watch me when I set them up so you'll understand the process better."

"That's for sure!" Zhang Fei then called one of them to bring the Zhishou Gang into their residence, and the old blacksmith was quite shocked to see the inside, especially after seeing the number of people inside.
"Can we start now, Old Fa?"
Fa Zhen nodded to Zhang Fei before surveying the surroundings of the residence.
"Three of them are attack formations, so we can't set them up in one place.
I'll set up the Five Elements Convergence Array and the Misty Phantom Array here, and you can trap and attack enemies from the front.
As for the Thousand Sword Array and the Hundred Illusion Array, I will set both of them in the back area, and both can prevent enemies from trying to infiltrate from there.
Installing the Nine Dragons Sealing Formation Array in the east and the Frozen Heaven Array in the west is more suitable."
Since Fa Zhen was more senior and experienced in formation arrays, Zhang Fei immediately agreed with his decision.
"What about the Qi Gathering Formation?"
"Your Qi Gathering Array is just a basic array, and I will replace it with the Heavenly Qi Convergence array.

It is a high intermediate array, and its effect is 10x stronger than yours." Zhang Fei's eyes lit up after hearing that, and he asked Fa Shen for the method to create that array, especially since he also wanted to make one in his training space.
"Let's start now; I still have a lot of other things to do."
Since most were only intermediate formation arrays, it was not difficult for a high-level array master like Fa Zhen to set them up.
In less than two hours, he had already successfully set up two formations in Zhang Fei's residence.
After that, he continued to set up the two formations for the east and west areas, and it only took him a little over an hour to set them up.
Zhang Fei then took Fa Zhen to the back of his residence, and he immediately set up the two formations as initially planned.

After he had set up both of them, he set up the Heavenly Qi Convergence Array, covering the entire area of the residence so that everyone inside did not need to gather in one place to cultivate, and they could cultivate from their rooms.
After installing everything, Fa Zhen installed the Golden Defensive Formation Array, his best protective formation array.
Its creation was much more complicated than all previous formations, and it took quite a long time to prepare everything.
Zhang Fei closely observed Fa Zhen as he prepared the formation. 'This formation is his best formation, huh?
I guess Xian Feng asked him to use it.'

Once the preparations were complete, Fa Zhen immediately instructed Zhang Fei to arrange the materials in various corners of his residence as per his instructions, and he immediately proceeded with the creation process once all the materials had been placed in their respective positions.
A golden dome enveloped the residence five hours later, indicating that the defensive formation was perfectly installed.
Observing Fa Zhen's extreme exhaustion from exerting so much Qi to create the formation, Zhang Fei promptly gave him some Qi recovery pills, shocking the old array master.
"Old Fa, please keep them a secret, or Lian Jinshu will report it to the alchemy union, and those people will come here to bother me."
"I know." Fa Zhen nodded in response.
"Since everything is settled, I will return to the capital immediately."

chapters.title: Chapter 539 Start Forging
paragraphs: "Wait a minute, Old Fa." Fa Zhen raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei. "Can you sell me the materials to create the Heavenly Qi Convergence Array? Since the Heavenly Qi Convergence Array is superior to the Qi Gathering Array, I intend to use it in other locations, thus necessitating the materials."

Fa Zhen imparted the formation method and handed some materials to Zhang Fei. "I only have one set of materials left, so you should try creating the Qi Gathering Array first, or they will be destroyed if you fail to create it."

"Yeah, you're right; I'll do it as you suggest." After that, Fa Zhen took his returning jade out and immediately broke it. Zhang Fei hurried to catch up with Gang Zhishou, who had already finished building the forging furnace.

"It's done; you can start practicing today." Zhang Fei nodded in satisfaction after he saw the forging furnace. "After you feel ready, you can use those thunderstrike alloys to forge your first weapon, and I'll prepare some other materials so I can teach you to make higher equipment."
"Do you want to spend the night here, Old Gang?"
Gang Zhishou immediately rejected Zhang Fei's offer. "I would love to, but I must prepare myself for that blacksmithing competition, so I must return now."

"All right, I will see you in a few days, and I will have successfully forged my first weapon by then." After Gang Zhishou disappeared, Zhang Fei went to Zhang Chen, who was standing in the distance with Wang Zhetian and Dou Luotian. "Emperor Xian ordered Old Fa to provide us with the best protective array, and he also helped me set up several other arrays around this residence so all of you will be completely safe while you stay here."
"I think that's a good thing, Fei'r." Zhang Chen then turned toward the forging furnace, which was far from their location. "Do you want to become a blacksmith?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed as he nodded. "Grandma, we will meet more and more powerful cultivators every time we go to a higher realm, so we need stronger equipment to protect ourselves. Unfortunately, high-level equipment is too expensive, so I want to become a blacksmith to forge more equipment for all of you. Furthermore, due to the existence of the Alchemy Union, I am unable to sell pills in this realm. Therefore, I am considering opening an equipment shop instead."
Zhang Chen let out a soft sigh before hugging Zhang Fei. "I'm glad to see you like this, but I hope you won't push yourself too hard, and you should rest when you need it."

"Don't worry, grandma. I know my limit and won't push myself beyond my limits." Zhang Fei then looked at his grandfather and Dou Luotian. "My clone on earth met Gabriel a few days ago, and he offered me to join his side. However, I was not interested in interfering in the internal affairs of the winged race, so I rejected him."

Dou Luotian was not surprised by that. "Ever since you told us that you met Jiang Yinghua, I had expected Gabriel to come to see you, but I didn't expect that he would come so soon. Honestly, people on his side are too selfish and more concerned with their safety."

"They may be selfish to you, but in my opinion, their decision is the best." Zhang Fei then turned his gaze to the people engaged in their activities in the distance. "To me, the safety of all of you is the most important, so I can't care about other people's quarrels or fights. Even if many wars occur in this realm, I will not participate in them and will only focus on protecting all of you. If the situation becomes too dangerous, I will immediately take you to a safer realm. Anyway, I'm considering going to the Tian Realm and challenging the Heaven Tower."

"What do you mean by that? Why do you want to challenge the heaven tower? Doesn't that mean you are deliberately looking for trouble with them?" Dou Luotian asked with a frown. She was afraid that Zhang Fei would make a big mess there and slaughter many members of her race.

"I need to settle something there, but I will not tell you about it." Zhang Fei then thought for a moment. "I know your concerns, but I can assure you that I will not cause a big mess there as long as they do not hinder me from achieving my goal."
"When will you go to the Tian Realm?"

Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "I haven't decided when I'll go there yet, and I'm still considering it." Zhang Fei then released Zhang Chen from his embrace. "I'm going to install a formation in my training space, so I'll go there now."
After Zhang Fei disappeared, Dou Luotian immediately asked Zhang Chen. "Can you persuade him not to go there, Sister Chen?"

Zhang Chen shook her head at Dou Luotian. "Sister Dou, Fei'er will never change his mind once he has decided on something, so there is no way I can persuade him. I suggest you contact Micah when you guys return to Earth so he can tell your father about his plan, and they can prepare for the worst from now on."
"Yeah, you're right." Dou Luotian then turned to her husband. "It's been more than two weeks since we returned to Earth, so I think it's time for us to return for a while."
Wang Zhetian nodded in agreement to his wife. "All right, we'll ask Fei'er to send us there once his clones return."
Huan Ya looked restless in the alchemy shop, mainly because the effect of Zhang Fei's enhanced demon charm still lingered in her mind, making it difficult for her to forget his figure.
The five men there with her seemed confused by her behavior, especially since she had never been like that before. "What do you think about that brat, Huan Ya?"

Lian Jinshu's question brought Huan Ya back to her senses, but she immediately shook her head at him. "Senior Lian, I advise you not to find trouble with him. His cultivation is still in the Earth Realm. Yet, I sense he possesses extraordinary abilities that enable him to resist my charm technique, making it impossible for me to control him. Moreover, Emperor Xian and his family favored him, and he even sent his two personal guards specifically to save him from Situ Yi. Emperor Yun and Empress Shi are also interested in him, so we will be at a loss if we have to deal with them."
Lian Jinshu was furious with Huan Ya's words, but he couldn't refute her since she was telling the truth. Fighting Xian Feng was already difficult for him, let alone facing Yun Shang simultaneously.

Lian Jinshu suddenly remembered something and took it out of his storage ring, throwing it to Huan Ya, who caught it with a frown. "Since your charm technique is useless against that brat, you can use the scarlet blossom pill on him, and he will be head over heels for you after he swallows it. However, you must do it carefully, lest you swallow the pill in front of him, or you will be the one to bow down to him."

Situ Yi, whom Zhang Fei had enslaved, immediately raised his eyebrows. He immediately sent a transmission to his master and told him about Lian Jinshu's plan, but he ordered him to keep an eye on Huan Ya without stopping her.
"Senior Lian, you-" Huan Ya swallowed her words as Lian Jinshu took out a few stalks of fiery red flowers, and she looked eager to get them.

Lian Jinhua smiled faintly when he saw Huan Ya's expression, and he had already guessed that she would be interested in the flowers. However, he took out a pill and showed it to her, which caused her expression to turn ecstatic. Not only did she look excited, but the four male guards also appeared eager to get the pill. "If you bring that brat to me, I will give you these sunfire orchids and this superior-grade pure essence golden pill. With their help, you can break through to the seven divine realms directly, so the decision is yours."

After considering it, Huan Ya finally agreed to take Lian Jinshu's order. Moreover, Zhang Fei cultivated four major levels below hers, and she still had her unique ability, so she was confident that she could do something about him without alerting Xian Feng and his subordinates. "I will do it, but I can't possibly do it quickly because those two old men are protecting him, and I will find the right opportunity first."

Lian Jinshu smiled in satisfaction with Huan Ya's decision and immediately gave her a stalk of sunfire orchids to make her more enthusiastic about carrying out her duties. Unfortunately, he was still unaware that Situ Yi had already sided with Zhang Fei, and his plans had already been leaked to him.

"As for you four, I have a special task for you, and you must get the items I need, or I will report your failure to our organization." After that, Lian Jinshu threw four scrolls, one each, to the four people. "Go now."
"Yes."

After fully understanding the method, Zhang Fei immediately took out the materials to make the Heavenly Qi Convergence Array and prepared them according to what Fa Zhen had shown him. Since this was his first time trying to make a high-level intermediate array, and he only had one set of materials, he did it very carefully.

Unlike Fa Zhen, who took less than an hour to create the formation, Zhang Fei managed to create it after three hours. Although it took too long to complete, he was satisfied with the result, and they could improve their cultivation faster with the combined effects of the Heavenly Qi Convergence Array and the Yin-Yang Harmony Array. 'Hahaha! This way, I can reach the Heaven Realm faster than I originally estimated, and I will immediately bring Hu Yue to my side after I reach 10-Star.'

Mei suddenly spoke to him. [Master, your beast form is falling behind your human and demon forms, and your beast essence is still less than half before you can evolve into six tails. You should start focusing on that, and you need to find some strong female beasts for it. Your easiest chance is Shen Xinya because she has been offering herself to you for a long time, but you keep rejecting her because she only wants power.]

'No, I won't do anything to Shen Xinya as long as she's still like that.' Zhang Fei shook his head in refusal. 'Sigh! I've tried to woo Shen Huang too many times, but she's firm in her decision not to remarry, and she would hate me if I used my new demon abilities on her, so I never used them on her.'
[Hehe.] Mei suddenly laughed. [Master, you seem to have forgotten one of your demon abilities. You can use it on her to make her fall for you on her own, just like Shang Yaolin did.]

Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh before replying to the AI. 'I haven't forgotten that ability, Mei. I never used the dream imprisonment on Shen Huang because she hardly ever slept, and she kept her focus on cultivating, so it wouldn't be useful against her. I will see her now, but I'm sure she will reject me again.'
"Hmm?" Shen Huang, who was cultivating in her room, immediately opened her eyes when she sensed Zhang Fei's presence. "Why did you come here? Didn't you want to practice blacksmithing?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed before sitting down beside Shen Huang. "Hey, you've always been paying attention to me, huh? However, you keep rejecting me, even though I've been courting you for the past few months."

Shen Huang tilted her face to the side. "Why do you want me to be your wife so badly? You already have Xueyi, Yue'er, Boitata, Lingxue, and your big sister. They are more than enough to help you evolve, right?"

"Do you think I want you just to help me evolve?" Zhang Fei responded with a frown. "We've spent so much time together; you should already know my character. If I wanted it like that, I would have accepted Shen Xinya long ago, especially since she had already offered herself to me. As for Xueyi and the others, I chose them to be my wives not because I wanted their beast essence but because I wholeheartedly loved them."

Shen Huang had no words to refute Zhang Fei because they had been living together for a long time, so she knew his feelings for them. Even so, she had never been interested in having a new partner, let alone the man who seduced her was the husband of her granddaughter and granddaughter.

Seeing Shen Huang fall silent, Zhang Fei immediately grabbed her hand. "I am a lust demon, and you know that I can force you to fall for me by using my abilities. However, I have never used them on you, so you should already understand my feelings for you. I want you to become my wife, not because of your beast essence, but because I have feelings for you. I hope you can give me a chance, and I will prove my feelings to you."

"No." Sheng Huang immediately refused and tried to pull her hand from his grasp, but Zhang Fei held it tighter. "I understand your feelings, but you don't understand mine. I have long decided not to accept other men in my life, so I hope you will stop seducing me and find other female beasts to be your wife."
Zhang Fei did not immediately let go of Shen Huang's hand and looked at her thoughtfully. "Do you want to continue living in solitary like this?"

"Yes." Shen Huang replied with a determined nod. "I already have a daughter, a granddaughter, and a great-granddaughter. My life is complete with them by my side, so I don't need a husband, and I will only focus on my cultivation."
Zhang Fei sighed heavily at Shen Huang's stubbornness, and he immediately used the dream imprisonment on her before letting go of her hand. "I'll go now, and you can continue your cultivation."

Shen Huang kept staring at the door, even though Zhang Fei had already left the room, and she rubbed the hand he had held earlier. 'I'm sorry. You've helped me so much that I've been able to break through to the sovereign realm, and you've even brought me to this realm. However, I don't want to feel that feeling again, so I will never be able to accept you.'

After he left Shen Huang's room, Zhang Fei immediately went to the capital to pick up Liu Hua. It was already quite late, and he didn't want any trouble to happen to her in the capital, especially since Situ Yi had already informed him about Lian Jinshu and Huan Ya's plan.

Afterward, Zhang Fei went straight to the forging furnace and took one piece of thunderstrike alloy out of his storage ring. He then heated the furnace to the right temperature and began heating the alloy. He then took out a device and threw it on the ground, and a soundproof barrier immediately surrounded the location so that people would not be disturbed by his forging activities.

After the thunderstrike alloy softened, Zhang Fei immediately removed it from the furnace and started hammering it according to the method Gang Zhishou had taught him. He hammered the alloy carefully, adjusting his strength with each stroke.
Several senior women, such as Liu Qingyu, Shen Xueyi, and others, watched Zhang Fei forge his first equipment from a distance.

After two hours, Zhang Fei finally managed to forge his first weapon. However, he was dissatisfied with the result because it was too bad compared to the one forged by Gang Zhishou, so he immediately took out another thunderstrike alloy and repeated the process. Unfortunately, the results did not meet his expectations again, so he restarted the process.

Situ Yi, whom Zhang Fei had enslaved, immediately raised his eyebrows.
He immediately sent a transmission to his master and told him about Lian Jinshu's plan, but he ordered him to keep an eye on Huan Ya without stopping her.
"Senior Lian, you-" Huan Ya swallowed her words as Lian Jinshu took out a few stalks of fiery red flowers, and she looked eager to get them.
Lian Jinhua smiled faintly when he saw Huan Ya's expression, and he had already guessed that she would be interested in the flowers.
However, he took out a pill and showed it to her, which caused her expression to turn ecstatic.
Not only did she look excited, but the four male guards also appeared eager to get the pill.
"If you bring that brat to me, I will give you these sunfire orchids and this superior-grade pure essence golden pill.
With their help, you can break through to the seven divine realms directly, so the decision is yours."
After considering it, Huan Ya finally agreed to take Lian Jinshu's order.

Moreover, Zhang Fei cultivated four major levels below hers, and she still had her unique ability, so she was confident that she could do something about him without alerting Xian Feng and his subordinates.
"I will do it, but I can't possibly do it quickly because those two old men are protecting him, and I will find the right opportunity first."
Lian Jinshu smiled in satisfaction with Huan Ya's decision and immediately gave her a stalk of sunfire orchids to make her more enthusiastic about carrying out her duties.
Unfortunately, he was still unaware that Situ Yi had already sided with Zhang Fei, and his plans had already been leaked to him.

"As for you four, I have a special task for you, and you must get the items I need, or I will report your failure to our organization." After that, Lian Jinshu threw four scrolls, one each, to the four people.
"Go now."
"Yes."

After fully understanding the method, Zhang Fei immediately took out the materials to make the Heavenly Qi Convergence Array and prepared them according to what Fa Zhen had shown him.
Since this was his first time trying to make a high-level intermediate array, and he only had one set of materials, he did it very carefully.
Unlike Fa Zhen, who took less than an hour to create the formation, Zhang Fei managed to create it after three hours.

Although it took too long to complete, he was satisfied with the result, and they could improve their cultivation faster with the combined effects of the Heavenly Qi Convergence Array and the Yin-Yang Harmony Array. 'Hahaha!
This way, I can reach the Heaven Realm faster than I originally estimated, and I will immediately bring Hu Yue to my side after I reach 10-Star.'
Mei suddenly spoke to him.
[Master, your beast form is falling behind your human and demon forms, and your beast essence is still less than half before you can evolve into six tails.
You should start focusing on that, and you need to find some strong female beasts for it.
Your easiest chance is Shen Xinya because she has been offering herself to you for a long time, but you keep rejecting her because she only wants power.]
'No, I won't do anything to Shen Xinya as long as she's still like that.' Zhang Fei shook his head in refusal. 'Sigh!
I've tried to woo Shen Huang too many times, but she's firm in her decision not to remarry, and she would hate me if I used my new demon abilities on her, so I never used them on her.'
[Hehe.] Mei suddenly laughed.
[Master, you seem to have forgotten one of your demon abilities.
You can use it on her to make her fall for you on her own, just like Shang Yaolin did.]
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh before replying to the AI. 'I haven't forgotten that ability, Mei.
I never used the dream imprisonment on Shen Huang because she hardly ever slept, and she kept her focus on cultivating, so it wouldn't be useful against her.
I will see her now, but I'm sure she will reject me again.'
"Hmm?" Shen Huang, who was cultivating in her room, immediately opened her eyes when she sensed Zhang Fei's presence.
"Why did you come here?
Didn't you want to practice blacksmithing?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed before sitting down beside Shen Huang.
"Hey, you've always been paying attention to me, huh?
However, you keep rejecting me, even though I've been courting you for the past few months."
Shen Huang tilted her face to the side.
"Why do you want me to be your wife so badly?
You already have Xueyi, Yue'er, Boitata, Lingxue, and your big sister.
They are more than enough to help you evolve, right?"
"Do you think I want you just to help me evolve?" Zhang Fei responded with a frown.
"We've spent so much time together; you should already know my character.
If I wanted it like that, I would have accepted Shen Xinya long ago, especially since she had already offered herself to me.
As for Xueyi and the others, I chose them to be my wives not because I wanted their beast essence but because I wholeheartedly loved them."
Shen Huang had no words to refute Zhang Fei because they had been living together for a long time, so she knew his feelings for them.
Even so, she had never been interested in having a new partner, let alone the man who seduced her was the husband of her granddaughter and granddaughter.
Seeing Shen Huang fall silent, Zhang Fei immediately grabbed her hand.
"I am a lust demon, and you know that I can force you to fall for me by using my abilities.
However, I have never used them on you, so you should already understand my feelings for you.
I want you to become my wife, not because of your beast essence, but because I have feelings for you.
I hope you can give me a chance, and I will prove my feelings to you."
"No." Sheng Huang immediately refused and tried to pull her hand from his grasp, but Zhang Fei held it tighter.
"I understand your feelings, but you don't understand mine.
I have long decided not to accept other men in my life, so I hope you will stop seducing me and find other female beasts to be your wife."
Zhang Fei did not immediately let go of Shen Huang's hand and looked at her thoughtfully.
"Do you want to continue living in solitary like this?"
"Yes." Shen Huang replied with a determined nod.
"I already have a daughter, a granddaughter, and a great-granddaughter.
My life is complete with them by my side, so I don't need a husband, and I will only focus on my cultivation."
Zhang Fei sighed heavily at Shen Huang's stubbornness, and he immediately used the dream imprisonment on her before letting go of her hand.
"I'll go now, and you can continue your cultivation."
Shen Huang kept staring at the door, even though Zhang Fei had already left the room, and she rubbed the hand he had held earlier. 'I'm sorry.
You've helped me so much that I've been able to break through to the sovereign realm, and you've even brought me to this realm.
However, I don't want to feel that feeling again, so I will never be able to accept you.'
After he left Shen Huang's room, Zhang Fei immediately went to the capital to pick up Liu Hua.
It was already quite late, and he didn't want any trouble to happen to her in the capital, especially since Situ Yi had already informed him about Lian Jinshu and Huan Ya's plan.
Afterward, Zhang Fei went straight to the forging furnace and took one piece of thunderstrike alloy out of his storage ring.
He then heated the furnace to the right temperature and began heating the alloy.
He then took out a device and threw it on the ground, and a soundproof barrier immediately surrounded the location so that people would not be disturbed by his forging activities.
After the thunderstrike alloy softened, Zhang Fei immediately removed it from the furnace and started hammering it according to the method Gang Zhishou had taught him.
He hammered the alloy carefully, adjusting his strength with each stroke.
Several senior women, such as Liu Qingyu, Shen Xueyi, and others, watched Zhang Fei forge his first equipment from a distance.
After two hours, Zhang Fei finally managed to forge his first weapon.
However, he was dissatisfied with the result because it was too bad compared to the one forged by Gang Zhishou, so he immediately took out another thunderstrike alloy and repeated the process.
Unfortunately, the results did not meet his expectations again, so he restarted the process.

chapters.title: Chapter 540 Xian Xianqin's Invitation
paragraphs: Early in the morning, Zhang Fei had already used up three-quarters of the thunderstrike alloys that Gang Zhishou had given him, and he finally managed to forge his first weapon according to his wishes. Since the materials were low-rank, the sword was only a mortal-grade weapon.

Zhang Fei was satisfied with it, especially since it marked his status as a beginner blacksmith. Based on Gang Zhishou's explanation, blacksmiths only have seven ranks: beginner, spirit, master, grandmaster, saint, divine, and supreme.

A beginner-rank blacksmith is capable of forging equipment in the mortal grade, and they can progress to the spirit rank after successfully forging their first spirit-grade equipment. However, forging equipment at that rank is not easy. Blacksmiths at the master and grandmaster ranks are capable of crafting equipment of the earth and heaven ranks. A saint rank is a blacksmith who can forge low-rank celestial to low-rank divine equipment, and those who succeed in crafting mid-grade to high-grade equipment are divine-rank blacksmiths.

Gang Zhishou had never met a supreme-rank blacksmith because the highest rank in the middle realms was only a divine rank, and only one person had reached it: the leader of the blacksmith union. Even his master, Duan Zhao, is only a saint-rank blacksmith. Meanwhile, his blacksmith rank is only at grandmaster rank.
"Are you satisfied with the results?" Liu Hua asked as she and several other women approached Zhang Fei.

"The result is satisfactory, but this sword is only a mortal grade, so it's useless." Zhang Fei immediately handed the sword to Liu Hua. "This is enough for me to practice my blacksmithing skills, and I will try to forge other equipment later, but I have to meet Old Gang first to get the materials first."
Liu Qingyu then asked him. "Why don't you build another blacksmith workshop in the training space?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei pulled Liu Qingyu into a hug. "Old Gang is kind and willing to teach me about blacksmithing, but I am still unfamiliar with his character, so I did not bring him there. After this, I will bring Hua'er to the capital and buy materials to build another blacksmith workshop in the training space so I can get more used to forge equipment."
"Husband, we will join you because we are bored of staying here and want to explore the capital."

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows at Zhang Lingxue's words, but his other wives also looked eager to go to the capital. They have been staying in the training space ever since they left for the Nine Stars Realm, and they have been in seclusion since they arrived in the realm. Even after their residence was completed, they had not gone anywhere and focused on their training, so they wanted to refresh their minds. "I will take all of you to the capital, but I won't be accompanying you, so please exercise caution. Lian Jinshu is still pursuing me, and he has even instructed Huan Ya to use the scarlet blossom pill on me in an attempt to seduce me.

Instead, they laughed after hearing that, but Shen Xueyi then spoke. "Lian Jinshu is such an idiot to send a woman to you; he doesn't even know your identity as a lust demon lord. Even though Huan Ya's cultivation is in the quasi-divine realm, I believe you will have no difficulty subduing her."

Zhang Fei smiled at that. "To be honest, I used my enhanced demon charm on Huan Ya when she and Lian Jinshu visited the restaurant, and I'm sure the effects are still lingering in her mind. That's why I'm going to walk around by myself to lure her to come to me, and I'll use her to destroy that old man, including his family."

Shen Yu and the others were unsurprised that Zhang Fei had targeted Lian Jinshu's family, as he had previously dispatched Situ Yi to capture Zhang Lingxue. Moreover, their husband is not forgiving and will never forgive anyone who targets them. "You must clean yourself up now, and we will go to the capital after."
They arrived at the capital, but Zhang Fei did not bring all his wives from Earth and the two Dryads. He asked them to train to fight beasts with the disciples of both sects.
Senior cultivators like Shen Huang, Shen Xinya, Zhang Long, Yang Yudie, Zie'er, Liu Rong, and Liu Ming accompanied them to train in the forest.

Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] summoned their respective partners out of the training space, especially since most of them still lacked the experience to fight as cultivators, such as the demons from the Diyu Realm. However, their group did not join the other group; instead, they trained in another forest, especially since the previous forest was already crowded, with Zhang Fei's main harem and those disciples training there.
As for Zhang Wuji and Yan Zhixiu, Zhang Fei sent them to the Netherworld Realm because they had spent a long time in the Nine Stars Realm and needed the demon aura there to increase their demon rank.

According to their plan, the women looked around the capital area in several groups. Liu Qingyu left with Chu Ying, Chu Xing, Chu Qing, and Wei Luan. Zhang Lingxue left with three other women: Ye Lian, Zhao Ziqin, and Zhang Xiaoling. Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu left together to see another area first. Meanwhile, Boitata was too lazy to look around the capital, so she joined Liu Hua and went to their restaurant.

Their presence attracted the attention of the capital's residents, especially the men. Many admired them from afar, but others tried to approach them because of their beauty. Naturally, they ignored them and maintained a cold attitude toward them, which caused some of them to become angry. However, they immediately ran away like frightened rabbits when they sensed several intense pressures pressing down on them, as they knew the owner of those pressures.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei leisurely walked toward the market district to buy materials to build another blacksmith workshop. His gaze never shifted from the map, and he kept watching the women. He found several names following their groups, such as Old Wen and Old Feng.
'Xian Feng deliberately sent them to get my attention.' Zhang Fei suddenly looked up and smiled at Xian Xianqin, who was floating down toward him. "Did you miss me, Princess?"

Even though they already knew about Zhang Fei's closeness to the royal family following the opening of his restaurant yesterday, the people around him continued to curse and mock him, believing that he was overconfident.

'This guy is truly shameless! He already has many beautiful wives by his side, but he still tries to seduce me.' Xian Xianqin then answered Zhang Fei. "I came here wanting to offer you something, but I'm not sure you'll be willing to accept it. It is related to the Star Tower, so I hope you can consider it first."
The Star Tower caught Zhang Fei's interest. "What is your offer?"
"Can you stop calling me a princess?" Xian Xianqin's question baffled the people around them. "You can call me something else, especially since we've known each other for a while."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and immediately grabbed Xian Xianqin's hand, leaving the onlookers gasping in shock. His next question made them ridicule him even more. "What if I call you my darling?"

"You... you..." Xian Xianqin stuttered as red hues appeared on her cheeks, but she immediately pulled her hand back from Zhang Fei's grasp. "I'm not your darling! You must address me as a princess forever!"
The onlookers exchanged confused glances after they saw Xian Xianqin's behavior, especially after they noticed the red hues on her cheeks. They had never seen her lose her cool like that before.
Zhang Fei just smiled in response to Xian Xianqin's behavior. "Do you want me to join you?"

"Yes." Xian Xianqin replied with a nod. "We were planning to go to the tower in a week, and you were interested in going there, so I wanted to invite you to join us. We will go with our sect members, and I will take you to our sect if you are willing to join us."

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows because he had not decided to join any sect, and he could go there using his Nine Cloud Steps and teleportation. However, if he went there, he would meet too many powerful cultivators, so he needed strong backers to protect him, and the people of the Xian Imperial sect were his best choice. "Do I have to join your sect for that?"

"No." Xian Xianqin denied it with a shake of her head. "My parents told us not to force you to join our sect, so you don't need to join us. I know you can go there with your abilities, but going there with us is much better than going there alone, right?"
Zhang Fei immediately agreed. "I'll go with you, but I need to buy some materials first."
"Do you want to build something else?" Xian Xianqin inquired.

Zhang Fei immediately told Xian Xianqin about his plan to build a blacksmith workshop. He then showed her the swords he had forged before, but she seemed uninterested in them since they were only mortal-grade. "I know their quality is ordinary, but these swords are my first equipment, so I'm quite satisfied with successfully forging them. At least I have officially become a blacksmith now, and I will continue to improve my skills in forging equipment under the guidance of Old Gang so I can forge high-grade equipment in the future. After I succeed in forging one, I will forge a lot of equipment for them."

Xian Xianqin stared at Zhang Fei for some time before releasing a sigh in her heart, as his talent made her feel extremely jealous. She already knew that he was an alchemist apprentice, a rank one array master, and he was now also a beginner blacksmith.

While walking towards the market district, they discussed various topics, particularly the Star Tower. However, Zhang Fei smiled faintly when he saw Huan Ya's name on his map, and he followed them at a distance.

Xian Xianqin frowned after Zhang Fei told her about Huan Ya's whereabouts, but he asked her not to pay attention to the female guard and to contact her father's subordinates, asking them not to stop the woman. 'Are you sure you can face her alone? Her cultivation is on par with mine, and I heard she has a unique ability, so you may not be her opponent.'

'If we fight using our cultivation, I'm not her opponent.' Zhang Fei then looked at Xian Xianqin. 'However, you still remember my other identity, right? Not many people can resist my lust demon abilities, and there are only two people who can resist them so far.'
'Only two people?' Zhang Fei answered Xian Xianqin with a nod. 'Who are they? How can they resist your abilities?'
Zhang Fei told her right away. 'Feng Yao came from the upper realms and is a unique cultivator. The other one is Jiang Yinghua, and she is a winged race with strong light elements.'

'Eh?' Xian Xianqin's expression changed to surprise upon hearing Jiang Yingyua's race. 'How do you know the members of the winged race? I've met some of them in the past, and their light element is indeed extraordinary; even my mother admits it.'

'My original home realm is directly connected to three other realms.' After hearing that, Xian Xianqin put on a curious look, so Zhang Fei immediately told her about the three realms. 'Lillea and Janette are Dryads from the Diyu Realm, but I have relocated the members of their race to the Sky Jade Realm.' I have a pretty good relationship with the demons of that realm, but they are not demon cultivators. The Tian Realm is home to the winged race, but they call themselves angels. As for the Xian realm, that realm is where humans with supernatural powers live, and they consider themselves to be gods.'
'Aren't they too arrogant to call themselves gods?' Xian Xianqin asked with a frown.

Zhang Fei gave a nod of agreement. 'They can brag about themselves because they are much stronger than ordinary humans, rivaling the winged race or the demons. They tend to think highly of themselves since they have no opponents stronger than them because there are no cultivators in my home realm. Cultivators are no different from them; many consider themselves gods due to their superior cultivation.'

'You're right.' Xian Xianqin replied with a slight nod. 'Ximen Gongfu was one of them; he always thought he was a demon god. That's why his thoughts were never aligned with those of Ximen Changtian, and his ambition to rule this realm was simply too lofty.'

'A demon god, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered with a slight smirk. 'Ximen Gongfu was too naive to believe he was a demon god, and there were countless demons stronger than him in the universe. I've met one of them, and she could easily wipe out both demon kingdoms in this realm. Moreover, she's not even the leader of her race, and the leader of her race is much more terrifying than him.'

Before long, they had arrived at the market district, and Zhang Fei rushed to buy all the materials he needed to build a blacksmith workshop. After he bought everything, Xian Xianqin immediately led him to the Xian Imperial Sect, which was located quite far outside the capital.

Huan Ya, who had been following them, felt confused seeing them leave the capital. She hurriedly followed them, but she maintained a safe distance to prevent their discovery. Unfortunately, she was unaware that they had noticed her presence and purposefully allowed her to follow them.

After they were far enough away from the capital, Xian Xianqin asked Zhang Fei. 'Are you going to do something about that woman now? If you want to do it now, I will help you deal with her, and she will not be able to fight both of us at once.'

'No need.' Zhang Fei declined, casting a quick glance at Huan Ya's hiding place. 'I know your worries, but I am confident in my abilities and speed. For now, I just want to get to your sect and hear your plans regarding the tower, and I'll confront her after we get back.'
Xian Xianqin didn't say anything, but she doubted that Zhang Fei could handle Huan Ya alone. 'Sigh! I'll follow him later and help him if he has trouble handling her.'

After some time, they reached the Xian Imperial Sect's location, leaving Zhang Fei in awe of its grandeur. The sect's prominence was significantly greater than all other sects in the Sky Jade Realm, and its area extended several miles in all directions. Moreover, the protective array that protected the sect was as powerful as the one that protected the Xian royal palace. The top of the walls was equipped with various types of ordinary weapons or artifacts, and he could see countless dots gathered inside it.
"Hehe." Xian Xianqin chuckled at Zhang Fei's expression. "Are the sects in the Sky Jade Realm this big?"

"No." Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head. "The Blazing Phoenix Sect is the largest sect in my realm, yet it still pales in comparison to this sect. As for my sect, the Yin-Yang Pavilion used to be a prostitution area, but Shen Xueyi's ancestor turned it into a dual cultivation sect."
"Does that mean all your sect members are prostitutes?"

"Do you think I'm a prostitute?" Xian Xianqin immediately covered her mouth with both hands. "Many of them are indeed no different from prostitutes, and some of them even have two partners, either male or female disciples. However, many others are loyal to their respective partners, and some of them are even still virgins, such as Mu Lingshu and Lin Dong'er."
Xian Xianqin had no interest in discussing dual cultivators, so she guided Zhang Fei into the Xian Imperial Sect. "Let's go; I will introduce you to my master."
