I know you can go there with your abilities, but going there with us is much better than going there alone, right?"
Zhang Fei immediately agreed.
"I'll go with you, but I need to buy some materials first."
"Do you want to build something else?" Xian Xianqin inquired.
Zhang Fei immediately told Xian Xianqin about his plan to build a blacksmith workshop.
He then showed her the swords he had forged before, but she seemed uninterested in them since they were only mortal-grade.
"I know their quality is ordinary, but these swords are my first equipment, so I'm quite satisfied with successfully forging them.
At least I have officially become a blacksmith now, and I will continue to improve my skills in forging equipment under the guidance of Old Gang so I can forge high-grade equipment in the future.
After I succeed in forging one, I will forge a lot of equipment for them."
Xian Xianqin stared at Zhang Fei for some time before releasing a sigh in her heart, as his talent made her feel extremely jealous.
She already knew that he was an alchemist apprentice, a rank one array master, and he was now also a beginner blacksmith.
While walking towards the market district, they discussed various topics, particularly the Star Tower.
However, Zhang Fei smiled faintly when he saw Huan Ya's name on his map, and he followed them at a distance.

Xian Xianqin frowned after Zhang Fei told her about Huan Ya's whereabouts, but he asked her not to pay attention to the female guard and to contact her father's subordinates, asking them not to stop the woman. 'Are you sure you can face her alone?
Her cultivation is on par with mine, and I heard she has a unique ability, so you may not be her opponent.'
'If we fight using our cultivation, I'm not her opponent.' Zhang Fei then looked at Xian Xianqin. 'However, you still remember my other identity, right?
Not many people can resist my lust demon abilities, and there are only two people who can resist them so far.'
'Only two people?' Zhang Fei answered Xian Xianqin with a nod. 'Who are they?
How can they resist your abilities?'
Zhang Fei told her right away. 'Feng Yao came from the upper realms and is a unique cultivator.
The other one is Jiang Yinghua, and she is a winged race with strong light elements.'
'Eh?' Xian Xianqin's expression changed to surprise upon hearing Jiang Yingyua's race. 'How do you know the members of the winged race?
I've met some of them in the past, and their light element is indeed extraordinary; even my mother admits it.'

'My original home realm is directly connected to three other realms.' After hearing that, Xian Xianqin put on a curious look, so Zhang Fei immediately told her about the three realms. 'Lillea and Janette are Dryads from the Diyu Realm, but I have relocated the members of their race to the Sky Jade Realm.' I have a pretty good relationship with the demons of that realm, but they are not demon cultivators.
The Tian Realm is home to the winged race, but they call themselves angels.
As for the Xian realm, that realm is where humans with supernatural powers live, and they consider themselves to be gods.'
'Aren't they too arrogant to call themselves gods?' Xian Xianqin asked with a frown.
Zhang Fei gave a nod of agreement. 'They can brag about themselves because they are much stronger than ordinary humans, rivaling the winged race or the demons.
They tend to think highly of themselves since they have no opponents stronger than them because there are no cultivators in my home realm.
Cultivators are no different from them; many consider themselves gods due to their superior cultivation.'
'You're right.' Xian Xianqin replied with a slight nod. 'Ximen Gongfu was one of them; he always thought he was a demon god.
That's why his thoughts were never aligned with those of Ximen Changtian, and his ambition to rule this realm was simply too lofty.'
'A demon god, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered with a slight smirk. 'Ximen Gongfu was too naive to believe he was a demon god, and there were countless demons stronger than him in the universe.
I've met one of them, and she could easily wipe out both demon kingdoms in this realm.
Moreover, she's not even the leader of her race, and the leader of her race is much more terrifying than him.'
Before long, they had arrived at the market district, and Zhang Fei rushed to buy all the materials he needed to build a blacksmith workshop.
After he bought everything, Xian Xianqin immediately led him to the Xian Imperial Sect, which was located quite far outside the capital.
Huan Ya, who had been following them, felt confused seeing them leave the capital.
She hurriedly followed them, but she maintained a safe distance to prevent their discovery.
Unfortunately, she was unaware that they had noticed her presence and purposefully allowed her to follow them.
After they were far enough away from the capital, Xian Xianqin asked Zhang Fei. 'Are you going to do something about that woman now?
If you want to do it now, I will help you deal with her, and she will not be able to fight both of us at once.'
'No need.' Zhang Fei declined, casting a quick glance at Huan Ya's hiding place. 'I know your worries, but I am confident in my abilities and speed.
For now, I just want to get to your sect and hear your plans regarding the tower, and I'll confront her after we get back.'
Xian Xianqin didn't say anything, but she doubted that Zhang Fei could handle Huan Ya alone. 'Sigh!
I'll follow him later and help him if he has trouble handling her.'
After some time, they reached the Xian Imperial Sect's location, leaving Zhang Fei in awe of its grandeur.
The sect's prominence was significantly greater than all other sects in the Sky Jade Realm, and its area extended several miles in all directions.
Moreover, the protective array that protected the sect was as powerful as the one that protected the Xian royal palace.
The top of the walls was equipped with various types of ordinary weapons or artifacts, and he could see countless dots gathered inside it.
"Hehe." Xian Xianqin chuckled at Zhang Fei's expression.
"Are the sects in the Sky Jade Realm this big?"
"No." Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head.
"The Blazing Phoenix Sect is the largest sect in my realm, yet it still pales in comparison to this sect.
As for my sect, the Yin-Yang Pavilion used to be a prostitution area, but Shen Xueyi's ancestor turned it into a dual cultivation sect."
"Does that mean all your sect members are prostitutes?"
"Do you think I'm a prostitute?" Xian Xianqin immediately covered her mouth with both hands.
"Many of them are indeed no different from prostitutes, and some of them even have two partners, either male or female disciples.
However, many others are loyal to their respective partners, and some of them are even still virgins, such as Mu Lingshu and Lin Dong'er."
Xian Xianqin had no interest in discussing dual cultivators, so she guided Zhang Fei into the Xian Imperial Sect.
"Let's go; I will introduce you to my master."

chapters.title: Chapter 541 Chao Yuanfeng
paragraphs: As soon as they entered the Xian Imperial Sect, Zhang Fei smelled a familiar scent, so he immediately used the nature awareness ability he got after Zefyr made a contract with him. Countless Qi threads appeared before his eyes in that instant, but he focused his attention on the only dark Qi thread among the others.
Zhang Fei then grabbed it and tracked down its owner, discovering it was a male demon. 'As expected, there is a demon in this sect, yet no one is aware of his identity.'
"What happened to you? Are you under pressure because of the many strong cultivators in the sect?" Xian Xianqin inquired after observing Zhang Fei's facial expression.

'Hmm? I'd better not reveal the man's identity for now, especially since I don't know whether he is a good or evil demon. Furthermore, revealing his identity abruptly could potentially raise suspicions towards me.' Zhang Fei shook his head at Xian Xianqin directly. "Even though the cultivators in the Sky Jade Realm had not yet reached the seven divine realms, they were already much stronger than me when I first arrived there. I never felt pressured by their presence, so I am also not the least bit pressured by the people in this sect. Who is your master? Is that person as strong as your parents?"

"My master is Chao Yuanfeng, and his cultivation is one minor level below my parents at the 4-Moon Divine Expansion Realm. However, not only is he one of the best sword cultivators in this realm, but he is also a soul cultivator, just like you. Zhang Fei turned to Xian Xianqin in surprise. "I don't know about his soul cultivation level, but my father said he is the best soul cultivator in this realm."

Zhang Fei nodded slightly in response. 'A soul cultivator, huh? He might be the best in this realm, but he couldn't possibly surpass Qiao Liangren or Shang Yingyue, let alone the Soul Emperor, Huan Di.'

"Hey, Princess!" They immediately turned to the source of the voice, and they saw a woman hurriedly running towards them. She arrived before them moments later, but the sight of Zhang Fei startled her, prompting her to pull Xiao Xianqin away from him. 'Who is that man? Is he your lover? Do you like a young leaf? Look at him; he's still 20 years old, so you're too old for him.'
With his keen sense of hearing, Zhang Fei could naturally hear the woman's words, causing him to smile in amusement. 'This woman! She's too outspoken!'
Mei immediately informed Zhang Fei of the woman's data. Her name was Yuan Luo, and she was over 100 years old. Her cultivation reached the quasi-divine realm, just like Xian Xianqin.
Xian Xianqin naturally noticed Zhang Fei's smile, and Yuan Luo's questions embarrassed her to the point of turning her face red and black with anger.
"Ouch... Ouch..." Yuan Luo screamed in pain as soon as Xiao Xianqin pinched her right ear. "Princess! Let go of my ear, or it will stretch down."

"If you dare talk nonsense again, I will pull your ears as long as possible until your appearance becomes similar to those long-eared monkey beasts." Yuan Luo repeatedly closed her mouth and nodded, prompting Xian Xianqin to release her ear and inquire immediately. "Why are you looking for me?"

Yuan Luo rubbed her right ear with one hand and pointed at Zhang Fei with the other. "Our Master sensed his arrival in our sect, so he asked me to meet you two, and he asked you to bring him to meet him directly."
Xiao Xianqin let out a soft sigh and turned to Zhang Fei. "At first, I want to show you some areas of this sect, but my master seems impatient to meet you, so we should go meet him right now."

"Sure." Zhang Fei immediately followed behind the two women, who were whispering about him. His eyes paid attention to the male demon's movements on his map, and he saw the man moving toward their destination. 'Hmm? That guy seems to be in the same group as Xianqin, but his master is a soul cultivator, so he should have known that he was a demon, yet he let him stay among them.'

After some time, they reached a somewhat secluded section of the sect. A fish pond and bamboo forest surrounded a simple house, and Zhang Fei could see that there were ten people inside, both male and female disciples.

Zhang Fei then glanced at the male demon, who had also just arrived at the location. From the system's scan, he learned that his name was Ximen Chuixue, and his cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend. 'He is stronger than Xianqin and Xianwu.'
Ximen Chuixue noticed Zhang Fei's glance, but Yuan Luo suddenly ran to his side and hugged his arm. "I thought you wouldn't be back today, but you're here now, Brother Chui Xue."

'Chui Xue? He disguised himself using that name, huh?' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered and used his demon eyes to examine Ximen Chuixue's soul, but the result was beyond his expectations. 'This guy's soul is similar to Angela's; I can't find anything negative about him.'

"Haha." Ximen Chuixue laughed and hugged Yuan Luo's waist. "I've been away for too long, and I've missed you. Moreover, our master also sent me a voice transmission, and he wanted to send us to the Star Tower soon, so I rushed back here."
Yuan Luo then pointed at Zhang Fei. "His name is Zhang Fei, and he is Princess Xianqin's future lover."
"Yuan Luo!"
Hearing Xian Xianqin's thunderous shout, Yuan Luo immediately hid behind Ximen Chuixue. "Brother, you have to protect me from the angry princess! I told the truth, but she kept scolding me!"
"Shut up!" Once again, Xian Xianqin shouted angrily. "Otherwise, I'll ask my uncle to punish you, and you can't go to the tower with us!"

Xian Xianqin was infuriated when Yuan Luo stuck out her tongue at her, but Ximen Chuixue immediately spoke to her. "Princess Xianqin, you two have been friends for a long time, so you already know Luo'er's character, and she just loves to tease you."

Hearing the commotion outside, the disciples inside hurriedly came out to check their situation, but they immediately shook their heads when they saw the behavior of the two women. They've been in the same group for decades, so they know their characters well. Despite their frequent arguments and quarrels, they never viewed each other as enemies, and their relationship was actually quite close.

However, Zhang Fei's presence diverted their attention, confusing their group. After all, he was still only 20 years old, and his cultivation was only at 1-Star Earth Realm, so he shouldn't have been allowed to join their sect.

Xian Xianwu immediately explained to them. "Brothers and sisters, his name is Zhang Fei, and our master invited him here on purpose. Although he is much younger than us, and his cultivation is far below ours, you should not underestimate him because he is much stronger than he looks from the outside."
*Swoosh*

After Xian Xianwu said that, a male disciple suddenly moved as fast as lightning toward Zhang Fei to catch him, but his hand went through his illusion. Instantly, the other disciples fell into a daze in their spots because the male disciple's cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend, yet he was able to avoid him, and they could not even see his movements.

Ximen Chuixue, Yun Luo, and the other disciples then searched for Zhang Fei in the surrounding area, but they still couldn't find him. Meanwhile, Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin smiled in amusement at their reactions, especially since they already knew that they couldn't underestimate Zhang Fei's speed.
Seconds later, they looked behind Xian Xianqin because Zhang Fei had appeared there, but their expressions still showed that they had not yet recovered from their shock.

Xian Xianqin looked back immediately, but Zhang Fei suddenly hugged her waist in front of them, making her face bright red with embarrassment. "Senior Brothers and Senior Sisters, please forgive me; I didn't mean to show off in front of you."
'Hey! Let me go! Otherwise, I'll force you!' Xian Xianqin sent a voice transmission to Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei laughed in his heart and released his embrace from Xian Xianqin's waist, making her feel relieved. On the other hand, Xian Xianwu cast a suspicious glance at him, suspecting that he was interested in his sister. "Do you all believe me now? Even if we all work together to capture her, we will never succeed."

All of them nodded in agreement to Xian Xianwu, but Yuan Luo suddenly shouted. "Hey, Princess! He is not an ordinary young cultivator, so you should accept him as your lover, or else other women will snatch him away from you."

"He already has several wives, so I will never fall in love with him." Xian Xianqin shouted in frustration. "Moreover, all of his wives are much prettier than all of us, so he won't even glance at us."
"Huh?" Xian Xianqin's revelation left Yuan Luo and the other female disciples dumbfounded, especially since Zhang Fei was still too young in their eyes.

Zhang Fei scratched his head. "Princess Xianqin is right. I have several wives, and we are just small people with no status in this kingdom. That's why you can stop teasing her, especially since we are not meant to be together, Senior Sister Yuan."
Zhang Fei's last sentence caused Xian Xianqin to feel guilty, as she didn't mean it that way. She wanted to refute that, but she immediately swallowed her words back.
Xian Xianwu could only sigh in his heart, but he chose not to comment on it, believing that his sister could solve the problem herself.
"You guys should go in now, and you can join us, Zhang Fei."

Hearing that, they all rushed into the house, where their master, Chao Yuanfeng, was sitting cross-legged in the middle. They immediately sat down and surrounded him, with the exception of Zhang Fei, who was asked to sit in front of him. "You are truly not ordinary. Despite being only 20 years old, your cultivation has already reached the 1-Star Earth Realm, and your soul power has already reached the half-perfection stage of the soul core level. I can also see that you have already forged your body to be as strong as this, leading me to believe that you are also a body cultivator. Even though it is too thin, I can sense the sword qi in your body, so you have trained in the sword path before."

Ximen Chuixue and the others once again looked at Zhang Fei in shock, especially since pursuing a path of cultivation was already very difficult for them. Not many people can walk two paths of cultivation at once, let alone walk four.

Zhang Fei shook his head at Chao Yuanfeng. "Senior, my cultivation can reach this stage because I am a dual cultivator, and I have many women by my side who are always ready to help me. Therefore, my cultivation pales in comparison to all of you, especially considering that you have achieved your current level through your own efforts. You are right that I am a soul and body cultivator, and I also learned swordsmanship, but my ability in the sword path is too ordinary."
"Are you really a dual cultivator, Zhang Fei?" Yuan Luo asked in a tone of shock.
Zhang Fei nodded to her. "People may look down on the dual cultivation path, but it is the best path for me, and I will never be ashamed to admit my status as a dual cultivator."
"Oh." Yuan Luo nodded as she glanced at Xian Xianqin. 'Hmm? She's obviously interested in him, or else she wouldn't look so disappointed, right?'
Chao Yuanfeng then asked, "Can you tell me the name of your master in the soul cultivation and sword cultivation paths?"

"Senior, I don't have a master in the two paths." Zhang Fei's answer shocked not only Chao Yuanfeng but also his disciples, except for Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin. "Some of my wives and partners are sword cultivators, so I learned swordsmanship from them. I don't have a master in the soul cultivation path, but I know two senior soul cultivators, and they patiently guided me in learning it. Their names are Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue, but I'm sure you've never heard of them."

Chao Yuanfeng immediately searched his memories for those two names, but he didn't know them because they weren't cultivators from the middle realms; they came from the upper realms. "You're right, I don't know them. There are so many cultivators in our universe, and many of them are much more experienced than me in the soul cultivation path. Xianqin said that you are interested in the Star Tower, and she asked me to bring you there, so I asked her to bring you here. Although your cultivation is still at the 1-Star Earth Realm, you already have the qualifications to challenge the tower with your current abilities. However, you will probably fail to pass the challenges on the first floor, especially the battle challenge."

"Princess Xianqin already told me that we would be facing random enemies, and there were many cultivators much stronger than me there, so I was aware that my chances of passing the first floor were small. However, I was curious about the other challenges, so I wanted to challenge the tower." Zhang Fei then paused for a moment. "Moreover, I'm still young now, and the opportunities to challenge the tower are endless. If I fail this time, then I'll rechallenge it after I become powerful. At least I can get an understanding of the challenges, so I can better prepare myself to face them in the future."
Chao Yuanfeng nodded his head before turning to one of his male disciples. "Chui Xue, you are my disciple with the best physical strength, so I want to test Zhang Fei's attack power through you."

"Yes, Master." Ximen Chuixue immediately stood up from his seat and walked in front of Zhang Fei, who also immediately stood up. "Junior brother, you don't need to worry about hurting me, so feel free to use all your strength to attack me."
Xian Xianwu immediately interrupted. "Master, I don't think you need to test Zhang Fei's attack power, especially since my father has already tested it himself."
"Oh?" Chao Yuanfeng turned to Xian Xianwu. "What does Emperor Xian think about his strength?"
"Painful." Xian Xianwu answered briefly.

"Prince Xianwu, Emperor Xian may have tested his strength, but we want to witness his true strength firsthand. Moreover, Brother Chui Xue's physique is solid, so I'm sure he can withstand his attack." Xian Xianwu turned to the female disciple with a frown, but Yuan Luo and the other disciples also agreed with her. "Zhang Fei, you don't need to hold yourself back, and you can attack our brother with all your might."
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly as he glanced at the woman. Mei immediately informed him that her name was Bai Tian'er, and her cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend.
Zhang Fei then looked at Ximen Chuixue again. "Senior brother, I will use all my strength to attack you."
"Yes." Ximen Chuixue nodded and immediately took a defensive stance. "You can start, Junior Brother."
Zhang Fei immediately took an attacking stance, took a deep breath, and concentrated his strength into his right fist. When he was ready, he punched Ximen Chuixue directly in the abdomen.
*Boom*

Instantly, the atmosphere inside the house became silent, and all of them looked at Ximen Chuixue, who was embedded in the wall on their right. Zhang Fei's attack power far exceeded their expectations, as evidenced by the destruction of the wall behind him, leaving a hole in it.

Meanwhile, Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin shook their heads, especially since they had witnessed Zhang Fei knocking their father back several steps with just one punch. Although Ximen Chuixue was stronger than them, he could not possibly be stronger than their father.

"Cough... Cough..." Ximen Chuixue coughed hard as he wiped the blood from his mouth, and his expression was one of utter shock as he looked at Zhang Fei. "Junior brother, your attack power is too terrifying for a cultivator at your level, and it will be even more terrifying after you break through to the seven divine realms."

She wanted to refute that, but she immediately swallowed her words back.
Xian Xianwu could only sigh in his heart, but he chose not to comment on it, believing that his sister could solve the problem herself.
"You guys should go in now, and you can join us, Zhang Fei."
Hearing that, they all rushed into the house, where their master, Chao Yuanfeng, was sitting cross-legged in the middle.
They immediately sat down and surrounded him, with the exception of Zhang Fei, who was asked to sit in front of him.
"You are truly not ordinary.
Despite being only 20 years old, your cultivation has already reached the 1-Star Earth Realm, and your soul power has already reached the half-perfection stage of the soul core level.
I can also see that you have already forged your body to be as strong as this, leading me to believe that you are also a body cultivator.
Even though it is too thin, I can sense the sword qi in your body, so you have trained in the sword path before."
Ximen Chuixue and the others once again looked at Zhang Fei in shock, especially since pursuing a path of cultivation was already very difficult for them.
Not many people can walk two paths of cultivation at once, let alone walk four.
Zhang Fei shook his head at Chao Yuanfeng.
"Senior, my cultivation can reach this stage because I am a dual cultivator, and I have many women by my side who are always ready to help me.
Therefore, my cultivation pales in comparison to all of you, especially considering that you have achieved your current level through your own efforts.
You are right that I am a soul and body cultivator, and I also learned swordsmanship, but my ability in the sword path is too ordinary."
"Are you really a dual cultivator, Zhang Fei?" Yuan Luo asked in a tone of shock.
Zhang Fei nodded to her.
"People may look down on the dual cultivation path, but it is the best path for me, and I will never be ashamed to admit my status as a dual cultivator."
"Oh." Yuan Luo nodded as she glanced at Xian Xianqin. 'Hmm?
She's obviously interested in him, or else she wouldn't look so disappointed, right?'
Chao Yuanfeng then asked, "Can you tell me the name of your master in the soul cultivation and sword cultivation paths?"
"Senior, I don't have a master in the two paths." Zhang Fei's answer shocked not only Chao Yuanfeng but also his disciples, except for Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin.
"Some of my wives and partners are sword cultivators, so I learned swordsmanship from them.
I don't have a master in the soul cultivation path, but I know two senior soul cultivators, and they patiently guided me in learning it.
Their names are Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue, but I'm sure you've never heard of them."
Chao Yuanfeng immediately searched his memories for those two names, but he didn't know them because they weren't cultivators from the middle realms; they came from the upper realms.
"You're right, I don't know them.
There are so many cultivators in our universe, and many of them are much more experienced than me in the soul cultivation path.
Xianqin said that you are interested in the Star Tower, and she asked me to bring you there, so I asked her to bring you here.
Although your cultivation is still at the 1-Star Earth Realm, you already have the qualifications to challenge the tower with your current abilities.
However, you will probably fail to pass the challenges on the first floor, especially the battle challenge."

"Princess Xianqin already told me that we would be facing random enemies, and there were many cultivators much stronger than me there, so I was aware that my chances of passing the first floor were small.
However, I was curious about the other challenges, so I wanted to challenge the tower." Zhang Fei then paused for a moment.
"Moreover, I'm still young now, and the opportunities to challenge the tower are endless.
If I fail this time, then I'll rechallenge it after I become powerful.
At least I can get an understanding of the challenges, so I can better prepare myself to face them in the future."
Chao Yuanfeng nodded his head before turning to one of his male disciples.
"Chui Xue, you are my disciple with the best physical strength, so I want to test Zhang Fei's attack power through you."
"Yes, Master." Ximen Chuixue immediately stood up from his seat and walked in front of Zhang Fei, who also immediately stood up.
"Junior brother, you don't need to worry about hurting me, so feel free to use all your strength to attack me."
Xian Xianwu immediately interrupted.
"Master, I don't think you need to test Zhang Fei's attack power, especially since my father has already tested it himself."
"Oh?" Chao Yuanfeng turned to Xian Xianwu.
"What does Emperor Xian think about his strength?"
"Painful." Xian Xianwu answered briefly.
"Prince Xianwu, Emperor Xian may have tested his strength, but we want to witness his true strength firsthand.

Moreover, Brother Chui Xue's physique is solid, so I'm sure he can withstand his attack." Xian Xianwu turned to the female disciple with a frown, but Yuan Luo and the other disciples also agreed with her.
"Zhang Fei, you don't need to hold yourself back, and you can attack our brother with all your might."
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly as he glanced at the woman.
Mei immediately informed him that her name was Bai Tian'er, and her cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Transcend.
Zhang Fei then looked at Ximen Chuixue again.
"Senior brother, I will use all my strength to attack you."
"Yes." Ximen Chuixue nodded and immediately took a defensive stance.
"You can start, Junior Brother."
Zhang Fei immediately took an attacking stance, took a deep breath, and concentrated his strength into his right fist.
When he was ready, he punched Ximen Chuixue directly in the abdomen.
*Boom*
Instantly, the atmosphere inside the house became silent, and all of them looked at Ximen Chuixue, who was embedded in the wall on their right.
Zhang Fei's attack power far exceeded their expectations, as evidenced by the destruction of the wall behind him, leaving a hole in it.
Meanwhile, Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin shook their heads, especially since they had witnessed Zhang Fei knocking their father back several steps with just one punch.
Although Ximen Chuixue was stronger than them, he could not possibly be stronger than their father.
"Cough...
Cough..." Ximen Chuixue coughed hard as he wiped the blood from his mouth, and his expression was one of utter shock as he looked at Zhang Fei.
"Junior brother, your attack power is too terrifying for a cultivator at your level, and it will be even more terrifying after you break through to the seven divine realms."

chapters.title: Chapter 542 The Ten Challanges
paragraphs: "Are you okay, Brother?" Yuan Luo asked as she helped Ximen Chuixie up.
"Yeah." Ximen Chuixie nodded and held his stomach. "Although the attack was harrowing, I didn't suffer any injuries, so you don't have to worry about me."

With a sense of relief, Yuan Luo led Ximen Chuixie back to their seat, but Bai Tian'er unexpectedly approached Zhang Fei. She propped her chin on her hand and looked him up and down, causing him to frown after sensing her using her soul technique on him.
*Roar*
Bai Tian'er staggered back after she heard the roar from within Zhang Fei's soul. She looked at him with a questioning look about the source of the roar, confusing the other disciples.

Chao Yuanfeng had already surmised the existence of something within Zhang Fei's soul, leading him to realize that Bai Tian'er had glimpsed something from within. However, he wasn't as ignorant as her to check his soul because he didn't know Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue, and he guessed that they were superior to him, or else they wouldn't be able to help him develop his soul power so quickly.
Zhang Fei smiled faintly and asked. "Why do you keep looking at me like that, Senior Sister?"

"Nothing." Bai Tian'er shook her head and returned to face Zhang Fei. She then pointed her index finger at his chest, but her eyes glanced at Xian Xianqin for a moment before speaking to him. "You are really interesting, little boy. Since Princess Xianqin isn't interested in you, it's fine if I get close to you, right? Unlike her, I don't care if you are a dual cultivator, nor do I care if you have many women by your side."

Xian Xianqin clenched her fists tightly as she glared at her senior sister, but Bai Tian'er wore an indifferent expression. Xian Xianwu and the other disciples shook their heads at her attitude, but none of them said anything; even Chao Yuanfeng chose to remain silent.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and pulled Bai Tian'er's hand down. "Please forgive me, Senior Sister. You are indeed beautiful, but you will only bring endless trouble to me because there are so many men crazy about you, and I don't want my peaceful life to be disturbed by them."
Bai Tian'er raised her eyebrows. "How do you know about that? You don't even know my name, let alone my life."

"Senior sister, I may be much younger than you, but I am much more experienced than you in terms of feelings. Indeed, I don't know anything about you, but I can guess your situation from your attitude." Bai Tian'er didn't say anything to answer him, but Zhang Fei could see the curiosity in her eyes. "You can guess as you like, but I will never change my opinion about you."
Yuan Luo glanced at Xian Xianqin, who looked relieved after Zhang Fei rejected Bai Tian'er. 'Hehehe! My guess was right on target! Our princess is interested in this young leaf.'
"That's enough, Tian'er." Bai Tian'er nodded to her master and returned to her seat while Chao Yuanfeng gestured for Zhang Fei to sit down again. "Has Xianxin told you about the other challenges?"

Zhang Fei nodded in response. "The tenth challenge includes the demon heart challenge, battle challenge, nature challenge, sin challenge, survival challenge, willpower challenge, soul challenge, beast challenge, maze challenge, and enlightenment challenge."

"That's correct." Chao Yuanfeng then explained each challenge to Zhang Fei. "You can only pass the demon heart challenge if you manage to lift the burden in your heart, but it's not an easy task, and all of them have failed repeatedly. In fact, only Chui Xue and Bai Tian'er have successfully passed the demon heart challenge, but they failed the enlightenment challenge."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei turned to Ximen Chuixue for a moment, as he did not expect that a demon like him had successfully passed his demon heart challenge.
Unlike Ximen Chuixue, who smiled faintly after their master mentioned it, Bai Tian'er wore a proud look.
Zhang Fei could not care about her and asked Chao Yuanfeng again. "What are the requirements for passing the other eight challenges, Senior?"

"To pass the natural challenge, you need an understanding of the laws of elements. However, it is often troublesome, especially since the elements that appear are often not our elements. Additionally, we will be faced with extreme climate, such as thunderstorms, snowstorms, and various others." Zhang Fei himself had heard about it from Xian Xianqin, so he was not too surprised by it. "The willpower challenge is actually quite difficult, but we can complete it easily as long as we have made sufficient preparations before facing it. They will send us to a special place where time stops, leaving us unsure of how long we will be there. Many cultivators failed because they had to face this challenge alone."

"A place where time stops, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "Loneliness is one of the most frightening experiences for living beings, and not everyone can withstand such extreme loneliness. Since we don't know the time in there, we will experience extreme boredom and loneliness, and both will drive our minds crazy."
"That's right." Chao Yuanfeng nodded to Zhang Fei. "I'm not sure how strong your mental strength is, but I doubt you can overcome that challenge, especially with so many people around you."
Zhang Fei did not deny it, but he already had a solution to overcome the challenge. "Don't worry, Senior. I can definitely pass the challenge."
Chao Yuanfeng and all his disciples, including Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu, looked confused by Zhang Fei's confidence.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed while rubbing his nose. "Even though I have many people by my side, I am also used to facing such a situation, so I am confident that I can pass the challenge. Then, what about the survival challenge, Senior?"

"The survival challenge requires teamwork, so all of you must help each other pass it. If one of you fails to meet a requirement, then the entire team will fail. The test will reveal itself randomly once we reach the challenge location." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding to Chao Yuanfeng. "The worst they have ever faced was that they had to face several levels of beast hordes in an extreme place, and the strength of the beasts at each turn would continue to increase, but their strength would not exceed the cultivation of the highest member."

Zhang Fei once again looked at Ximen Chuixue and Bai Tian'er, especially since they were the strongest among Chao Yuanfeng's disciples. "So the strength of those beasts is at most 1-Moon Divine Transcend, right?"

Chao Yuanfeng nodded to Zhang Fei before explaining the other challenge. "The maze challenge is also a team challenge, and you have to find some keys to get out of it. However, the maze area is vast, and it will change every five hours. Due to flying restrictions, you must walk through the maze."

"That's really troublesome." Chao Yuanfeng's disciples nodded their heads in agreement with Zhang Fei. "The beast challenge should only require us to clean up the beasts that appear in front of us, right?"

"You're right." Chao Yuanfeng then told him something else. "The soul challenge is the easiest test for you and Tian'er, especially since you two are soul cultivators. However, Xianqin and the others will struggle since their soul power is weaker than yours."
Zhang Fei had already predicted the challenges he would face in the soul challenge. "Then, what about the sin and enlightenment challenge?"

"The test of the sin challenge is determined by your actions prior to taking it." Zhang Fei immediately turned to a male disciple. Mei informed him that his name was Ying Shanhu, and his cultivation was in the quasi-divine realm. "The seven deadly sins."
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows. "Pride, greed, wrath, lust, envy, gluttony, and sloth."

"Yes." Yang Shanhu nodded to Zhang Fei. "From the names of the seven, you should be able to guess the tests. In addition to the seven, we will face our karma, and it will be cumbersome if our hands are stained with the blood of many living beings. That's why the tests can be either easy or difficult, depending on our karma."

Zhang Fei immediately looked at his hands in silence, puzzling Chao Yuanfeng and his other disciples. Meanwhile, Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu had already heard that he faced lightning tribulation twice in one breakthrough, which meant his bad karma was too great. "Apparently, the sin challenge will be the most troublesome for me, but I still have confidence in overcoming it."

Chao Yuanfeng stared at Zhang Fei for a while before telling him the last challenge. "The enlightenment challenge can be a blessing or a disaster for us. You can choose one of the thousands of techniques in that place, but you only have one day to learn it. The higher the grade you choose, the higher the difficulty. If you succeed in learning it, then the technique will be yours. If you fail to learn it, the technique will disappear from your memories, and you will suffer a backlash."
"What grade is the highest, Senior?"

"A divine-grade technique." Zhang Fei's eyelids lit up after hearing that. "There are four types of techniques in it: attack, defense, support, and boost. You have the option to select only one technique, so you must carefully consider which one best suits your needs. If you force yourself to choose two or more techniques, the restrictions there will attack you, and you will be sent out immediately, which means you will also fail to pass the first floor."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "So when are we going to the Star Tower?"

"It's a week away, so you better start preparing yourself for all those tests." Chao Yuanfeng wanted to say something else to Zhang Fei, but Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu immediately stopped him because he would never agree. "If you want, you can stay in the sect for a week so you can get to know Chui Xue and the others better, which will be beneficial for your teamwork."

"All right, I'll stay here for a week." Zhang Fei immediately agreed to Chao Yuanfeng's request because he still didn't know them. "However, I still have some business right now, so I'll finish it first, and I'll come back here right after."
Chao Yuanfeng immediately turned to Xian Xianqin. "You can escort him out of our sect, or those old folks will stop him."
"Yes, Master." Xian Xianqin immediately led Zhang Fei away, but Xian Xianwu hurriedly followed them.
After their departure, Bai Tian'er immediately questioned their master. "Do you think he will be able to pass the first floor, Master?"

"I can't say for sure." Chao Yuanfeng answered with a shake of his head. "Although his attack power is exceptional for his current level, the battle challenge will be troublesome for him. He will meet stronger enemies, and they will not let him attack them like before, so he will probably fail to pass it. Even if he manages to pass it because of luck, I'm sure he'll stop at the sin challenge."
"The sin challenge?" All of them turned to their master in confusion.
Chao Yuanfeng immediately explained to them. "Judging from his previous reaction, coupled with the blood stench on his body, I'm sure he had killed too many living creatures."
"Does that mean he's a cold-blooded killer, Master?" A female disciple frowned as she posed this question.

"Do you think a cold-blooded killer would be able to act like him, Bing Yue?" The female disciple shook her head at Chao Yuanfeng. "I don't know how a young man of his age could have such a strong blood stench in his body, but I am certain that he was not a cold-blooded killer, and he probably killed them because they were a threat to him or the people around him. Otherwise, Emperor Xian wouldn't let him get close to his two children, especially Princess Xianqin."
Hearing that, Bai Tian'er smiled faintly and turned her head outside. 'Haha! Since he is going to join us, I have plenty of time to change his mind, and I will make him kneel to me.'

Chao Yuanfeng immediately spoke again. "You guys can go now and prepare everything you need to challenge the tower. Regarding the other groups from our sect, you don't need to worry about them; instead, you should concentrate solely on your group. Do you all understand?"
"Yes, Master."
"So, are you really going to face Huan Ya now?"

Her sister's question to Zhang Fei caused Xian Xianwu to raise his eyebrows. "Do you have a problem with Huan Ya? Huan Ya's cultivation has reached the quasi-divine realm, and her unique ability is truly frightening. Furthermore, she is supported by the alchemy union, so I strongly advise you to avoid her."

"Prince, I understand your concerns, and I also understand the difference in strength between us." Zhang Fei then turned to Xian Xianwu. "However, I can't possibly run away from those who are after me and my family, right? Lian Jinshu had ordered Situ Yi to capture Lingxue with the intention of taking her to his higher-ups in the alchemy union, but I managed to thwart his plan. He then ordered Huan Ya to capture me, and he even ordered her to use the scarlet blossom pill on me, so I decided to confront him now."

Xian Xianwu massaged his forehead because Zhang Fei was too stubborn. "I know you are confident in your abilities, but Xianqin and I cannot possibly let you face Huan Ya alone, so we will follow behind you. If she overwhelms you and corners you, we will come to your aid immediately."
Since they had good intentions to help and protect him, Zhang Fei naturally won't reject their wishes. "All right, you two can follow me, but you will only move if I am really in danger."

After that, they hurriedly left the sect, but Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin waited for Zhang Fei to walk a little further before following him. They used their concealing artifacts to hide their aura from Huan Ya.
Upon arriving outside the sect, Zhang Fei immediately searched for Huan Ya's location on his map, and he leisurely walked toward another area to lure the woman.

Huan Ya, who had been waiting for him, immediately ambushed Zhang Fei as soon as he arrived at an empty field. However, he immediately teleported away, foiling her sudden ambush and leaving her shocked.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed as he stood in mid-air. "I didn't expect Lian Jinshu to send his chief guard to capture me, but you underestimated me, Huan Ya. How do you feel now? Do you enjoy the influence of my charm?"

Huan Ya frowned because the effect of Zhang Fei's enhanced demon charm had not yet worn off, and the effect became even stronger once he used it once again. She said nothing and pulled out two daggers, using her full speed to fly towards him. However, her attack was unsuccessful, as he instantly vanished from her sight. 'What the hell with this brat? How can his speed surpass mine?'

"Your cultivation is indeed far above mine, but your speed is nothing in my eyes." Huan Ya immediately spun around and stabbed her dagger toward Zhang Fei, but he punched her stomach as fast as lightning, sending her flying quite far back.
Huan Ya immediately stabilized herself, held her stomach with one hand, and wiped the blood from her mouth with the other. "Cough... Cough..."

Zhang Fei then pulled out the Hongxi dagger, released his hormone manipulation toward Huan Ya, and teleported behind her to attack her. She immediately activated her protective artifact, causing his attack to hit her protection. He immediately teleported again after his failure, but that was enough for his demon pheromone to affect her.

Huan Ya's body quickly heated up as Zhang Fei's hormone manipulation aroused her lust, and her breathing swiftly became irregular, making it difficult for her to concentrate. 'What the hell happened to me?'

Huan Ya tried hard to suppress her lust and took out a returning jade to escape, but Zhang Fei instantly teleported in front of her and snatched it before moving elsewhere. "Do you think I will let my prey escape?"

Chao Yuanfeng immediately turned to Xian Xianqin.
"You can escort him out of our sect, or those old folks will stop him."
"Yes, Master." Xian Xianqin immediately led Zhang Fei away, but Xian Xianwu hurriedly followed them.
After their departure, Bai Tian'er immediately questioned their master.
"Do you think he will be able to pass the first floor, Master?"
"I can't say for sure." Chao Yuanfeng answered with a shake of his head.
"Although his attack power is exceptional for his current level, the battle challenge will be troublesome for him.
He will meet stronger enemies, and they will not let him attack them like before, so he will probably fail to pass it.
Even if he manages to pass it because of luck, I'm sure he'll stop at the sin challenge."
"The sin challenge?" All of them turned to their master in confusion.
Chao Yuanfeng immediately explained to them.
"Judging from his previous reaction, coupled with the blood stench on his body, I'm sure he had killed too many living creatures."
"Does that mean he's a cold-blooded killer, Master?" A female disciple frowned as she posed this question.
"Do you think a cold-blooded killer would be able to act like him, Bing Yue?" The female disciple shook her head at Chao Yuanfeng.

"I don't know how a young man of his age could have such a strong blood stench in his body, but I am certain that he was not a cold-blooded killer, and he probably killed them because they were a threat to him or the people around him.
Otherwise, Emperor Xian wouldn't let him get close to his two children, especially Princess Xianqin."
Hearing that, Bai Tian'er smiled faintly and turned her head outside. 'Haha!
Since he is going to join us, I have plenty of time to change his mind, and I will make him kneel to me.'
Chao Yuanfeng immediately spoke again.
"You guys can go now and prepare everything you need to challenge the tower.
Regarding the other groups from our sect, you don't need to worry about them; instead, you should concentrate solely on your group.
Do you all understand?"
"Yes, Master."
"So, are you really going to face Huan Ya now?"
Her sister's question to Zhang Fei caused Xian Xianwu to raise his eyebrows.
"Do you have a problem with Huan Ya?
Huan Ya's cultivation has reached the quasi-divine realm, and her unique ability is truly frightening.
Furthermore, she is supported by the alchemy union, so I strongly advise you to avoid her."
"Prince, I understand your concerns, and I also understand the difference in strength between us." Zhang Fei then turned to Xian Xianwu.
"However, I can't possibly run away from those who are after me and my family, right?
Lian Jinshu had ordered Situ Yi to capture Lingxue with the intention of taking her to his higher-ups in the alchemy union, but I managed to thwart his plan.
He then ordered Huan Ya to capture me, and he even ordered her to use the scarlet blossom pill on me, so I decided to confront him now."
Xian Xianwu massaged his forehead because Zhang Fei was too stubborn.
"I know you are confident in your abilities, but Xianqin and I cannot possibly let you face Huan Ya alone, so we will follow behind you.
If she overwhelms you and corners you, we will come to your aid immediately."
Since they had good intentions to help and protect him, Zhang Fei naturally won't reject their wishes.
"All right, you two can follow me, but you will only move if I am really in danger."
After that, they hurriedly left the sect, but Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin waited for Zhang Fei to walk a little further before following him.
They used their concealing artifacts to hide their aura from Huan Ya.
Upon arriving outside the sect, Zhang Fei immediately searched for Huan Ya's location on his map, and he leisurely walked toward another area to lure the woman.
Huan Ya, who had been waiting for him, immediately ambushed Zhang Fei as soon as he arrived at an empty field.
However, he immediately teleported away, foiling her sudden ambush and leaving her shocked.
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed as he stood in mid-air.
"I didn't expect Lian Jinshu to send his chief guard to capture me, but you underestimated me, Huan Ya.
How do you feel now?
Do you enjoy the influence of my charm?"
Huan Ya frowned because the effect of Zhang Fei's enhanced demon charm had not yet worn off, and the effect became even stronger once he used it once again.
She said nothing and pulled out two daggers, using her full speed to fly towards him.
However, her attack was unsuccessful, as he instantly vanished from her sight. 'What the hell with this brat?
How can his speed surpass mine?'

"Your cultivation is indeed far above mine, but your speed is nothing in my eyes." Huan Ya immediately spun around and stabbed her dagger toward Zhang Fei, but he punched her stomach as fast as lightning, sending her flying quite far back.
Huan Ya immediately stabilized herself, held her stomach with one hand, and wiped the blood from her mouth with the other.
"Cough...
Cough..."
Zhang Fei then pulled out the Hongxi dagger, released his hormone manipulation toward Huan Ya, and teleported behind her to attack her.
She immediately activated her protective artifact, causing his attack to hit her protection.
He immediately teleported again after his failure, but that was enough for his demon pheromone to affect her.

Huan Ya's body quickly heated up as Zhang Fei's hormone manipulation aroused her lust, and her breathing swiftly became irregular, making it difficult for her to concentrate. 'What the hell happened to me?'
Huan Ya tried hard to suppress her lust and took out a returning jade to escape, but Zhang Fei instantly teleported in front of her and snatched it before moving elsewhere.
"Do you think I will let my prey escape?"

chapters.title: Chapter 543 Huan Ya's Ability
paragraphs: As his demon pheromone increasingly affected her, Huan Ya glared at Zhang Fei, and her breathing became heavier. 'What exactly did he do to me? I didn't see him use anything earlier, but my overflowing lust caused me to lose control. Tch! I didn't want to use my ability because he was just an ant, but his speed was truly troublesome, so I was forced to use it.'

Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows as soon as Huan Ya removed the necklace around her neck, triggering several changes in her body. Her dark purple shimmered, a dark purple aura enveloped her body, and numerous dark purple tattoos appeared, forming a line that spread across her body.

Quickly, Huan Ya's dark purple aura spread throughout the area and formed a dark purple dome, enveloping the two of them. Zhang Fei was stunned for a moment when many naked women appeared in front of him, and he naturally could recognize their identities immediately; two of them were Shen Huang and Feng Yao.

Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin, who were watching them from afar, panicked as soon as they saw Huan Ya's dark purple dome. They wanted to move to save Zhang Fei, but he stopped them through telepathy, especially since the effect of her ability was useless to him.
[Master, Huan Ya's unique ability is a domain; it seems to be related to temptation and hidden desire, especially since you want these women to be your wives.]
'A temptation and hidden desire domain, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered to himself. 'Is there a method to create a domain in the system shop, Mei?'
[Unfortunately, there is currently no such method available in the shop. You may need to wait for the system to upgrade a few more times, Master.]

'I see.' Zhang Fei saw Huan Ya disappear from his sight, but he could find her through the map, and she hid herself among the women. 'If she used it on ordinary men, they would definitely fall into this temptation. Fortunately, I am a lustful demon lord, and I am more lustful than she thought.'
Suddenly, all the women moved towards Zhang Fei, groping his body and even kissing his face. However, his gaze was only on Huan Ya, who had disguised herself as another woman far behind them.

Zhang Fei immediately used the demon corruption, causing darkness to fill Huan Ya's domain. He then released his aura, bouncing all the women away from him. She was shocked to see him transform into his lustful demon lord form.
"De... demon..." Huan Ya trembled because of Zhang Fei's lust demon form, and her trembling intensified when his blood-red eyes glowed after he used his demon eyes.

"It seems you've had some bad experiences with demons, huh?" Huan Ya immediately flew away from Zhang Fei, but his darkness corruption had already weakened her, and her speed decreased significantly due to its effects. Moreover, she was already affected by his hormone manipulation, and her ever-increasing lust disturbed her greatly. "Unfortunately, you're too late, and you won't be able to escape from me anymore."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Several poisonous, thorny tree branches shot up from the ground, but Huan Ya immediately used her daggers to cut them down. However, the tree branches were simply endless, and they kept popping up to attack her.
*Roar*

"Ugh!" Huan Ya became dizzy and confused as soon as Zhang Fei unleashed his demon king's roar, and those tree branches immediately wrapped around her body from top to bottom. Their thorns penetrated her skin, and their poison spread rapidly into her body, causing her movements to become even more sluggish. Some of them tied up both her hands and feet, rendering her unable to move.
Zhang Fei immediately moved in front of Huan Ya, touched her chest, and used his demon-absorbing technique on her. "Argh!"

Since Zhang Fei had no intention of killing Huan Ya, he immediately stopped once she weakened. The weakening of her mental state caused his hormone manipulation to affect her mind further, causing her to become completely horny. Her domain immediately disappeared by itself, so he also withdrew his darkness corruption.

However, Zhang Fei had other plans for Huan Ya, so he pressed his palm against her chest and forced her soul out of her body. After that, he released his soul, fused their souls, and returned their souls to their bodies after he was done.

Zhang Fei then removed the effects of his hormone manipulation from Huan Ya's body and calmed her lust by using his light qi, allowing her to regain her senses. Her body was utterly limp after he absorbed most of her life force and vitality, and he immediately supported her so she didn't fall to the ground.

"You don't have to look at me like that." Zhang Fei then returned to his human form, removed the tree branches, and forced Huan Ya to swallow an antidote. "You are still useful to me, and I don't want to have any problems with the alchemy union, so I didn't have the intention to kill you from the start. However, your life is tied with me now, and you will die if I die, so you should think about your future carefully."

'This bastard!' Huan Ya could only curse in her heart. Even though she was controlled by her lust earlier, she was still aware of Zhang Fei's actions, and she could feel the connection between their souls.

"Zhang Fei!" Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin shouted as they flew to their sides, but they exchanged glances for a moment after they saw Huan Ya's condition. "What happened to her? How did you escape her unique ability?"

Zhang Fei smiled before explaining, "Her unique ability is a domain of temptation, and it brings out our hidden desires. If people don't have strong mental or soul power, they will undoubtedly fall into temptation. Fortunately, I am a soul cultivator and a demon, so it does not affect me. Regarding her condition, I used my demon abilities to absorb her life force and vitality, which resulted in her becoming weaker."
"What do you mean by a domain?" Both of them asked in confusion.
Zhang Fei shook his head at them. "I can't explain it to you two, especially since I have no knowledge about a domain. Perhaps my master knows something about it, so I'll try to ask her later."
Xian Xianqin looked at Huan Ya and asked, "How did she know about a domain?"

"I don't know." Zhang Fei actually already knew because he could easily read Huan Ya's memories after their souls merged, and each person needed a different method to create their domain. He then gave her two recovery pills so that she could recover her condition faster. "For now, you can return to Lian Jinshu's side, and I want you to find a way to bring his family to me."
Huan Ya was shocked to hear that, feeling that Zhang Fei was crazy for targeting Lian Jinshu's family, but she remained silent and nodded to him.
Xian Xianwu immediately asked Zhang Fei. "Does this mean you have enslaved this woman?"

"No." Zhang Fei denied it with a shake of his head. "I didn't enslave her because doing so would only make Lian Jinshu and the people from their organization suspicious. Instead, I used something else on her to avoid their suspicion. Nevertheless, the effect is not much different from enslavement, and she won't be able to refuse my orders."

Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu looked at Huan Ya with pity, especially since she had chosen the wrong target. She ended up falling into Zhang Fei's hands, and she couldn't even refuse his orders. However, her situation also led them to realize that he was far more terrifying than they had initially thought. He could even defeat a cultivator at their level without much difficulty, which means he could also defeat them.
"So what's your next plan?" Xian Xianqin asked.

"I already said I would stay in your sect for a week, and I will keep my word. However, many of my wives are in the capital now, so I have to bring them back to our residence first, and I will return to your sect afterward." Zhang Fei then looked towards the capital. "I will bring this woman back there now, and you two can wait in the sect."
Without waiting for their reply, Zhang Fei immediately used his teleportation and took Huan Ya away with him, causing Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin to let out soft sighs.
Xian Xianqin immediately turned to her brother. "With his current abilities and speed, I think Zhang Fei should be able to pass the first floor."

"Yeah." Xian Xianwu replied with a nod. "I don't know how Zhang Fei was able to hone his speed, but his speed is truly remarkable, and cultivators at the divine transcendence may not necessarily be able to keep up with his speed."

"Speed is a vital point in actual combat, and it will give us plenty of time to find our enemy's weaknesses. Even if we can't beat our opponents, we will have a great chance of escape." Xian Xianqin then flew away. "Let's go back, Brother."

Xian Xianwu nodded and followed behind Xian Xianqin, but he repeatedly looked back as he was curious about Zhang Fei's previous abilities, especially his ability to create and control plants. 'Could it be that he also has the wood element? As far as I remember, only wood cultivators can do something like that.'
After they arrived at the capital, Zhang Fei immediately asked Huan Ya to report to Lian Jinshu, and he rushed to his restaurant to wait for all his wives, who were still having fun in the city.
Zhang Fei found three unexpected guests in his restaurant, but they did not dare make a mess, especially since Old Wen kept monitoring them.
One of the three guests was Huangfu Lian, the prince of the Huangfu Kingdom. The other two are his partners, Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying.

'I didn't expect to see them again so soon.' Zhang Fei then entered his restaurant and glanced at the sea dragon bracelet on Dan Qingying's right wrist. He was eager to snatch it because Zhang Lin really liked the bracelet, but Huangfu Lian snatched it from him when he wanted to buy it from Duan Lingtian. 'Since they came here, I won't waste this opportunity.'

Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying, who were sitting facing the exit, immediately glanced at Zhang Fei. Their hearts skipped a beat as soon as he activated his enhanced demon touch, and they immediately realized that he was the man they had been looking for since several days ago.
'Qingying, that guy used something on us.' Gu Hanshuang spoke through a voice transmission, directing her attention back to the dishes in front of her to prevent Huangfu Lian from suspecting her.

Dan Qingying, who was also afraid of Huangfu Lian, nodded slightly as she stopped gazing at Zhang Fei. 'I don't know what his purpose is for doing this to us, but we'd better think of a way to meet him. We have to do it carefully, or else Prince Huangfu will find out, and he will punish us.'

Huangfu Lian noticed Zhang Fei's arrival, and he immediately remembered him, but he just snorted and ignored him. After all, he had heard that the owner of the Sky Jade Restaurant had a relationship with the Xian royal family, and they had constantly been monitoring him closely, so he didn't want to have any problems with them.

However, Huangfu Lian raised his eyebrows as soon as he saw Zhang Fei go up to the second floor because the place was off-limits to visitors, causing him to realize that he was the restaurant's owner.

'How can that brat have a relationship with the Xian royal family? Xian Feng even sent one of his aides to protect this place.' Huangfu wanted to check the activity on the second floor with his senses, but he immediately gave up the idea, especially since Old Wen would swiftly notice and stop him. 'Tch! I will report that brat to my father so he can take appropriate action against him, and he will be useful for us in destroying Xian Feng.'
"What do you plan to do to them?" Liu Hua inquired immediately after Zhang Fei revealed the identities of the three guests to her and Boitata.
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and asked back. "Don't you already know the answer, my dear Hua'er?"

"Our husband must be thinking about snatching those two women from Huangfu Lian." Liu Hua nodded in agreement with Boitata. "Those two women are nothing special, and I'm sure he just wants to have fun with them for a while before throwing them away. I think your efforts to snatch them away will not have any significant impact on him, husband. Instead, you can do something about him directly, and he will be more useful to you, especially in facing Emperor Huangfu."

Zhang Fei did not deny Boitata's opinion. "You are right; they are no different from tools to Huangfu Lian, and he can dispose of them whenever he wants. However, that guy is one of the princes of the Huangfu Kingdom, so he could not have come here without protection, and his father must have ordered his best men to protect him from afar. That's why I had to snatch those two women from him, and I will use them to do something to him."
Liu Hua then asked again. "How was your meeting with Princess Xianqin's master? Are you interested in joining the sect?"

"The sect is indeed huge, and there are many powerful cultivators there. Although the sect seems peaceful, they seem to have some complicated internal issues, so I'm not interested in joining." Zhang Fei then informed them of his intention to spend a week in their sect, but he didn't plan to go alone; instead, he would send one of his clones there. "This week, we will enter seclusion again, and I will help you improve your cultivation. After that, I will take you all to the Star Tower to test your strength in the stone obelisk, allowing you to gauge your progress. If you make the top 100, I'll take you to the first-floor tests. As for the tests, I will tell you after they return, so I don't have to explain them twice. Anyway, I need to purchase forging materials, so I'm heading to Old Gang's place right now."

Zhang Fei immediately descended to the first floor and walked out. However, he once again used his enhanced demon charm on Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying, causing their feelings to become even more messy and impatient to meet him.

Huan Ya had already arrived at the alchemy shop, and following Zhang Fei's directive, he reported to Lian Jinshu, which caused the old man to frown. "Senior Lian, I want to be able to break through to the seven divine realms, but I will not take such a risk to deal with the royal family and the people of the Xian Imperial Sect, so I will not do anything to that kid. If you still insist on capturing him, you can ask Senior Yong Zhengjun for help, especially since he is more capable than me to carry out that mission."

Lian Jinshu fell silent as the situation became more complicated with Zhang Fei having ties with the people from the Xian Imperial Sect, so he had to think things through more carefully, or he would be the one to bear the consequences. "All right, you can go back to your place now, and I will contact my brother-in-law to discuss this matter."

'This greedy old man is truly foolish! He doesn't have any information about Zhang Fei's identity, but he insisted on capturing him, and I fell into his hands because of him!' Huan Ya simply nodded to Lian Jinshu before departing from the alchemy shop.

After that, Lian Jinshu immediately contacted Yong Zhengjun and asked for his help in capturing Zhang Fei, but his brother-in-law refused his request right away. He still had a lot of business in the Bai Kingdom, so he also didn't want trouble with the people from the Xian royal family and the Xian Imperial Sect. "Damn it! Those two are really unreliable!"
