"Don't you already know the answer, my dear Hua'er?"
"Our husband must be thinking about snatching those two women from Huangfu Lian." Liu Hua nodded in agreement with Boitata.
"Those two women are nothing special, and I'm sure he just wants to have fun with them for a while before throwing them away.
I think your efforts to snatch them away will not have any significant impact on him, husband.
Instead, you can do something about him directly, and he will be more useful to you, especially in facing Emperor Huangfu."
Zhang Fei did not deny Boitata's opinion.
"You are right; they are no different from tools to Huangfu Lian, and he can dispose of them whenever he wants.
However, that guy is one of the princes of the Huangfu Kingdom, so he could not have come here without protection, and his father must have ordered his best men to protect him from afar.
That's why I had to snatch those two women from him, and I will use them to do something to him."
Liu Hua then asked again.
"How was your meeting with Princess Xianqin's master?
Are you interested in joining the sect?"
"The sect is indeed huge, and there are many powerful cultivators there.

Although the sect seems peaceful, they seem to have some complicated internal issues, so I'm not interested in joining." Zhang Fei then informed them of his intention to spend a week in their sect, but he didn't plan to go alone; instead, he would send one of his clones there.
"This week, we will enter seclusion again, and I will help you improve your cultivation.
After that, I will take you all to the Star Tower to test your strength in the stone obelisk, allowing you to gauge your progress.
If you make the top 100, I'll take you to the first-floor tests.
As for the tests, I will tell you after they return, so I don't have to explain them twice.
Anyway, I need to purchase forging materials, so I'm heading to Old Gang's place right now."
Zhang Fei immediately descended to the first floor and walked out.
However, he once again used his enhanced demon charm on Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying, causing their feelings to become even more messy and impatient to meet him.
Huan Ya had already arrived at the alchemy shop, and following Zhang Fei's directive, he reported to Lian Jinshu, which caused the old man to frown.

"Senior Lian, I want to be able to break through to the seven divine realms, but I will not take such a risk to deal with the royal family and the people of the Xian Imperial Sect, so I will not do anything to that kid.
If you still insist on capturing him, you can ask Senior Yong Zhengjun for help, especially since he is more capable than me to carry out that mission."

Lian Jinshu fell silent as the situation became more complicated with Zhang Fei having ties with the people from the Xian Imperial Sect, so he had to think things through more carefully, or he would be the one to bear the consequences.
"All right, you can go back to your place now, and I will contact my brother-in-law to discuss this matter."
'This greedy old man is truly foolish!

He doesn't have any information about Zhang Fei's identity, but he insisted on capturing him, and I fell into his hands because of him!' Huan Ya simply nodded to Lian Jinshu before departing from the alchemy shop.
After that, Lian Jinshu immediately contacted Yong Zhengjun and asked for his help in capturing Zhang Fei, but his brother-in-law refused his request right away.
He still had a lot of business in the Bai Kingdom, so he also didn't want trouble with the people from the Xian royal family and the Xian Imperial Sect.
"Damn it!
Those two are really unreliable!"

chapters.title: Chapter 544 The Sword Souls
paragraphs: [Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the earth realm or above.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Fei shook his head as he noticed someone following him from a distance. He guessed that it was Huangfu Lian's guards, and Mei immediately confirmed it. 'Huangfu Bo, huh? That idiot prince must have told his father about me, and Huangfu Shou ordered him to follow me.'

[As expected, you are indeed a magnet for trouble, and trouble has begun to disturb your life in this realm, Master. Lian Jinshu is after you because of Zhang Lingxue, and Huangfu Shou is after you because of your relationship with the Xian royal family.]

Zhang Fei released a soft sigh and nodded. 'I didn't want to cause trouble with anyone, but Xian Feng was really persistent in bringing me to his side. He even ordered his aides to protect us, which drew the attention of his enemies to me. I'm not afraid of them, but I won't fight them openly either, and I'll wait for them to come to me.'
Before long, Zhang Fei had arrived at the blacksmith shop, and he immediately looked for Gang Zhishou, who was forging equipment at his forging site.

Observing Gang Zhishou's full concentration, Zhang Fei remained silent, closely observing his senior as he meticulously forged the equipment. As a novice blacksmith with limited experience in forging equipment, he needed to expand his knowledge before he could create high-quality equipment for all his wives. 'Hey, Mei! Open the two daily gift packs.'
[You gained 50.000 beast essence.]
[You gained 50.000 Qi.]

An hour later, Gang Zhishou had finished the equipment, but he threw it aside after assessing it. "Phew! I can't possibly defeat the blacksmiths of the Divine Flame Realm if my abilities are still stuck like this."

"This equipment is actually quite good, but you seem to be aiming for a higher level, Old Gang." Zhang Fei expressed this as he took the equipment and examined it. "Are the skills of the blacksmiths from that realm that good?"

"I can't say whether they are good or not, and you can judge their abilities for yourself during the competition. You can have it if you want it, especially since it is useless to me, and I have no interest in selling it either." Gang Zhishou then asked. "How is your training? Have you gotten used to blacksmithing?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei immediately put away the equipment before taking out his first sword, and he swiftly handed it to Gang Zhishou. "After I used up three-quarters of the thunderstrike alloys, I managed to forge it perfectly, but I would like to know your opinion on it."

Gang Zhishou immediately observed the sword based on its thickness, shape, sharpness, and hilt. "I thought you would need a week to forge your first weapon, but you did it in a day. The thickness is perfect, but the sharpness still needs improvement, and you should flatten the sharp part further. The shape isn't bad, but it won't sell, and you can use your imagination more in forging your next weapon."

Zhang Fei scratched his head after Gang Zhishou mentioned imagination, but he admitted that his imagination in forging weapons was still lacking. "I will try to improve my imagination again, Old Gang. Do you still have the thunderstrike alloy?"

"A lot." Gang Zhishou then gave Zhang Fei a few batches of thunderstrike alloys. "You can use them to forge the best sword, and I will teach you to forge a mid-tier mortal-grade weapon after you have successfully forged it perfectly."
Zhang Fei immediately stored those alloys in the system inventory. "Old Gang, do we need special materials to forge a spirit weapon?"

"Yes." Gang Zhishou nodded to Zhang Fei. "Although a spirit-grade weapon is the most basic weapon for cultivators, we require materials far superior to the thunderstrike alloy. We usually need two to three materials to forge one, and the process will take longer. Have you ever heard of a soul weapon?"
"I have one." Zhang Fei immediately summoned the demon extermination sword. "Old friend, he is my friend, so you can let him observe you."
*Zing... Zing...*

Gang Zhishou immediately took the sword from Zhang Fei's hand, rubbed the blade, and then examined the materials used to forge it. "Everything about this sword is truly marvelous! Unfortunately, its grade is only a spirit grade, but it is still not perfect, and you can upgrade it to a higher grade if you can find the right materials. However, I cannot recognize the materials used by the blacksmith to forge it, so I can't help you increase its grade."
"Do you think Senior Duan Zhao can help me with that, Old Gang?"

"No." Gang Zhishou shook his head and returned the demon extermination sword to Zhang Fei. "I got my blacksmithing knowledge from my master, so I'm sure he won't be able to recognize the materials either, but you can ask him when you meet him on the day of the competition. In my opinion, the best choice is for you to find the blacksmith who forged it, and you can ask that person to improve its grade."

Zhang Fei smiled bitterly at that, especially since he got the demon extermination sword from the system reward. Unfortunately, the system did not record the name of the blacksmith who forged it, making it impossible for him to locate the blacksmith. "Are you going to forge equipment again?"
"Yes." Gang Jinshou then took out three different metals. "Since you are interested in learning how to forge a spirit-grade weapon, I will demonstrate it for you now, so please pay close attention."

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement, and Gang Zhishou began to heat the three metals in the furnace. A while later, he took the three materials and melted them together, molding them in a special container into a new type of metal.

Gang Zhishou then immersed it in a special liquid to accelerate the cooling process, during which he explained to Zhang Fei the process of forging a spirit-grade weapon. Once it hardened, he started heating it again, and after it softened, he began hammering it.

Unlike when he forged a mortal-grade weapon, Gang Zhishou took a longer time to forge a spirit-grade weapon. After three hours, he successfully forged a long sword and handed it to Zhang Fei once it had cooled. "This sword is only an ordinary spirit-grade sword, and we need a soul if we want to turn it into a soul weapon. However, finding a suitable soul for our weapon is not easy, and we have to put the soul into it right before we finish forging it."
"Are there any special requirements for the souls we will use to create a soul weapon?"

Gang Zhishou nodded to Zhang Fei. "We can use the souls of humans, beasts, demons, or even natural races to become the soul of our weapon. We must first build a close relationship with it before using it, or else it will refuse to enter our weapon. Usually, the blacksmith will use the soul of the living being closest to them, so the chance of success is very high."

"The soul of the living creature closest to us, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered as he thought about the soul inside the demon extermination sword. "Is it possible for us to establish communication with the soul within our soul weapon?"
Zhang Fei's question left Gang Zhishou bewildered. "You should be able to do it, right? If you can't do it, your sword won't be able to respond to you."

"I can't do it yet." Zhang Fei immediately summoned the demon extermination sword again. "My sword always follows my orders and reacts to my every word, but I have never met or spoken directly with the soul inside it."
Gang Zhishou nodded and then told Zhang Fei, "Just like us humans, a soul sword also has a soul space, but not everyone can enter it; only its owner can."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that. "Does that mean I just need to use our bond to enter its soul space?"
"Yes." Gang Zhishou then explained to Zhang Fei how to access his sword soul space.
Zhang Fei immediately sat cross-legged on the ground with the demon extermination sword in his lap, but he right away closed his eyes and released his soul.

Zhang Fei's soul entered the demon extermination sword soul space a while later, but the atmosphere inside confused him because it was divided into two areas: one bright and the other dark. "Don't tell me that my sword has two souls."

"You are right, Master." Zhang Fei immediately looked up and saw two women, about 17 years old, standing there. From their appearance, they were clearly twins, but they were the complete opposite of each other, more like the Amaris Twins. They had long black and white hair, respectively. "We are the souls of the demon extermination sword, and our father forged the sword."
"Your father?"
Both women nodded to Zhang Fei. "We died long ago, and our father couldn't accept our deaths, so he put our souls into the demon extermination sword."
"Why did he do that?" Zhang Fei asked with a frown. "If he really cared about you two, he should have let you guys die in peace, and you guys might have been reincarnated by now."

Both women exchanged glances for a moment before floating down in front of Zhang Fei. They immediately grabbed his hand and led him to another area, where a large rock was located right between the two areas. "Our father is not only the best blacksmith, but he is also one of the best soul cultivators in the universe. Unfortunately, he had too many enemies, and we were not at home when one of them came to our residence. When we returned, that person had killed all of our family, including our mother, grandparents, uncles, aunts, and cousins."
Zhang Fei's expression turned painful after hearing that, and he hugged the souls of the two women. "Then, how did you two die?"

"When we found them, their condition was really terrible, as that guy had cut their bodies into pieces and hung their heads in front of our residence." Zhang Fei immediately inhaled deeply. "Our father, deeply devastated by their deaths, was unaware that he was still hiding in our residence. He then captured us and used us to force him to hand over something to him, or he would kill us. Even though our father had handed it over to him, he still killed us before his eyes."
Zhang Fei then turned the souls of the two women to face him. "Who exactly is that person? Why did he slaughter your family? What item is he looking for?"
"We don't know anything about that item." Both women answered by shaking their heads. "That guy is a demon, and he's powerful."
"A demon?"

Both women then continued. "When we opened our eyes again, we found ourselves in this state, and our father was also in a serious condition. He told us that he would make a sword that could kill the demon, so he wanted to use our souls to strengthen it. We were angry because we were too weak and couldn't protect our family, so we agreed to his wishes."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Does that mean your father is still alive?"

"No." Both women shook their heads at Zhang Fei. "Our father realized he wouldn't live long due to his severe injuries, so he forced himself to forge the demon extermination sword, which he managed to complete in a few days. Before death came to him, he implanted our soul into it, and we've lived here ever since. After that, we entered hibernation and waited for the master of this sword, but its master never appeared for a very long time. We don't know who picked up the sword and gave it to you, but we are happy because you are the master, and we hope you can help us kill the demon so our father and family can die in peace."
Zhang Fei naturally wouldn't refuse, especially since the demon extermination sword was already a part of him. "Do you two know the identity of that demon?"
"Our father told us that the demon came from the Abyssal Realm, and his name was Xereth."

Zhang Fei instantly frowned because the Abyssal realm was Morgana's home realm. "You two and the demon extermination sword have helped me a lot, so I will help you two kill Xereth. However, I am still too weak now, and that guy is clearly much stronger than me. That's why I can't do it in the near future, and it will take a very long time, so I hope you two can be patient and wait for me to become strong."
"We understand, and we will continue to assist you in becoming stronger."
Zhang Fei then asked them. "So, what are your names?"
"My name is Jian Guang'an." The woman with white hair answered.
The black-haired woman also told Zhang Fei. "My name is Jian Hei'an."
"Jian Guang and Jian Hei'an, you two must know my name, right?" Both of them nodded at Zhang Fei. "Where is your home realm? What is your father's name?"
"Our father is Jian Shen, and we used to live in the Starry Sky Realm, one of the planets in the upper realms."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I will bring you two back to that realm someday, and we will visit your old residence. Anyway, are you two able to reform your bodies?"

"Before our father put our souls into this sword, he already told us that we would never be able to reincarnate or reform our bodies, so we will continue to live as the souls of this sword. If this sword is destroyed, then our souls will be gone forever."
Zhang Fei was deeply disappointed upon hearing that. "You two are part of the demon extermination sword, and the sword is part of me, so I will never let you all disappear."
"Yes." Both women then asked Zhang Fei. "Can you accompany us often, Master? We have lived here for a long time and have never met anyone, so we want you to accompany us."
"Sure! I'll come in here often to accompany you two, but I have to get out now, or Old Gang will worry about me."

After Zhang Fei disappeared, Jian Guang'an said to her sister, "I originally thought our master would never notice our existence, especially since he hasn't been a cultivator for long. However, he already has knowledge of the soul sword, and the old man told him how to get in here."

"I thought so too at first." Jian Hei'an replied with a nod. "Moreover, our master has always been serious and persistent in his cultivation and training, so I'm sure he will become strong very quickly, and he will definitely help us to take revenge on Xereth."

Jian Guang'an then whispered something to his sister. Jian Hei'an, without hesitation, agreed with her sister's idea. "We just need to wait for our master to come in here again, and we will discuss it with him directly."

"How did it go? Have you met your sword soul?" Zhang Fei nodded to Gang Zhishou and told him about the two souls of his swords, shocking him. "All this time, I only knew that a weapon could only possess a single soul, but your sword actually has two souls, which meant their father was a skilled blacksmith in the past. Unfortunately, he died long ago, so I couldn't meet him."

Zhang Fei then stood up and put the demon extermination sword back into his body. "Since their parents are dead, I have to find another way to perfect my sword. Unfortunately, I can't do anything right now, so I have to wait until I can go to the upper realms to perfect it. Anyway, all my wives have gathered at my restaurant, so I will meet them there and take them back to our residence. I will see you again once I have successfully forged a sword of the highest quality."
"All right, you can go now, and I will forge other equipment."

"Can you accompany us often, Master?
We have lived here for a long time and have never met anyone, so we want you to accompany us."
"Sure!
I'll come in here often to accompany you two, but I have to get out now, or Old Gang will worry about me."
After Zhang Fei disappeared, Jian Guang'an said to her sister, "I originally thought our master would never notice our existence, especially since he hasn't been a cultivator for long.
However, he already has knowledge of the soul sword, and the old man told him how to get in here."
"I thought so too at first." Jian Hei'an replied with a nod.

"Moreover, our master has always been serious and persistent in his cultivation and training, so I'm sure he will become strong very quickly, and he will definitely help us to take revenge on Xereth."
Jian Guang'an then whispered something to his sister.
Jian Hei'an, without hesitation, agreed with her sister's idea.
"We just need to wait for our master to come in here again, and we will discuss it with him directly."
"How did it go?
Have you met your sword soul?" Zhang Fei nodded to Gang Zhishou and told him about the two souls of his swords, shocking him.
"All this time, I only knew that a weapon could only possess a single soul, but your sword actually has two souls, which meant their father was a skilled blacksmith in the past.
Unfortunately, he died long ago, so I couldn't meet him."
Zhang Fei then stood up and put the demon extermination sword back into his body.
"Since their parents are dead, I have to find another way to perfect my sword.
Unfortunately, I can't do anything right now, so I have to wait until I can go to the upper realms to perfect it.
Anyway, all my wives have gathered at my restaurant, so I will meet them there and take them back to our residence.
I will see you again once I have successfully forged a sword of the highest quality."
"All right, you can go now, and I will forge other equipment."

chapters.title: Chapter 545 Meet Morgana And Feng Yao
paragraphs: (A/N: I changed Morlock to Xereth.)

As soon as he arrived at his restaurant, Zhang Fei immediately took all his wives who were in the capital back to their residence. He first sent Wang Zhetian, Dou Luotian, Wang Xiaofeng, and Wang Zhuxian back to earth at their request. After that, he took all his wives, including Mu Lingshu, into the training space for a week of seclusion.

Zhang Fei's first clone also immediately entered the training space to enter seclusion with all his partners, especially since he also wanted to test their skills at the Star Tower, particularly at the stone obelisk.

Meanwhile, Feltia [2] traveled to the Diyu Realm to meet Morgana, mainly because he wanted to know Xereth's background and his reasons for slaughtering the family of the forger of the demon extermination sword.
"Oh? I thought you wouldn't come back to this realm." Morgana uttered those words as soon as Feltia [2] appeared before her and Oz the First.
Feltia [2] immediately asked. "Do you know anything about Xereth?"
"Hmm?" Feltia [2]'s question surprised Morgana. "Where did you hear that name? Have you met him before?"
"No." Feltia [2] replied with a shake of his head. "I've only heard his name, but I've never met him. Who is he really?"

Morgana released a heavy sigh before telling him, "Xereth was a traitor to our realm, and he killed our fourth demon emperor. It happened about ten thousand years ago, and we haven't seen him since then. I don't know what really happened to him, but he was one of the senior demons in our realm. He was powerful, and our current demon emperor was not his match. His cultivation should have reached the divine ascension, so you should run away immediately if you meet him, or else you'll die at his hands."
"Ten thousand years ago, huh?" Feltia [2] muttered to himself as he thought that the demon extermination sword should be that old. "Why does he target humans?"

Morgana shook her head at him. "I only know that Xereth and the senior demons of his generation really hate humans, but they have never attacked them before. Moreover, he has been missing for too long, so I can't confirm the reason he attacked them."

"I see." Feltia [2] glanced at Oz the First for a moment, but he could see that he still hadn't regained his memories. "In that case, I'll go meet someone else, and he might know Xereth's reason for attacking humans."
After Feltia [2] disappeared, Oz the First immediately asked his wife, "Is Xereth really that strong?"

"Yes." Morgana nodded to her husband. "Not only Xereth, but the five demons of his generation are also powerful. However, they are different from him, and they are completely loyal to our demon emperor's lineage."
"If their strength is not inferior to his, why didn't they stop Xereth from killing the fourth demon emperor?"

Morgana shrugged in response. "They are too old for me to understand their way of thinking. However, they have sworn to protect our current demon emperor, and they will do anything to do so, including sacrificing their lives. Anyway, you don't need to think about that guy, and you should focus on getting your memories back. Once you get them back, I'll help you open the lock on that soul."
"Yeah, you're right."
Meanwhile, Feltia [2] had already arrived at the central region of the Sky Jade Realm, and he immediately contacted Feng Yao.

A while later, Feng Yao had already arrived in front of him, and Feltia [2] immediately asked her about Xereth. "I don't know where you heard about him, but you must be careful of him and run away if you meet him."
"What exactly is his reason for slaughtering humans?"

"I don't know Xereth's reasons, but my parents said that he was someone's puppet." Feltia [2] raised an eyebrow at Feng Yao's response. "He once tried to invade my Phoenix realm, but he was no match for my parents and our race members, and they managed to injure him heavily. However, they did not know the identity of the person behind him, and they suspected that the person was a cultivator from higher realms, especially since he also tried to attack the other realms, including the Heavenly Moon Realm."
"Higher realms?"

Feng Yao nodded to Feltia [2]. "According to my father, there are other realms beyond the upper realms, but we don't have much information about them yet. We can't go there using flying artifacts like we usually do in the lower, middle, and upper realms. He guessed that the only way to get there was to transcend the seven divine realms, but no one has ever managed to do so, and the highest cultivation in the upper realms currently only reaches the 2-Moon Divine Ascension Realm."
"I see." Feltia [2] nodded in understanding before asking again. "Do you know anything about the Starry Sky Realm?"

"Yes." Feng Yao immediately told him. "The Starry Sky Realm used to be a gathering place for the best blacksmiths in this universe, but they abandoned that realm and moved to the Xianjin Realm. No humans lived there anymore, and it was filled with beasts of various types. Some mythical beasts, such as dragons, vermilion birds, and others, founded their branch clans there."
Feltia [2] was interested in going to the Starry Sky Realm after hearing that, but he immediately threw away the idea because his abilities were not yet sufficient to go there.
"So, how's your life in the Nine Stars Realm? Have you caused any trouble there?"

"Do you think I like to cause trouble?" Feltia [2] then told Feng Yao. "Your guess is right; I've encountered some troubles in that realm. A representative from the Alchemy Union is targeting Lingxue, and it was my fault because I didn't know anything about that organization. I purchased quite a lot of herbs from their shop, and many of them were high-ranking. The shop owner wanted her to join his organization, but I refused him. That's why he sent two guards from that organization, but I've already dealt with them, and they're on my side now. However, I'm sure that he won't stop, and he might send more people to disturb us."

Feng Yao was not too surprised by this. "The Alchemy Union is indeed arrogant, and they control the alchemy market in the entire middle realms. Their leader is too confident and overconfident about his abilities. He once tried to expand his organization to the upper realms, but the alchemists there beat him so badly that he didn't dare to set foot there again. Anyway, people from my realm will be arriving here in two weeks, so you need to bring Zhang Yue back by then."

"All right, I will bring my big sister here in two weeks." After that, Feltia [2] immediately returned to the Nine Stars Realm and went to the Xian Imperial Sect, especially since Zhang Fei had already said that he would spend a week there to consolidate their teamwork before going to the Star Realm.

Immediately after Feltia [2] left, Feng Yao took out her interspatial communication device and contacted someone to go to the Alchemist Union headquarters. "That old bastard, how dare he target my sister? I must teach him a lesson for that, or else he will continue to be arrogant."
Inside the inn, a middle-aged man kneeled on one knee in front of Huangfu Lian. "How did it go, Huangfu Bo? Did you manage to find that brat's residence?"

"I couldn't find his residence, first prince." Huangfu Lian immediately frowned, so Huangfu Bo hurriedly explained everything to him. "If my guess is right, that brat has the space element, or else he wouldn't have been able to disappear just like that."
"What about all the women in the restaurant? Are they still there?"

"Yes." Huangfu Bo answered with a nod. "They live in that restaurant, but Old Wen keeps protecting them. We can't do anything about them, or we'll face the Xian royal family. Prince, your father contacted me after learning that Chao Yuanfeng planned to send all his disciples, including Xian Xianwu and Xian Xianqin, to the Star Tower. That's why he asked you to come back today, and he wants you to lead our people to that tower to do something about them."

Huangfu Lian didn't care about Xian Xianwu or Chao Yuanfeng's other male disciples, but he was eager to get Xian Xianqin and his other female disciples. "All right, we will return to our kingdom right now, and I will bring our best people to capture that princess and her friends."

"Prince." Huangfu Lian immediately turned to his two women. "Since you want to go to the tower, and our strength is not enough to challenge it, Qingying and I will return to our sect. After you return, we will accompany you again."

Huangfu Lian nodded to them and retrieved his returning jade. He then looked at Huang Bo, who also immediately took out his jade. The moment they crushed it, the two of them vanished from the room, leaving the two women feeling relieved.
"So, how should we look for that guy?"

"Isn't that easy?" Gu Hanshuang then lay down on the bed. "He owns that restaurant; we can look for him there. However, it's already nighttime, so we should rest first before meeting him tomorrow morning."
Dan Qingying nodded in agreement and lay down beside her friend. "What do you think is his reason for doing such things to us? We don't even know each other, so I feel strange about that."
"I don't know, and we'll find out when we see him tomorrow."

Meanwhile, Feltia [2] had already arrived at the Xian Imperial Sect, where he was engaged in conversation with Chao Yuanfeng's male disciples, including Xian Xianwu. They explained the survival challenge test to him, especially since the tests they had faced in the past were different. "Does that mean we will face a different test?"

"That might happen." Xian Xianwu replied with a nod. "The purpose of the survival challenge is to reach the deepest area before time runs out, but we also need to overcome all the obstacles that hinder us in each area. The most challenging obstacle is the riddle, as it presents numerous random questions that are difficult to understand. If one of us fails, then the whole team will fail."
Feltia [2] nodded in understanding. "Can we help the others solve their riddles?"

"We can do it, but we must first solve our riddles, which is difficult." Ying Shanhu then pointed to a male disciple. "Yu Chongming is the smartest among us, but he always has difficulty solving his riddles, so we can't expect too much help from others, and we have to try hard to solve our riddles ourselves."

Yu Chongming immediately looked at Feltia [2] and told him about the most problematic riddle he ever got. "It took me a whole week to solve it, but we failed because Hang Chi couldn't solve his riddle."
"Haha." Huang Chi laughed as he rubbed his head. "Brother Yu, I tried hard to solve my riddle back then, but I couldn't figure it out at all."

Yu Chongming shakes his head. "If only you read more literature about cultivation, you should be able to solve such an easy riddle. Unfortunately, you are too lazy, and you think that muscles are better than the mind."

"Hahaha!" Another male disciple suddenly laughed out loud. "Brother Yu, your words are sharp as usual, but I support you that Brother Huang places too much importance on his muscles over his brain, so he is the stupidest among us."

Huang Chi folded his forehead before shouting at him. "Hey, Xuan Wuji! I won't help you if we meet those powerful beast hordes again! I'm not as smart as you or Brother Yu, but I'm still stronger than you. If I didn't help deal with them back then, we would have failed from the start!"
Xuan Wuji immediately covered his mouth as he glanced at his other sect brothers, but all of them shook their heads in response, including Ximen Chuixue. 'Tch! They're not loyal friends!'

Another male disciple named Xi Shen suddenly spoke to them. "All right, we should take a rest now, and we will focus on strengthening our cooperation in the next week. Since Zhang Fei is our new member, we should help him integrate with our group, and I hope we can pass the first floor this time."

All of them, with the exception of Ximen Chuixue, agreed with Xi Shen and hurried back to their respective rooms. He then asked Feltia [2] to go with him before asking. "Do you have any questions for me? Previously, you looked at me with a strange gaze, so I thought you had questions for me."
"Why did you join this sect?" Feltia [2]'s question confused Ximen Chuixue. "You might be able to hide it from Senior Yuanfeng and the others, but I can tell your true identity."

Ximen Chuixue shook his head at Feltia [2]. "You are a little wrong about that, especially since I did not hide my identity from my master. Instead, he brought me into this sect, and he helped me hide my identity from them. He found me nearly dead when I was still very young, but he saved me and brought me here. Since then, I've been living in this sect, and he taught me about cultivation."
"Oh?" Feltia [2] was surprised by Ximen Chuixue's confession.

"You are right. I am a demon, and I am part of the Ximen Clan. However, I am no longer part of them, and I live for myself. In fact, I want to kill Ximen Gongfu and Ximen Changtian, especially since they were the cause of my parents' deaths." Ximen Chuixue then faced Feltia [2]. "How did you find out my identity? I have lived in this sect for decades, but no one has been able to find out my identity, including Emperor Xian."

"I can distinguish each person's Qi, so I can tell your darkness element, no matter how well you hide it." Ximen Chuixue raised his eyebrows in disbelief. "There are indeed many humans born with the darkness element, but theirs is different from the demon, so I immediately knew that you were a demon."

"You're a terrible young man, don't you realize?" Ximen Chuixue sighed softly. "Even though I'm a demon, I really like them. I've treated them as my real brothers and sisters, and I don't want to lose them, so I hope you'll keep my secret to yourself."
Feltia [2] nodded to him. "Does anyone else know your identity?"

"Yuan Luo has long known that I am a demon." Ximen Chuixue sighed softly before continuing. "I am a moon demon, and I will return to my true form during the full moon. Back then, she accidentally saw me transform into my demon form, and she was frightened by me. However, we both loved each other, so she slowly tried to accept my true identity. Unfortunately, our relationship is still stuck at this stage, and we don't dare to take any further steps, especially since her parents may not be able to accept my identity. Do you hate demons?"

"Why should I hate demons?" Feltia [2] asked back. "Not all demons are evil, and I know many good demons. Just like other living beings, many demons merely want a peaceful life for their races. However, due to past events, other living beings have come to hate them and have always regarded them as evil creatures."

Ximen Chuixue nodded to him. "I only want to have a peaceful life, but people will hate me once they know my identity and immediately hunt me down. That's why I haven't thought about going further with Yuan Luo. Otherwise, she would be forced to share their hatred towards me, and I don't want her to go through that."
"Well-"
"Zhang Fei." They immediately turned to the woman, and they saw Bai Tian'er walking towards them, so Ximen Chuixue swiftly left Feltia [2]. "Can I talk to you?"

paragraphs: Meanwhile, Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua were standing behind a middle-aged man, Yun Yishan, the sect master of the Yun Imperial Sect, who was giving instructions to dozens of disciples.

Although he was the Emperor of the Yun Kingdom, Yun Shang was never directly involved in the affairs of the Yun Imperial Sect; instead, Yun Yishan handled all matters. "I understand that many of you are eager to pass all the first-floor tests, but I urge you not to push yourself too hard, as you are the future of this sect and kingdom. All of you are still very young, and your chances of challenging the Star Tower are still very long, so you guys must know when to advance and when to retreat, or else you will all face the repercussions of the backlash of your failures, which will be detrimental to yourselves. Do you all understand?"
"Yes, Sect Master Yun!" All the disciples answered in unison.

"You'll lead them to the Star Tower, but you must stay vigilant to protect them, especially since the other three kingdoms will send their people there." The elders nodded to Yun Yishan. "Huangfu Shou has openly shown his intention to annex our kingdom, so I'm sure he will order his sons or daughters to do something against Yun Qihong and Yun Xinyue, and he might also send some of his aides to smooth his plans. If that happens, you guys must use all means to save them, including your lives."
"Leave it to us, Sect Master. We will definitely protect our prince and princess well." All the elders answered with solemn nods.
Yun Yishan nodded slightly before turning to Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua, who immediately moved in front of their children, Yun Qihong and Yun Xinyue.

Yun Qinghao's face was similar to Yun Shang's, and his appearance was similar to that of a scholar, just like his father. His figure was quite tall and slender, and he wore plain white clothes embroidered with clouds.

Yun Xinyue's face is more of a combination of Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua. She wore a long white dress and a light blue silk belt around her waist, showcasing her perfectly curved body. She was like a clean white sheet of paper. Even without any makeup, her beauty doesn't have a single flaw. Her long black hair was silky smooth, falling to her shoulder. She had eyes as clear as the purest water, perfect upcurved lips, and one of the biggest chests among the female disciples.

Gu Xuehua spoke directly to her children, but she talked to them via voice transmission. 'Once you two arrive at the Star Tower, I want you to join Xianwu and Xianqin. I believe you two will be safe by their side, especially with Zhang Fei by their side.'
'Zhang Fei?' Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue exchanged confused glances, as they had never heard of him. 'Who is he, Mother?'

Gu Xuehua immediately touched their foreheads and shared Zhang Fei's description, which surprised them due to his young age. 'Your father and I have only met him once, but I can assure you that he is no ordinary cultivator, and he can protect you both. Even Brother Feng and Sister Qingzhuang have high confidence in him, and they want to draw him to their side.'

'Your mother is right.' Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue immediately looked at their father. 'Although Zhang Fei's cultivation is still at the 1-Star Earth Realm, his raw strength has already surpassed many cultivators, and he can even knock Brother Feng back with a single punch. His cultivation is far below the two of you, but he has mastered the laws of light, wind, and fire elements. His speed is even more remarkable; even if I use my best speed, I still won't be able to catch up with him. That's why you shouldn't doubt him, and you will be safe as long as you can build a good relationship with him.'

Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue were stunned for a long time after listening to their father, but they knew that he rarely praised others, so they chose to believe him. 'All right, we will follow your instructions, and we will try to build a good relationship with Zhang Fei.'

Yun Shang and Gu Xuehua nodded in satisfaction with the answer. "You all can depart now, and you just need to try your best. You shouldn't feel disheartened if you fail this time, and you should work harder to challenge the tower in the future."
"Yes, Emperor!"
After that, the elders immediately led them to leave the Yun Imperial Sect using a large flying artifact, and all of them looked impatient to challenge the tower.

"What do you think will happen in the tower, Second Brother and sister-in-law? Do you think Huangfu Shou will order his children to do something to them openly?" Yun Yishan suddenly asked Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua.

"Yes." Yun Shang nodded to his little brother. "Unlike us, Huangfu Shou is a maniac, and he will not hesitate to sacrifice anyone to fulfill his sky-high ambitions, including sacrificing his children. He probably told them to attack my and brother Feng's children, but I don't know which ones will go to the tower."

"I think he will send Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Xiaofan, especially since Huang Xiaogang is more focused on military affairs." Both men nodded in agreement with Guo Xuehua. "However, he might also send his other children, especially since he is growing impatient to take over our kingdom and the Xian Kingdom."
"Have you ordered those old folks to protect Qihong and Xinyue from behind, Second Brother?"

Once again, Yun Shang nodded to his little brother. "Two of them have been in the Star Tower for the past few days, and I asked them to make sure that the situation there is safe before our children arrive there. The other two will follow behind their entourage, and I asked them to bring them back immediately if there are any changes in the situation there."

"I see." Yun Yishan was slightly relieved after hearing that. "However, the situation might get complicated because the Bai Kingdom is on Huangfu Shou's side now, and Bai Yaowei will definitely order his children to help them. Moreover, Zhou Xiaochuan's relationship with the two demon kingdoms is also worrying, and I'm afraid the situation in the tower will become even more chaotic this time."

Yun Shang exhaled heavily in response to that. "I'm not overly concerned about the demons under Ximen Changtian, but the demons under Ximen Gongfu pose a significant threat and could potentially cause chaos in the tower. However, the kingdoms of the beasts and natural races will also send their representatives to the tower. I'm sure they won't dare to act openly with their presence, but we can't underestimate their emperor's ambition, especially since we can't predict his plot."

"Don't worry, I'm sure our children will be safe." Guo Xuehua expressed this while embracing her husband's arm. "The seniors of my Guo Clan have also moved to the Star Tower, and I ask them to focus on protecting our children."
"Brother, we will return to the royal palace now." Yun Shang said to his little brother, and he immediately took his wife away from the sect.
Not long after the group from the Yu Kingdom departed, several flying artifacts also left the Bai and Zhou kingdoms, and their destination was the Star Tower.

Meanwhile, in the Beast Kingdom, Long Huang and Long Baiyun stood side by side above their palace, looking at several flying artifacts that were rapidly flying away from their kingdom. Unlike the Yun and Xian Emperors, neither of them looked worried in the slightest, and they fully believed that their children would be fine in the Star Tower.
"What did you previously say to our two sons?" Long Baiyun suddenly asked her husband.
"Haha." Long Huang laughed before telling her. "I asked Chen'er and Tian'er to test that kid's abilities, and I asked them to use all their abilities in doing so."
"Hmm?" Long Baiyun raised his eyebrows. "Aren't you afraid that kid will die at the hands of our sons?"

"You underestimate that kid too much, wife." Long Huang replied with a shake of his head. "Chen'er's cultivation has reached 3-Moon Divine Transcend, and Tian'er's has reached 1-Moon Divine Transcend. However, they may not be able to defeat him, especially since he has four elements and he has mastered the laws of three of them. Moreover, a heavenly fox has an innate ability, which is related to the space element. I believe it will not be easy for them to defeat him, let alone kill him."

Long Baiyun let out a soft sigh and looked far away. "Do you think those demons will target our sons? Ximen Changtian may not do anything, but I'm sure Ximen Gongfu has already sent the demons under him to the tower, and he may have ordered them to capture our sons."

"Heh!" Long Huang snorted coldly. "If that guy dares to send the demons under him to attack our sons, I will go straight to the dark demon kingdom, and I will teach Ximen Gongfu a severe lesson that he will never forget for the rest of his life. However, I believe he will not do that, and his target should be the children of those humans, so you don't have to worry about our sons. Not to mention, Xiao Lianghua also sent many members of the natural races there, and those heretics will not dare to move openly."
"I hope you're right about that." Long Baiyun replied with a slight nod.

At the top of a tall and large tree, several people from different races stood side by side while looking at flying artifacts speeding toward the center of their realm, where the Star Tower was located.

In front of them, a man with an appearance of about 30 years old stood straight with both hands behind him, and his long black hair kept dancing in the wind. Even though his expression looked serious, a calming and cool aura radiated from his body. Black and red clothes cover his tall figure, his slanted eyes feature two green pupils, and his ears point at the tips.

At the man's side stood a woman around 25 years old with long bluish-white hair and skin as white as snow. She had a charming oval face and an elegant appearance in a light blue silk dress with white sleeves. Her light blue eyes were as clear as crystals, her ears looked attractive with pointed tips, and her heart-shaped lips were covered in a red rose color.
"Will they all be okay, Lianghua?" The woman asked in a melodic tone.

"Yes." Xian Lianghua, the Emperor of the Natural Races, nodded in response. "I know you are worried about them, Xue Jingling. I have provided them with various artifacts, some of which are capable of detecting the presence of those demons. I also sent the strongest elders to protect them, so I'm sure those heretics wouldn't be able to do anything to our people. The tower will be more chaotic than usual, and I expect a big battle between humans and demons, but I've told them not to interfere in their affairs."

"Our realm will never be peaceful as long as those demons exist, but we can't get rid of them, especially since most are strong." Xue Jingling then turned to the east. "Those humans, particularly Huangfu Shou, are no different from them, and his ambition to dominate others is truly frightening. He even succeeded in taking over the Bai Kingdom without the other emperors knowing, and he will probably succeed in taking over the Xian and Yun kingdoms soon. Regarding the Zhou kingdom, the true intentions of Zhou Xiaochuan remain unclear, but it's possible that he is already under the influence of demons."

"Just let the humans mind their own business, and we don't need to interfere in their affairs." Xian Linghua's expression suddenly turned serious. "We natural races are a peace-loving race, but I will not remain silent if they threaten our safety. If they dare to attack our kingdom, I will immediately lead the others to wipe out their kingdoms, and we will drive them out of our realm."

After Xian Linghua's statement, the people behind him appeared excited. However, a short and stocky man suddenly asked him a few questions. "Emperor, what are we going to do with those foreigners? Are we going to let them live in our kingdom? They appear to be planning to open a shop in Lunaris Town, but I've instructed my people to stop them."

"Ren Zhu, they are indeed foreigners, but they are still natural races like us, so you don't need to stop them and let them set up their shop." Xian Linghua then looked towards the southeast. "Moreover, their leader is quite interesting, and I can't wait for him to come to our kingdom."
"Emperor, please forgive me if I am being presumptuous, but who exactly is their leader? What is his reason for sending them to our kingdom?" A young woman with long red hair asked.
Xian Lianghua gave a faint smile before sharing the information with them. "Their leader is actually a human, and he is still very young, around 20 years old."
"What?" The people behind him screamed in shock. "Then, we must-"

"No need." Xian Lianghua interrupted them with a shake of his head. "That kid is indeed a human, but he is also a beast and a demon. That's why I can't wait for his arrival, and I believe that he will be the key to bringing peace to our realm."
"A human, a beast, a beast? How is that possible, Emperor?"
Xian Lianghua released a soft sigh before answering them. "I don't know how he can have three forms at once, and his beast form is not an ordinary beast but a heavenly fox."
"A heavenly fox?"

"Yes." Xian Lianghua then told them about something. "According to the legend, there was a fox with ten tails that lived in ancient times, and the heavenly fox was his direct descendant. The ten-tailed fox is the protector of the natural races, and he has helped our races from all realms a lot. That's why I'm not surprised if those foreigners are willing to obey him, and they are clearly loyal to him."
"Is the ten-tailed fox still alive, Emperor? So far, I have only met the nine-tailed fox, but I have never met the ten-tailed one."

"The ten-tailed fox died long ago, Shu Yao." The red-haired woman and the others looked shocked by Xian Lianghua's answer. "He is actually very strong, and his strength is equal to or even exceeds that of other mythical beasts. However, he suddenly disappeared, and no one knows how he died. After his death, a new fox race emerged, which is the heavenly fox race. Currently, they live on one of the planets in the upper realm, which is the Heavenly Moon Realm."
"The upper realms?" They were even more shocked after hearing that. "If they live in the upper realms, then why did he come to this realm? Isn't that a loss for him?"

"Haha." Xian Lianghua laughed. "Lei Ting, that kid didn't come from the upper realms but the lower realms, so it's not surprising that he came to this realm, especially since our realm is in the lower realms. Anyway, you guys don't need to worry about him. We'll find out everything when he visits our kingdom, but I don't think that will happen anytime soon, so we'll have to wait for him."
After that, they immediately dispersed and returned to their respective places, but Xian Lianghua and Xue Jingling remained there. "What do you think was his purpose in coming to our realm, husband?"

"I don't know." Xian Linghua turned toward Cyanwood Mountain. "He has four elements, so I suspect that the reason he came to our realm was the item on the mountain peak, but it is not a trivial matter to go there. Even Lei Ting, with her high understanding of the lightning law, cannot get close to it. He will only die horribly if he forces himself to go there, so I will never allow him to go there."
Xue Jingling nodded in agreement with her husband. "My cultivation is becoming increasingly unstable, and I think I will break through to 5-Moon soon."
"Let's go back now, and I'll help you to break through."

chapters.title: Chapter 548 Ximen Changtian
paragraphs: "Emperor!" A male demon shouted as he walked into the dim throne room. "I just received news that your brother sent his subordinates to the Star Tower to help Zhou Xiaochuan's children, and their numbers are not small."

On the throne, a middle-aged man with red hair down to his back stared at the male demon with his narrow red eyes. A black mask covered half of his face, and a black grand robe covered his entire body. Behind him, a large sword with a blade as red as blood floated by itself.
The middle-aged man is Ximen Changtian, the Emperor of the Ximen Kingdom. "Do you think Gongfu intends to have a big war with those humans, Mo Tian?"
"I'm not sure about his intentions, Emperor." Mo Tian answered by shaking his head. "However, he sent some bloodthirsty demons there, and he also sent those former humans with them."

"I see." Ximen Changtian nodded in understanding before giving the order. "Go to Hongwu's place and order him to lead some demons to the tower, but tell him not to clash directly with humans, let alone those beasts and natural races. His main task is to complete the challenges on the first floor, or I will lock him up again if he fails to get past them."

"Yes, Emperor." Mo Tian then asked. "Are you also going to send Princess Ximen Yueliang there? Her cultivation has just broken through to the 1-Moon Divine Transcend, so she should be ready to challenge the tower."

Ximen Changtian thought for a moment before agreeing. "All right, go to my daughter and ask her to go to the tower. I want you to order those two old demons to accompany her. If something terrible happens to my daughter, I'll execute them."

Quickly, all the flying artifacts landed outside the barrier protecting the Star Tower, and the elders of each group immediately led their members to descend.

Without wasting any time, the elders immediately took out their respective tokens and led them into the Star Tower area through several holes opened in the barrier.

paragraphs: Like his father, Long Tian and Long Chen have blue hair, one shoulder-length and the other back-length. They also have two blue horns on their heads and two dragon wings on their backs. As they walked towards the stone obelisk, they kept their eyes on Zhang Fei. Despite his low cultivation, they did not underestimate him, especially since their father praised him so much, something Long Huang almost never did.
"Big brother, that guy is not bad, and he seems to be aware of our actions." Long Tian spoke as his eyes glanced at Zhang Fei.

Long Chen nodded in agreement with that, but he raised his eyebrows when he noticed many eyes were on Zhang Fei. "I don't know what's going on, but many people seem to be targeting him, especially people from the Huangfu and Bai Kingdoms. Look at them; Huangfu Lian and Huangfu Xiaofan looked like they wanted to swallow him alive, and their two sisters were no different from them."

After hearing that, Long Tian briefly looked at the four people from the Huangfu Kingdom before shifting his gaze to the three people from the Bai Kingdom. He could see that their gazes were also focused on Zhang Fei.

"It seems true that the Bai Kingdom is the Huangfu Kingdom's lackey, especially since they also seem to be targeting him." Long Chen agreed with his little brother. "Are we going to help him deal with them, Big Brother?"

"No need." Long Chen immediately rejected his little brother's idea. "Do you see any fear on Zhang Fei's face? Despite his low cultivation, he doesn't seem to be the least bit pressured by these people's presence, so there's no need for us to do anything to help him. Moreover, our father thinks highly of him, so I want to see the ability behind his confidence. Unfortunately, we won't have the chance to fight him, especially since those guys will make a move against him soon."
"Yeah." Long Tian then looked back at their group and asked them to speed up their journey, especially since he couldn't wait to take on those challenges.
"Hey, Big Brother! Where did you meet that guy? What's so special about him?" Huangfu Xiaofan questioned Huangfu Lian while he glanced at Zhang Fei.

"I first met him at the artifact shop in the Xian Kingdom, and I initially thought that he was just a brat with no status. He opened a restaurant there, and Xian Feng's aides kept protecting him, so I reported it to our father. Huangfu Lian then looked at Zhang Fei's group. "Moreover, he is close to Xian Xianqin and Xian Xianwu, so we must capture him if we fail to capture those two."

Huangfu Xiaofan nodded slightly in response. "Chao Yuanfeng is clearly focusing his attention on them, and I'm sure Xian Feng's aides are hiding around here to protect his children, so it will be difficult for us to capture them."

"Our best option to capture them is when we undergo tests from the maze and survival challenges, especially since those people won't be able to protect them." Huangfu Lian then turned to his two sisters. "Xiaomei! Xiaoying! I know our father ordered you two to capture Yun Qinghao and Yun Xinyue, but I want you to focus more on capturing Zhang Fei. Since Xian Feng is so protective of him, I'm sure he possesses certain qualities that pique his interest, making him more valuable than those two."

"We know." Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying had already set their sights on Zhang Fei without Huangfu Lian having to ask them. First, his cultivation was far below theirs, yet he could act calmly among so many powerful cultivators, indicating that he was indeed not an ordinary cultivator. Second, his good looks attract their attention, and they will use any means to get him.

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "I may have a way to bring her back to you, but we must proceed with caution and focus on our tests first."
